4835610.desc: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.

5293210.name: ROGRID
5293210.desc: 當踩地雷遇上Roguelike。根據線索推理隱藏的格子，在怪物與陷阱之間尋找寶藏。搭配職業、技能與神器，用自己的策略突破地城。

movies.name: ROGRID — Gameplay Trailer 2026 (zh-TW · 繁體中文)
ROGRID — Gameplay Trailer (zh-TW · 繁體中文)

5308440.name: Tiny Desktop Fishing
5308440.desc: 《微型桌面钓鱼》是一款轻松治愈的像素风桌宠钓鱼小游戏。在秋日田园的湖畔，开启悠闲垂钓时光。你可以随时打开桌面，抛竿、等鱼咬钩，收集各式各样的小鱼，享受不被打扰的慢节奏休闲体验。无需重度操作，随时开玩，适合碎片化时间放松。

5359760.name: The Harbour Between Us
5359760.desc: 一款免費的溫馨桌面釣魚遊戲，訴說小小港灣裡一段從未老去的愛情。釣魚、逛黃昏市集、摸摸貓咪，再循著未曾寄出的情書，幫助兩位年邁的戀人重新相聚。

4714620.name: Dynamite Blue
4714620.desc: 以角色與劇情為核心的2.5D回合制RPG。在天空、街道與暗影交織的賽博龐克都市維爾海文，與60多名各懷故事的英雄同行。《Exos Heroes》原班團隊新作。

top.text: AI art, english translation is close to gibberish, there's no option menu to change the game to fullscreen mode or reduce volume. Combat is super simple with only basic attack and skill as options.

5340080.name: CHAMBER: ATOM BREAKER INC
5340080.desc: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

4206250.name: 高山之旅
4206250.desc: 高山，慢慢爬。和登山小貓一起，走向七大洲的 150 座真實山峰。挑選路線、備好補給，照顧沿途的體力與心情，登上山頂，再平安歸來。翻開動物圖鑑，發現山友留下的藏寶，或把旅程留在桌面一角，讓小貓陪你度過日常。

5328220.name: Mall Corp
5328220.desc: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

4668060.name: Reshine Demo
4668060.desc: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

5197920.name: 概率工坊 Demo
5197920.desc: 《機率工坊》是一款以彩券為題材的經營模擬遊戲：你不是下注的人，而是制定規則的人。從零設計一個彩種——號碼怎麼選、票價訂多少、設幾個獎級、獎金如何分配，把每一期收入分進獎池、加盟商佣金、公益金與利潤，每一個決定都由你做出。然後讓它運轉 60 期：銷量隨規則起伏，加盟商隨市場前景與實際收益來去，而彩迷們的人生，會因中獎或一次次「差一點」走向截然不同的方向。試玩版提供完整 60 期經營週期，期末可檢視經營總結與城市帳本；規則由你制定，機率從不說謊。

5359970.name: 爪爪谋略 Demo
5359970.desc: Paw and Plot is a lighthearted, hex-based turn-based strategy game. Players follow Latte, a kitten separated from his family, who meets Cantheon—a fallen feline deity hunted by wild cats. By helping Cantheon regain his power, Latte embarks on an adventure to reunite with his family.

4621970.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
4621970.desc: 帶領英雄小隊穿梭於無盡的地下城循環之中。在這款不斷成長的漸進式（Incremental）冒險遊戲中，收集戰利品、解鎖永久升級，並在邁向更深層地下城的過程中建立強大的協同效應。

4693350.name: I can offer your Flowers Demo
4693350.desc: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist !

5404520.name: Dragon Heist Demo
5404520.desc: A co-op heist game for up to 4 players: sneak into a sleeping dragon's lair, loot its gold, steal its egg and escape through the portal together, without making a sound.

4331890.name: GetHigh.EXE
4331890.desc: 在跑酷障礙賽道上奔跑跳躍，一路攀登至山頂，掌握精準且節奏明快的街機式挑戰。

6850.name: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
6850.desc: Enter the realm of a retired assassin, forced back into action by treason. You may be a hired killer but you still have a sense of loyalty and justice. Visit the dark recesses of a world corrupted by crime, greed, degradation and dishonor. And a past that catches up with you.

6860.name: Hitman: Blood Money
6860.desc: Money Talks. Silence Pays. Prepare to Make a Killing. When assassins from Agent 47's contract agency, The ICA, are eliminated in a series of hits, it seems a larger, more powerful agency has entered the fray. Sensing he may be a target, 47 travels to America, and prepares to make a killing.

628800.name: Super Hydorah
628800.desc: 超級宇宙巡航機是非線性的水準射擊，旨在提供具有挑戰性的體驗， 在經典元素的基礎上增加智慧性和豐富性。 無論是獨自還是和你的朋友一起， 面對Meroptians登陸蘭斯三角洲的的威脅，都是緊張而愉悅的時光。

613470.name: The Inner World - The Last Wind Monk
613470.desc: The flute nose dynasty has been watching over Asposia for centuries on end. In secret, they fill the roly-poly world with light and life. Emil, a trader for odds and ends, has led all the Asposians astray, making them believe that the dynasty is in cahoots with dark forces.

movies.name: The Inner World: The Last Wind Monk - Out Now
The Inner World: The Last Wind Monk - Teaser

compare.en: The Inner World - The Last Wind Monk

274520.name: 陰暗森林 Darkwood
274520.desc: 《陰暗森林》—以全新視角詮釋生存恐怖。白天，在內容豐富、瞬息萬變的開放世界中探索並搜刮資源；夜晚，躲進藏身處設法死守，祈禱黎明盡速到來。

244160.name: Homeworld Remastered Collection
244160.desc: Experience the epic space strategy games that redefined the RTS genre. Control your fleet and build an armada across more than 30 single-player missions. Choose unit types, fleet formations and flight tactics for each strategic situation.

2103680.name: Mediterranea Inferno
2103680.desc: Explore the inner demons of three childhood friends on a summer retreat. Unearth secrets, fears and obsessions as you help them reconnect and rediscover themselves. A mature and treacherous visual novel from the creator of Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.

284160.name: BeamNG.drive
284160.desc: 一款能執行任何操作的動態軟體物理效果車輛模擬器。

4889610.name: Ice Cream Hero
4889610.desc: Ice Cream Hero is a sweet tower defense challenge for one to four players. Team up with friends or play solo as Nilla, a brave little ice cream hero defending his land’s precious Sprinkle Bank from hungry silverware, chaotic waves, and big bad bosses.

5255590.name: Parry X Break
5255590.desc: Designed for high replay value and quick restarts, Parry X Break is a fast paced spin on the brick breaker genre where the ball goes faster every time you parry it. Parrying speeds up the ball, raises your point multiplier, and levels up your ball so you can break locked bricks.

5296420.name: GemLoop
5296420.desc: GemLoop is a match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.

4381180.name: Coin Harvest
4381180.desc: 機械臂把源源不絕傾瀉到高台上的硬幣掃下邊緣。解鎖島嶼、征服六個領域、飛升收集水晶，這款放置遊戲會在你工作或玩遊戲時待在桌面上。

top.text: Chilling game

5356880.name: FORGEFIELD
5356880.desc: Live wallpapers and screensavers for Windows, featuring nine animated worlds rendered in real time. Explore black holes, auroras and glowing embers. Choose a world, adjust its visual settings, and enjoy it on your desktop or in fullscreen.

5208900.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
5208900.desc: Run a sports agency, not a team. Recruit stars across four leagues, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, survive scandals and holdouts, then retire to an interactive career review and post your score to the monthly global leaderboard. Premium, no microtransactions.

movies.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire — Launch Trailer

4769150.name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
4769150.desc: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

4633060.name: Pareidolia
4633060.desc: Confront the games your own mind plays on you deep within a remote forest. Step out of your tent, set up your cameras, and gather clues. Remember: those silhouettes you see in the shadows might not just be your paranoia. The darkest corner of your mind is your deadliest enemy.

2641800.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
2641800.desc: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

movies.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts trailer

5286740.name: AimZen
5286740.desc: AimZen is a minimalist first-person aim trainer with stackable hotkey-activated modifiers, built to sharpen precision, reaction speed, and muscle memory.

5332060.name: It'll Hold
5332060.desc: Play poker hands to build a tower of cards, one floor at a time. Each hand lays a floor piece on the plot. Stack matching suits straight up to grow your multiplier, beat every floor's target and hire a crew on your coffee break. Miss a target and the lot comes down.

4185740.name: アオノアーティファクト+
4185740.desc: "Blue Artifact" is a side-scrolling action game where Fran, a girl awakened deep underground in a research facility, uses magic to escape. Collect “treasures” within the facility to uncover the secrets of the research lab.

movies.name: アオノアーティファクト+Official Trailer

3536520.name: Warding Witches
3536520.desc: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

top.text:
Great so far!  I’ve only played Arcade-Apprentice as of now.  The apprentice mode feels great to get some familiarity with the game and the stages.  Doesn’t feel too easy like some novice modes tend to be.  

Also the mu

A fun and accessible bullet hell with unique characters, satisfying upgrades, and plenty of replay value. The Story Mode is great for newcomers, while the co-op adds another layer of fun. Some stages become repetitive an

I'm not good with bullet hell games but it felt nicely balanced, not too easy not too hard.
Tutorial is fast and explains everything. Gameplay felt crisp.

And the music is superb for such a neat gem of a game. Especiall

5336590.name: Howling Woods
5336590.desc: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

top.text: If you enjoy peaceful sandbox games and Halloween aesthetics then you will likely enjoy this game. I was apprehensive about the developers use of AI, and by all means that can be criticized, but the game does look and fu
It's chill and very low-demand, nothing to really manage other than fright. It looks nice, overall. I'm struggling with lag as things progress, though.

1024950.name: Starship Horizons: Bridge Simulator
1024950.desc: Starship Horizons is a multi-player experience allowing 2-6 players commanding a Starship as the bridge officers in the roles of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Science, Operations, and Engineering.

top.text: fun group game

5126160.name: Tall Orders
5126160.desc: Tall Orders is a co-op platforming game where you and a friend play as small gnomes tending to a wizard's potion shop for the day. Work together to overcome your size, find the right ingredients, and brew potions. But beware, handling the ingredients may cause strange side effects!

fullgame.name: 考古致富：挖出個博物館

5088810.name: 考古致富：挖出個博物館 - 支持者包
5088810.desc: This Supporter Pack is for you if you love Big Dig and want to help support Hjalte and Schu make more games! It adds a French dog named Adrien who helps you redecorate your Museum! Plus a statue with YOUR name on it!

4304900.name: 考古致富：挖出個博物館
4304900.desc: 《考古致富：挖出個博物館》是一款挖寶增量遊戲。為了幫助市長完成橫跨共和國的修路大業，你必須去挖走那些藏在路下的文物，同時將這些挖出來的寶貝們統統搬進博物館吸引遊客，利用挖掘文物和經營博物館賺來的資金解鎖更好的開採設備、擴充團隊，進而向著下一片區域瘋狂開挖！來為市長的修路工程掃清一切障礙吧！

top.text:
Digga tunnah, dig, digga tunnah
When you're done, ya dig a bigga tunnah
Digga tunnah, dig, digga tunnah
Quick before the hyena come
Let's Get It Done!

dlc.name: 考古致富：挖出個博物館 - 支持者包

5440800.name: OMSI 2 Add-on O560 III Series
5440800.desc: O560 III Series – add-on for OMSI 2 is a pack of legendary intercity buses intended for intercity and medium distance lines. Manufactured in Turkey, those buses are dedicated to the European market. Most popular in Germany and all over the Europe.

5262270.name: SoloGami Demo
5262270.desc: Fight tactical card duels across three rows and three rounds. Infect enemy cards with parasites, turn the weather into a weapon, and master the art of the well-timed pass. Every card hand-crafted, every duel a puzzle. Just you, the board, and one more match.

3535920.name: Mike goes on hike Demo
3535920.desc: 告別城市，展開一場第一人稱健行冒險。探索山間步道、拍攝照片，將旅途中的回憶填滿麥克的旅行日誌——從刺激的滑索體驗，到營火旁的寧靜夜晚。

4919380.name: Grand Theft Idiots
4919380.desc: A chaotic free-for-all heist game where you backstab your friends for the biggest payout. Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and steal their loot right out of their hands. Race to the getaway van before the cops arrive, because until you extract, nothing you stole is truly yours.

4952170.name: Her Revenge
4952170.desc: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

5460790.name: Frogball Demo
5460790.desc: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

5225370.name: VIZZA Demo
5225370.desc: VIZZA讓模擬化為鮮活的畫面。觸碰圖案，調整行為與色彩，錄下值得珍藏的瞬間，或讓它成為動態桌布。

5350040.name: Manafest
5350040.desc: A free 1v1 collectible card game with a mean sense of humour. Build a 30-card deck from six kinds of mana, climb the ranked ladder, draft from sealed packs and fight in weekly tournaments.

2089530.name: Parawyrm
2089530.desc: Parawyrm is a unique horror experience like no other where enemies and hazards will challenge your very senses. Explore a seamless world with collectables to find and secrets to uncover...

17710.name: Nuclear Dawn
17710.desc: Explore war-torn post-apocalyptic landscapes and take fight against enemies using various weapons in this FPS/RTS hybrid.

301840.name: City of Brass
301840.desc: 資深《生化奇兵》開發人員傾力打造，以阿拉伯之夜為藍本的第一人稱冒險動作遊戲。

397190.name: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun
397190.desc: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun is a turn-based tactical and strategic game set during the Sengoku era; primarily focusing on the Japanese Warring States period and Japanese Invasion of Korea.

compare.en: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun

975470.name: Silver Chains
975470.desc: Silver Chains is a first-person horror game with a strong emphasis on story and exploration. Search for clues within an old abandoned manor to unravel the truth about the terrible events which have happened.

277700.name: On Rusty Trails
277700.desc: 在這個風馳電掣的跳躍遊戲裏，隨機應變，適者生存就是最高綱領。 時刻准備著，以秒殺的速度轉變你的陣營。 無論是高台厚榭還是萬丈深淵，保存點還是致命陷阱——即使在一躍之間，一切都變化莫測。。。

movies.name: On Rusty Trails - Release Trailer (Traditional Chinese)

301860.name: Submerged
301860.desc: 淹沒之城是第三人稱無戰鬥遊戲，在其中你可以探索神秘的汪洋城市，在偌大的戶外環境中發現荒涼之美。你成為米古的角色，一個年輕女孩帶著她受傷的弟弟，乘著他們的小漁船來到這個城市。用船到處探索汪洋城市，登上沉沒的建築物，用望遠鏡看清城市，尋找可以拯救弟弟的補給品。用自己的步調探索城市時，你碰上了多采多姿、繁茂生長的棲息地，而發現隱藏的物品慢慢拼湊出破碎世界還有一個破碎家庭的故事。

top.text: 如果不执着全成就纯粹的享受风景和音乐是不错的体验。后期略枯燥重复，相当于把古墓丽影里的攀爬单独制作了一个游戏。站在高处先用望远镜各个角度看一遍能找到大部分收集内容。我为了全成就开全地图花了将近十小时，整个后期有点折磨人，只为了圆满结束游戏。10分的话，我给7分。玩法简单轻松没压力。想给个中评价，没有的话那就给个推荐吧。

1125910.name: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
1125910.desc: 古老的傳說揭開了現實的面紗, 帶來了一場奇妙的冒險. 背起你的行囊, 穿越現代歐洲, 揭開一段塵封往事, 品味一位從未被加冕過的國王的辛酸秘史.

1028530.name: Paper Memories - Comics from Finding Paradise & To the Moon
1028530.desc: Over 50 pages of comic of stories from To the Moon and Finding Paradise, featuring stories from both the main games and side plots.

1028420.name: Paper Memories - Comics from To the Moon & Finding Paradise
1028420.desc: Over 50 pages of comic of stories from To the Moon and Finding Paradise, featuring stories from both the main games and side plots.

fullgame.name: 神树残响（Echoes of the Divine Tree）

3818700.name: 神树残响DLC扩展包 - 奴莱比岛之旅
3818700.desc: This expansion pack is additional content for "Echoes of the Divine Tree", featuring a new main storyline, new maps and new companions.

1773090.name: Impostor Factory - The Bestest Dancers Comic
1773090.desc: Following the peculiar events of the To the Moon series’ 3rd instalment, Impostor Factory, there’s no telling just what kind of shenanigans the SigCorp Doctors are up to this time. . . . Except in this comic. This comic tells it.

1518670.name: CBT With Yuuka Kazami: Patchouli Knowledge's Surprise
1518670.desc: Patchouli Knowledge has something to show you! What could it be, I wonder?

1160540.name: The Crown of Leaves: Chapter 2
1160540.desc: The second chapter of the Crown of Leaves.

418890.name: [Platypus Comic Strips+] To the Moon, too!
418890.desc: *Spoilers!* To the Moon, too! is a short comic following the Platypus (Platplat) & Paper Rabbit as they attempt to reunite with Johnny & River after they parted at the end of To the Moon.

7670.name: BioShock™
7670.desc: BioShock is a shooter unlike any you've ever played, loaded with weapons and tactics never seen. You'll have a complete arsenal at your disposal from simple revolvers to grenade launchers and chemical throwers, but you'll also be forced to genetically modify your DNA to create an even more deadly weapon: you.

889910.name: Hell Pie
889910.desc: Hell Pie is an obscene 3D platformer that takes bad taste to the next level! Hell Pie sees you grab the horns of Nate, the ‘Demon of Bad Taste’. He is given the honorable task of gathering the disgusting ingredients for Satan’s infamous birthday pie!

8850.name: BioShock® 2
8850.desc: Set approximately 10 years after the events of the original BioShock, the halls of Rapture once again echo with sins of the past. Along the Atlantic coastline, a monster has been snatching little girls and bringing them back to the undersea city of Rapture.

4956940.name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
4956940.desc: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

5126170.name: Phasewright
5126170.desc: A pulse crosses one cell per tick — the longer way arrives later. From that one rule you build machines out of light: lay conduits, split colours, hit the beat. Quiet, untimed, free.

top.text: Fantastic foundation for a game, especially a free one.  Played through 30 levels in about 30 minutes.  Shows a ton of potential.  I think they missed a couple unintended consequences.  I could see a lesson they were try

5241840.name: Armament Inc
5241840.desc: Build a global arms empire in this idle tycoon. Research weapons, automate production, ship contracts across a live world map, out-maneuver rivals in diplomacy, and flex your fortune in a private mansion on your way to the top.

3308220.name: Galatico
3308220.desc: Blast your way to the top of GALATICO, a high-tempo movement shooter inspired by the best shooters of the 90s. Dismantle the gatekeepers of the universe's most powerful technology: Portals. Clock-in… it's time to trim the fat from GALATICO.

top.text: Fun boomer shooter game with promising mechanics hope to see it improve on its way to a full release

Super fun game, would recommend! I love checking every nook and cranny to find secrets and extra loot. Classic boomer shooter that really gets you moving quickly around levels to get better angles on enemies, 10/10 <3

played the demo a while back so this was on my radar. awesome game. reminds me a bit of a game called Deadshot, but this one is more sci-fi. the map design is really well done. You're always moving around trying to find

5068500.name: Headshot Manager
5068500.desc: Take a tactical-FPS org from open qualifiers to the Major: sign players, train the map pool, win the veto, then coach every round live as the match plays out in front of you. A real simulation underneath, where every stat is earned.

1624430.name: Vahnora
1624430.desc: Vahnora is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG of faction war. Choose Sanctum or Forsaken, master one of eight classes, hunt world bosses for gear, carry relics through enemy lines in Mortis Pass and storm your faction's castle with your guild.

top.text: confusing even for me, an ultrakill player

top.text:
畫面逼真流暢、音效臨場感十足、操作感絕佳、介面簡潔明瞭 ，各方面都做得非常棒👍，
前不久買RIDE 4非常喜歡，MotoGP 21價格不貴就原價入手了👍

原本是先玩了RIDE4但是突然覺得RIDE4有點膩了就買了MotoGP21原本以為操控差不多應該很好上手,結果突然覺得MotoGP21才是真正的摔車模擬器,熟悉了好一段時間才終於比較習慣,玩了MotoGP21突然覺得RIDE4(難度已調整至實際情況了)的輪胎好抓歐,MotoGP21更考驗油門煞車還有傾角控制的細膩度,前煞太多後輪浮起灣中油門太多傾角太深厚輪開滑就沒辦法做出很好的成績來,而且還要隨時注意剩餘的油量來調整動力模式,如果一直使
用鍵盤的確又些難度,遊戲反饋很真實,不過很快就上手了,遊戲細緻度很棒還有眾多細節,值得遊玩

1944430.name: Amnesia: The Bunker
1944430.desc: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

top.text: 玩起來更像是惡整你的解謎遊戲，怪物一開始很恐怖，三小時候就變得很煩了。太多門根本打不開，為了打開一個門拿裡面的道具，必須要跑到地圖的另一端拿鑰匙，重點是你根本不知道這個鑰匙一開始藏在哪裡，而且為了這個鑰匙，你還要先找屍體，拿狗牌密碼，然後再開置物櫃拿筆記，然後上面才告訴你鑰匙位置之類的前置作業一大堆，所以整個遊戲主角都像無頭蒼蠅一樣折返跑。

357310.name: Oriental Empires
357310.desc: Turn based 4X strategy game, recreating the civilizations of ancient China. Develop your land, build great cities, raise huge armies and fight epic battles, with hundreds of soldiers fighting right on the game map. Advance your technologies, culture and religion to create one of mankind’s biggest empires.

top.text: 玩這種大戰略最怕全英文，文字量一多就會懶得看，像是十字軍之王2等paradox出的大戰略很多眉角要釐清就會讓人卻步。幸好Oriental Empires已經有簡中漢化，而且操作上沒那麼刁鑽。遊戲給的操作提示不多，所以剛玩要慢慢摸，不過對玩過全戰系列Total war玩家來說很好上手。比較可惜的是一些AI尋路徑問題好像沒有修正，以及戰鬥呈現有點僵硬外算不錯的作品；在價格上比起paradox那種遊戲本體便宜但DLC花費可觀的遊戲來說這遊戲C

節奏很緩慢的文明帝國類遊戲，
背景是參考春秋戰國時代，
科技樹分四系，演進有三個時代。

戰鬥方面:
是以地圖上直接戰鬥的模式，類似Total war但不能部隊微調，
所以還是用數量去壓制，戰鬥起來很無趣看不到兵兵戶打的狀況。
兵種就算比較有趣了，兵有分平民與貴族，
某方太多時會造成動亂的成因，所以要平衡。

建築方面:
一階城市有固定的空位去蓋建築，
需要升級城市來獲得更多空位。
農田與城外建築是在地圖上直接建築。
建築的缺點就是看不

目前还只是一个预览版本，坐等制作组加入承诺的中文字幕，这个是超重点哦。
战役模式能够扩充一下就更完美了。特别要说画面问题，还是不错的，重点要看和谁去比较，和全面战争系列？那明显不可能，制作费也不是一个级别的。可是如果你要和三国志13，信长野望去比？完爆光荣好几条街。如果你可以接受光荣游戏的画面，没有任何理由不接受这东方帝国

你需要一位朋友並且附加一對應手把才能完成全部成就，Good Job！ :)))
这游戏当年玩的时候感觉很爽，真的

598730.name: Shakedown: Hawaii
598730.desc: Build a "legitimate" corporation via open world missions, shakedowns, sabotage and property acquisition.

top.text: This is a fantastic game & should be introduced into the school curriculum to show kids how corrupt capitalism works for the One percent. I didn't get any bugs. Go have some fun.
fun, silly, and simple open world game <3

This game is so boring. I was expecting Retro City Rampage which was an excellent game. You spend most of the game on the phone talking to people. It feels like the game is playing itself. Gameplay is very repetitive.

1634860.name: Minishoot' Adventures
1634860.desc: 飛進手工打造的迷人世界，開始一場開放式探索和爽快雙搖杆射擊動作的冒險。從光亮的地上世界一路殺到最幽深的洞穴，改良你的飛船，擊敗地下城中的首領，救出自己的朋友！

top.text: 就.....打飛機版的2D薩爾達，只是把角色怪物NPC換成小飛船。謎題解謎不難，大部分是在找路，加速後的衝刺與甩尾速度感操作起來還不錯，其他的就比較一般。

享受探索跟成長的部分很不錯
非常好玩！
根本就是射擊版超任蕯爾達傳說，好玩

327410.name: A Bird Story
327410.desc: An experimental short from the creator of To the Moon & Finding Paradise: A simple & surreal 1-hour interactive animation about a boy and an injured bird, told without dialogues.If you're looking for To the Moon-like experience, I'd suggest playing Finding Paradise first.

top.text:
算是 Finding Paradise 的前傳短篇故事，時間軸和製作時間都比 Finding Paradise 早。
有玩過 Finding Paradise 的人可以補，但對沒玩過的人而言有點沒頭沒尾的。
很舒服的小品故事

5061040.name: Quartermark
5061040.desc: 你的隊伍會自己戰鬥。誰在隊伍裡、他們帶著什麼，由你決定——這就是整個遊戲。12 名英雄、9 個可串聯成金色連攜的關鍵字、100 張地圖、440 隻怪誕的 3D 怪物、100 個首領，以及可能毀掉你最強裝備的強化階梯。

3825930.name: Aolta
3825930.desc: You've woken up after a millennium with no memory of your life before. You've become an alien in your own planet. This world is yours to discover.

5056360.name: Crypt Survivor
5056360.desc: 深入受詛咒的地穴，體驗這款動作 Roguelite 遊戲。駕馭各具特色的職業，搭配強力升級，獲得被擊敗首領的能力。闖過危機四伏的五層地穴，打破詛咒；或在無盡模式中挑戰你的極限。

top.text:
What I expected: Casual Roguelike experience
What I got: A raging boner from the soundtrack

1558620.name: 麻雀旅人
1558620.desc: 摸三張牌，選一張走路；用牌袋構築，用一局真正的麻將打倒 Boss。《麻雀旅人》是一款 HD-2D 像素風的休閒麻將肉鴿：走遍四風群島，堵上麻將規矩的漏洞，趕在封印破開之前抵達封魔潭。

movies.name: 麻雀旅人 宣傳片（繁體）

2105440.name: Fall of Bali
2105440.desc: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided into many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has seen war for nearly two centuries and now the threat of imperialism has come. With all your might and potential, can you survive and win this era?

5218590.name: Turrakata
5218590.desc: Hustle is an open-world survival-crafting game and top-down shooter set on a tiny planet. You're a dude hunting down the guy who stole your red cap, exposing your ugly, putrid, bald head. Shoot, gather, craft, build, expand your map, dodge bullets and fight bosses to seek revenge.

5047760.desc: Return to the orphanage Helena once called home after receiving a mysterious letter from a childhood friend. The orphanage was closed years ago after a mysterious fire. 4454110.name: Softboiled

5326730.desc: 桌面文字編輯器，內建便利貼。數百 MB 的檔案數秒開啟，記憶體佔用與檔案大小脫鉤。未儲存的變更自動快照，當機也不會丟。22 種編碼、15 種介面語言，主題與每一句介面文字都能自己改。

5357460.name: Cheat Koi-Koi
5357460.desc: A single-player koi-koi roguelite in a nighttime gambling den. Read your opponent, peek at hidden cards, and swap your way to victory. Get caught, pay a fine. Choose tricks and upgrades, buy tools, and beat the den's owner Ririka for the prize.

269670.desc: With BADLAND: Game of the Year Edition, experience the multi-award-winning action adventure like never before - redesigned for Steam.

205910.name: Tiny and Big: Grandpa's Leftovers
205910.desc: You are Tiny, a nerdy inventor, who tries to reclaim his most beloved possession - Grandpa's underpants!

1182620.name: Impostor Factory
1182620.desc: A bonkers time-loop tragicomedy murder mystery thriller featuring multiple casualties and a suspicious cat, from the creator of To the Moon & Finding Paradise.

top.text:
如果你是因為「To the moon」找來的朋友，想必你也不需要任何推薦。
但如果你只是湊巧逛進來的過客，請務必從「To the moon」開始玩。

3645890.name: GONE Fishing
3645890.desc: GONE Fishing 是一款 1-8 人生存恐怖遊戲，你和好友必須齊心協力……靠釣魚活下去。唯一的生存之道，就是在湖泊吞噬你們之前，不斷滿足它永不饜足的飢餓。 你能餵飽它的胃口……還是成為下一份祭品？

top.text: 還不錯 但感覺要多人玩才能有其他時間去做其他事情

5224050.name: Random & Unfair Battlefields
5224050.desc: Random & Unfair Battlefields is a chaotic fantasy RTS where you barely control your own army. Pick a faction, muster your forces, and issue decrees (spells) to tilt the odds in your favour. Randomly generated maps and daily events mean no two battles play out the same.

5246400.name: Bloom
5246400.desc: A puzzle-platformer about an innocent, curious being exploring the planets of Bloom, planting seeds and sprouting flowers with its song. Sing! Use your voice and impact the ecosystem that birthed you, and become one with the cosmos.

top.text: Cute and wholesome, love this game! Sploinky is one of the real ones.

5327190.name: Sloptoberfest
5327190.desc: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

3847310.name: BONG FLIP
3847310.desc: BONG FLIP is a fast-paced arcade game about launching, flipping, dodging enemies, and landing. Build your score, collect ridiculous skins, and see what you can survive before you crash. Flip it. Land it.

4354660.name: Zone Nova
4354660.desc: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

5189370.name: Trapoint
5189370.desc: 用陷阱規劃敵人的行進路線，再用這些陷阱消滅敵人的 Roguelite 據點防禦遊戲。封住要道，把敵人逼進同一條路，在那條路上設置陷阱，每一波結束後從三張卡牌中選一張，獲得新的陷阱。敵人會鑿穿牆壁、拆毀陷阱，一路殺來。

3777630.name: SnowRunner - Season 19: Research & Restore
3777630.desc: 歡迎來到瑞士，此處正在進行重大的基礎建設翻修工程！駕駛 2 款強大的全新卡車，穿越 3 張冬季地圖吧！ 「第 19 季：Research & Restore」包含於第五年度通行證。需要《SnowRunner》主遊戲才能執行。

5352170.desc: A relaxing logic puzzle where you connect dots to make one loop, using the numbers as clues. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 12,000 more, Easy to Expert.

5343820.desc: An atmospheric 3D exploration game about cheering up the lovely folks of HillVeil and making memories that last a lifetime!

movies.name: Everest: Summit To Valley On Foot

5373570.name: CrossSpell Demo

4974640.name: zenaimu
4974640.desc: A slime pen for your desktop! Make your workspace 10x cuter with slimes that bounce around while you use your PC. Try your luck at the gachaclaw each day to get new slimes for your collection!

5355820.name: Beatrice
5355820.desc: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

4578110.name: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
4578110.desc: 記住，你是站在正義這一方的。在這款人氣獨立遊戲《I Am Your Beast》的劇情前傳 DLC 中，前往東南亞打一場影子戰爭。

5202800.name: We Were Here Tomorrow Soundtrack
5202800.desc: 官方《We Were Here Tomorrow》原聲帶：欣賞 15 首由 Tom Wolkers 作曲的復古風格合成波樂曲，聽見想像中的 80 年代之聲。

5202830.name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition
5202830.desc: 《Tomorrow Fan Edition》包含獨家內容，僅提供給最有熱誠的探險家們。藉由數位美術集、官方原聲帶，以及獨特桌面一起探索《We Were Here Tomorrow》的美術與音樂。

2315050.name: 我們曾到此：明日
2315050.desc: 你和夥伴在一座神秘的諾契克設施中醒來，想不起來自己究竟為何會來到這裡。在這款非對稱的合作冒險遊戲當中，必須藉由溝通與合作才能揭開祕密的真相。唯有同心協力才能決定明日的命運...

movies.name: We Were Here Tomorrow - Release Date Trailer
We Were Here Tomorrow - Release Window Trailer

dlc.name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition

5439950.name: Gravity Miner Demo
5439950.desc: A PS1-style first-person mining roguelite inside a floating cube of a million blocks. Shift gravity to walk on any wall, dig for ore before your oxygen runs out, dodge buried bombs and hatching monsters.

40800.desc: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer comes to Steam with a playable Head Crab character (Steam-exclusive)!

238010.name: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut
238010.desc: You play Adam Jensen, an ex-SWAT specialist who's been handpicked to oversee the defensive needs of one of America's most experimental biotechnology firms. When a black ops team breaks in and kills the very scientists you were hired to protect, everything you thought you knew about your job changes.

compare.en: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut

91200.name: Anomaly: Warzone Earth
91200.desc: Lead an armored squad through the perils of this reversed tower defense action-strategy game!

2073850.name: THE FINALS

dlc.name: THE FINALS - Season 11 Ultimate Battle Pass Bundle

3957780.name: Teddy Horses
3957780.desc: Teddy Horses 是一款溫馨的牧場模擬遊戲。化身可愛的泰迪熊，照顧、繁育並騎乘色彩繽紛的馬兒。為夥伴梳理毛髮，擴建夢想馬廄，參加精彩賽馬，自由探索陽光明媚的寧靜山谷！

top.text: I really tried to understand what this game is going for, but I can safely say it's either not getting there or what it IS going for is just bad.

3976340.name: Cucina Stellata
3976340.desc: 在飽受飢餓之影侵擾的廚房之中，烹製十九世紀義大利的傳統料理。一款小巧的心理恐怖遊戲，將美食學、儀式與源自宇宙的無盡食慾一併呈現在餐桌之上。

dlc.name: Cucina Stellata - Supporter Pack: Curiosities and Recipes

3469910.name: 星艦奇航記: 未知前哨站
3469910.desc: 在這款劇情導向的前哨站建造遊戲中，率領船員踏入奇異的新世界！一邊研究、探索、建設，一邊迎戰威脅新盟友的神祕宇宙力量。 艦長，您的冒險就此啟航！

top.text: I'm a pretty avid Star Trek fan and an enjoyer and base builders. The game does a pretty solid balance of having a rich and detailed crew, especially the main officer staff, that I want to make sure get through the missi
“The coordinates she’s setting… it’s a standard textbook tactical grid. Beautifully symmetrical. Mindless, but beautiful.” — Captain Kathryn Janeway
Game runs well, I really enjoy the theme. The music is good and the building is interesting. I'm very pleased so far, we will see how it goes long term but I'm hopeful.

5348850.name: Farthest
5348850.desc: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

3506830.name: Out of the Shadows
3506830.desc: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.

5357680.name: O'BLOCK

5165300.name: Passage Zero
5165300.desc: A short psychological horror experience that asks one question: are you paying attention, or just doing what you were trained to?

5352130.name: TrackCrafter
5352130.desc: Make music with TrackCrafter. Play synths, build beats, record audio, and arrange full tracks. Connect a MIDI controller or use your computer keyboard. Import MP3s and WAVs, shape your sound with effects, and export your finished mix.

5217930.desc: Sherlock Holmes recounts a murder from years past. Take the role of Holmes, investigate the manor, and use evidence, testimony, and the timeline of that night to unravel an alibi and solve the case in this classic-style mystery adventure.

4885210.desc: 《AKIBA LOST (秋葉原迷蹤) 》原聲帶！共收錄31首樂曲，包括由《女神轉生》系列的增子津可燦負責作曲的遊戲原創樂曲，以及電視劇中使用的樂曲！

4889930.name: AKIBA LOST (秋葉原迷蹤) Drama Movie
4889930.desc: 十三年前，秋葉原發生了六名少女失蹤的未解之謎——「秋葉原神隱」。新城大輝宣布以此為題材製作一款真人實拍遊戲。被召集出演的六位女性，正是象徵日本亚文化聖地「秋葉原」的多彩人物。然而，她們本應演繹的故事，漸漸開始侵蝕現實。《AKIBA LOST（秋葉原迷蹤）》究竟能否完成？

5353290.name: WebBound Solitaire
5353290.desc: A Spider Solitaire game with a journey. Climb a 116-level campaign across 29 unique zones, beat boss deals, earn up to 4 stars per level, collect relics and themes, and rank up from Novice to Legend. Or relax with Freeplay, Endless runs and a new Daily Spider every day.

4131220.name: AKIBA LOST (秋葉原迷蹤)
4131220.desc: 十三年前，秋葉原發生了六名少女失蹤的未解之謎——「秋葉原神隱」。新城大輝宣布以此為題材製作一款真人實拍遊戲。被召集出演的六位女性，正是象徵日本亚文化聖地「秋葉原」的多彩人物。然而，她們本應演繹的故事，漸漸開始侵蝕現實。《AKIBA LOST（秋葉原迷蹤）》究竟能否完成？

dlc.name: AKIBA LOST (秋葉原迷蹤) Drama Movie
AKIBA LOST (秋葉原迷蹤) Original Soundtrack

5357630.name: Lodebreaker
5357630.desc: Lodebreaker is a colorful mining idle clicker. Smash mineral-rich rocks, upgrade your pickaxe, and recruit a crew that keeps digging while you're away. Discover rare specimens, beat timed Mega Blocks, and ascend for permanent bonuses as you push deeper.

5009950.name: 十三州·漢刃
5009950.desc: 《十三州・漢刃》是一款三國題材的回合制策略卡牌遊戲。選擇主戰者、構築牌組，以兵將佈陣、權謀設伏，在四季天時中尋找致勝機會。獨自挑戰 AI、邀請好友連線，或透過房間配對尋找對手；在雙人對戰中與隊友共享戰線與兵法點，讓彼此的出牌接成一場逆轉。戰後收集卡牌與外觀，解鎖並肩作戰的羈絆故事。

1730790.name: A Sister's Journey
1730790.desc: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

top.text: Waited for years, and it was so worth! the game is beautiful, feels great and the OST is amazing! My only real complaint for now is that the dialogue seemed to stretch out for quite a long time, making it quite hard to f

5354440.name: Swaplines
5354440.desc: 只要把同色的球聚到對應顏色的 LINE 上，一款簡單輕鬆的解謎遊戲。玩得越多越能摸清訣竅，解題也越來越得心應手。謎題隨機生成，無限暢玩；每解開一道謎題，背景中可愛的城鎮就會一點一點成長。

5146460.name: Quantum Go
5146460.desc: Quantum Go reimagines the ancient game of Go with quantum mechanics. Place classical stones or create superpositions across the board, then watch possibilities collapse as the battle unfolds. Face challenging AI, build a career, compete in tournaments, or challenge other players in multiplayer.

4941420.name: Folk-Tography
4941420.desc: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

3716120.name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
3716120.desc: Truth Beneath the Shadows – A detective game where players unravel hidden mysteries by connecting clues to expose a secret organization. Every piece of evidence brings you closer to the dark truth lurking in the shadows.

5142090.name: Deadly Contagion Soundtrack
5142090.desc: Relive the tension of Deadly Contagion through its soundtrack. Includes the soundtrack in MP3 format.

4985010.name: CGC - Cemetery
4985010.desc: Crisis Guard Corporation (CGC) is hiring. Five-night security contract. No prior experience required. Competitive compensation. Positions available immediately.

4013020.name: 要不要和我女友開幹？
4013020.desc: 引導女友和朋友上床的「自主」NTR模擬遊戲！！ 有著扭曲性癖的「秋歲」， 究竟能否讓女友「美夏」沉迷於這種特殊玩法呢？

3670730.name: Horror Tales Eats The World
3670730.desc: 終極血腥與恐怖體驗。 Bodycam與血腥恐怖相遇。探索黑暗、荒廢且寫實的場景，這裡充斥著血腥場面、殘酷暴力和令人毛骨悚然的超自然實體。尋找隱藏的錄影帶。揭開血腥恐怖的故事。你的麥克風正在監聽你。保持安靜。活下去。

movies.name: Horror Tales Eats The World Release Date Trailer
Horror Tales Eats The World - Official Gameplay Trailer

5324810.name: Hippocratic Chaos
5324810.desc: Hippocratic Chaos is a chaotic co-op hospital game where teamwork is the best medicine. Treat patients, handle emergencies, manage supplies, and keep your hospital running with friends. Save lives, survive the shift, and try not to become the next patient!

646570.name: Slay the Spire
646570.desc: 我們將卡牌遊戲與 Roguelike 遊戲融為一體，製作出了這款最棒的單機牌組構築遊戲。打造出獨一無二的牌組、遇見無數離奇的生物、發現威力強大的遺物、去屠戮這座高塔吧！

1055880.name: Miracle Snack Shop / Philia After Story
1055880.desc: 我們的主角和菲莉亞開啟了新生活，期間會發生什麽事呢？快來一探究竟吧！

1330420.name: Some Some Convenience Store / Adela After Story
1330420.desc: 探索艾德菈結局之後的故事

5342930.name: Dementium II
5342930.desc: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.

5356840.name: Fzzy Bzzy's The Beautiful Ones
5356840.desc: A straight forward action rpg where you play as Shell, a mouse destined to lead sinking mice out of the dark! Based around the Universe 25 experiment, a dying society of rats and mice fight to survive in a post-apocalyptic world!

4015730.name: Bunny Hopper
4015730.desc: 《Bunny Hopper》是一款節奏飛快的3D平台跳躍遊戲，每個動作都至關重要！操控戰鬥機器人，利用牆面奔跑、衝刺與跳躍避開致命陷阱，在高速移動中射擊目標。挑戰艱難賽道，測試反應極限！

4944870.name: Fuse Beads Simulator
4944870.desc: A simple and tense fuse bead challenge game.

3331850.name: Brush duel
3331850.desc: Brush Duel 是一款競技繪畫遊戲，兩位玩家將即時重現世界名畫。比對手畫得更快、更準確，或創作充滿趣味的惡搞版本。支援線上 1 對 1 對戰、私人房間、自動評分與快速對局。

5169690.name: Dystopia
5169690.desc: Dystopia is a VR rhythm game: slice glowing crystals or shoot them with a laser pistol to live radio. Five stations, always on. Every song is unique. Archive favorites to replay. 4554330.name: 逃離部落客：逃跑

4673080.name: Sloperator Inc.
4673080.desc: 三個章節。7個小遊戲。多結局。從賽博龐克企業反烏托邦，到2000年代的軍校生活，再到一列神秘的火車。一部奇異、以故事驅動的視覺小說，你的選擇至關重要。

4429690.name: Dreams Of A Visionary
4429690.desc: 《梦想家的梦境》是一款第一人称探索冒险游戏，背景设定在一座神秘的维多利亚式豪宅中。探索细节丰富的房间，解决极具挑战性的谜题，逐步揭开这个超现实梦境中隐藏的秘密。

4886080.name: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
4886080.desc: 关于埃及黑社会中的阿努比斯的动作RPG俯视图：快速近距离战斗，抽搐，遗物和与成群的死者和古代神灵的战斗。

dlc.name: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld Demo

5294080.name: Clean your Garden
5294080.desc: Clean Your Garden is an incremental: you click the screen, you kill bugs, you earn amber. Amber unlocks weapons, tree branches and allies, and the next run pays far better. Twelve weapons, six bosses and a whole desert to open up.

3255840.name: Insanitorium - Don’t Be Afraid
3255840.desc: Trapped in a psychiatric hospital, you must escape demons lurking in the shadows.Explore Insanitorium only with your flashlight and scarce batteries, defend yourself with a machete and a dart gun, and face the strange patients. movies.name: 餘燼之鎮 發售日預告

241600.name: Rogue Legacy
241600.desc: Rogue Legacy is a genealogical rogue-"LITE" where anyone can be a hero. Each time you die, your child will succeed you. Every child is unique. One child might be colorblind, another might be a dwarf with vertigo. But that's OK, because no one is perfect, and you don't have to be to succeed.

5156550.name: 墨痕之塔
5156550.desc: 《墨痕之塔》是一款手繪風格的卡牌構築 Roguelike。選擇五名特色角色之一，組合卡牌流派、收集印記，在充滿戰鬥、商店與隨機事件的高塔中不斷攀登。

5292490.name: Panos
5292490.desc: A casual tactical strategy game where you investigate Region 412, uncover secrets, fight seven powerful factions, and make choices that shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

5024300.name: VRPlayerSim
5024300.desc: A desktop immersive video player with webcam-based head tracking, designed for normal monitors and XR glasses. Simulate VR-style viewing from flat videos or enjoy 180° and 360° immersive content — no gyroscope required.

3701460.name: Furry Fantasy Adult World
3701460.desc: Explore a sandbox open world, customize anthro furry characters, build, fly and create your own fantasy adventures alone or with friends.

movies.name: Trailer - Work in Progress / Subject to Change

top.text: This game is in an extremely unfinished state and suffers frequent fatal error crashes. Animations and models are severely limited in variance and of poor quality.

5206610.name: Revenant Dawn
5206610.desc: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic Survival Horror adventure.

5368560.name: Oval Office Tidy Up
5368560.desc: Some people will finish it in one sitting. Some will start by recognizing a few flags and leave knowing exactly where Benin is. Read the flag on each folder, figure out where that country is and file it on the right continent shelf. Tidy up fast and beat your best time.

4737540.name: 21: Dead Man's Deck
4737540.desc: Blackjack with a knife in it. Count an 11-card shoe, bend the rules with 155 cursed trumps and outplay six masked Kept and the Fate Dealer. Lose a round and the Bone Press on your arm bites. The fourth bite kills. Bonus: Dead Man's Well, a gothic falling-block game, is in the box.

5179830.name: Pixelia
5179830.desc: Pixelia is a pixel-art multiplayer world where you build cities, manage economies, develop heroes, forge alliances, and wage wars. As civilizations evolve through eras, new gameplay emerges—from RPG adventures to racing, strategy, and cyberpunk combat.

5250360.desc: Take control of a professional basketball franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27. Build through the draft, trades and free agency, manage contracts and rotations, develop your players and create the strategy that will turn your team into a dynasty.

5238680.desc: Read the question. Read the electorate. Choose your answer before time runs out. VoxPrinceps is a political narrative-decision game where every debate can swing state support and your opponent gets a chance to swing it back.

5360330.desc: JSAUX PIXEL is the companion app for the JSAUX dot-matrix display, supporting the display of system status, weather, music, social media notifications, GIF animations, and personalized content.

4272020.name: WOIM

1252240.name: Aeon Drive

5368450.name: Farkle: Tavern Dice
5368450.desc: Farkle: Tavern Dice brings the classic push-your-luck dice game to a cozy medieval tavern. Roll for points, decide when to bank your score, and risk another throw for a bigger payoff—or lose the round.

5240770.name: Mine Heroes
5240770.desc: 《掃雷英雄 Mine Heroes》是一款掃雷 + Roguelite + 回合策略獨立遊戲。玩家扮演骰子英雄，在掃雷棋盤上擊敗怪物、攻克 80 個關卡，5 大職業、多種隱藏職業等你解鎖。經典掃雷玩法 + 骰子 RPG + 地城冒險，給你從未有過的掃雷體驗。

4409620.name: ARCS
4409620.desc: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

5056370.desc: A first-person action score-attack game about dealing with one spaceship disaster after another. Put out fires, patch hull breaches, handle asteroids and aliens, and survive your 10-minute shift. Protect your cargo and ship as you chase a higher score in this chaotic space delivery game.

5223090.name: Pawnimals
5223090.desc: Lead ten animal armies in 3D chess. Challenge the computer across five difficulties or play a friend locally. Learn with Danger Sense and 100 guided lessons, solve 100 mate-in-two puzzles, and conquer the nine-battle Gauntlet.

4731510.name: Subject Zero
4731510.desc: You are a scientist turned into test subject zero, forced to fight the infection by venturing through your own nightmares. Will you survive.

4207990.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
4207990.desc: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in one of the most beloved Flash-era tower defense series! Experience the original three GemCraft games in one collection. GemCraft 1, GemCraft 0, and GemCraft Labyrinth!

3996640.name: Inky's Sleep
3996640.desc: 沉浸在 Inky 的夢境中，這是一場黑暗卻迷人的 2D 恐怖冒險，帶有一絲超現實主義的色彩，主角是一隻可愛的小貓。探尋秘密、解開謎題，並躲避令人作嘔的怪誕怪物。

5132990.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
5132990.desc: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

movies.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1 | Out Now Trailer
Puppet Mall: Chapter 1 | Release Date Trailer

4896360.name: Ceto-7
4896360.desc: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

5198670.name: No Murders in Grimwick
5198670.desc: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

top.text:
69 minutes of a cute little game.

I enjoyed and I recommend.
Maybe 7 Euro for an hours gameplay and no soundtrack is a bit much. But it is handdrawn and is made by a one person - so that makes it easier on the wallet.

5279620.name: Halloween On Goober Street
5279620.desc: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

top.text: A FREE BANGER??????? HE DOESN'T STOP!

2279440.name: Soul Mates
2279440.desc: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!

top.text: Mary .... is ....cute....

4246850.name: TitleIt!
4246850.desc: Turn a photo into the funniest caption. Write, vote and compete in quick online rounds with friends on Steam, Android and the web. Play for free, join with a room code and collect your winning moments. Optional purchases available.

4024600.name: Pyramidion
4024600.desc: 把一塊巨石完好無損地運到金字塔頂。在這款支援2或3人線上合作的物理模擬遊戲中，掌握合力推動的時機，該等就等，與好友分工合作，克服沿途障礙。

top.text:
當初朋友覺得這個遊戲很有趣, 玩了之後我在想 "這舍遊戲真的可以上架嗎?"
期待後續的更新~~~
六星級的連線品質，推薦！
發瘋啦嚴厲斥責這是可以上架的嗎?

5341070.name: The Wrong Way
5341070.desc: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

top.text: Ftf on a budget of 20 bucks and a veal parmesan sandwich but still a fun game

3216230.name: MEAT TRAIN
3216230.desc: Meat Train is a FPS game where you operate a train thats uses MEAT for FUEL. Explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead, scavenge for weapons and loot. Upgrade the train and attempt to destroy an evil AI megafactory.

top.text: Taking the time to write a review as i reckon the dev deserves more love for this game. This one has been on the wishlist for a while and just saw it was on sale so i bought it and went into it without to crazy expectati
MEAT MEAT MEAT MEAT MEAT!
i liked it its a ton of fun

5134560.name: DON'T SWITCH
5134560.desc: Co-op horror for 2-3 friends. Ransack a haunted mansion for cursed tapes, wake the spectres and blast them back to hell with a holy cross. Keep your energy up: the thing in the walls can possess you, and then YOU are the one hunting your friends.

4509200.name: Grease Trap '99
4509200.desc: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

1508190.name: Finding Words
1508190.desc: Open a magical storybook and find the words that bring its tales to life. Complete 50 word-search puzzles across ten funny fantasy stories, fill in the missing passages and collect charming stickers, one discovery at a time. Play at your own pace.

4731070.name: Kron Wars
4731070.desc: A persistent space MMO that runs in your browser. No download. No installation. Open a tab and you are in the Frontier. Trade, mine and fight across 2 universes and 12,000 sectors, in an economy that players build. And one mechanic that no other MMO has: war rewrites the map.

5101820.name: カスペナ～カスタムペナント野球
5101820.desc: 從選秀發掘新秀，培養自己的球員，帶領球隊挑戰冠軍。在這款棒球經營模擬遊戲中，你將擔任總經理，決定打線、投手起用、自由球員補強、交易與續約。探索球員各自的成長樹、尋找隱藏新秀，也能投資球場與周邊城鎮。比賽以觀戰方式進行，不直接操作球員；不想親自處理的工作可以交給電腦。球隊、聯盟規則與球員姓名風格皆可自訂。

3422000.name: Ward Off Evil
3422000.desc: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

top.text: Really cool game. Combat is self-explainatory and challenging. The world presented in the game is pretty decent lore-wise. I like consistency of the art style. It has some niances, like the map could be preserved from on

Love RPG? Make sure to Follow my Curator PageI liked the game. It's like indie Wartales, but with a completely different setting. Magic, monsters, quests, and multiple endings. There are still plenty of flaws (no main qu

5292500.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
5292500.desc: 畢業典禮正逐漸走向崩潰。這本應是再尋常不過的一天，你只需要選擇先開口向哪位朋友打招呼。打招呼的順序會改變對話的內容，同時令周遭的景致在一次次的輪迴中變得扭曲。不知為何，好友漸漸收起了臉上的笑容。等你察覺到真相的時候，畢業典禮也將不復當初。這是一部以友情為主題的互動聲畫讀物。每重複一周目，令人不忍直視的真相都將變得更加清晰——包括破碎的過程在內，精緻而細膩。

3323980.name: Sweet Swipe
3323980.desc: 在 《Sweet Swipe》 中，奔跑、跳躍和滑行，盡顯風格！一款令人興奮的 2D 平台遊戲，操作簡單，跑酷風格的動作，手繪街頭藝術，原創配樂，以及一個關於勇氣、韌性和正義的精彩故事。

4996960.name: Handle with Care!
4996960.desc: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

top.text:
Question - Did I just spend nearly three hours wiggling my bean's butt and spanking people?

Answer - Yes.

10/10 would give myself repetitive spank injury again

(also works great on steam deck)

Funslop 

Love the theme and the familiar British town vibe. Also BUMS. BUTTS. Whatever your preferred rear end terminology is this game has em nice and peachy and jiggly and SLAPPABLE. 

5/5 for a fiver(99)

5364850.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
5364850.desc: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

1564060.name: 疯狂灯塔 Lighthouse of Madness
1564060.desc: 踏上這段受洛夫克拉夫特啟發的奇幻之旅，揭開這座島嶼上等待著你的謎團。 探索島嶼，破解棘手的謎題，最重要的是：儘量別失去理智。

movies.name: Lighthouse of Madness - Official Release Date Trailer

5341000.name: Ashnar's Lair
5341000.desc: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

5346530.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
5346530.desc: Battles run on their own. Send a party of four into dungeons, scoop up piles of gear, upgrade it, and push deeper. With levels up to 999 and over 100 dungeons, this is an idle hack-and-slash RPG that keeps going while you watch.

4303660.name: Wartide
4303660.desc: 一款駐留在螢幕角落的增量式桌面防禦遊戲。波次越來越難，升級越來越強，進度永不停止。在工作或休息時建設基地、解鎖永久加成、壯大軍隊。

2862170.name: Elderwood Online Demo
2862170.desc: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

4247410.name: Run, Run from the Blast!
4247410.desc: Challenge yourself in a frantic escape through an urban environment, where every mistake brings you one step closer to your demise. Only a perfect run will truly give you a chance to make it out alive.

2488560.name: Abandoned Hearts
2488560.desc: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

movies.name: Abandoned Hearst — Official Reveal Trailer | Mythbyte

5144200.name: Hurl
5144200.desc: HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena. The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

883710.name: Resident Evil 2
883710.desc: 一切都凌駕於玩家的想像之上。 一場生化災難於1998年9月襲擊了浣熊市，從殘害倖存者的喪屍地獄中生還吧。 無盡的刺激、引人入勝的故事和無法想像的恐怖正在等候你。 見證系列首屈一指的傑作──《Resident Evil 2》的重生吧。 別被這場慘劇吞噬。

367500.name: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen
367500.desc: 廣受好評的RPG動作遊戲Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen，現已推出高清版本，並包括所有先前收費DLC內容。

2050650.name: Resident Evil 4
2050650.desc: 生還僅是惡夢的開端。 前所未見的生物災害「拉昆市事件」已過去六年。 成為特務的里昂·S·甘迺迪接獲命令，前往營救被綁架的總統千金。 為此里昂踏進被「瘋狂」支配之地，他的結局會是…… 一場生與死、恐懼與釋懷互相交織的嚴酷營救劇即將揭開帷幕。 透過直觀的操作和最新的畫面，以及再構成的故事重生為全新的生存恐怖體驗。

21690.name: Resident Evil 5
21690.desc: 這遊戲是在2009年推出的Games for Windows - Live version。如果你在Steam上購買Untold Stories Bundle，它將會升級令內容與Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition相同。

304240.name: Resident Evil
304240.desc: 生存恐怖類型的遊戲回歸！這是重新製作的高清版Resident Evil。

952060.name: Resident Evil 3
952060.desc: 不管逃到哪裡也會被追至絕路。 拉昆市發生突如其來的生物災害，更為巨大的威脅被投入至這個逐漸崩潰的城鎮中…… 多重的危機、九死一生的驚險動作和重新建構的逃生劇，一一超乎你的預想。 你能逃離這片絕望嗎？ 同時收錄《Resident Evil Resistance》。

1967430.name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
1967430.desc: 經典的解謎神秘冒險名作回來了！ 《逆轉裁判》系列作者巧　舟所製作的《Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective》，將推出期待已久的高清重製版。 由負責《大逆轉裁判》BGM的人氣作曲家北川保昌對原版樂曲進行的同期編曲外，還有插畫集和BGM集等新追加內容！

top.text:
過程跟演出有趣到想忘掉都難
我會永遠記得裡面的舞步 

這就是巧舟在逆轉裁判的幽默與大膽
以全新的載體跟玩法呈現出來的結果啊

請在不要接觸任何劇情暴雷的情況下打開 會擁有最好的體驗

巧舟哥的全盛時期，恐怖如斯。
精巧有趣的謎題與解謎，獨此一家。
如齒輪般契合的劇情，前後呼應的巨北。
初見很糙但是後來發現特別有表現力的畫面，
還有特別抓耳，一聽就知道什麼東西要來了的音樂。

強烈推薦。
创意非常不错

1196590.name: Resident Evil Village
1196590.desc: 在《Resident Evil》主系列的第8部作品中展開一場令人毛骨悚然的絕命拚搏。 伊森一家的平靜生活又再一次被捲進了混亂之中，而打破這種平靜日常的不是別人，正是克里斯·雷德菲爾。伊森又再一次陷入那無法醒來的噩夢。 經過多年開發，日趨成熟的RE Engine為大家打造了全新的生存「動作」恐怖體驗。

top.text: 延續7代的劇情，蠻令人喜歡的，也有延續很重的沉浸感和劇情，蠻不錯的

9 / 10
精彩的演出，系列最好的大场景。东欧奇幻恶灵古堡，精彩刺激的冒险。
缺点，明显给RE4预备的素材，前期压迫十足最后BOSS挂的草率，以及剧情杀。
浪费塑造好的反派
好玩到翻掉，可以充分感受到自己成長的遊戲，特價時入手絕對超值，過關後有機會可以體驗村影模式，會感到非常的有趣

1277400.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: 破滅之翼
1277400.desc: 《MONSTER HUNTER STORIES》是一款RPG遊戲，玩家將會成為與魔物建立羈絆、加以培育並與之共存的「騎士」，在「Monster Hunter」的世界中冒險。本作為系列第二彈，有關羈絆的全新故事將會揭開帷幕。

按這個道理來看我這個評論應該會建立起我跟大家的羈絆之力給我的銀行帳號匯款啊？

45740.name: Dead Rising® 2
45740.desc: 銷量破百萬的Dead Rising續集，今次Dead Rising 2將喪屍及生存恐怖遊戲，一次過帶進美國最新最大的娛樂主題公園Fortune City。

top.text:
他媽的什麼爛遊戲
沒有做繁體中文的語音包
說什麼找不到這個這個檔案
在那邊玩遊戲我之前還是以前小時候回憶在玩的時候都是盜版的全部都用好了然後什麼都沒有問題我現在回來支持新版的正版的
我還要幫他安裝繁體語音MOD
沒有自動存檔然後還不能存檔我到底要怎麼玩

如果我沒先玩過3代，這遊戲我仍然不會給正面評價，因為同時期的死亡之島完全吊打這部作品。
沒錯，這系列強在於有大量惡搞元素，但嚴格說起來玩遊戲性本身還是不夠好。
雖然同樣與死亡之島系列一樣都允許玩家改裝武器，可是一來武器的耐用度真的還是不夠，殭屍數量又比死亡之島的還多好幾倍，常常打到一半武器就壞掉，然後要重做一把又得到處找材料。
好用的武器就那幾種，最強大的往往都無法藏在身上，玩家角色一受到攻擊或是碰到些什麼，手上那把藏不住的武器就

265550.name: Dead Rising 3 Apocalypse Edition
265550.desc: 探索被喪屍病毒感染的Los Perdidos城，並在軍方介入突擊並掃平整個城市之前，連同所有生還者尋找逃出之路。

top.text:
不錯玩 一些組合武器或車輛玩起來很有樂趣.難度不會太高可以一定程度上輕鬆玩
劇情上我覺得也不會太突兀.簡單易懂的好
可以帶上生還者一起冒險也頗有趣味.小夥伴們也不至於太弱.不需要平凡照顧這點很好
有些支線任務太過麻煩.單一個支線任務就要人跑遍整區地圖也太誇張
有些要找武器或道具的任務沒有指引有點麻煩
且有些任務需要找的道具還佔用物品欄位.初期會感到吃力
但總體來說玩得很開心.值得推薦~

222480.name: Resident Evil Revelations
222480.desc: Resident Evil® Revelations 以高質素高清畫質、強化光影效果及音效重臨 PC 平台。

movies.name: Resident Evil Revelations Dev Diary: Heritage Horror

top.text: 什麼?你說你遊戲都快結束了還不會閃避?那恭喜，準備被最終boss當狗搧，一搧一個不吱聲，你說靠走位?不好意思，繞背搧，幻影搧，無呼吸連搧，你說AI隊友怎麼不吸引仇恨?不好意思，我克里斯就是原地手槍連射，挪動半步?不存在的
童年回憶，操作簡單又不缺乏趣味，主線大概9小時通關，總共12章，遊戲內沒有遇過一次bug
nice

548430.name: Deep Rock Galactic
548430.desc: Deep Rock Galactic 是一款可以 1 至 4 人同時遊玩的多人合作第一人稱射擊遊戲，有酷酷的太空矮人、100% 可破壞的環境、程式生成的洞穴以及無數的外星怪物。

top.text:
目前遊玩時間大約 71 小時，基本上都是跟認識的人一起玩。

我自己最喜歡這款遊戲的地方，就是它的職業分工真的做得非常明確。偵查兵靈活、可以照明，挖礦也方便；工程兵可以做平台給偵查兵踩，還有機槍塔可以補火力；鑽頭兵負責挖路；機槍兵則是有很多高破壞力武器。四個職業真的是各司其職，而且少了哪一個都會很有感。像少偵查兵，挖礦會慢很多、照明也不夠；少鑽頭兵，開路就會變得超級麻煩。四個人一起玩的時候，合作感真的非常強。

隨機生成的洞穴地圖也很不
玩的我在MC裡挖礦也猛按F
低氧關卡我耖

Deep Rock Galactic - Supporter II Upgrade
Deep Rock Galactic - Robot Rebellion Pack
Deep Rock Galactic - Rival Tech Pack
Deep Rock Galactic - Dawn of the Dread Pack

254700.name: Resident Evil 4 (2005)
254700.desc: (推出日: 2014) 特工Leon S. Kennedy被派去拯救被綁架的美國總統女兒。

top.text:
個人評價總分：5 ∕ 5分（就是神作，不容反駁）
● 5星級- 神作、該遊戲類型的重要代表、容易沉迷上癮
   4星級- 佳作、值得實體收藏、不時會想拿出來回味
   3星級- 普作、第一輪體驗尚可、等二手折扣價買
   2星級- 小作、同人等級的小品水準、電波粉絲向
   1星級- 差作、各方面極差缺陷多、看網路攻略或吐槽就好
   0星級- 糞作、遊戲界黑歷史、爛到連玩盜版都嫌浪費時間

優點：
劇情沒門檻，因為走的是不同舊三部曲劇

2291670.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Supporter II Upgrade
2291670.desc: 為了慶祝 DRG 五週年，我們現在向我們最熱衷的玩家們推出贊助者資格 2。

1430610.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Roughneck Pack
1430610.desc: 如果你真的很想幹點粗活的話，新的血汗礦工包將可以助你一臂之力。用這四套全新的獨特裝甲（每種職業各一套）、全新的頭盔、和全新的塗裝好好打扮一番吧

801860.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Supporter Upgrade
801860.desc: 你喜歡 Deep Rock Galactic，但覺得這樣不夠，還想要更多嗎？那麼贊助者資格正好適合你！資助我們的遊戲開發流程，然後到遊戲內領取贊助者專屬的獎勵吧！

2934390.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Order of the Deep Pack
2934390.desc: 深淵戰兵附加下載內容將會給你一套備受敬重的矮人採礦公會的專屬裝甲。現在是你出面代表戰兵團的時候了，朝著危險的深淵邁向更遠的地方吧。

1797340.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Rival Tech Pack
1797340.desc: 敵對科技組合包可以讓你用我們的新敵人的風格裝飾你的武器，畢竟也沒什麼理由浪費掉這些精良的零件，對吧！

920571.name: Resident Evil 2 - All In-game Rewards Unlocked
920571.desc: 以下內容原本只能在達到指定紀錄後才可獲得，現在可以立即為它們解鎖： - 額外模式：「第 4 生還者」 - 額外模式：「豆腐生還者」 - 服裝 - 無限獎勵武器 - 概念美術 - 模型 ※不包括「幽靈生還者」的紀錄達成報酬。

3481460.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Skullcrusher Pack
3481460.desc: 碎顱猛者附加下載內容將會給你一套碎顱者氏族的祖傳裝甲，這是一個和碎顱烈酒有著相同名號的好戰氏族。據說這套裝甲仍會回應戰爭號角的召喚，並且渴望著再次被人披戴上陣的時刻。

2165590.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Biohazard Pack
2165590.desc: 岩痘已經蔓延到哈克瑟斯上，而我們強悍的礦工們必須穿上精良的裝備對抗它！用這四套全新的獨特裝甲（每種職業各一套）、全新的頭盔、和全新的塗裝好好打扮一番吧。

1283091.name: Deep Rock Galactic - MegaCorp Pack
1283091.desc: 研發部門工業用壓力機出品的最新成果！該是時候為你的武器和裝備換上最新型的設計美學了 - 這套公司認證的業界龍頭組合包正好可以滿足這項需求：全套的業界龍頭裝備外觀

3535330.name: Terraspace
3535330.desc: The game "Terraspace" offers you a unique experience of planet settlement and terraforming — creating conditions for life on unsuitable planets. This will require you to build the necessary structures to populate the planet.

881020.name: Granblue Fantasy: Relink
881020.desc: 以4人隊伍聯手作戰，王道動作RPG遊戲！ 擁有專屬動作特色的眾多角色登場。在共同作戰中接連使出招式，透過4人集中攻擊的「連結攻擊」與「奧義連擊」，華麗地打倒敵人吧。 極具深度的戰鬥模式加上自由度高的培育系統，還有能因應玩家情況，讓動作遊戲新手也能充分享受遊戲的輔助功能。 大家一起組隊，盡情享受冒險與戰鬥吧！

3764200.name: Resident Evil Requiem
3764200.desc: 予生者恐懼。給屍者安魂。 《Resident Evil Requiem》標誌著「Resident Evil」系列和生存恐怖遊戲的新紀元即將開始。「Requiem」（安魂曲）將會撼動玩家的精神深處。

252950.name: Rocket League®
252950.desc: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and...

4761040.name: Its Flammin Bingo
4761040.desc: Its Flammin Bingo is a rougelike strategy game about playing bingo. Buy and use items in the shop to weigh the odds in your favor. Earn enough points to complete each round and earn coins. Gain bingo after bingo to thrive.

3567020.name: Mumble Pines: The Arrival
3567020.desc: In this first-person story-driven horror game, you take a job as a janitor to access a run-down island summer camp that got shut down, after the dissapearence of your younger brother, which was only one of many incidents. It’s up to you to uncover the island’s buried secrets.

4833540.name: Juice Stand Tycoon
4833540.desc: Turn a tiny street-corner juice stand into the hit of the festival. Mix recipes for the weather, set prices and stock up before the rush. Customers tell you exactly why they walked away, so fix it on the fly and keep the cash rolling in. Eight levels. Try Level 1 free.

3991200.name: Momolitos
3991200.desc: 探索充滿活力的地區，收集材料並餵養可愛的 Momolitos，幫助牠們進化成數百種獨特的形態。這是一場溫馨的生物收集冒險，結合了探索、發現，以及照顧自己充滿好奇生命的實驗室的樂趣。

5077390.name: PCpill
5077390.desc: PCpill™ is an action-packed top-down shooter where you take control of the PCpill™ Antivirus to disinfect the hard drive of an old desktop PC. Use your PillGun to blast the rot away and restore your computer, one file at a time!

4813620.name: TankFall Arena
4813620.desc: Retro-inspired tank arena combat where every wall can become a weapon. Master ricochets, random battlefields, powerful pickups, and chaotic multiplayer battles against friends or AI opponents. Supports solo play, team battles, local multiplayer, and Remote Play Together.

5360850.name: Grind Grid
5360850.desc: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

5297330.name: Rescuing My Wife
5297330.desc: Your wife, Amanda, has been kidnapped by a family of demonic creatures. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, defeat the demonic family members, and find Amanda.

3874160.name: NIPH
3874160.desc: NIPH 是一款風格獨特的 roguelite 平台遊戲，戰鬥激烈且充滿風險。在探索廣闊多樣的奇幻世界時，使用各式各樣的物品來進行斬擊、射擊、學習與施展魔法！

4751790.name: TRY
4751790.desc: A quiet evening turns into something far more unsettling. What begins as a normal night at home slowly changes as strange events, memories, and unexplained encounters begin to unfold.

5230710.name: FULL THROTTLE RALLY
5230710.desc: An arcade racing game inspired by 90s classics, where you race at high speed, master drifts, and tear through tracks inspired by Mexico.

3570930.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
3570930.desc: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

top.text: If I were you guys I wouldn't waste my money on this thing, at least not in it's current state.  This has to be one of the shortest games I have played.  The lack of content is pathetic.  The first one was basically the

5393320.name: NULLBYTE
5393320.desc: A puzzle about reading someone else's code and the one-byte mistake. A whole little machine on one screen: 256 cells, four registers, a stack. From "which way the stack grows" to a chain of borrowed code. You win not with the right answer, but with what the machine actually did.

5227650.name: Ration Me Tender
5227650.desc: An adult romance visual novel set at a coastal desalination plant during a supply crisis. Follow production director Nizar Sabhan through three distinct romance routes as work, marriage, and responsibility collide behind the fence at Ras Mishaal.

5288330.name: NOVA
5288330.desc: Conquer the galaxy one world at a time. Nova is a fast, minimalist real-time strategy game of fleets, factions and gravity. Send your forces between planets, portals and stations, outmaneuver seven rival AI factions, and survive black holes and asteroid belts across 12 chapters.

5208860.name: Dub House
5208860.desc: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

5283650.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
5283650.desc: 一款以韓國月子中心為舞台、為期五天的第一人稱心理恐怖遊戲。護理師在一夜之間換了人，而新來的那位，似乎總是抱著你的孩子。

3502620.name: 惡魔夜瘋狂
3502620.desc: 不分敵我全部殺殺殺！死越多越強的養成型RTA模擬RPG登場！運用殘酷無情的「剝削侍從系統」進行戰鬥，將邪惡發揮到極致！

5063150.name: 搖曳露營△ 相約搖曳露營△All -in -one!! Chill Time
5063150.desc: “讓人百看不厭” 當你伏案工作或學習時，《搖曳露營△》就陪伴在你的身旁。 在你身邊，凜、撫子和夥伴們今天也在享受露營的樂趣。看著她們的身影，你也能更專注於手邊的工作或學習。你可以利用1000多種裝備打造專屬的露營地，而那些全神貫注的時光，也將化作日記中的點滴記錄累積下來。

5104990.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
5104990.desc: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

5377200.name: Chained Pirates Together
5377200.desc: 一顆被詛咒的骷髏將你的船員鎖在一起，唯有塔頂的一道雷電才能打破詛咒。在這款適合 1–4 名海盜的物理合作攀爬遊戲中攀登 1000 公尺——一次失誤的跳躍，就會把所有人一起拖下去。

3844890.name: Lost Jelly
3844890.desc: An arcade adventure with a new twist!🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

2757440.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
2757440.desc: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

1713730.name: Moadra
1713730.desc: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

3734220.name: 末世神槍
3734220.desc: 這款類魂 FPS 遊戲，將你拉進傳奇美術總監 Viktor Antonov 筆下的末日西部：這片血染黃沙的詭秘之地。洞悉獵殺你的怪物、每顆子彈都要精打細算，用火藥與禱告鍛造你的專屬戰鬥風格。無論單槍匹馬或連線並肩作戰，槍手啊，向西行吧，跟這個沉淪的國度共赴終局。

Guns of Eschaton - Co-Op Mode Gameplay Teaser

1301950.name: Time Loader
1301950.desc: Time Loader is a story-driven puzzle-platformer with tiny robots, alternate realities, nostalgic music, and primitive tech from the 90s!

1119980.name: In Sound Mind
1119980.desc: In Sound Mind is an imaginative first-person psychological horror with frenetic puzzles, unique boss fights, and original music by The Living Tombstone. Journey within the inner workings of the one place you can’t seem to escape—your own mind.

297920.name: Space Colony: Steam Edition
297920.desc: Space Colony: Steam Edition is a remaster of the real-time base builder and strategy game from Firefly Studios, creators of the Stronghold series. In Space Colony you colonize to survive, designing intergalactic bases that keep your crew productive, happy and defended against hostile alien threats.

814360.name: Mythic Ocean
814360.desc: Teach the gods to create a better universe - or mess it all up in Mythic Ocean, a narrative exploration game where your choices shape the fate of the cosmos.

1630.name: Disciples II: Rise of the Elves
1630.desc: The award-winning series Disciples introduced a milestone in the game's very successful history; the introduction of a new race: The Elves. The Elven Race added a new dimension to the game and added countless hours of gameplay. Now that series has expanded further with Disciples II: Rise Of The Elves.

compare.en: Disciples II: Rise of the Elves

866140.name: Arise: A Simple Story
866140.desc: 踏上感傷的旅程，體驗失去心中所愛的失落。你將操縱時間，重塑環境，親歷一段段苦樂參半的回憶。這是一個關於快樂與苦難、喜悅與悲哀的故事，終有一天也將在你我身上重演。

2990.name: FlatOut 2
2990.desc: Experience the drive of your life as you throw yourself around on and off the track causing fences to shatter, tyre walls explode, water tanks and barrels fly across the track into other cars.

924070.name: Arboria
924070.desc: Fight, die, and fight again in this dark fantasy trollz-like roguelite. As a Yotun troll warrior, descend into the ever-changing, creepy dungeons of Durnar. Use a variety of Symbiotic Weapons and Bio-Mutations to slay enemies and heal The Father Tree.

6220.name: FlatOut
6220.desc: Ram through pile-ups and smash through your windshield as you push racing to the edge! FlatOut™ delivers more heart-stopping thrills than any sane driver can handle!

332200.name: Axiom Verge
332200.desc: Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.

1286320.name: Exoprimal
1286320.desc: 以人類最強大的「強攻裝甲」擊破史上最兇猛的「恐龍」的團隊對戰動作遊戲​​ 本作是一款線上專用團隊對戰動作遊戲，玩家將會身穿專為不同定位而設的最先進動力服「強攻裝甲」，對抗以壓倒性數量侵襲而來的「恐龍爆發」。

top.text: 感覺卡普空已經把這遊戲視為棄子了，不更新新玩法新恐龍，連強攻裝甲都是技能幾乎複製貼上的版本，都沒有完全全新的東西，現在匹配都是獵頭者，想要完全真人的對局基本都沒有都是跟AI打，舊的東西都玩得快膩了，希望卡普空還是能再多更新這款遊戲，畢竟我當時就是因為恐龍+機甲這個因素才買的遊戲。

525040.name: The Disney Afternoon Collection
525040.desc: 集合一群令人愛戴的迪士尼角色，《Disney Afternoon》將帶你回到遊戲黃金時代，讓冒險充實你的下午。 六款經典遊戲擁有經強化後的嶄新視覺效果，當中包含可回復至復古感覺的濾鏡選項功能。

top.text: 非学好玩游戏，童年的回忆~~

1406810.name: After Us
1406810.desc: 貪婪、犧牲，以及希望──在這扣人心弦的故事中四處探索荒誕的後人類世界的每一個角落，並給予地球上的生命第二次繁盛的機會。

top.text: 好玩的一款環保遊戲, 隨進度會越來越好玩, 期待2
場景美術超頂的

741510.name: The Hong Kong Massacre
741510.desc: 快節奏的俯視射擊遊戲，在香港街頭的槍林彈雨中殺出一條血路。 《The Hong Kong Massacre》受到經典的動作電影啟發，將您置身於一場無情的復仇之中，其中充滿了殘酷的影片式槍戰場景以及陰暗的地下交易場所。

top.text:
不是個可以無腦突突突就通關的爽 Game ，就連 John Wick 來也可能要在一關卡上重來上百回

可惜的地方在於後期的關卡，堆太多敵人了，也無檢查點，必須在毫髮無傷的情況下連殺三十餘名敵人

但總歸瑕不掩瑜，這款的帶給玩家的視覺聲效，真的玩起來很爽
我很少給遊戲負評，但這隻真的玩不下去，我香港人玩到一半已經感到極其無聊

3357650.name: PRAGMATA
3357650.desc: 《Pragmata》是Capcom的獨特科幻動作冒險遊戲。 命運多舛的調查小組成員休將與機器人女孩黛安娜合作，在被AI操控的月球設施中尋找返回地球的方法。

top.text: 非常好一款養女兒遊戲，尤其全程穿著塗鴉工作服在避難所互動以及打通關。整體遊戲性非常足，故事也完整，還好滑鼠有側鍵可以比較好操作。大多數BOSS戰鬥不會到非常難，有一定的規律在，甚至武器、晶片搭配好也好打許多。

2026/10/10 : 全成就
名副其實的養女兒遊戲
主線長度中等
其他都是收集要素或挑戰要素
流派構成算有但有些強力晶片要解真結局路線才會解鎖
推薦完多周目或NG+，有老卡一貫的通關後開始爽game模式

故事好，美術好，女兒好
遊戲性不好，剛開始還算有新意但玩差不多一半就膩了一度差點棄坑，因為不便宜還是逼自己打完了

5292740.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
5292740.desc: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

movies.name: Raze the Zombie Horde - Gameplay Trailer
Raze the Zombie Horde - Gameplay Trailer

4437140.name: if you stay
4437140.desc: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

top.text:
Finished the entirety of the game in about an hour and a half, including all 3 endings and I am left heart broken. 

In the first 10 minutes I was already enamored by the two main characters, their setting, and their str

I usually never leave reviews but I just had to for this game! I took a chance when I saw it because I just adore the art style. On top of the art style I REALLY enjoyed the story, I'm a little worried to get ending two,

dlc.name: if you stay - creator support pack

5281080.name: 水族派對
5281080.desc: 《水族派對》是一款用心打造的畫風治癒、以海底模擬為題材的收集遊戲。在這裡，你將成為一家水族館的館長，打理萌魚海島的日常，收集超過 1000 種多類型的奇幻萌魚。

3191530.name: Irradiate 235
3191530.desc: Discover and automate unique materials. Engineer the machines and tools for your factory. Handle hazardous materials to make near-limitless energy. Use your own tools to navigate a labyrinth of alien passages and uncover dangerous tunnels in this innovative Automation and Engineering game.

top.text: this game is a lot of fun. the art style is super engaging, the rag doll is fun to use and makes the combat feel really fun! i spent at least 10 hours just exploring the map looking for secrets and when i found them all
Honestly one of the best automation games I've played in 2026, the graphics are really good, the music is phenomenal, I am addicted to this game now, and I want you to be addicted to it too!

5374170.name: 悠閒露營△：睡衣派對包
5374170.desc: 收錄睡衣造型服裝，以及打造舒適露營地的裝備的追加內容。透過5人的服裝與7件裝備，享受睡衣派對。

fullgame.name: 搖曳露營△ 相約搖曳露營△All -in -one!! Chill Time

5374150.name: 悠閒露營△：本栖高中冬季露營包
5374150.desc: 收錄本栖高中制服搭配大衣的冬季造型，以及凜的爺爺的整套露營裝備與冬季本栖湖露營地的追加內容。透過5人的服裝、7件裝備與1處露營地，享受冬日露營地的風情。

4172450.name: The Hidden Ones
4172450.desc: The Hidden Ones is a cooperative horror puzzle game that supports four-player online multiplayer. An seemingly ordinary fire incident unravels the prologue to a cold case that has been buried in a small town , binding the fates of four protagonists into an eerie and intricate maze of mystery.

5260110.name: Second Source
5260110.desc: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

5165600.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - 追加模式《蒼藍雷霆GUNVOLT GX》
5165600.desc: 《蒼藍雷霆GUNVOLT GX》為外傳作品《銀白鋼鐵X2》的主角亞裘拉與系列主角鋼伏特並肩作戰的追加模式。

movies.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - DLC Launch TC

5352190.name: 尋找六葉草
5352190.desc: 在陽光斑駁的森林空地裡，靜靜尋找三葉草的第一人稱觀察遊戲。超過 50 萬株真實大小的三葉草中，藏著 54 株四葉草、18 株五葉草，以及僅有的一株六葉草。蹲下身，撥開葉子，摘下一株，用自己的眼睛數一數葉片。沒有時間限制。

movies.name: 尋找六葉草 預告片

5420310.name: 凱洛提亞：地城遠征 Demo

5373780.name: In Falsus - CHUNITHM Collaboration Song Pack
5373780.desc: 跨越世界的邂逅。不同機種，嶄新體驗——收錄 5 首來自《CHUNITHM》的曲目！

5291460.name: Empty The Lake!
5291460.desc: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

3491960.name: Lost Liminal
3491960.desc: "Descend into liminal space—evade lurking horrors, solve cryptic puzzles, and use your camera to preserve the memories you leave behind in this eerie world. Switch to night vision to uncover hidden clues and trace what's amiss. This first-person indie horror will keep you guessing at every turn."

981430.name: Gordian Quest
981430.desc: 这是一场史诗般的Roguelite冒险，结合了角色扮演、战棋战术和牌组构筑的最佳体验。你将组建英雄的队伍，带领他们完成艰巨的任务。帮助英雄们与彼此建立羁绊并获得新的组合技能，你能握紧手中的曙光，刺破世界中心的黑暗，驱散笼罩大地的诅咒吗？

5134280.name: The Guest from the Fields
5134280.desc: 麥田裡有個東西佇立著。每次你看見它，它都離你更近一些——而且那不是人。你的祖母說，你不該看它的。

4607340.name: 伊莉亞娜公主的墜落之夜～她已不再屬於你～
4607340.desc: 魔王被擊敗後，勇者艾德蒙終於救回了摯愛的公主伊莉亞娜。然而，失去魔王制衡的世界再次陷入混亂。返程途中，勇者一行在溫泉旅館稍作休息，卻意外捲入一場圍繞權力與陰謀展開的危機。探索旅館、蒐集線索、與不同角色交流，並在關鍵時刻做出你的選擇。你的每一個決定都將影響故事的發展，並導向12種截然不同的結局。你能否揭開隱藏於黑暗中的真相，守護公主與夥伴，迎來真正的幸福結局？

5341050.name: 寶石與宮殿
5341050.desc: 深入層層礦脈，發掘60種獨特寶石，靈活運用多種採礦工具並完成收藏。讓每項發現陳列於寶石博物館，再以珍貴藏品逐區點亮萬晶宮殿。

4036370.name: Risk it Little Biscuit
4036370.desc: Risk it, little biscuit! Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

4413070.name: 我推的祭品
4413070.desc: 直播介入×調查推理心理恐怖ADV。透過留言與打賞「介入直播」，再以「推理」改寫她們結局的15天。

dlc.name: 我推的祭品 試玩版

4560000.name: Battle Nap
4560000.desc: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

2451700.name: Atrion Project
2451700.desc: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

3596870.name: 櫻姬7
3596870.desc: 櫻花盛開的樂園裡，貓娘、魔女與精靈們將你團團包圍，與她們共度甜蜜日常，打造獨屬於你的豪華後宮。

top.text:
[後半に日本語レビューあり]
A Cute Tile-Connection Puzzle Searching for Catgirls at a Cherry-Blossom Inn
The protagonist visits an old inn for a rare vacation. However, a teleportation accident scatters the Sakura Hime girls from ano
Better than GTA 6 will ever be

5318000.name: 村民集結：村莊保衛戰
5318000.desc: 一款輕鬆又燒腦的背包like + 肉鴿 + 彈幕射擊村莊防禦遊戲。招募村民英雄，合理搭配格子，合成橙色超級英雄，守住村莊，阻止拆遷隊！50個章節，12位普通英雄，11位超級英雄，等你來戰！

top.text: 一坐就是一小時。彈幕割草的快感很足，而且肉鴿機制做得很不錯，失敗了也能積累資源去升級村莊和英雄。每次重開都能感受到自己在變強，非常適合下班後無腦爽一把

5231500.name: Axiom of Stars
5231500.desc: Resurrect a fallen sky, one constellation at a time. Axiom of Stars is a calm, luminous logic puzzle game: 2048 puzzles across multiple constellations, each a new way to think, and new mechanics to figure out.

5348500.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
5348500.desc: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

fullgame.name: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves

4868040.name: FATAL FURY CotW - DLC Costume ”Classic Mai Shiranui"
4868040.desc: ■《餓狼傳說 City of the Wolves》不知火 舞專用服裝 可將可遊玩角色「不知火舞」的服裝更換為「經典版 不知火舞」。

5165820.name: 靈魂面甲：萬骨狂歡DLC
5165820.desc: Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form!

4961170.name: Just One More Expedition
4961170.desc: A tiny expedition roguelike that respects your time and you can finish during a coffee break. One more run is never just one more run.

3690870.name: Tow Game
3690870.desc: Tow Game is a physics-based action game where you control a car being towed by a tow truck. Swing around the environment using the tow cable and earn points by causing chaos and destruction.

fullgame.name: Halls of Torment 苦痛殿堂

4100210.name: Halls of Torment - The Lost Archives
4100210.desc: 在深埋於苦痛殿堂下方的淪落文庫，鮮血邪教徒與判官追尋凡人不得染指的禁忌祕密，甚至連這裡的藏書都會伺機襲擊生者。

5365190.name: Tidy Tails
5365190.desc: 你的貓把店鋪弄得一團亂，5555隻貓咪絨毛玩偶正等著回到貨架上。升級你和貓咪的技能，切換天氣來改變玩法，玩小遊戲、尋找收藏品，同時好奇當一切整理完畢後，車庫裡究竟藏著什麼。

5306740.name: Forgotten Hill Injustice Demo
5306740.desc: Navigate through brand new and familiar locations, meet disturbing characters and solve tricky puzzles. Play again as Mr. Larson and delve into the deepest mysteries of the town in this new point and click adventure in the Forgotten Hill series. Can you survive?

5215390.name: UNCOUNTED
5215390.desc: Uncounted 是一款大規模增量塔防遊戲。一個區域，一波敵人：數以萬計的敵人由 GPU 模擬。在投放前放置並瞄準每一座砲塔，然後利用這一局解鎖下一門武器。

4977840.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
4977840.desc: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

3522130.name: Dunthera - Tower Defense
3522130.desc: Construct your towers, guide your hero, and resist escalating waves of monsters. Collect resources from enemies, select impactful cards, face powerful bosses, upgrade your towers and hero to control the fate of your battlefield !

5100710.name: Orbital Madness
5100710.desc: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

5064390.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Judge Dredd™
5064390.desc: 透過 Judge Dredd™（Bally 於 1993 年製作的經典彈珠遊戲），踏入巨型都會一號的反烏托邦街頭。

2727210.name: Deathless. The Hero Quest
2727210.desc: In Deathless, elements of a collectible card game, roguelike, and turn-based strategy combine seamlessly. Build a unique deck of cards, discover unusual relics, and defeat legendary bosses. No two journeys will ever be the same with endless Path. Crush the Evil and save the world!

1796580.name: Sorry We're Closed
1796580.desc: 《Sorry We're Closed》是款奇異的劇情導向生存恐怖遊戲，講述天使與惡魔的碰撞下所引發的故事。遊戲結合了經典的固定視角探索，和街機風格的射擊玩法。蜜雪兒必須運用她的第三隻眼看穿兩個世界，找出隱藏的祕密並解開謎團。

2420580.name: ALYSSA
2420580.desc: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.
