4956380.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
4956380.desc: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

4527880.name: Hell's Handbook
4527880.desc: With your trusty handbook, banishing monstrosities beyond mortal comprehension is as simple as 1-2-3!! In this turn-based tactics puzzle game, you lead a team of contractor ghost busters through a series of haunted houses, each with a different set of unidentified monstrosities.

5369050.name: Glowtide Isle
5369050.desc: Start a new life as a cat on a small, sleepy island. Fish, catch bugs, dig up fossils and decorate your home, then shape cliffs, rivers and paths your way. Befriend 24 animal neighbors, fill the museum and relight the old Tide Whistle, one cozy day at a time.

5101180.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
5101180.desc: 按下一個按鈕。立刻後悔。這是一款幾分鐘就能玩完的迷你類比恐怖喜劇，適合實況蒐集反應，也適合包裝成一場小小的背叛送給朋友。你要做的只有一件事：按按鈕。沒有漫長的冒險，也沒有任何灌水內容。最好什麼都別告訴朋友，只說這遊戲很短，叫對方戴上耳機並分享畫面，然後坐下來欣賞反應。之後發生的任何事情，我們都不負責。它很短、很壞，也非常適合檢驗友情。請謹慎送禮，祝你們好運。強烈建議佩戴耳機。至於友情，我們概不保證。

top.text:
Finally, a horror game that fits my attention span. One button, a few minutes, and some questionable life choices. Best experienced without spoilers, then gifted to a friend with a suspiciously innocent “trust me.”

Frie

As the name implies, the shortest horror game it is.

3280980.name: Mimic Alert
3280980.desc: 你在一支負責偵測並消滅擬態怪的部隊服役——擬態怪是一種能夠變成任何物體形態的生物。仔細檢查周圍環境，用盡你全部的專注力來發現它們。 與好友線上雙人合作，通關完整戰役。

4629050.name: Eric's Farm
4629050.desc: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

4118750.name: LWT American sunset - Southwestern Sexcapades
4118750.desc: Experience American Sunset: Southwestern Sexcapades — a massive DLC packed with new routes, sizzling scenes, and branching paths. Choose between Cuckold or Alpha dynamics, explore Vegas and the swingers club, and shape Tracy and Justin’s fate in thrilling, replayable ways.

1546080.name: 永不落敗 Every Day We Fight
1546080.desc: 雖然身陷時間循環，但這支反抗軍小隊是人類的最後希望。《永不落敗》融合了即時探索、回合制戰術與 Roguelite 策略。玩家將學習新技能，尋找新武器，發展新戰術，努力對抗神秘的外星威脅。

top.text:
我很少見的給出差評，但我覺得這遊戲值得我給這個評價

雖然這款的特色就是Rogue，但實際玩起來真的太痛苦了，度過了簡單的第一章之後就是糟糕體驗的開始
每次只要戰敗一次就是全部從頭打，對，全部從頭，包含地圖上的一些小戰鬥也會全部重置
會繼承的講白點就是只有你的角色天賦樹而已
然後正式版跟體驗版的難度上差異真的非常巨大，我可不記得一顆手雷就能直接轟400收掉一個人
而且手雷要炸到敵人根本天方夜譚吧，從頭到尾沒成功過，敵人跑得跟飛的一樣，而

【不推薦】成長感幾乎為零，時間線機制反而持續打擊玩家投入
玩到第一章結束後，我的基地依舊簡陋，武器還停留在初期的幾把低階裝備，角色實力幾乎沒有任何提升。敵人卻能用手雷輕鬆秒殺我，難度與成長完全不成比例。遊戲要求玩家有「藍波等級」的一挑多能力，但卻沒有給予對應的資源與命。

資源與成長系統的致命缺陷
我幾乎逛遍城市大半區域，總共只收集到約 5、600 廢料，但一個綠色品質的部件就要 300。這樣的資源量根本杯水車薪，讓人對藍色或紫色裝備完
這遊戲體驗挺不錯的,就是有點貴

5265110.name: Furry Snow Leopard
5265110.desc: Furry Snow Leopard 是一款充滿誘惑力的成人解謎遊戲，主角是一位迷人的雪豹少女。解鎖她最大膽的形象，欣賞火辣誘人的插畫，並一步步揭開她冰冷卻魅惑的目光背後所隱藏的一切。

top.text: Mass-producing low quality games is not good, especially with Ai

4799440.name: Matadors
4799440.desc: Matadors is a 3v1 game where farmers try to carry hay bales to the barn without getting caught by an angry bull. Set traps, wave flags, and use your stun gun to get back safely.

3488890.name: Sayaka: My Naughty Milf Neighbor
3488890.desc: Move in, settle down, and let Sayaka, your hot MILF neighbor, spoil you like never before! She’s warm, she’s caring, and she’s ready to make you feel very welcome. Will you resist her charms, or let her teach you a few thing about sex?

4347910.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe Upgrade
4347910.desc: 此為可在《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》內使用的道具套組，包含可將陸行鳥外觀變更為魔導裝甲的道具、可學會遊戲中隊友的極限技「地獄隕石」的道具與在遊戲初期可派上用場的道具。

top.text:
這個Dlc可以不用買了

我玩Demo花了約五個小時完成第一章，把所有角色和幻兵都升到上限，武器和防具都是第一章能獲得最好的。結果今天發售後，預購獎勵、早鳥購買獎勵包括豪華版內容都超廢！廢到笑XDD

而豪華版也就魔導裝甲之鑰和魔人的秘傳書，有那麼一~~~點點點用，可以改變陸行鳥和飛空艇外觀。剩下那些道具遊戲中就能獲得了。然後這豪華版要價520元。真的不值得買。

除非是為了那兩個外觀，否則真心不推薦。

5347940.name: 八字倖存者

5416010.desc: Break an infinite field of bricks in every direction. Every ring is a new level, every level unlocks a new chiptune track, and the shop turns one lonely ball into a storm of exploding, block-shredding chaos. Then zoom out. Forever.

5383020.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
5383020.desc: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

5383030.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
5383030.desc: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

5039290.name: Soul

This is a Visual Novel with some minor choices that change the dialogue a little. You progress through the story by clicking on the screen.

5206540.name: RUN Gor I Demo
5206540.desc: Are you capable of mastering your own body? Do you know what you need to eat? Move and build the protein your body needs before you run out of time. Face your dreams and obtain the necessary nutrients, avoid the monsters, and run. You are not alone.

5386060.name: Keep on Digging!
5386060.desc: 在 Keep on Digging 中挖出寶箱、收集戰利品，用金幣購買新技能和裝備，繼續挖掘。

4541170.name: Retro Pond
4541170.desc: 打造你夢想中的池塘，培育稀有魚類，與好友分享，並參加各種比賽

3905010.name: ONE PIECE 海洋盛宴
3905010.desc: 跟草帽一行人一起經營芭拉蒂2號店！ 從小船上揭幕的是專屬於您的海上餐廳。 收集食材開發新菜單、用室內裝飾隨心所欲裝潢店內…… 隨著提升餐廳的水準，這間店會成長得越來越充滿朝氣與活力，就連「那個角色」也有機會變成這裡的常客。 每當夥伴或常客增加，您的餐廳便會離大海上人人讚不絕口的店更邁進一步！ 「ONE PIECE」角色們大排長龍的海上餐廳，今日開業！

movies.name: 20260528_マルチ-ONE PIECE Clove ティザーPV_TC_ Fullbit_master

5385430.name: Тройной след: Пятый след (изображения)
5385430.desc: High-quality images used in the "Triple Trail: The Fifth Trail" expansion.

299950.name: GET EVEN
299950.desc: 深吸一口氣……試著去回想：一個女孩，一把椅子，一個炸彈。只要保持……冷靜。跟著聲音進入記憶深處。放鬆……尋找腦海最深處那些最黑暗的記憶。你能找到她嗎？時鍾正在滴答作響……這只是治療的一部分。

1072500.name: AO Tennis 2
1072500.desc: 《AO TENNIS 2》是唯一一個由社群為社群設計的網球體驗。設計屬於你自己的球員、體育館與傳奇比賽。在職涯模式中參加比賽，進軍世界網壇。

282470.name: Don't Starve: Reign of Giants
282470.desc: Don’t Starve: Reign of Giants is an expansion pack that adds new characters, seasons, creatures, biomes, and other challenges to Don’t Starve.The entire world of Don’t Starve has been expanded and is now even more uncompromising! New mysteries, challenges and scientific innovations await your discovery.

393010.name: Don't Starve: Shipwrecked
393010.desc: Sail to adventure through the treacherous seas of Don't Starve: Shipwrecked! With new playable characters, biomes, creatures and seasonal effects; Wilson and the whole Don’t Starve cast of characters embark on a sea-bound journey of exploration, adaptation and of course, starvation.

1248433.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ - Super Baby 2
1248433.desc: 可使用角色「超級貝比2」。 此外還包含此角色異色顏色、大廳角色、Ｚ貼圖等道具。

1315300.name: Megaquarium: Freshwater Frenzy - Deluxe Expansion
1315300.desc: Freshwater Frenzy is the first Deluxe Expansion for Megaquarium. Including dozens of new fish, tanks and decorations, not to mention a challenging freshwater-focused campaign! Discover everything the freshwater habitat has to offer in this fully loaded expansion!

3027840.name: 逸劍風雲決-坐騎擴展包：疾風駿影
3027840.desc: 【坐騎擴展包：疾風駿影】爲遊戲本體《逸劍風雲決》的擴展包，該擴展包包含6種坐騎。

992174.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ - Gogeta (SSGSS)
992174.desc: From his debut in the movie, Gogeta (SSGSS) now comes to DRAGON BALL FighterZ!

3615530.name: Soulstone Survivors: Supporter Pack
3615530.desc: 墮落支持者組合包為所有22位虛空獵人解鎖異變的全新造型，讓各位一探他們沉淪後的樣子。購買此DLC即是支持《靈魂石倖存者》持續開發。非常感謝！

5340370.name: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
5340370.desc: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.

2060870.name: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
2060870.desc: Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.

1267540.name: WRC 9 FIA World Rally Championship
1267540.desc: 《WRC》是頂尖越野模擬遊戲系列。帶著前所未有的逼真遊戲體驗與更多內容回歸：3 項新拉力賽、35 個全新特別賽段、建立屬於自己的自訂錦標賽，以及完全重新設計的引擎音效。

544750.name: SOULCALIBUR VI
544750.desc: “由最強劍豪奏曲，光與闇的起點” SOULCALIBUR20週年的最新作品隆重登場！ 親自體會武器格鬥動作遊戲巔峰的絢麗畫質呈現的全新刀劍交鋒故事！

617480.name: 時光之塔
617480.desc: 一款全新RPG遊戲在等待著你。在這款劇情豐富的地下城探險遊戲中你將體驗到奇特的全新遊戲戰鬥，能夠允許你隨時暫停或使用子彈時間。只有深思熟慮才能迎來成功。新增的RPG精簡模式以及永久死亡模式將為你帶來更為酷炫的體驗。

2139460.name: Once Human
2139460.desc: 《Once Human》是一款怪奇世界生存遊戲，遊戲發生在一個怪誕的末日世界中，你需要和好友並肩為了生存資源而戰，建造你們的家園領地，並一起戰勝恐怖的未知，揭露世界淪陷的真相。曾經，你是人類中的一份子。現在，你仍是嗎？

5120560.name: ERA-ming（时代：明末）
5120560.desc: 这个游戏是我使用AI编写的，最大特色应该算是可以使用自然语言进行指令，进行游戏，不过游戏目前还只能算是有个主体框架，就像简介里说的，游戏还缺少大量素材使游戏丰满起来，当前的文本模式说实话还是有点乏味。如果有朋友有兴趣可以访问网站，来这里创建各类素材将游戏丰满起来。甚至可以在这里获取游戏代码，回去做重新创作。steam中的游戏包中有完整的可运行程序，可通过按钮和自然语言进行游戏。 官方网站在游戏压缩包中存在，访问官网后，您可以在剧本，素材等页面创建游戏相关文件，在代码页面看到本游戏的代码，游戏页面可以找到游戏压缩包，所以你想做点什么？ 欢迎您的加入。

3121930.name: Dimon - The Witch's Pervert Assistant
3121930.desc: Dimon, brutal freelancer and all-time pervert, is now working as a witch assistant after the previous one disappeared due to mysterious circumstances…and little does everyone know about his twisted plan.

5382570.name: Rêverie: Audio Stories
5382570.desc: Close your eyes, listen, and choose. Rêverie brings you illustrated audio stories where your choices change the ending. Two free stories: a king's messenger on a stormy medieval night, and a fairy tale full of songs for young and old. No ads.

2882840.name: Pinhead Adventures
2882840.desc: Pinhead Adventures is the debut title from Neversold Play as Pinhead and Orbo, upgrade and explore dense worlds filled with action and puzzles Fight back Zortan's hordes of Spikers, Spitters, Swoopers, and Spods Board his ship for the final confrontation. Who will experience the space beyond time?

5371940.name: One Must Fall 2197: Singularity
5371940.desc: A free 1v1 robot fighting game: the 1994 classic One Must Fall 2097, rebuilt in HD. 21 giant robots, 15 arenas, a Tournament career with a mech lab, Arcade, Training, and versus on one PC or online with Steam friends. Fight with supers and EX moves, or switch to the original rules.

movies.name: One Must Fall 2197: Singularity - Gameplay Trailer

4761550.name: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD
4761550.desc: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD 是一款充滿氛圍的第一人稱遊戲，將路邊便利商店的日常工作、超自然事件、心理恐怖元素與黑色幽默融為一體。

4433100.name: 來自異界的初戀手機
4433100.desc: If she’s truly gone… Then who is answering the phone?

5289260.name: GRID OPS
5289260.desc: Premium, single-player open-world extraction shooter set in a San Francisco warzone. Scout with UAV radar, hijack vehicles, take a combat helicopter armed with minigun and missiles, clear hostile territory, and reach extraction alive.

5263610.name: 101 Cats: Frankfurt
5263610.desc: 加入這場冒險，在精心打造的法蘭克福風景中，尋找101隻小貓咪🐾的藏身之處。 🏆贏取眾多成就。你能找到多少隻呢？ 😺快來抓緊時間！ ⏱️

movies.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in Frankfurt - PLAY NOW!

3558150.name: Duckpool
3558150.desc: A rubber duck. Lasers. Bathroom chaos. Duckpool is a challenging top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Blast bizarre enemies, dodge traps, defeat bosses, and escape with your soap. Build a flock of 150 ducks and uncover the mystery behind the bubbles.

5028320.name: Amazecards
5028320.desc: 規劃每一步行動，帶領尋寶法師完成30個充滿挑戰的解謎關卡！巧妙使用卡牌，躲避陷阱與障礙，在森林、沙漠和地牢中尋找通往寶藏的正確道路。

5315360.name: Watershed
5315360.desc: Rain on real terrain and watch the rivers run. Drain the oceans to the Ice Age and the Persian Gulf becomes a valley. Roll the atlas back to 3000 BC, then send a caravan across what remains. An educational sandbox on real elevation data, with its sources on every layer.

5329870.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
5329870.desc: 你的塗鴉就是你的鬥士！畫一個角色，看它在擊飛系派對對戰中大顯身手。畫的大小、形狀和顏色會決定能力值和30種屬性技能中的一種。同螢幕最多4人對戰、挑戰CPU，或在線上排位賽中與來自世界各地的塗鴉一較高下！

5347100.name: Deeper Than Gold
5347100.desc: Descend into an endless crypt alone or with up to three friends. Fight goblin hordes across five biomes and their bosses, stack relics and blessings, and decide when to turn back – gold only counts once you get it out alive. How deep will you go?

5190860.name: TetraCore
5190860.desc: Spin, move, and rotate your central core to catch tetrominos rushing from all four sides. Fill and clear rings to drive up your score multiplier, survive the increasing speed, and challenge a friend in local split-screen!

3558100.name: Eyes On Me
3558100.desc: Live a girls life while being stalked by a serial killer with an insteresting sexual fantasy. Can you reveal the story without completely shitting yourself?

5239320.name: Lust of Rome
5239320.desc: 你擁有一所角鬥士學校。白天為競技場訓練三位美麗的女人，夜晚召她們到你的房間，並追求因你的名聲而登門的羅馬名門女子。一款為六位女性全都準備了性愛場景的3D成人視覺小說。

5443850.name: No One Left To Die Demo

5222980.name: Renz Soccer Sim
5222980.desc: Build your squad, develop players, manage your club, and watch every match unfold in this 2D soccer management simulator. Chase trophies and build a dynasty.

2906990.desc: *MoonTraum* is a fishing game set in a mysterious dream world. Lost in a world where dreams take the form of fish, you meet Welt, a cat fisherman, and begin your fishing adventure. Catch uniquely designed fish and complete your collection!

5303370.name: Suspencil
5303370.desc: 一款結合繪畫與身分推理、最多支援8人的線上派對遊戲。根據題目作畫，透過畫作與討論，找出唯一拿到不同題目的「狼人」。還可加入「狂人」：在別人的畫上塗鴉，暗中幫助狼人獲勝。即使被投票找出，狼人也能透過猜中平民的題目逆轉獲勝。

3841050.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
3841050.desc: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters EN

4748140.name: MatchMaker95 - A Programming Simulator
4748140.desc: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit — all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

4025380.name: They Come in Fives
4025380.desc: You are the Reaper on Lucifer's payroll. Hand over souls, keep the bodies. Build an army of empty vessels on Earth, then risk them all in brutal permadeath runs through Hell. Overthrow the Boss. Claim the Throne.

287390.name: 戰慄深隧：最後曙光 重製版
287390.desc: 時間來到2034年。在末日後的莫斯科廢墟地底，倖存的人類面臨無所不在的生命威脅，這些危險不僅源自外頭，也來自內部。變異怪物在荒涼地表下的墓穴中伺機而動，並在有毒的天空中狩獵。

393520.name: Iconoclasts
393520.desc: 和叛逆機械師Robin壹起揭開瀕死行星的秘密。這款華麗的平臺動作遊戲讓妳探索充滿謎題的世界，和有趣的角色互動並挑戰精心設計的BOSS戰，感受關於目標、信仰和嘗試幫助他人的故事。

389730.name: TEKKEN 7
389730.desc: 體驗三島家長久爭戰的精彩結局。以Unreal Engine 4打造，一代格鬥遊戲傳奇在此回歸，並帶來令人屏息的精彩劇情、高潮迭起的戰鬥，並且能與好友勁敵們一起享受創新緊張的刺激戰鬥。

613100.name: 房產達人
613100.desc: 《房產達人》是成為一人裝修小組的獨一無二機會。購買、整修、改造毀壞的房屋。賦予它們新的生命，並銷售獲利！

1462810.name: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship
1462810.desc: 在評論家及專業車手的萬眾矚目下，標準設定的模擬越野賽車已改頭換面！登上2021賽季的領獎台，慶祝競賽50週年，重溫傳奇車種過去的精采瞬間。《WRC》前所未有的刺激體驗！快來迎接挑戰吧！

899440.name: GOD EATER 3

678950.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ

4773930.name: 君临传奇之风起云涌
4773930.desc: 江湖将乱，风云已动！经典复古高爆国战版传奇，专为兄弟情义与热血厮杀而生！不氪金照样封神，不将就才能称王。极品装备、绝世武学全凭实力爆出，BOSS越狠，爆得越疯，捡到你手软！ 战鼓擂响，屠龙在手，兄弟们整装待发——攻沙、夺城、君临天下！

2552310.name: 莎拉的黑店
2552310.desc: 《莎拉的黑店》是一款輕松休閑的回合製策略管理遊戲。你將扮演主角「莎拉」，經營一家名為「地下城旅館」的旅館。這家旅館位於地下城入口，專門服務兩個敵對的冤家公會。拜托！沒有人會拒絕賺錢的機會吧？只要不被他們發現就行！你的目標是在一年內成功經營旅館，實現財富自由！

5359780.name: 象棋
5359780.desc: Enjoy Chinese chess in an ink-wash setting. Play against an offline opponent or a friend on the same device, learn through interactive lessons and endgame challenges, review game records, and create your own positions.

5069390.name: Hentai Tales: Humanoid Doll
5069390.desc: 多年積蓄之後，我終於帶回了入門款陪伴型機械女僕「綿綿」。 然而，一場故障打亂了我平凡的日常，並為我帶來了一份秘密補償：擁有故障連線的頂級「狂野」原型機「薇歐拉」。 我踏入機械女僕與非尋常親密關係世界的旅程，就此展開。

4815730.name: Kurdistan Simulator
4815730.desc: Kurdistan Simulator 是一款實驗性的步行模擬遊戲，背景是一個並不存在的國家的空曠大地。當你在這片只存在於某人想像中的虛無裡漫遊時，你會發現無事可做……直到你找到隱藏的驚喜。

5221020.name: Fitz's Aim Trainer
5221020.desc: An FPS aim trainer that runs natively on Mac and Windows. 30 default excercises along custom excercise creation. There is a ranked benchmark mode ranging from Mortal to Omnipotent, global leaderboards and custom excercise sharing. Made by one person who just wanted an aim trainer for Mac.

5263600.name: 101 Cats: San Francisco
5263600.desc: 加入這場冒險，在精心打造的舊金山風景中，尋找101隻小貓咪🐾的藏身之處。 🏆贏取眾多成就。你能找到多少隻呢？ 😺快來抓緊時間！ ⏱️

movies.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in San Francisco - PLAY NOW!

5377090.name: Dealer's Choice
5377090.desc: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

5403390.name: Super Clown Save Santa
5403390.desc: 2.5d Platformer where you control Super Clown. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and enemy bee and Save Santa Claus and Save Christmas

5132600.name: Touwers: Defend the Realm
5132600.desc: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

4435490.name: 決勝時刻®：現代戰爭® 4
4435490.desc: 在《決勝時刻®：現代戰爭® 4》中，朝鮮半島爆發戰爭，北韓發動全面入侵，世界局勢瀕臨失控。

441380.name: PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2
441380.desc: The much-awaited sequel to PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION! Featuring eye-popping 3D graphics and funky visuals! New modes include Score Attack and an Adventure mode!

movies.name: PAC-MAN Championship Edition 2 - Double PAC-MAN Madness!

775500.name: 緋紅結繫
775500.desc: 此為以腦部與科技蓬勃發展的世界為舞台，可以置身體驗運用自身「念力」與夥伴們的形形色色力量戰鬥的超腦力動作，以及採用雙主角視角描寫的扎實故事劇情的「超腦力動作RPG」

331600.name: One Piece Pirate Warriors 3
331600.desc: 從佛夏村到神秘的德雷斯羅薩，如實呈現《航海王》的原版劇情。你有堅定的決心，可以打敗多佛朗明哥和其他史上最危險的海賊嗎？

movies.name: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 3 - 3 Brothers Trailer
One Piece: Pirate Warriors 3 - Dressrosa Trailer ESRB

1082430.name: Before Your Eyes
1082430.desc: 展開一段扣人心弦的第一人稱敘事冒險遊戲，你將透過實際的眨眼，操控劇情走向，並影響結局。這種創新的操作方式，將讓你完全沉浸在悲喜交加的回憶世界中，同時在你眼前閃過一生。

movies.name: BEFORE YOUR EYES - Announce Trailer TC
Before Your Eyes - The Art of Blinking TC

1163550.name: 隊長小翼 新秀崛起
1163550.desc: 「隊長小翼 新秀崛起」是以至今依然飽受世界喜愛的動畫作品「隊長小翼」為題材，加上符合現代風格的影像水準，讓所有人都能簡單施展超級球技的足球動作遊戲。

compare.en: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions

743450.name: Monster Prom
743450.desc: You have 3 weeks to get a date for Monster Prom! Go through absurd and funny situations, raise your stats and seduce one of your classmates. Beautiful art, bold, unapologetic dialogue and hard choices make up this Multiplayer (1-4 players) Dating Sim. Be your worst self.

1140270.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
1140270.desc: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

219740.name: 饑荒
219740.desc: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

755500.name: ONE PIECE World Seeker
755500.desc: 「好了，要從哪開始冒險呢！」 登上前所未見的獨特島嶼，讓您全心享受「一個大冒險」的動作冒險遊戲登場！ 化身為魯夫，解開島上隱藏的種種謎團吧。

1859470.name: 吃豆人 吃遍世界
1859470.desc: 冒險的舞台是「幽靈之島」。為了從邪惡機器人「Toc-Man」手中拯救被綁架的PAC-MAN一家人，PAC-MAN的冒險即將啟程。

dlc.name: 吃豆人 吃遍世界 超合金PAC-MAN（Chrome Noir）
吃豆人 吃遍世界 點歌機

1089090.name: ONE PIECE 海賊無雙4
1089090.desc: 在『ONE PIECE：海賊無雙4』躍入前所未有的『ONE PIECE』世界！對龐大的敵軍不斷打出破壞力超群的攻擊，在充滿爆發力的動作冒險當中重現動畫的名場面吧。震撼的視覺效果、高速的戰鬥體驗、粉絲喜愛的角色們齊聚一堂，這就是究極的「海賊無雙」體驗。

848350.name: Katamari Damacy REROLL
848350.desc: 操縱王子，一邊滾動塊一邊黏住各種物體，讓塊越來越大──新鮮感翻騰的動作遊戲。

552590.name: The Sexy Brutale
552590.desc: The Sexy Brutale — a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult! Relive the same mysterious day where the guests at the casino mansion are being murdered by the staff over and over again...

1062810.name: Inkbound
1062810.desc: A turn-based tactical roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Play solo or co-op, create powerful builds, and save the Atheneum.

dlc.name: Inkbound - Supporter Pack: Rise of the Unbound
Inkbound - Supporter Pack: The Starship of Terrors
Inkbound - Supporter Pack: The Story Begins

454650.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2
454650.desc: 知名的DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE推出續作──DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2。 畫面表現提升後的DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2，將帶領你進入史上最龐大、最多彩的七龍珠世界。

movies.name: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 - Fly Through Time

429570.name: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries
429570.desc: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries stars the iconic, blade-wielding character from Robert Kirkman's best-selling comic books.

movies.name: The Walking Dead: Michonne - Launch Trailer
The Walking Dead: Michonne - Behind The Scenes

compare.en: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries

2537470.name: 疫區檔案
2537470.desc: 致敬90年代生存恐怖經典《惡靈古堡》。深入被封鎖的死城，面對令人窒息的孤立與嗜血的畸變怪物。拼湊散落破碎的真相，在資源極度匱乏的博弈中步步為營。在這裡，每一顆子彈都是奢侈的希望。當退路封死、彈盡糧絕，唯有最冷靜的大腦，才能在絕境中計算出一線生機。

movies.name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death - Release date teaser  TC

4336790.name: Cyan Soul
4336790.desc: An arcade style, pixel art, boss-rush puzzle action game. Move your character up, down, right and left! Dash through enemy attacks and obstacles! Pick up objects and hurl them at the boss to cause damage! Gather enough points and unleash max damage with a powerful projectile or form!

3954920.name: Saving Songburg™
3954920.desc: Saving Songburg™ is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!

5330340.name: Bunny Coming
5330340.desc: 一款與兔女郎女僕「水無瀨露娜」一起享受故事的視覺小說遊戲。透過流暢的Live2D動畫，體驗與她的對話、可愛的互動，以及各種略帶刺激的情境。

5020970.name: STRIKEM
5020970.desc: Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI.

5377190.name: Halloweenies Candy Run
5377190.desc: Trick-or-treat with up to 4 players. Loot the houses on procedurally generated streets. Find rare physics based candy and bank it before the Candy KPI catches up with you. Buy weapons and abilities to help your odds against the horde. Your friends can hear proximity chat, but so can the hunters.

3923150.name: Climb King
3923150.desc: Climb. Fall. Repeat. A high-stakes pixel-art climbing game with grab-and-swing movement, harsh drops, and “safe points” that aren’t as safe as you’d like.

4607890.name: AICOMI APPEND DATA
4607890.desc: Power up your Aicomi experience with this supplemental data pack!

5406050.name: Bunny Bun
5406050.desc: 你是實驗人員 賓尼 賓，為了研發「智慧藥水」，你把你的天賦帶到這家藥水實驗室。 你必須處理原材料，透過合成材料，製造特殊的藥水效果。 為了測試藥水效果，你可以喝一口，感受一下藥水的奧妙。 社會處於動盪時期，你能夠運用你的才能，改變世界嗎？

5013160.name: Hubble Bubble
5013160.desc: 1-4 位好友的合作水煙店模擬遊戲。在太空站經營 Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge：裝好煙碗、燒好炭、招待外星人，然後假裝一切正常。這座太空站上，沒有什麼是正常的。

5124790.name: Strip Bubbles: A night in the City
5124790.desc: Match, pop, and reveal! Unwind with this seductive anime bubble shooter beneath the neon glow of the Midnight District. Meet 4 gorgeous girls in their private spots, collect their wardrobe, and choose your path through interactive reward trees and hot endings.

5335510.name: Moon Sweepers
5335510.desc: 整個月球等你打掃，開局只有一把牙刷。與好友組成最多16人的清潔小隊，收集並販售月塵，升級工具，解鎖清潔載具。把這份荒唐的工作變成蒸蒸日上的事業，前提是你的朋友真的肯幫忙。

5384900.name: A Cruise for Murder
5384900.desc: A 3D modern remake of the classic Cruise for a Corpse, along with original music, different plot and 15 puzzles.

3855160.name: Vampire Girl - The Fallen Vampire -
3855160.desc: Yuri, once a princess of the vampire clan, had been relentlessly pursuing the vampire hunter who killed her parents. While living as an adventurer to hide her true identity, she travels to the town of Arteheim in search of clues, but…!?

4006760.name: Desktop Taxi
4006760.desc: A cozy idle taxi sim with Lofi beats. Grow your taxi business quietly in the corner of your screen while you work.

5179420.name: Project Screams
5179420.desc: Project Screams is a 1-8 player online co-op horror game. Memorize the Daycare, spot the anomalies, and make the right call by voting to progress. Miss an anomaly or make the wrong decision, and you'll be sent back to your checkpoint. How far can you make it?

1069690.name: Rogue Lords
1069690.desc: 在黑暗奇幻的類 rogue 遊戲中扮演魔鬼！ 經由不同事件與回合制戰鬥來領導著名的邪惡天才，散佈恐懼與腐敗。在你的門徒之間建立綜效，使用你的邪惡力量對那些可悲的惡魔獵手進行報復。

3837960.name: The Story of Noah
3837960.desc: Welcome to the captivating world of "The Story of Noah" — a journey for you and your children into ancient times and one of the most inspiring stories of the Holy Scriptures! Step into the role of Noah — the man chosen to build an ark and save his family and all animals from the great flood.

5232660.name: Terminal Dice
5232660.desc: Terminal Dice is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder played with physical dice. Roll your hand, spend limited OPS to alter results, then arrange dice in an ordered buffer and compile a score. Win encounters to rewrite die faces, shape your build, and break rule-changing bosses.

3860760.name: One Week Away
3860760.desc: 一部提供紳士與主導人格路線選擇的成人動態視覺小說。在為期8天的旅程中塑造對話與親密場景，決定懷孕結局，贏得兩個完整結局之一。

3129420.name: ASPIS
3129420.desc: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.

5197690.name: Endless FPV
5197690.desc: Fly fast, react on the fly, and master an endless FPV course that changes every run. Mix course segments from themed decks, build your own custom deck, and customize your drone to match your flying style.

5376710.name: CloudBurst
5376710.desc: Pilot a heavy airship through a sea of clouds, pull alongside your rivals and fire broadsides. Drift out of the storm and you sink. Up to ten captains over LAN or Steam, six modes, three kinds of terrain, and bots to fill every empty seat.

4758090.name: Select Eleven
4758090.desc: A single-player, text-based cricket management game. Scout signings, develop players and pick your eleven. Run one of 160 clubs across seven nations through T20 leagues, 50-over cups, promotion, relegation and global club tournaments.

movies.name: One Ball. Your Call.  Gameplay Trailer

5251070.name: Want a Bomb?
5251070.desc: 獨自出發，或與夥伴組成最多4人的線上隊伍，炸開群山，尋找太陽寶石！在這場第一人稱合作冒險中，出售礦石、研究並升級炸彈與裝備，挑戰島上的怪物。從引線引發的連環爆炸，到能把朋友也發射出去的發射器，用各種瘋狂工具開闢自己的道路吧。

5358500.name: Revving: Engine Simulator
5358500.desc: 親手發動、催油門、換檔，駕馭 19 具引擎：從 Harley 的 V 型雙缸到 F1 賽車的 BRM H16，每一具都以 3D 在你眼前運轉。每個聲音都根據模擬的引擎物理即時運算，包括活塞、汽門、進排氣流動與每個汽缸的燃燒，沒有錄音，也沒有循環音檔。離合器、油門、煞車搭配 H 型排檔桿，忘了踩離合器就會打齒；也能用序列式換檔或交給自排。支援鍵盤、滑鼠與遊戲手把，類比扳機控制油門與煞車。Honda B18C5 與 Chevrolet 454 免費提供。

4873550.name: BudMageddon
4873550.desc: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

5262070.name: AUREUS GEMWORKS ― リリトリオンの宝石工場
5262070.desc: Build a gem factory, one card at a time. Combine factory automation with deckbuilding as you mine, refine, transport and ship precious gems. Work with an eccentric crew in the abyss and meet the demands of Lilitryon, your gold-loving supervisor.

4348500.name: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition - Prologue
4348500.desc: 將破舊受損的家具重新變為精美的傑作。打磨、噴漆、拋光，享受輕鬆的修復過程。體驗免費的序章內容，開啟你翻新工作室的第一步。

5300960.name: KEEP IT ON HER
5300960.desc: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

movies.name: KEEP IT ON HER — Gameplay Trailer v004
KEEP IT ON HER — The Six Regulars (Explainer)

5204200.name: Companion OS
5204200.desc: A customizable 3D AI companion that lives on your desktop. Chat, talk, play mini-games, listen to music, use useful tools, and choose between cloud or local AI.

3711910.name: Cursebound
3711910.desc: A story-rich action adventure where you play as a god walking among humans to break a deadly curse. Explore a stylized world blending 2D pixel art and 3D low-poly landscapes, face colossal bosses, master an elemental form, and test your limits in Endless Mode.

5312590.name: A Secret Stay With : Isabella
5312590.desc: Step inside an exclusive private residence with Isabella, your captivating host. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with intimate, seductive reveals.

5331220.name: A Sweet Date With : Freesia
5331220.desc: Embark on a sensual honeybee-hunting adventure with Freesia, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Freesia's enticing layers.

movies.name: A Sweet Date With Freesia - Trailer

4428060.name: Sex & Fast Food
4428060.desc: Manage a high-octane fast food empire by day, and explore explicit, choice-driven adult narratives by night. Hire a unique staff, customize your restaurant, and unlock intimate encounters in this unapologetically mature 18+ business simulator. Can you handle the heat?

5247390.name: Licensed to Love: Airi
5247390.desc: Licensed to Love: Airi is a short adult retro-style visual novel about joining a relationship training agency and learning what happens when practice starts to feel real.

5318870.name: V-Buddy UltraDeluxe
5318870.desc: VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever! Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

5359010.name: Halloween Fair: Tidy Up Together
5359010.desc: A little spooky. A lot to tidy. 2048 halloween items to be exact. Bring order to a moonlit Halloween fair in this cozy cleanup game for up to 4 players. Sort scattered decorations, earn festival sparks, and unlock upgrades that help the whole team turn a giant mess into a job well done.

2859750.name: Killer Santa 1990
2859750.desc: Step into a chilling 1990s horror story. After returning to your late grandfather's old house, you uncover missing people, a cursed DVD, and a murderous Santa Claus hunting you down.

fullgame.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest

4467800.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack
4467800.desc: 加入你最喜愛的《貓戰士》部族，探索各個領地，並與經典角色互動。

3960600.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
3960600.desc: 在一場以深受喜愛的《貓戰士》系列小說為靈感、身歷其境的動作冒險中，創造屬於你自己的貓戰士，並在湖區領地中展開旅程。狩獵、探索、與敵對部族戰鬥、揭開預言，並透過你做出的每個選擇，塑造屬於你的傳奇。

compare.en: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest

dlc.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack

4800650.name: 7 Millimeters
4800650.desc: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

5054950.name: I'm Your Boss, Olivia!
5054950.desc: I'm Your Boss, Olivia! - This is a visual novel where you take on the role of the boss of a company where a lustful employee named Olivia works. Office challenges, funny jokes, and lots of sex await you.

3669620.name: 战锤幸存者
3669620.desc: 《戰鎚倖存者》由《Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun》開發團隊打造，是一款官方授權的暗黑風彈幕倖存遊戲。操控超過 40 名來自《Warhammer 40,000》與《Warhammer Age of Sigmar》宇宙的經典角色，殲滅一切信奉死亡與毀滅之徒。

22600.name: Worms Reloaded
22600.desc: Ten years on from Worms™ Armageddon and the turn-based comic mayhem continues in Worms™ Reloaded, an all-new edition available for PC through Steam.

200170.name: Worms Revolution
200170.desc: Worms™ Revolution is the latest game in the classic turn-based strategy series to come to the PC.

70600.name: Worms Ultimate Mayhem
70600.desc: Load your weapons and experience a whole new dimension in destructive turn-based cartoon action!

3892270.name: Gamble With Your Friends
3892270.desc: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

5284710.name: SHAME
5284710.desc: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

4100790.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
4100790.desc: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

4626420.name: Real Life Simulator
4626420.desc: 與朋友一起攀登商業巔峰！買賣二手商品，建立汽車展廳，掌控房地產市場，並擁有城市裡最大的企業。《Real Life Simulator》將所有商業貿易模擬融合在一個2D合作世界中。

3168520.name: BloomTale
3168520.desc: BloomTale 是一款溫馨的花店經營模擬遊戲，結合創意與店鋪管理。設計美麗的花藝作品、經營店鋪，並在萬物皆有機會綻放的魔法世界中滿足顧客需求。

4438170.name: Riskline
4438170.desc: Riskline is a multiplayer game about risk, greed, and outplaying your rivals. Spin slots, bet on roulette, challenge other players to duels, grab limited items, and decide when to cash out. Whoever hides the most money in the bank by the end of the match wins.

5271360.name: ChessGuardians
5271360.desc: 在挑戰想像力的棋盤上對弈——從古典辦公室到全息與末日廢土。迎戰風格各異的引擎與變體玩法,匯入你的對局,與數百萬玩家同場競技。你熟悉的西洋棋,以你從未想像過的方式呈現。

2428110.name: Who Invited You?
2428110.desc: Some of your party guests were never invited. They look like your friends, answer to their names, and behave exactly the same. Photos, messages and phone calls are the only proof. Find them before the night ends — alone or with up to three friends.

4866750.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
4866750.desc: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

3844750.name: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR
3844750.desc: FlatOut 4: Total Insanity VR is destructive arcade racing at windshield distance. Trade paint, survive pileups, and fly through the windshield when the impact hits. Race across remastered FlatOut 2 tracks, wreck rivals online, and fight to finish with your car still moving.

movies.name: Flatout 4 Total Insanity VR | FULL LAUNCH UPDATE!

5204250.name: 模拟穿越-三国
5204250.desc: 穿越到群雄并起的汉末，你不是开局便号令天下的主公，而是从小卒、文吏或斥候起步的无名之人。结识会记住承诺、恩情与背叛的历史人物，完成上官任务，献上计策，积累军功与治绩，在复杂的人脉和官场中争取升迁。你可以招募亲随、经营私人部曲、组建攻城军团、治理城池、发展势力科技，也能求亲成婚、经营家庭，或在时机成熟时举旗自立。每推进一个月，战争、调任、疾病、背叛和天下大势都会继续演变；你的选择不仅决定自己的仕途，也可能让熟悉的三国历史走向另一条道路。

4132960.name: Little Ghosties
4132960.desc: Little Ghosties is a cozy 2D idle desktop companion game where adorable ghosts live inside a terrarium on your desktop. Hatch, raise, and collect unique ghosts as they grow from eggs into fully grown adult ghosts.

5169900.name: DODGE GAME
5169900.desc: Dodge relentless enemy swarms, build score-multiplying combos, and unleash devastating powers in a fast-paced arcade survival game. Conquer evolving arenas, defeat intense bosses, and climb the leaderboards.

5316540.name: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
5316540.desc: 不知是什麼東西把這間溫馨的萬聖節小店弄得一團糟。把南瓜、魔法藥水和糖果放回原位，找出奇特的線索，認識一位神祕的新朋友。這是一款輕鬆的第一人稱整理遊戲，帶有一點淘氣的趣味。

2704900.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind
2704900.desc: Uncover the dark secrets of Prague's Bohnice Asylum. As an investigative journalist, you must document forbidden experiments and chilling paranormal encounters. Collect photographic evidence and survive the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

5008900.name: 《決勝時刻》捐助計畫（C.O.D.E.）英勇組合包
5008900.desc: 適用於《決勝時刻®：現代戰爭® 4》和《決勝時刻®：現代戰域™》的《決勝時刻》捐助計畫（C.O.D.E.）英勇組合包，以美國海軍陸戰隊退伍軍人Kyle Carpenter的經歷為靈感，並與他密切合作打造。

4936170.name: Alien or Duck!
4936170.desc: A fast-paced alien sports arcade game! Take control of cosmic saucers, dodge dangerous obstacles, and kick a giant beach ball into your opponent's zone. Fire chaotic magic balls—fire, lightning, and fog—to sabotage your friends in multiplayer or conquer the Single Player Championship!

4486370.name: Banana Life Sim
4486370.desc: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

5322590.name: Railwright
5322590.desc: Design and build your own rail vehicles, lay the tracks they run on, drive your creations, haul cargo, and develop new technology in an open-ended railway engineering sandbox.

5188640.name: Pancake! No break!
5188640.desc: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

3659190.name: TechRunners
3659190.desc: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

5295360.name: DODGE GAME Soundtrack
5295360.desc: Experience the DODGE GAME soundtrack, featuring over 45 original tracks created exclusively for the game. Relive the intensity of every run, from overwhelming hordes and epic boss fights to reality-breaking encounters.

5038160.name: SQUIRT GAME 💦
5038160.desc: 你自願捲入這場瘋狂的鬧劇，如今卻發現自己已經深陷其中。現在，你成了一檔大膽成人實境秀的明星。運用手段、誘惑你的性競爭對手，贏得最終大獎。讓我們盡情狂歡吧！🐙💦

4863300.name: SLICEFALL
4863300.desc: A reflex-puzzle game about stacking narrowing blocks until one falls down. Precision timing keeps your blocks wide, while filling rows clears space and boosts your score. Adapt your strategy across various game modes while utilizing power-ups and changing up color palettes.

5364900.name: Abax
5364900.desc: A Classic Board Game Experience , Original Game design and mechanics should be engaging and challenging even for the most experienced board game enthusiast. Utilizing a Dice Roll Mechanic for all actions so even the most well planned strategy may fall apart.

5247790.name: DenimDoug_909
5247790.desc: Follow Denim, a blue dog, on a bizarre adventure filled with strange characters, unexpected choices, and plenty of random outcomes. This animated FMV point-and-click game features 20+ different endings, and every choice can lead somewhere unexpected!

5461140.name: Anti-Human: Arcade [New Belleville Demo]
5461140.desc: Drop into the arena, score as much points as possible by hacking, slashing, shooting and casting while dodging enemy fire and performing stylish kills. Prove your worth, test your skill, and do not forget the most important step: Show off your high score to everyone in ANTI-HUMAN: ARCADE!

2849490.name: 物質世界2：遠征
2849490.desc: 《物質世界2：遠征》是一款融合生存、探索與硬核戰鬥的開放世界ARPG。在這裡你不是天命之子，而是必須步步為營，對抗饑寒、管理背包並在戰前做好萬全規劃的普通冒險者。前路嚴酷且未知，但每一次死裡逃生都將化為成長的養分。背起行囊，踏出城牆！一場足以讓你銘記的凡人史詩正等你啟程！

movies.name: Explore Aurai - Open Beta Trailer TC

770390.name: Draugen
770390.desc: Draugen is a single-player, first-person Fjord Noir mystery set in 1920s Norway. Explore a forgotten coastal village in your search for your missing sister, accompanied by your independent and enigmatic young ward. Norwegian Game of the Year 2019.

22670.name: Alien Breed 3: Descent
22670.desc: Experience the final explosive chapter in the Alien Breed series and uncover the horrifying truth surrounding the existence of the Breed. Launch discount good thru Nov. 24 10am PST.

4764930.name: Master of Command - The Lion & Eagle
4764930.desc: The Lion & Eagle DLC adds two new playable nations to Master of Command: Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Command new armies, doctrines, reforms, units, regions, encounters, music, officer traits, items, and flag emblems as you march under the Swedish lion or the Commonwealth eagle.

391220.name: Rise of the Tomb Raider™
391220.desc: 「Rise of the Tomb Raider：歡慶 20 週年」方案包括基本遊戲和內含全新內容的 Season Pass。玩家可在新的「血濃於水」(Blood Ties) 故事中探索卡芙特莊園，並在「蘿拉夢魘」(Lara’s Nightmare) 中保衛家園，抵禦喪屍入侵。

movies.name: ROTTR Make Your Mark PEGI ENG

8000.name: Tomb Raider: Anniversary
8000.desc: Tomb Raider: Anniversary retraces Lara Croft's original genre-defining adventure  globe-trotting 3rd person action-adventure in pursuit of the legendary Scion artifact. Using an enhanced 'Tomb Raider: Legend' game engine, the graphics, technology and physics bring Lara's adventure and pursuit of a mystical artifact known only as the...

8140.name: Tomb Raider: Underworld
8140.desc: Tomb Raider: Underworld represents a new advancement in exploration-based gameplay. As fearless adventurer Lara Croft explore exotic locations around the world, each designed with an incredible attention to detail resulting in breathtaking high-definition visual fidelity that creates a truly believable world and delivers a new level of...

movies.name: Tomb Raider: Underworld - Beneath the Sea Gameplay Trailer
Tomb Raider: Underworld - Mexico Gameplay Trailer

7000.name: Tomb Raider: Legend
7000.desc: Follow Lara Croft down a path of discovery as she travels the globe to remote, exotic locales in search of one of history's greatest artifacts, that unleashes unwelcome figures from Lara's mysterious past.

4690300.name: 奴隸公主艾爾妮婭
4690300.desc: 在這款RPG中，你將扮演曾經的公主、如今卻淪為奴隸的艾爾妮婭。為了復仇，她必須一步一步重新爬回頂點。你可以透過在帝國的市民面前忍受羞辱和深入危險的地下城戰鬥冒險兩種方式來賺錢。你能一直堅守身為公主的尊嚴嗎？

5293100.name: 無光回響
5293100.desc: 《無光回響》是一款深海題材的倖存者肉鴿。你將引導一顆光核，在沒有陽光的深海裡不斷下沉。環繞光核的共生體會自動攻擊靠近的怪物，你負責走位躲避、收集光點升級，挑選詞條構築流派。光核越亮，視野和射程越大，引來的怪物也越多；熄燈潛行則更隱蔽。擊敗五隻巨物，下潛至 1050 公尺的淵底，做出你的選擇：重回光明，或留在深淵。

3839200.name: Future Fab Heroes
3839200.desc: Future Fab Hero, your mission begins now! Team up with your robot companion, CHIP-E, to complete hands-on technology and manufacturing simulations, earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and defend the Mars Innovation Zone from alien threats in a unique educational adventure.

5195600.name: QuestAway
5195600.desc: 住在工作列旁邊的迷你放置類RPG。組好英雄隊伍，派他們出去戰鬥，你就回去忙自己的事。等你回來，戰利品已經在等著了。每天12次，所有人一起挑戰一隻巨像。

3881920.name: Good Children Say Grace
3881920.desc: My parents adopted an orphan who burned down her house. I haven't slept since my girlfriend disappeared. Now everything looks like eggs. Good Children Say Grace.

4234400.name: Boys in the dark
4234400.desc: Survival horror meets gay dark romance. Trapped in a nightmare realm, fight grotesque monsters and solve twisted puzzles. Caught between a possessive lover and a mysterious stranger, you must uncover the truth. Will you survive the horror and the heat of Boys in the Dark?

movies.name: Boys in the dark Official Trailer

3786840.name: Slime Slasher
3786840.desc: You take on the role of a slime fighting alongside the rebels against Brain 738 and a spacefaring race of penguins. Become a warrior, archer, or mage and play through your own story to a unique ending!

4834110.name: RuinBlade
4834110.desc: This is a small personal work. Please manage your expectations

4775990.name: Puppetry
4775990.desc: Puppetry is a 3D puzzle-mystery adventure where you play as a haunted voodoo doll trapped inside a mysterious mansion.

5354300.name: Sex Office 2
5354300.desc: Balance your office work routine with the allure of money and romance. Complete your tasks on time, go out and win over major investors, or risk it all at the casino. Meet three unique female colleagues, deepen your relationships with them, and unlock nine exclusive intimate scenes.

5333520.name: FUTA GIRLS
5333520.desc: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

2445430.name: Tensei Brave
2445430.desc: 在魔王的侵略下，世界各国纷纷走向灭亡。 危难之际，幸存的国家召唤出了勇者。 玩家将操纵勇者，集结同伴，踏上讨伐魔王的旅途。 游戏内可操纵角色10名以上，培养自己喜欢的角色， 在广袤的地图上探索，拯救世界吧！

5272490.name: Catch The Ducks
5272490.desc: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

5385830.name: Lily or Horse
5385830.desc: 世界上最簡單的遊戲。擲一枚硬幣，猜猜看：百合還是馬？連續猜對 10 次就能獲勝。猜錯的話，押上的金幣全部輸光。運氣好的話，只要擲 10 次。

4709550.name: Behind the Corner
4709550.desc: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

5280270.name: Task Bar Cube: Inventory Package
5280270.desc: Task Bar Cube 是一款有趣的桌面放置型角色扮演遊戲。解鎖所有儲物分類及頁面,包括額外的 Steam 庫存頁面,還可獲得更長的掛機寶箱容量。

5280220.name: Task Bar Cube: Character Pack
5280220.desc: Task Bar Cube 是一款有趣的桌面放置型角色扮演遊戲。解鎖 10 名基礎屬性更強的專屬英雄,還可獲得永久金幣加成與更長的掛機寶箱容量。

5280250.name: Task Bar Cube: Support Package
5280250.desc: Task Bar Cube 是一款有趣的桌面放置型角色扮演遊戲。解鎖 10 名基礎屬性更強的專屬夥伴,還可獲得永久金幣加成與更長的掛機寶箱容量。

4924290.name: Fire Bug
4924290.desc: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

5306880.name: Gross Survivors
5306880.desc: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

5084200.name: Task Bar Cube
5084200.desc: Task Bar Cube 是一款放置型 RPG，可以全螢幕遊玩，也可以直接從工作列遊玩。培養你的角色和寵物，收集稀有裝備，探索數十種不同的成長系統。

35130.name: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light
35130.desc: Take control of Lara and her new partner Totec, a Mayan tribesman, and uncover the ancient artifact known as the "Mirror of Smoke" in this all new action adventure game.

movies.name: Lara Croft: Guardian of Light Trailer
Lara Croft Guardian of Light Trailer 2 (PEGI)

compare.en: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light

dlc.name: Lara Croft GoL: Hazardous Reunion - Challenge Pack 3
Lara Croft GoL: Things that Go Boom - Challenge Pack 2
Lara Croft GoL: All the Trappings - Challenge Pack 1
Lara Croft GoL: Raziel and Kain Character Pack

1250.name: Killing Floor
1250.desc: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Free updates, free special events and a ridiculous amount of fun!

movies.name: Killing Floor Pier of Pain Trailer

dlc.name: Killing Floor - Community Weapons Pack 3 - Us Versus Them Total Conflict Pack
Killing Floor - Urban Nightmare Character Pack

4999150.name: Chesstria
4999150.desc: Chesstria is a unique chess roguelite that blends the original chess rules with consumables, artifacts, and banners. Face unique boss banners, run the Gauntlet, and discover unique events. Fight 1v1 against your friend, or compete on the daily leaderboard. Or just solve some complex puzzles!

5040820.name: Hide Your Cash
5040820.desc: 把私房錢藏進馬桶水箱、壓在床墊底下、塞到冰箱後面。然後闖進朋友家翻箱倒櫃，把他們的錢找出來；屋主只能擋門、推你、拚命裝無辜。1–4 人物理派對遊戲，可以和朋友連線，也可以單人對戰電腦。

movies.name: HIDE YOUR CASH - Find It Before He Does

3282980.name: Urbex Murder
3282980.desc: Urbex Murder is a cooperative horror game where you explore abandoned places alone or with friends. Solve puzzles, confront events, and uncover hidden secrets. Each map offers unique scenarios for an immersive and terrifying experience.

5367400.name: Geargrave Outlands
5367400.desc: Lead a convoy through a wasteland that remembers. Set the marching order, drive in formation, put your crew on the guns, and decide in every fight what you take home: the vehicle, the cargo, the crew, or nothing but a story.

movies.name: Characters and vehicles in the game

5150040.name: Soraseed Desktop 2026
5150040.desc: A drone simulator for free flight and practical skills training. Practice square routes, figure eights, and more, with wind, night-flight settings, and customizable controls. A one-time-purchase 2026 edition.

5099960.name: 爱在触及之处 Love Where Touches
5099960.desc: "Love Where Touches" is a supernatural high school doujin VN. A third extra lunchbox made daily, an invisible girl in the classroom, and magical truths hidden behind forgotten memories... To protect the one you cherish, would you sacrifice your memories to reach true happiness?

4718780.name: Wandering The Corridors
4718780.desc: Walk through an endless corridor and look for anomalies. Observe every detail, remember what you see, and discover what has changed before moving forward.

5213530.name: DRIFTIT
5213530.desc: Top-down drift racing with deep arcade physics. Throw one car sideways through 20 hand-built tracks in five low-poly worlds, chain slides for points, chase your own ghost and set the fastest three-lap time on Steam leaderboards checked against every run's replay.

3088790.name: Market master Simulator
3088790.desc: Turn your grandfather's empty shop into the busiest supermarket in town. Order stock, fill the shelves, set your prices and serve customers, then grow your own crops, raise animals, run a factory and drive across a sunny coastal city.

5404950.name: Foodland Puzzle
5404950.desc: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

5061340.name: Puzzle Wild Cats
5061340.desc: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5232250.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments
5232250.desc: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5151450.name: Puzzle Nuts
5151450.desc: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5295630.name: Wok King
5295630.desc: You and your friends run a Chinese restaurant in a cherry blossom town on an island. You travel to various places to purchase different quality ingredients, frantically completing orders in the kitchen, riding an e-bike to deliver the delicacies to customers, striving to become the wok king!

5074080.name: Parry Dungeon
5074080.desc: Created by an insane solo developer. Short first-person dungeon crawler with directional parrying, counterattacks, and monster CONSUMPTION. Parry monster. Counterattack monster. Kill monster. Eat monster. Find more monsters. Kill them too. Find more. Kill them too....or die.

5232310.name: Puzzle Penguins
5232310.desc: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5087110.name: LastAlive
5087110.desc: LastAlive is a hardcore psychological survival simulator set in a world created by your own mind. To survive, explore a dead city, gather resources, craft tools, fortify your position, and make fateful decisions. Complete all the objectives, preserve your sanity, and wake up.

5381180.name: Slaskescape 2
5381180.desc: 40種相互連結的技能，推動你在這款單人3D放置RPG中持續成長。收集材料、打造更好的裝備，運用雇工、召喚生物與發明實現自動補給。選定下一個解鎖目標，讓角色繼續忙碌。

5385650.name: Idle Gas Station Tycoon
5385650.desc: Turn a tiny roadside pump into a thriving highway service empire. Serve cars, grow your station, hire staff, add a shop, car wash, garage, truck stop and EV chargers, then expand to new locations. A relaxing low-poly idle tycoon, no ads, fully offline.

4924750.name: Village of the Mirror
4924750.desc: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

5358580.name: Give Us Back Gravity
5358580.desc: 在廢棄太空站裡打撈物資的無重力「見好就收」Roguelite。沒有煞車：推進器消耗氧氣，想停下只能蹬牆，或把貨物往反方向丟。太空站結構每次都不同，配額每 3 次下潛結算一次。儘管貪心，但只有活著帶回氣閘才算錢。最多支援 4 人線上合作。

2478970.name: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
2478970.desc: Discover Lara Croft’s Original Adventures, Lovingly Restored – Now with New Challenge Mode

movies.name: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Challenge Mode Launch Trailer
Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Launch Trailer

compare.en: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft

580200.name: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles
580200.desc: Unwind and enjoy the slow life in Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles, a relaxing open-world adventure game. Yonder is set in the world of Gemea. A natural island paradise with eight distinct environments ranging from tropical beaches to snow-capped summits.

2525380.name: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered
2525380.desc: 她的傳承淵遠流長！在這款重製的《Darkness Trilogy》中，遊玩新系列的《Tomb Raider》冒險旅程。

movies.name: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered Launch Trailer
Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered Announce Trailer

3124540.name: 遙遙西土 Far Far West
3124540.desc: 大吼咿哈快上馬，西部牛仔英姿颯！ 《遙遙西土》是一款熱鬧非凡的4人合作射擊遊戲，你將踏上西行旅途，一路斬妖殺怪、施法念咒、完成任務、領取賞金。召集隊友，完成任務，然後趁你還活著（大多時候）趕緊拿錢走人。

movies.name: 驚魂西土 現已上線

4000.name: Garry's Mod
4000.desc: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

4708610.name: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths
4708610.desc: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths 是一款硬核 2D 像素風平台遊戲，每一次失誤都至關重要。戰鬥、躲避陷阱，並通過考驗精準操作、反應速度與冷靜判斷的關卡。

3827150.name: Quick Translate Engine
3827150.desc: 無論您是即時翻譯電影字幕，在遊戲中與外國隊友聊天，還是理解圖片中的文字。Quick Translate Engine 只需一個按鍵即可消除螢幕上的任何障礙。

2445780.name: Grifford Academy
2445780.desc: 《Grifford Academy》是一款劇情豐富、描繪成長歷程的角色扮演遊戲，故事背景設於神秘的書中世界。你的抉擇將影響角色們的性格發展。踏上探索卡爾德里亞秘密的旅途，參與極具策略性的回合制戰鬥。

5069860.name: Shear line
5069860.desc: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

2774560.name: Foulbreaker
2774560.desc: Welcome to the exciting fantasy world where the mix of adrenaline, strategy and magic reaches its peak! "Foulbreaker" is a bagel in the classic sense, where you will have an endless battle with frenzied monsters in a troubled kingdom.

4929010.name: Unforgiving Dungeon
4929010.desc: Roguelike, Turn-Based Combat, Dungeon Crawler, 2D, Pixel Art

4637470.name: 雷霆校場
4637470.desc: 在此進行空戰截射、對地投彈、防空射擊等技能訓練！您可以高度自訂載具和武器的性能參數，自由擺放您與目標的相對位置，自由搭建屬於您的練習場景。以及超便捷的一鍵重置功能，還能助您在短暫的1分鐘內完成3到5次訓練，是保持手感和快速積累經驗的好幫手！

5328190.name: Wild Draw
5328190.desc: 出牌。坑你的朋友。然後，輪到槍戰了。WILD DRAW 是一款支援 3–6 名玩家的第一人稱派對遊戲，每一回合都從酒館牌桌開始，最後在混亂中收場。

5442420.name: SQUIRT GAME 💦 - WALLPAPERS 18+
5442420.desc: Give your desktop a playful adult twist with this exclusive wallpaper collection for SQUIRT GAME 💦. Featuring eye-catching artwork inspired by the game, this pack is a great way to bring its characters and atmosphere to your screen.

4343600.name: 墨武天工
4343600.desc: 《墨舞天工》是一款以神話古代中國為背景的開放世界生存動作遊戲。身為建造者與戰士，您將在破碎而美麗的世界中「運墨籌謀，持刃而戰」。透過採集資源、建造庇護所與耕種農作，在這個世界中生存下來。

5122330.name: Console Space
5122330.desc: You are the captain aboard a starship. Make decisions in the terminal's text logs: from repairing the reactor to moral dilemmas that irreversibly change the fate of the crew.

5058690.name: Moostache Farm
5058690.desc: An idle farming game about Moostache, a farmer with one small field and a big mustache. Grow wheat, eggs, milk, apples and carrots, then trade the harvest for chef hats. Big Food Inc. buys your farms each season. Spend the profit on its shares until you own the company.

4726830.name: PYTHON:KINGDOM WARS
4726830.desc: Command six unit types with Python and fight real-time wars against AI large language models. Write code. Build tactics. Control the battlefield. 10 tutorial levels to get you started. 10 AI LLM challenge levels to conquer. Others play with reflexes. You play with algorithms.

5347600.name: Crazy City Golf
5347600.desc: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

5366400.name: Prism Core
5366400.desc: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

1436590.name: Phoenotopia: Awakening
1436590.desc: Embark on a grand adventure in Phoenotopia! An action-adventure puzzle platformer inspired by the great classics. Meet charming townsfolk, brave the dungeons, and thwart evil in your quest to save your family.

5090990.name: MAFIA HOTEL
5090990.desc: MAFIA HOTEL是一款支援最多16人的第一人稱社交推理派對遊戲，也是你和朋友的桌遊之夜聚點。體驗經典黑手黨及其他充滿祕密與心理博弈的模式。盤問朋友，為自己的說法辯護，然後信心十足地指錯人。

5378020.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
5378020.desc: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

3752410.name: Dispatch Control
3752410.desc: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

3330380.name: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
3330380.desc: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.

dlc.name: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side Soundtrack

5105260.name: AVXRPG
5105260.desc: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

5288620.name: Kiss Me on the Oligarch's Dime
5288620.desc: Debt-ridden wedding producer Luka returns to the Adriatic town he fled to stage a secretive oligarch wedding. Over six closed days, choose one of three romance routes: a runaway pop-star bride, the dressmaker he abandoned, or a furious local organizer.

dlc.name: Kiss Me on the Oligarch's Dime Demo

5249350.name: Hedge Knight
5249350.desc: Raise a mercenary company and fight at its head in a medieval fantasy action RPG. Command infantry, archers and cavalry, storm castles, ride dragons and unleash spells that send enemy ranks flying. Recruit, train and conquer across a campaign of rival kingdoms.

3493540.name: Transport Fever 3
3493540.desc: 經典運輸模擬遊戲《運輸業大亨3》強勢回歸，帶來規模更大、更深入、更豐富的運輸體驗。運用百年來不斷發展的各式交通工具，打造改寫世界樣貌的陸、海、空交通路線，設計並建構你理想中的運輸網路。

499170.name: 沉星之序
499170.desc: 由《時空幻境》《見證者》的導演喬納森·布洛打造的敘事冒險遊戲，《沉星之序》將帶你踏入一個魔法與謎團交織的世界。破解超過1000個精心設計、相互關聯的謎題，邂逅獨特的可操控英雄，掌握不斷演變的玩法機制，最終揭開一場宏大的謎局。

5274500.name: 永禄立志伝
5274500.desc: 活在戰國日本。遊歷日本全圖，招募士兵、與武將交談，在合戰中擊退大名家。從浪人到仕官，或是舉旗起兵、逐鹿天下。融合部隊經營、即時合戰與人際交流的戰國模擬遊戲。

232090.name: Killing Floor 2
232090.desc: In KILLING FLOOR 2, players descend into continental Europe after it has been overrun by horrific, murderous clones called Zeds that were created by rogue elements of the Horzine Corporation. 6-player Co-Op & 12-player VS Zed-slaughtering mayhem.

movies.name: Killing Floor 2: Full Release Launch Trailer

893680.name: Project Warlock
893680.desc: Project Warlock is a first-person shooter that fans of Doom, Hexen, and Wolfenstein cannot miss. It serves you an exploding cocktail of bullets, spells, and monsters. Battle through 60 levels of non-stop action, packed with bloodthirsty enemies and challenging bosses.

410710.name: System Shock: Enhanced Edition
410710.desc: Re-discover what made System Shock the first of it's kind, a ground breaking immersive sim that would inspire a generation of games to come....

movies.name: System Shock: Enhanced Edition Source Port Trailer
System Shock: Enhanced Edition Launch Trailer

242640.name: Styx: Master of Shadows
242640.desc: Styx: Master of Shadows is an infiltration game with RPG elements taking place in a dark fantasy universe, where you sneak, steal and assassinate your way through as Styx, a Goblin two-centuries of age.

movies.name: Styx: Master of Shadows - Launch Trailer

1608700.name: Soundfall
1608700.desc: 《聲之境》是一款音樂地下城冒險遊戲，結合尋寶射擊動作與節奏型音遊。您可以進行單人遊戲，或與最多 4 名朋友在本機或線上合作。動作越貼近配樂的節奏，效果就越強大！

1300.name: SiN Episodes: Emergence
1300.desc: 您扮演 John Blade，是精銳的 HardCorps 特勤隊指揮官，誓言保護 Freeport 市民的安全。 四年前，您擊敗了那位美麗聰明卻又冷血，並且想依自己扭曲思想再造人類的科學家 Elexis Sinclaire 。 法律無力制裁 Elexis 和她的龐大集團 SiNTEK，於是 Blade 決定挺身而出執行正義。 加入 Blade 陣營的還有身懷秘密的駭客 JC，以及擅長滲透各種高度戒備設施的新手 Jessica Cannon。進入鮮活生動的 Freeport 市，這是結合了紐約、舊金山、東京的未來世界。 就在 Freeport 市遭受變種大軍攻擊的同時，您必須在 Sinclaire 推動她的邪惡計劃，並永遠改造人類之前阻止她。

1406850.name: 廖添丁 - 稀代兇賊の最期
1406850.desc: 《廖添丁 - 稀代兇賊の最期》是一款2D動作橫軸平台遊戲。玩家扮演台灣傳奇英雄--廖添丁，穿梭在20世紀初的大台北地區，劫富濟貧、行俠仗義，並隨著劇情發展，經歷一段精彩的冒險故事。

405820.name: Turok
405820.desc: A world where time has no meaning - and evil knows no bounds. Torn from a world long gone, the time traveling warrior Turok has found himself thrust into a savage land torn by conflict.

982290.name: Airborne Kingdom
982290.desc: The sky city builder awaits. Create your own flying kingdom and lead it on a quest across an expansive world. Explore the varied landscape, build up a floating metropolis, aid struggling people below, uncover lost secrets and, ultimately, bring back the Airborne Kingdom legend.

1943730.name: Wicked Island
1943730.desc: Survive a harsh, alluring open world in this 18+ survival RPG. Craft gear, build your home, customize your character, and command dragons! Explore deep dungeons and battle fierce monsters. Fight to win, or succumb to your desires with a fully integrated sex defeat and pregnancy system.

4943380.name: Dead Pulse
4943380.desc: Dead Pulse is an atmospheric, adrenaline-fueled zombie survival FPS set in a red-tinted post-apocalyptic wasteland. Face endless waves of the undead, unlock powerful weapons and roguelite skills, and fight to survive the crimson night in a dark, gritty world.

5209250.name: KING 4 A DAY
5209250.desc: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

5339880.name: Wizard X World
5339880.desc: Wizard X World offers a great experience as one of the best action games for kids. This game contains of special 3D graphics system helps with imagination. Prepare yourself and embrace the fantasy world.

5398650.name: TRACE IT
5398650.desc: 紙感風格的數字鐵軌益智遊戲。照著列與欄的數字推理，從入口鋪一條鐵路通到出口，每一關都只有唯一解。500 關闖關、無盡、放鬆與每日挑戰，獎牌與 60 個成就，鋪通的那一刻，小火車就會沿著你的軌道開出去。

3138080.name: 有些東西修不好
3138080.desc: 一款關於修復、家人與未曾回覆的過去的短篇敘事冒險。透過對話、查看物件與簡單維修，聽見客人的故事，重新面對舊手機裡的七通未接來電。約半小時的單人體驗，最後的聯絡選擇由你決定。

5380860.name: Last House Standing
5380860.desc: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

5281110.name: Anima Trium
5281110.desc: In Anima Trium, Leop believes he and his friends may be the last survivors of an ancient war. Until he spots a boat on the horizon. Explore islands and uncover a forgotten past in an adventure RPG full of mystery, featuring turn-based combat with manual and automatic modes.

4262030.name: Last Fisherman
4262030.desc: In abandoned biomes, forgotten cities, and lifeless waters, you cast your line — often without knowing whether it is still worth it. Rare fish, fragile systems, and a world without explanation create an atmosphere that observes rather than entertains.

5342920.name: SpellWeave
5342920.desc: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

5358030.name: Lumbrix
5358030.desc: Lumbrix 是一款倖存者類射擊遊戲，你不斷成長的蠕蟲身上的每一節既是武器也是生命。用頭部大砲瞄準，以身軀作盾，進化武器，撐過十分鐘迎戰頭目。

5388030.name: LEVELS Demo
5388030.desc: 探索史上首款真正的開放世界 Backrooms：一個無限的程序生成世界，遍布獨特的生態域，所有線上玩家共享同一個世界。（當然，實體們也住在這裡！）

5426580.name: 六年级奶瓦聚会
5426580.desc: Grade Six Naiwa Gathering is a relaxing and casual jigsaw puzzle game. Featuring 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 difficulty options and an auto-save function, players can restore the heartwarming scene of the Naiwas' dinner party through simple clicks in a cozy and joyful atmosphere.

5393420.name: Elya
5393420.desc: 在這款單人桌面陪伴養成遊戲中領養一位真正生活在桌面上的夥伴。和她聊天、培養羈絆、留下長期記憶，並以角色、造型、動作和工作坊作品打造專屬體驗。

4984610.name: Hazard Crew
4984610.desc: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

514150.name: Line of Sight: Vietnam
514150.desc: Every day brings another mission. Every day is LIFE or DEATH. Be quick, be quiet and be careful. That’s what will get you HOME ALIVE.

316790.name: Grim Fandango Remastered
316790.desc: One of the most acclaimed adventure games of all time is now back, better than ever. Grim Fandango Remastered has the all the beautiful art and engaging story fans remember, but has also been remastered to look, sound, and control even better than the award-winning original release.

5315300.name: DeepCore Breach
5315300.desc: Thousands of rift creatures. One base. Aim every turret's line of fire, then take the main cannon into your own hands. Take down five bosses across 15 maps, grow stronger between runs, and climb the global leaderboard in Endless. Build and share your own maps on the Workshop.

5390450.name: Reel to the Stars
5390450.desc: Drag your bobber and reel in a whole screen of fish! Upgrade your rod, grow a huge skill tree, and fish your way from a quiet pond through the Arctic, the deep sea and the Dragon Palace all the way to outer space. A cozy fishing incremental with 278 fish species and your own aquarium.

dlc.name: Reel to the Stars - Supporter Pack

5074200.name: The Bots Want Your Gold!
5074200.desc: Defend your base from the robotic horde! Mine ores and sell them to make quick cash. Use your hard-earned money to buy weapons, attachments, and equipment that will assist you in defeating the bots! How long can you hold off the horde?

movies.name: The Bots Want Your Gold! - Trailer

5409020.name: Spin To Win
5409020.desc: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

4461260.name: Ball Bugz
4461260.desc: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

5074470.name: 星海余烬：联合舰队
5074470.desc: Take the helm of a ten-thousand-ton flagship and feel it answer to momentum. A 2D real-time space combat game of flagship piloting, fleet command and roguelike growth. Fly the ship yourself, order escorts, refit warships, recruit captains - alone or with three friends over LAN.

dlc.name: 星海余烬：联合舰队 Demo

4265280.name: Nile Express
4265280.desc: Build the first railway network in Africa. Create profitable routes in Egypt, from Alexandria to Aswan. Deliver passengers and goods to the right destinations. Take care of your railway network and deal with accidents.

2644100.name: Allogloom
2644100.desc: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

4715430.name: River Secret
4715430.desc: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

5169220.name: Campsite
5169220.desc: Warm nights in the evergreen forest, the peace and quiet, the gentle flicker of fire. Too quiet, almost unnatural. Something sinister lurks in the dark. It's faster than you, it's smarter than you, and it wants you out of it's forest. Your only hope to keep the flames from hollowing. Good luck.

2058670.name: Viking Life
2058670.desc: Lead a Viking warband from the fjords to England and France in a roguelite of real-time battles. Swing your axe in the front line, command dozens of warriors, and when you fall, wake up in Valhalla and build up your village for the next saga.

4111820.name: Born of the Moon
4111820.desc: Trapped in the von Adelstein mansion, one of you has already made a pact with the beast. Born of the Moon is a social horror for 3-6 players. Asymmetrical roles, sabotage, and insanity mechanics are deadlier than monsters. Will you survive until dawn if you can't even trust your own ears?

5472570.name: Horny Asylum :  The Undercroft
5472570.desc: 新崗位：精神病院底下淹水牢房的夜班警衛。看監視器，把門、地板陷阱和管子甩上，讓電池撐到 6:00。收容人進了警衛亭，會慢慢把你做完。撐到早上，你挑誰跟你一起打卡下班。

4087210.name: Red Rain
4087210.desc: Survive a decimated yet beautiful post-apocalyptic landscape as Allie, a competent survivalist and mother raising her daughter against the backdrop of a broken world.

5303890.name: Project Neko
5303890.desc: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across four difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

4078410.name: Post-Utopia: Europe2999
4078410.desc: Europe2999 is a third-person shooter mixing survival, narrative and full customization. On a tense Mediterranean island, secure your treatment, forge your legend, and decide the fate of a world on the brink of collapse.

3703300.name: I Checkmate Thee
3703300.desc: "I Checkmate Thee" is a turn-based puzzle game with limited vision, in the setting and genre of horror and chess. The king is armed with a sword to escape from the confinement of the chessboard. Go through chess games, where every move is a step towards death!

5198690.name: Balance Due
5198690.desc: 《Balance Due》是一款支援單人與線上合作的奇幻動作遊戲。狩獵怪物、收集戰利品、強化武器，並在時間耗盡前返回大本營。完成每日金幣配額，管理不斷變化的Due，努力生存並決定屬於你的結局。

5441800.name: Hentai Mayhem : Storymode
5441800.desc: 歡迎來到我的國度，騎士。劇情模式把 Hentai Mayhem 拖進 Abyssal Realm：手工打造的章節、真正的戰利品、會反咬的女王，還有在 Crimson Throne 上等你的我，莉莉絲。征服我們，每一位都會解鎖她的場景。

5396730.name: PrankzPlz!
5396730.desc: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

3115160.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
3115160.desc: 在《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2》中，以帝皇之名殲滅異端！在此復古第一人稱射擊遊戲《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的續作中，扮演極限戰士馬魯姆·凱多或戰鬥修女尼拉·維拉斯，迎戰更多敵人、挑選更多武器，掌握全新的滅敵方式！

5465800.name: Final Night At Hotel Demo
5465800.desc: Final Night At Hotel is a horror game for up to 5 players. Together, you must investigate the creature haunting the hotel, collect clues, and vote each night for determine the strategy to defeat it. When night falls, your goal is clear: kill or exorcise the creature...

5265120.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
5265120.desc: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

5107320.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
5107320.desc: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

5431210.name: Boa Survival
5431210.desc: A survival game where you fight various fantasy creatures and chop down trees.

5391110.name: Infernal West Demo
5391110.desc: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

5407340.name: Thalassomania Demo
5407340.desc: Co-op PS1 horror on a North Sea trawler for 1-4 players. Fish, steer through the storm, keep the engine alive and watch the cameras while the jobs split you up. There's one more aboard than there should be, and you'll hear it before you see it.

1924180.name: Phantom Spark
1924180.desc: 投入刺激的高速世界《Phantom Spark》。在單人戰役中挑戰冠軍，展示你的精準技術，或者在分割畫面本地多人模式中與朋友競速較量，亦或是在全球線上排行榜上爭奪頂尖排名，留下你的傳奇足跡。

1197650.name: Barotrauma - Supporter Pack
1197650.desc: 這是專為想深入了解木衛二的人所準備的《Barotrauma》額外內容收藏。

fullgame.name: 地下蟻國 Empires of the Undergrowth

3402630.name: 地下蟻國 - 贊助包 Empires of the Undergrowth - Supporter Pack
3402630.desc: 《地下蟻國》支持者包內含：原聲帶、4K 桌布、殖民地螞蟻全新外觀等許多內容。

2927990.name: Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi - ASMR DLC
2927990.desc: Enjoy this short fully voiced scene that brings the Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi experience to life through the use of immersive ASMR!

1261120.name: Automobilista 2 2020-2022 Season Pass
1261120.desc: This Season Pass covers all planned DLC packs planned for Automobilista 2 over 2020 & 2022 - includes 6 Premium Race Tracks with multiple versions, 3 major Expansion Packs with several cars and tracks as well as other minor car or track packs.

1079180.name: Slime Rancher: Secret Style Pack
1079180.desc: Give your favorite slimes a fresh, new look by discovering secret styles hidden in special treasure pods throughout the Far, Far Range!

452240.name: Dawn of the Robot Empire
452240.desc: Witness first hand the Dawn of the Robot Empire. Can you stop the invading robotic forces from another galaxy? Blast your way to victory in this retro sci-fi shooter. You'll need fast reflexes and an accurate aim to win.

5324320.name: Puzzle Peace: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles
5324320.desc: Free-to-play cozy jigsaw puzzles. Solve gorgeous scenes from 40 to 1,296 pieces, sort pieces into trays by edge, color or shape, and come back every day for a new Daily puzzle that everyone plays. No rush - just soft music and the click of a perfect fit on your cozy sunlit table space.

5315330.name: Tiny Spellcaster
5315330.desc: Blast through endless hordes and hold the line against these demons! Tiny Spellcaster is a corner arcade idle shooter with rogue-lite upgrades, where rng and strategic builds help you overpower the rapid swarms of monsters closing in. Master the magic, unleash the chaos!

4898560.name: Tetromancer
4898560.desc: Tetromancer is a Tetris battler where the board is your war economy. Clear lines to conjure an army, then command it in real time against wave after wave of invaders. Stack greedily and you'll field a bigger force, but crowd your board and one bad piece can bury you.

4738510.name: Topdeck Duel
4738510.desc: 一款漸進式卡牌 Roguelike，每次勝利都會擴展你的牌組！安排卡牌位置獲得強力增益，奪取敵方卡牌，並合併它們來提升稀有度。在挑戰之間累積金幣，用於永久全域強化，精通 Topdeck Duel！

5342690.name: Keep It Trolling: Fantasy Edition
5342690.desc: Test your luck and strategy in Keep It Trolling: Fantasy Edition! Roll color-coded dice, match mythical creature cards, and build score streaks. Bank points safely or Keep It Rolling to unlock legendary cards—just beware of the devastating BUST!

5196220.name: DATE_SIMULATOR.EXE
5196220.desc: Go on three exclusive dates with charming girls! Enjoy their company and the cozy moments you share. Lost media. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

5041720.name: Debt Wish
5041720.desc: You start with $100 and a line of credit. Trade, borrow, bribe, and gamble your way up until you own everything. An incremental finance sim where the debt can be your best friend or worst enemy.

5203480.name: KickOff
5203480.desc: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

3118840.name: Sibir
3118840.desc: Sibir 是一款在廢棄蘇聯地堡無情深處展開的高強度生存探索遊戲。在黑暗中的每一步都可能是最後一步。

5420000.name: TatuBall Soundtrack
5420000.desc: Take TatuBall's peaceful atmosphere beyond the game with six LoFi tracks by TGM and Purrple Cat. Includes the menu theme and all five stage tracks as MP3 files, with a total listening time of approximately 20 minutes.

5362060.name: The Third Seal
5362060.desc: 熄了燈的牌桌上，每個人都偷偷拿起一件受詛咒的物品。燈光重新亮起，你才知道誰早就盯上了你。第一人稱恐怖心理戰遊戲，支援 1 至 4 名玩家，可獨自對戰 AI，或與好友連線同桌。獲得第三枚封印，你就自由了。

5331330.name: History Experience: Rome Demo
5331330.desc: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

5305770.name: Gimby
5305770.desc: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

5407600.name: Conveyor Crew Demo
5407600.desc: A 1970s analog horror where you descend into a dark 3D warehouse to scavenge parts for your conveyor puzzles while something stalks you in the shadows. Think harder to risk less, risk more to think less. At Ironside, your survival is just a bonus.

5087180.name: Excids: Endless Siege
5087180.desc: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

5373170.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless
5373170.desc: Walk through Claude Monet's paintings as a Great War veteran carrying his wife's ashes to the sea. Stop, look closer, and paint color back into the world he lost. A quiet, wordless pilgrimage where stillness is rewarded.

5131740.name: 单机斗地主
5131740.desc: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

5489440.name: A Week Before Autumn Demo
5489440.desc: Pine Hill is a quiet Midwestern college town. Quiet enough that nobody seemed to hear Ginny Nicholson die. Alone with the thoughts in your head, now you just want to know one thing: why?

movies.name: A Week Before Autumn Gameplay Trailer
A Week Before Autumn Teaser Trailer

2769570.name: Fable
2769570.desc: 在沉浸式的開放世界動作角色扮演遊戲中，成為你自己心目中的英雄。在這裡，每個選擇都將形塑你的旅程，名聲就是一切，而童話般幸福快樂的結局並非必然的終點。

1137450.name: ENCODYA
1137450.desc: Neo Berlin 2062. Tina – a nine-year-old orphan – lives with SAM-53 – her big clumsy robot guardian –in a rooftop makeshift shelter in Neo-Berlin, a dark megalopolis controlled by corporations.

3024130.name: 泡泡鎮餐廳物語
3024130.desc: 歡迎來到這座可愛的海濱小鎮！從零開始經營你夢想中的餐廳，烹飪一道道美味佳餚；單人掌勺或最多 4 人協作，讓後廚高效運轉。工作之餘，田間耕種、出海垂釣、探索森林，或在小鎮悠閒漫步——每一天都有新鮮事，讓這裡成為你的溫馨小家！

4389980.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
4389980.desc: 一款殘酷的8位復古射擊遊戲，靈感來自80年代最好的B級恐怖片。你是塞繆爾·阿爾瓦雷斯，一個破碎的人，發現了一間比任何噩夢都更糟的木屋。活過這一夜，並面對溫達科爾的力量——否則你將看不到黎明。

1920320.name: Parasite
1920320.desc: You are a parasite of unknown origin, and without a host you won't last long. Take over people, burn through their bodies, read their minds and evolve, while a secret organization closes in. A survival horror roguelike about possession, conspiracy and building a nefarious cult.

5248430.name: Picpic
5248430.desc: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

1737870.name: REKA
1737870.desc: 踏入一個揉合了斯拉夫民間傳說的世界，盡情沉浸在溫馨魔幻的氛圍當中。漫步於霧氣迷濛的秋日森林，建造、裝飾、自由改造你那棟行走的雞腿小屋。幫助當地村民、馴服林中生物，並在大女巫芭芭雅嘎的指導下，學習古老的溫和巫術。

5088140.name: 幻影線：序章
5088140.desc: 體驗惡夢的開端。《幻影線：序章》是一款以戰火紛飛且超自然事件頻發為背景的1-4人連機合作戰術射擊遊戲。在全盤任務正式開始之前，收容可怕的異常現象，在核戰混亂中穿行，檢驗你與小隊成員的生存本領。

movies.name: Phantom Line: Prologue - Official Launch Date Teaser

4765410.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
