4765410.desc: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

4466850.name: 萌萌寵物店
4466850.desc: 人，你好。你能帶我回家嗎？接手這家岌岌可危的寵物店，在城市的各個角落尋找、救助毛孩子，給他們找到最合適的新家。一步步升級改造你的店鋪，改善它們居住環境的同時，為你自己建造一幢夢想豪宅！準備好開啟這段充滿萌物與愛心的暴富之旅了嗎？《萌萌寵物店》現在開業！

5354560.name: Abenteurergildenmeister
5354560.desc: Lead an adventurer guild through story-driven quests and shape a settlement that grows on its own. Freely place its key buildings and roads. Your main task is to assign the most suitable adventurers to each quest.

5385170.name: ByeByeObake!
5385170.desc: 「看得見的人打不了，打得了的人看不見！」驅靈師與背後靈互相喊話配合的2～8人線上非對稱合作動作遊戲。依靠隊友的聲音，驅除看不見的惡靈吧。小心手滑，連隊友也一起驅除掉喔。

4881270.name: 赢麻了 Mahjong Rush
4881270.desc: A single-player mahjong roguelike with an ink-wash art style. Make runs and sets from your tiles to score points — complete a winning hand and your score multiplies. Buy Flower cards, talismans and treasures to get stronger.. Never played mahjong? A step-by-step tutorial gets you started.

4668100.name: 雅典娜與森林深處的色情陷阱迷宮 ～虛假的魔導士與智慧女神～
4668100.desc: 充滿慾望的淫亂地下迷宮，威脅著女主角的貞操，以及小鎮的和平！究竟是要探索迷宮、躲開陷阱並解開其中的秘密？還是要提升淫亂度，與整座小鎮一同沉迷墮落－－？輕鬆遊玩的色情陷阱迷宮RPG，就此開幕！

5285880.name: Munshi Meadows
5285880.desc: Hatch a Munshi from an egg and raise it your way. Train it on the toys in your garden, get to know its personality, and see which of 34 forms it grows into. Then race it across 70 courses, take on fights, cage matches and puzzle trials, build it a garden, and bring your friends along.

1932910.name: 卡牌城建
1932910.desc: Cardopolis 是一款卡牌城市建造遊戲，你將擔任市長。用一張張卡牌、一條條法律和一個個區域建設城市，並在時限內完成人口目標，別讓投資人失望！

5367280.name: 《PAYDAY 3》Guns Blazin' Crimebond
5367280.desc: 火力全開罪緣內含兩把全新雙持武器、三把經典武器、三套服裝組合、一款武器造型、表情動作等內容，讓你策馬出擊。

2951600.name: Chefs Arena
2951600.desc: Chefs Arena is a competitive party game you can play with your friends, family or online strangers. Cook dishes from whacky ingredients, fight monsters, sabotage, steal and feed an ever-hungry King.

5040510.name: In Silent Walls : Inside The House
5040510.desc: Trapped inside a house that defies all logic, explore your memories, escape the creatures hunting you, and uncover what truly connects you to the Red Hollow Sanatorium.

movies.name: In Silent Walls : Inside the house trailer

4608750.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome
4608750.desc: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

4236650.name: 不良婚姻懲罰師
4236650.desc: 《不良婚姻懲罰師》——专治婚姻蛀虫！调查、潜入、偷拍、监视、窃密、博弈……你的丈夫和妻子到底背着你做了什么？你的证据，就是最致命的制裁。现在，成为正义的影子，揭开情感背后一切的背叛与不忠吧！

3018340.name: Elementers
3018340.desc: Elementers is a 1-4 players satirical action-adventure, join the mage ranks and master the most powerful abilities while protecting the human race against the random monsters that keep attacking the villages for some unknown reason that you might find out.

5199280.name: DOOM MATES
5199280.desc: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

5355280.name: Only Luck
5355280.desc: 五顆骰子全是六？機率僅有 1/7776。如果變成 1/10 呢？《Only Luck》是一款像素風骰子點擊遊戲：點擊為投擲蓄力，一次擲出最多 9 顆骰子，收集 1100 種稀有組合，賺取聲望籌碼。升級聲望桌，轉動幸運轉盤，改寫規則，直到不可能的點數變得稀鬆平常。

5325200.name: History Experience: Rome
5325200.desc: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

5476530.name: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House Demo

2430710.name: Operator: Observation
2430710.desc: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

4910160.name: Legend Dary Demo
4910160.desc: 一款復古平台動作遊戲，講述平凡上班族為了贏得公主芳心而展開冒險。探索 3 個主題世界與 70 個關卡，收集鑰匙與星星，賺取金幣並升級武器、解鎖新角色。

4780790.name: Tetheg
4780790.desc: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

5231880.name: Blind Night
5231880.desc: Blind night- as the name states, you are blind using your heightened hearing senses like Daredevil himself. Move quickly, silently, hopefully you are successful traversing through a series of challenges and possibly something watching your moves.

5205040.name: Observation Protocol: The Observed Demo
5205040.desc: A self-contained slice of a first-person psychological horror. Wake inside a facility that watches you, live through one full cycle of its shifting rooms, and reach the demo's own ending. Roughly 50–60 minutes. Slow, atmospheric, and meant to be paid attention to. English only.

movies.name: Observation Protocol The Observed Demo - Announcement Trailer

235210.name: STRIDER™ / ストライダー飛竜®
235210.desc: 《Strider》在全新的冒險中回歸，在一個廣大的世界中作快如閃電的橫向動作遊戲。下載在2月19日推出完整遊戲，成為真正刺客。

2920450.name: GigaBash - Godzilla: Nemesis DLC
2920450.desc: 哥吉拉的宿敵來了！扮演王者基多拉和黑多拉，挑戰 #哥吉拉，在巨擊大亂鬥宇宙中展開終極怪獸對決。這兩個角色都擁有獨特的技能和玩法，靈感來自於它們電影中的標誌性時刻。

2161720.name: GigaBash - Godzilla 4 Kaiju Pack
2161720.desc: 終極的怪獸聯動來了！ 4 個來自哥斯拉宇宙的全新可玩角色領銜出演，每個角色都有自己的標誌性能力和獨特的動作組合。

1309620.name: Bears In Space
1309620.desc: 在這款超越巔峰的子彈地獄第一人稱射擊遊戲中，釋放你內在隱藏的熊性！踏上滑稽的復古風未來冒險之旅，用嚇死人的重武力摧毀那些滿腦子油的機器人。變身成為一隻熊，運用獨特力量，體驗《Bears in Space》超乎常理的快節奏行動！

1939970.name: Nobody Wants to Die
1939970.desc: 沉浸在2329年紐約的反烏托邦世界。永生是有代價的，總有人必須支付。在這個互動式黑色電影風故事中，扮演警探詹姆斯·卡拉，利用先進技術率領調查，冒著一切風險追捕一名專門對城市裡菁英階級下手的連環殺手。

3760770.name: Space Savory
3760770.desc: 在一個不太遙遠的星系中... 一家衛生狀況堪憂的餐館，充滿了黑暗的秘密和黑色幽默，位於宇宙虛無的中心。 歡迎來到 Space Savory。別被外表欺騙——宇宙中最美味的味道就在這裡烹飪。 (僅限於可觀測部分。)

5355200.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
5355200.desc: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

movies.name: Sort Them Alpacas: Overload - Gameplay Trailer

4326130.name: Spooky Market
4326130.desc: Spooky Market 是一款適合 1–4 名玩家的合作商店模擬遊戲，背景設定在永恆萬聖節的世界。經營自己的商店，販售各種商品，服務吸血鬼、骷髏等生物，招募特別員工，逐步發展並擴大你的店鋪。

4895300.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
4895300.desc: 用你的剑以重金属的节奏摧毁黑暗战士，观看史诗般的电影，同时掌握复杂的战斗系统，在线或离线羞辱你的对手，在这里你会发现开发商以前所未有的方式创造和结合的乐趣、讽刺和战争。

movies.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2 Season 1 Trailer Chinese T

dlc.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal - Waifu Armor
Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal Demo

3310570.name: Night Plane
3310570.desc: 《夜間航班》是一款工作模擬恐怖遊戲，你將扮演空服員，在一架注定失事的飛機上工作。你需要查驗機票、服務乘客，並決定誰可以留在飛機上——因為惡魔正潛藏在無辜者之中。當然，管理階層只會聳聳肩，表示：這是你的問題。

5084840.name: HEX: You Are It
5084840.desc: Tag your friends, smash their hiding spots and pass the curse. Up to 10 players chase each other through breakable cities, a mountain, the Moon and a plane, on foot, in cars and on hoverbikes. Don't be the Hex when time runs out.

4677860.name: The Spectacular Evermore
4677860.desc: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

3460540.name: Cardtographer
3460540.desc: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

4834850.name: Ecstatica II
4834850.desc: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

4834840.name: Ecstatica
4834840.desc: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

5226940.name: Tidy Farm
5226940.desc: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

4831830.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
4831830.desc: 知名長鼻子復古哈草族 Toey Weedz 的單人萬聖節特別企劃！從悲慘命運中救出那隻大名鼎鼎的饒舌牛、擊敗邪惡巫婆，並在扎實過硬的射擊遊戲核心上，親身體驗 9 個關卡的純粹復古 FPS 狂亂！

movies.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween Trailer 1
Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween Gameplay inside pyramid

dlc.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween Demo

4525060.name: Block By Block Tycoon
4525060.desc: Build a cozy city block by block in a spatial puzzle city-builder where smart placement earns points. Create powerful synergies, unlock new tools, expand, and grow a living city.

movies.name: Block By Block Tycoon Release Trailer

4174240.name: Dédale - A Cave Diving Experience
4174240.desc: This cave diving expedition was a bad idea. Your heart is racing, lungs are starving for fresh air, and this burrow never seems to end. Keep crawling.  Dédale is a horror game that plunges you in a cave diving expedition that is bound to go wrong.

3758440.name: Maja Island
3758440.desc: Sail through a mysterious open world island in your trusty boat, scavenge for resources to upgrade it, and face off against Maja.

5316360.name: Fully Funded
5316360.desc: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts with indicators and drawing tools, and a room full of things to throw when someone blows it.

4949930.name: Fragments
4949930.desc: Explore the LeBlanc hotel and reveal hidden illusions through Eugene’s camera, an archivist. Follow in Laura’s footsteps, an investigator working on the disappearance of Eugene's sister, 20 years ago. Armed with a camera and discretion, can you discover the hotel’s heart and its mysteries?

4567060.name: Retro Districts: In-Between Eras
4567060.desc: A time machine. A war. A leap into 2225. Humanity now lives in retro districts — neighborhoods dedicated to different decades of the 20th century. Unlock ideas, secrets and places — from cabarets to TV studios, from galleries to protests. Choose your words wisely. Every dialogue shapes your path.

movies.name: Retro Districts: In-Between Eras Gameplay Trailer

4704520.name: ShredDead
4704520.desc: ShredDead 是一款古怪又輕鬆的漸進式殭屍絞碎遊戲，主打不會失敗的成長體驗。擊敗無盡屍潮、蒐集戰利品、壯大技能樹，並讓殭屍持續進化。

3768800.name: Shopska Salad
3768800.desc: Defend your grandmother's salad from Bulgarian folk monsters in a first-person tower defense game. Set traps by day, then grab your shotgun to stop anything that gets through at night. Keep the salad fresh for seven nights, solo or with friends.

movies.name: Trailer, music: “Fight music theme01” by GTDStudio aka Palrom (OGA-BY 3.0

2765990.name: Skullf!
2765990.desc: You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf action! After another hilarious night terrorizing locals it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

5394900.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
5394900.desc: 在一座滿是怪物的小鎮經營萬聖節商店。佈置你的家，領養一隻古怪的寵物，探索街道，發現充滿秘密、走私販與驚悚驚喜的夜生活。

5469020.name: Drop That Pen Demo
5469020.desc: The demo includes two pens, the Blockus board and the first two grades. Everything you earn in it carries over to the full game.

5469330.name: STILLTRACE Demo
5469330.desc: The first two days of the quarantine and eight waves of co-op. Repair the radio, scavenge supplies and hold the beacon under attack: alone, with a friend or with a bot partner. Your progress carries over to the full game.

4490850.name: White Mask Mansion
4490850.desc: 尋找你的妹妹。死亡。重新開始。躲避追蹤者。死亡。躲藏起來。死亡。 找到鑰匙。死亡。潛行。死亡。抵達最終區域。活下去。重複。 你有能力逃離 White Mask Mansion 的恐怖嗎？

movies.name: Release Date and Demo Out Now Trailer

5132610.name: 3 Switch Problem Soundtrack
5132610.desc: 三個開關問題遊戲的音樂。

4968160.name: Kleromancy
4968160.desc: What if Slay the Spire used dice instead of cards? Build your own 3D dice, customize their faces, and roll them with real physics in this turn-based roguelike. Create powerful combos, manipulate your rolls, and fight your way through 7 corrupted biomes.

4831660.name: Silver Valley Screams
4831660.desc: Silver Valley may be full of dark corners, but your stomach won't fill itself. The year is 1975, and your father's disappearance is just the latest in a long string. Arm yourself if you plan to venture forth, find your father, and uncover the truth.

5176280.name: SplitOut
5176280.desc: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

4840960.name: 三個開關問題
4840960.desc: 在「三開關解謎公園」的九項挑戰中，撥動開關並觀察結果，找出哪個開關控制相應的裝置。一路上，你可以與其他小朋友交流，並參與各種戶外活動。

273300.name: Outlast: Whistleblower DLC
273300.desc: Whistleblower will let you play as Waylon Park, a software engineer under contract with Murkoff and the man who emailed journalists around the world - including Miles - at the beginning of Outlast. Spending a couple of weeks at Mount Massive, during which he was unable to even talk to his wife and son thanks to strict security protocols,...

567990.name: Sally Face - Season Pass
567990.desc: 《Sally Face》第二至五集附《Sally Face》原聲帶

2828720.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Character DLC
2828720.desc: 使用獨一無二的初音未來進入《Crypt of the NecroDancer》的世界！用可靠的大蔥、經典的服裝和驚豔全場的舞步華麗地擊敗所有擋在你面前的敵人。

fullgame.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut

2642210.name: Slay the Princess - Supporters Pack
2642210.desc: The Slay the Princess OST and over 160 HD Wallpapers. Buy this if you want to further support the developers!

fullgame.name: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers

1628970.name: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers - Supporter Pack
1628970.desc: Digital Art Book and OST for the game If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers.

3518320.name: The Outlast Trials - Sweet Release Pack
3518320.desc: Because candy is dandy, the Sweet Release Pack contains a set of 8 Legendary Outfits that may or may not come with gumdrop buttons, cell items that will rot your teeth, cell posters that will make any candy man jealous, sweet player icons and an E.S.O.P.

3307910.name: The Outlast Trials - Unholy Night Pack
3307910.desc: 'Tis the season to bring some festive horror to all Reagents.

fullgame.name: 紛爭終結者: 被遺棄的孩子們

1345800.name: TROUBLESHOOTER: Abandoned Children - Digital Art Book
1345800.desc: This DLC is a digital artbook of Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children.

1979540.name: 支持者升級
1979540.desc: 購買此版本遊戲旨在展現你對《Songs of Conquest》的開發，以及我們這些開發者的支持。上述額外內容只是錦上添花！

3030370.name: The Outlast Trials - Exotica Pack
3030370.desc: Travel the world from inside your cell with the Exotica Pack! The Exotica pack includes an exclusive set of 4 legendary outfits, E.S.O.P.s, cell items, cell posters and player icons so you can customize your horrific journey.

1450740.name: Monsters & Mortals - Monstrum
1450740.desc: Monstrum is a new Chapter for Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals. It includes 2 playable monsters (Brute & Fiend), 1 playable mortal (Prisoner Borisov), and a new map (Monstrum Madness).

554000.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED
554000.desc: 《Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED 》是《Crypt of the NecroDancer》的前傳可下載內容。控制百變多端的主角「Nocturna」，放膽去挑戰電力滿載的新關卡、頭目戰，以及更多内容！

3651820.name: The Forever Winter - Nosebleed Skin Pack
3651820.desc: The Forever Winter Nosebleed Skin Pack includes:- The Ethereal Pup for Shaman- The Blind Runner Skin for Scav Girl- Kaerguro Skin for Bagman

275850.name: No Man's Sky 無人深空
275850.desc: 《無人深空》是一款打破邊界的科幻遊戲，透過創新的隨機生成技術，打造了一個無盡宇宙供玩家自由探索，玩家可以穿越星際、挖掘未知星球、建立基地並與神秘外星生物共生 ，每個探險家都將書寫屬於自己的宇宙傳奇。

movies.name: 《無人深空：浩瀚宇宙》深度解析

251570.name: 7 Days to Die
251570.desc: 《七日殺》是一款開放世界遊戲，獨特結合了第一人稱射擊、生存恐怖、塔防和角色扮演等遊戲元素。快來體驗排名第一的終極殭屍生存沙盒RPG遊戲吧。暗黑伊甸園正在等你！

dlc.name: 慕尼黑啤酒節護甲套裝

48000.name: LIMBO
48000.desc: Uncertain of his sister's fate, a boy enters LIMBO

304430.name: INSIDE
304430.desc: 孤身只影且遭到追擊，一個男孩發現自己深陷一個黑暗計畫之中。

390290.name: Bulb Boy
390290.desc: One gloomy night, Bulb Boy wakes suddenly from a frightening nightmare to discover that evil has overshadowed the Bulbhouse. His family has disappeared and there are horrid monsters lurking in the shadows. Gather the courage and use his glass head to save everything he loves.

238320.name: Outlast
238320.desc: Hell is an experiment you can't survive in Outlast, a first-person survival horror game developed by veterans of some of the biggest game franchises in history. As investigative journalist Miles Upshur, explore Mount Massive Asylum and try to survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare.

990630.name: The Last Campfire
990630.desc: 《最後營火》是一場冒險故事，關於一個迷失的餘燼，困在處處謎團的地方，努力尋找生命的意義與回家的路。

882020.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 2
882020.desc: 驚險刺激的Monster Energy AMA Supercross 2018年錦標賽來了！ 體驗職業車手的生活、在複合場地測試自己的能耐、面對各種挑戰、管理您的賽事、吸引新的贊助商來獲取名聲並解除新內容的鎖定！

movies.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 2 - Launch Trailer
Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 2 - Announcement Trailer

compare.en: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 2

1726120.name: Cursed to Golf
1726120.desc: 《Cursed to Golf》是一款類高爾夫冒險遊戲，每一桿都至關重要。玩家的任務是衝出高爾夫煉獄，並成為高爾夫傳奇。遊戲中充滿了瘋狂的危險，超自然的強化能力以及無窮的可玩性。你將活著回到人間，還是會陷入……永遠打高爾夫的詛咒！ ？

movies.name: Cursed to Golf  - Release Date Trailer

752590.name: A Plague Tale: Innocence
752590.desc: 跟著年輕的艾蜜西亞與弟弟雨果展開令人揪心的旅程，

movies.name: A Plague Tale: Innocence - Game Awards
A Plague Tale: Innocence - Spoiler Trailer

421740.name: Goetia
421740.desc: Goetia is a point & click adventure where you play the ghost of a young lady. You are Abigail. Abigail Blackwood.

916350.name: Saturnalia
916350.desc: 這是一趟生存恐怖冒險：扮演一群角色，並探索舉行古老儀式的孤立村莊——其迷宮般的道路在你每次失去所有角色後都會改變

5317700.name: GemCremental
5317700.desc: 打造各式各樣的寶石，成為最偉大的魔女！ 一款溫馨的增量製作遊戲。

5306660.name: 雲端巡邏隊
5306660.desc: 《雲端巡邏隊》是一款以浮空島為戰場的快節奏第一人稱射擊遊戲。閃避、橫移、二段跳，在無人機群的圍攻中守住天空，迎戰三大首領，用戰鬥賺來的金幣購買武器，強化護甲、火力與推進器。穿越十二個各具風貌的戰役關卡，以六種武器應對十類敵人；挑戰每次嘗試都會隨機生成競技場配置的無盡模式，刷新個人最佳成績。完成首輪戰役後開啟飛升，征服包含初始戰役在內的三十輪挑戰。選擇難度與隨機修正條件，追求星級評價和每日任務獎勵。支援完整控制器操作及三十種遊戲語言。

5237400.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
5237400.desc: 分類、配對並整理繽紛的 Emoji 世界！探索 2,100 個可愛 Emoji 角色，解開輕鬆的整理謎題，將混亂化為完美秩序。享受溫馨又滿足的體驗，每一步都帶來快樂。建立屬於你自己的整潔 Emoji 收藏！

5087840.name: Chill Gyaru
5087840.desc: Byrd mirrors whatever you're doing. Study and she studies beside you; slack off and she slacks off too. A desktop-companion idle game about looking after a gyaru who lives in the corner of your screen — and saving up the deposit to keep her home.

5370160.name: 挂机传奇
5370160.desc: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

3891200.name: Role Player：山掛姊妹的扮裝糖水照　咕啾咕啾LIVE！
3891200.desc: 由於壯太珍藏的存滿Cosplay照片的相機損壞了，山掛姊妹提出願意成為他的Coser，為他出角色。他欣然接受，並且準備了多套Cosplay服裝，與姊妹一起前往Coser的天堂──哥斯達黎亞。他們能順利完成拍攝嗎？

compare.en: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!

5130520.name: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
5130520.desc: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

5245310.name: 掛機魔王 II
5245310.desc: 《掛機魔王 II》結合放置玩法與暗黑刷寶。自動戰鬥、收集戰利品並不斷強化英雄。選擇戰士、法師、術士、遊俠或死靈法師。六種稀有度、寶石、符文與傳奇威能，打造獨特的終局 Build。

movies.name: 挂机魔王2繁体中文宣传片

5039580.name: Sakura Shiren
5039580.desc: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad.

4922730.name: Send Them to Hell
4922730.desc: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?

4088450.name: RESIDUUM
4088450.desc: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

4597820.name: DRENCHED
4597820.desc: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

4630260.name: Room Zero
4630260.desc: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

4578740.name: Remain Seated
4578740.desc: you've fallen into an abandoned hospital and have become wheelchair-bound. With limited mobility You must use your resources to find yourself a way out while avoiding any dangers that may lurk within.

4209630.name: ELbab
4209630.desc: ELbab is a pixel-art roguelite set in an endless library. Choose tiles to progress through dungeon-like paths and enjoy a build-crafting experience similar to ARPG planning tools. All battles are automated, letting you relax with coffee, videos, or even other games while refining your build.

5399870.name: Idle Hoops
5399870.desc: 一款增量放置類籃球遊戲。投籃得分，組建一支最後簽下真山羊的陣容，在你離開時讓球隊繼續得分。贏下總冠軍，把你的球衣掛上穹頂，從自家車道一路打到太空球場。

5062910.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
5062910.desc: 寶箱、戰鬥、礦石、材料——冒險者會追尋什麼，取決於各自的性情。選定目的地，引導自動前進的冒險者，權衡抄近路與繞行的風險，並選擇兼具能力與壞習慣的技能來成長。這是一款地城Roguelite RPG。

5044970.name: Evoruption
5044970.desc: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

5000310.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
5000310.desc: A single-player top-down extraction shooter where you command Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori-crash-landed in a war-torn desert-by switching between them in real time. Secure supplies to survive, and with the allied forces' help, restore the dimensional transporter and return to Gensokyo.

4971070.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
4971070.desc: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, seven stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

movies.name: You Are the Only Competent Employee (Or Bring a Friend)

5188650.name: The Utsuro Hotel
5188650.desc: A retro first-person horror roguelite where the building decides where you go. Twelve doors, twelve floors, and no door says where it leads until the lock turns behind you. Find the key or gamble on the elevator. Reach the roof. You cannot fight anything here. You can only be somewhere else.

4605840.name: 江湖大镖客
4605840.desc: Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo open-world wuxia management game. Restore your ruined escort bureau with the ancient Mechanism Boat. Manage resources, trade, and fight with tower defense auto-battler gameplay. Seize territories and choose to be either a righteous hero or a ruthless jianghu overlord.

2894950.name: 塞莉婭傳說
2894950.desc: 这是一款即時回合制混合肉鴿的策略魔幻題材的RPG遊戲。 玩家通過控制角色在地下洞窟探索、戰鬥來獲取資源，策略選擇不同的角色合理安排資源分配，用最快速的管道組成適合各種關卡怪物調整的陣型，充分理解組合技能、魔法詞條、裝備、人物特點、站位、行動力、魔力值的分配，成就完全個性化的角色戰鬥風格。

4724580.name: Exhibition of the Heart
4724580.desc: Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

5117700.name: Fragments of Ember
5117700.desc: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

2696110.name: Situation Succ: Inn Elysium
2696110.desc: Situation Succ is a Dark-Fantasy game with a mythos inspired in part by both Asian and Western occult influences. As a detective who finds himself trapped inside an ancient inn by four evil entities, you have to use your wits and investigative abilities to try and escape.

5322620.name: Follow Suit
5322620.desc: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

5095680.name: A cointoss roguelike
5095680.desc: 來擲硬幣試試運氣吧。 機率應該是二分之一。

5062690.name: Re:Draw
5062690.desc: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

1095120.name: Helheim Hassle
1095120.desc: Helheim Hassle is a narrative adventure game with puzzle platforming elements. Play as Bjørn, a pacifist Viking that can detach and combine limbs at will to solve challenging puzzles and get out of uncomfortable situations involving desperate Norse Gods, Goblins, Dragons, and angry skeletons.

530390.name: Slayaway Camp
530390.desc: A killer puzzle game where you control Skullface, a psycho slasher bent on slaughtering camp counselors at the title campground. Slide an adorable voxel murderer around hundreds of isometric puzzle levels to squash, flay, and decapitate hapless victims in this darkly comic homage to 80s horror.

798490.name: Othercide
798490.desc: 身為人類最後的希望，你將帶領軍隊，利用原創的動態時間軸系統，在精彩動作與反擊交織的繁複之舞中戰鬥。

dlc.name: Othercide - Dressed to Kill - Cosmetics Pack

384110.name: Pathologic Classic HD
384110.desc: Pathologic Classic HD is the Definitive Edition of the original Cult Classic Psychological First-Person Survival game. In this unforgettable experience, players control one of three unique characters as they try to save a mysterious town from a deadly plague that cannot be stopped.

247430.name: Hitman: Contracts
247430.desc: Enter the world of a HITMAN - a world of crime, sin and greed. Delve into the mind of Agent 47 and encounter his greatest adversaries, completing the work that made him so brutally efficient and shaped him as an assassin. Eliminate your targets by any means necessary. There are no rules... only the contract, signed in blood.

247080.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer
247080.desc: 「《節奏地牢》是一款獲獎的硬派節奏類Rogue遊戲。隨著音樂移動，並跟著節拍進行猛攻。玩家必須按節奏移動，穿越隨機生成的地牢，同時與跳舞的骷髏、僵屍、龍等進行戰鬥，與此同時隨著屢獲殊榮的丹尼·巴拉諾夫斯基（Danny Baranowsky）的原聲帶搖擺起來！你甚至可以在本地合作模式中與朋友組隊！

dlc.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer：支援者升級包
Crypt of the NecroDancer：鏟子騎士角色 DLC
Crypt of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Character DLC
Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED OST - Chipzel
Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED OST - OC ReMix
Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED OST - Virt and Girlfriend Records
Crypt of the NecroDancer: AMPLIFIED OST - FamilyJules and A_Rival

414700.name: Outlast 2
414700.desc: Outlast 2 introduces you to Sullivan Knoth and his followers, who left our wicked world behind to give birth to Temple Gate, a town, deep in the wilderness and hidden from civilization. Knoth and his flock are preparing for the tribulations of the end of times and you’re right in the thick of it.

626660.name: Flipping Death
626660.desc: Possess the living, aid the dead and flip between the worlds of Flipping Death - a puzzling adventure platformer where you find yourself filling in for Death. Maybe your new powers will help you solve the mystery of your own demise?

1367590.name: 受折磨的靈魂
1367590.desc: Classic survival horror is back! Inspired by the original Resident Evil and Alone in the Dark series, Tormented Souls modernises with a fresh twist on the fixed perspective adventure - as Caroline Walker investigates the mysterious disappearance of twin girls in a terrifying mansion-turned-hospital.

337480.name: Zombie Vikings
337480.desc: 與僵屍海盜共同踏上極度危險又充滿樂趣的冒險旅程。一隊腐爛的武裝隊被派遣執行任務，他們要在恢宏的史詩世界中找回奧丁丟失的眼睛

239140.name: Dying Light
239140.desc: 這款第一人稱動作生存遊戲，位於一個充滿食肉喪屍的末日後世界。穿梭於一座被神秘病毒所摧殘的城市。收集物資、打造武器並面對成群的感染者。

914020.name: Gibbous -  A Cthulhu Adventure
914020.desc: Crazy cultists. Cthulhu. A talking cat. Gibbous takes you on an expansive, traditionally animated, hand-painted adventure. Play as three protagonists and explore a lushly rendered Lovecraft-inspired world, unraveling ancient conspiracies. A comedy cosmic horror adventure made in Transylvania!

792300.name: The Beast Inside
792300.desc: The Beast Inside is a unique, gripping twist on thriller and survival horror. Immerse in the story of long-buried secrets, personal tragedies, and madness. Play as two protagonists bounded by dark heritage. Combat the enemies, solve riddles and experience real terror in the 3D-scanned environment.

movies.name: The Beast Inside Launch Trailer - action trailer

438430.name: Valentino Rossi The Game
438430.desc: The most complete MotoGP™ game ever! Join Valentino Rossi’s VR|46 Riders Academy and train with him in order to become the new champion of the 2016 MotoGP™ season!

1466230.name: 神的超級大寶貝
1466230.desc: 好消息：你是天使——壞消息：天堂藥丸——好消息：你還有時間——壞消息：只有6小時。 啊？你想讓我一口氣說完？好的：天堂還有6小時就要爆炸了你必須想想辦法拿到《神的超級大寶貝》不然你死我死大家死明白嗎不明白你往下看

934700.name: Dead Island 2
934700.desc: 《Dead Island 2》是款刺激的第一人稱動作角色扮演遊戲，有著恐怖、黑色幽默與誇張的喪屍砍殺調製而成的獨特配方。探索遍地血污並且屍滿為患的經典洛杉磯風光。認識非凡的角色，並裝備大量武器、模組與技能，砍殺無數敵人，欣賞精緻的血液細節。

movies.name: Dead Island 2 Ultimate Edition Launch Trailer
Dead Island 2 Neighborhood Watch Reveal Trailer

1823930.name: Wavetale
1823930.desc: Surf the waters of a submerged city! Unravel the past, save the islanders from mysterious sea monsters and discover secrets hidden under the surface.

1608230.name: Planet of Lana
1608230.desc: 冰冷的機械入侵了星球，昔日綠意盎然的世界如今滿目瘡痍。女孩與她的夥伴並肩求生，在廢墟之中守護他們珍視的一切。這段關於愛、犧牲與信念的動人旅程，即使落幕，仍會深刻銘記於心，餘韻悠長。

573130.name: Aporia: Beyond The Valley
573130.desc: CRYNEGINE Indie Game of 2017. Featuring an incredibly detailed ancient world and a breathtaking soundtrack, Aporia: Beyond the Valley takes open world storytelling to new heights of adventure.

361990.name: Lakeview Cabin Collection
361990.desc: Delve into the diverse world of horror movies in this 2D action puzzler. Nothing can prepare you for the R-rated challenges you will face!

747360.name: Gray Dawn
747360.desc: Embark on a terrifying adventure of a priest accused of murdering an altar boy. Gray Dawn is a psychological thriller infused with religious elements and combines story-driven quests with an artistic experience.

movies.name: Gray Dawn Gameplay Trailer – Despicable Things

1158890.name: White Shadows
1158890.desc: The wolves are watching! Venture through a captivating but brutal dystopia where our young adventurer Ravengirl will travel through this huge city’s brightest highs and delve to its darkest depths on her perilous journey of discovery and finding her destiny where hope seems in short supply.

694280.name: Zombie Army 4: Dead War
694280.desc: Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter from the makers of Sniper Elite 4! Abominable occult enemies, epic weapons and a harrowing new campaign for 1-4 players await in 1940s Europe, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!

1175840.name: Whateverland
1175840.desc: 《隨便境》是一款手繪風格的點擊冒險遊戲，擁有分支對話系統、非線性的遊戲玩法、多種結局以及內置的回合制桌面小遊戲。

489260.name: Brut@l
489260.desc: A modern re-imagining of the classic ASCII dungeon crawler. Choose your hero and descend into a procedurally generated world constructed entirely from ASCII letters. Can you survive?

1577250.name: The Chant
1577250.desc: 第三人稱恐怖動作冒險單人遊戲，場景設定在一座杳無人煙的靈性靜修小島上。想生存下去，你必須製作物品、戰鬥，並逃離因靈修儀式出差錯而喚醒的宇宙恐怖空間，以及襲捲而來的恐怖生物。

movies.name: The Chant Launch Accolades Trailer PEGI

368260.name: 漫威午夜之子
368260.desc: 在漫威宇宙最黑暗的角落裡化身超級英雄，挺身奮戰、運籌帷幄！ 扮演傳奇惡魔殺手「獵人」，領導一支由超級英雄與超自然戰士組成的隊伍，面對世界末日的威脅。

1116580.name: Shady Part of Me
1116580.desc: 在充滿曲折與驚喜的感人故事中戰勝情感鬥爭。踏上夢幻旅程、令人驚歎的藝術感和漢娜·穆瑞（權力的遊戲、造型）的迷人聲音將陪伴著你。

movies.name: Shady Part of Me - Accolade Trailer
Shady Part of Me - Launch Trailer

427290.name: Vampyr
427290.desc: 倫敦，1918年——你是剛成為霧都吸血鬼的喬納森．里德醫生。身為醫生，你必須找到方法，拯救在這個城市中被流感肆虐的市民；你卻同時受到吸血鬼身份的詛咒，面對發誓要治癒的人，你卻需要以他們為餌食……

555220.name: 返校
555220.desc: 以一九六零年代的台灣為原型的架空劇情。 獨特的插畫拼貼風格，以及精心編製的原創音樂。 在令人屏息的緊張感中，解開一個又一個秘密。 孤獨的學生，殘酷的校園，以及讓人無力面對的真相。

1326470.name: Sons Of The Forest
1326470.desc: 你被派到了一座孤島上尋找走失的富翁，卻發現那是座由食人生物佔領的煉獄之島。你需要鍛造武器、建築棲身之所，努力生存下去。無論有沒有朋友相伴，都得想方設法在這款開放式恐怖生存模擬遊戲中活下去。

4312190.name: 破殼行動 (CRACK)
4312190.desc: 實驗室裡為什麼會有一顆巨蛋？你的工作很簡單：把它敲開。別問為什麼。 《破殼行動 (CRACK)》是一款支援 1–4 人合作的漸進式冒險遊戲。和朋友一起想辦法打開這顆神祕巨蛋，看看裡面到底藏著什麼。

1815570.name: Aces & Adventures
1815570.desc: Aces & Adventures is a deckbuilding RPG with poker-powered combat. Craft your deck, combining poker hands with powerful ability cards. Journey through 13 fully-voiced campaigns to save the Life Tree, or tackle procedurally-generated runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

242110.name: Joe Danger 2: The Movie
242110.desc: Joe Danger, the world’s most determined stuntman, returns to embark on a death-defying thrill-ride across the set of the greatest blockbuster movie ever made. Across 100 crazy levels he’ll chase crooks by police bike, destroy laser-firing robots with a stolen jetpack, escape giant boulders in a minecart, time-travel to punch dinosaurs...

558420.name: Stories Untold
558420.desc: Stories Untold is a compilation tape of four experimental adventures, including a remaster of the original hit episode “The House Abandon”.

5034420.name: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
5034420.desc: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

4993800.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
4993800.desc: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

5380600.name: Cricket Franchise Manager
5380600.desc: Build a T20 cricket franchise from the auction room up, then captain every ball. Outbid rivals for star players, set fields and match-ups in a deep live match engine, and manage the board, sponsors and finances across a global multi-league career.

5049810.name: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
5049810.desc: 《Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats》是一款與時間賽跑的隱藏物品尋找遊戲，你需要在世界最具標誌性的地點中找出100隻隱藏的貓咪。發現貓咪，謹慎點擊，巧妙運用提示，努力登上全球排行榜的巔峰。

4878890.name: Factory Shift
4878890.desc: 《进厂模拟器》是一款支援 1–4 人遊玩的第一人稱工廠產線模擬遊戲。趕訂單、修故障，還要對抗變異物品。在接連不斷的災難中維持產線運作，順便幫彼此收拾爛攤子。

4709490.name: Minatro
4709490.desc: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

4404570.name: Eternal Rift Defense
4404570.desc: Build mazes, place towers, and fight beside them in a 3D tower defense RPG. Defend 50 rifts solo or in 4-player co-op, level towers by standing on them, collect powerful gear sets, shape your build with heroes, talents, upgrades, and join a 10-player raid to slay a dragon.

4931550.name: MOGUMOGU! POOP BATTLE
4931550.desc: 操控 🥕 收集 🐰，和隊友一起餵給 🐺 吧！被吃掉的 🐰 會變成 💩……直接射進敵方陣地！！最多支援 4 人對戰的 2 vs 2 團隊戰。一個人玩或和好友連線都超級勁爆！

5213550.name: Spooky Sex Party
5213550.desc: Spooky Sex Party 是一款成人社交推理遊戲，故事發生在一場萬聖節居家派對的一夜之間。十二位女性扮成怪物登場，但其中一位根本沒有變裝。在災難降臨之前找出她是誰……否則你就會錯失和怪物女孩共度春宵的機會！

5233490.name: Sort The Bunnies
5233490.desc: 適合1–4人遊玩的溫馨收納模擬遊戲。整理500種不同造型的兔兔，填滿繽紛的層架，把凌亂小店變成讓人捨不得移開目光的收藏天地。解鎖實用升級，讓整理更輕鬆，也別忘了偶爾來點小惡作劇。

5045630.name: Crownspat
5045630.desc: 在這款輕鬆詼諧的即時戰略遊戲中率領你的王國，對抗三個敵對王國。指揮部隊、佔領領土、建造村莊與防禦工事、管理稅收和資源，並在色彩繽紛的等角視角戰場上以謀略擊敗敵人。

4356780.name: 桌面股神
4356780.desc: 《Screen Stocks》這款線上多人股票交易遊戲提供即時模擬市場，玩家運用買入、做空和賣出股票，以此累積驚人的財富。可與其他交易者聯手，亦可獨自發揮，智勝群雄。馬上加入，大賺特賺吧！

4854690.name: Cat Eats Sushi
4854690.desc: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

5323650.name: 魔法覺醒：英雄戰歌
5323650.desc: 輕鬆上手的策略肉鴿新作，融合彈幕射擊、背包管理與塔防玩法。隨機招募英雄、合成進化、招募女神、升級城堡，抵禦魔獸浪潮。100+關卡，局外成長，低配暢玩。

4594300.name: RACAR - Shooter FPS
4594300.desc: Online FPS shooter with state-of-the-art graphics and total customization!

4856160.name: Conquest of Empires 3
4856160.desc: 《帝國文明3》建構了一個策略至上的多元文明戰爭世界，在這裡，謀略是唯一的通行證，每位玩家都能憑藉智慧，在史詩沙盤中開創屬於自己的霸業。

4684140.name: Tax Empire
4684140.desc: 建立​屬於​你​自己​的​稅收​帝​國！​徵收​稅款、​擴展​城市、​僱用​稅務​官員、​管理​交通、​制定​新​的​政策，​並​在​邁向​財富​的​道路​上​獲​取盡​可能​多​的​收入。

3929570.name: 节度使战略：安史之乱
3929570.desc: 天寶十四載，安史兵變，禍起幽州，兩京失守，叛軍進逼靈州，形勢岌岌可危。玩家將領朔方支營節度使之職，重整官軍攻勢，以對抗叛軍，恢複大唐江山。

4982060.name: Anti-anti
4982060.desc: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

4683480.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
4683480.desc: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

movies.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps - Gameloop Trailer 1
Space Cadets: Engineering Corps - Gameplay Trailer 1

4451020.name: Block Party
4451020.desc: A shared online world where every block was placed by a player. Claim your own panel, draw pixel art with layer, stack, shape and selection tools, import images and 3D models, then walk your build in first person. React, comment, follow builders, and buy or sell panels.

5005140.name: Undermoon
5005140.desc: UnderMoon 是一款黑暗奇幻回合制戰術 Roguelike。穿越神祕傳送門，在方格戰場上規劃走位，選擇種族並搭配武器與技能，利用火焰、冰與閃電改變戰局。探索不同主題的區域，挑戰頭目，尋找離開這片月下世界的線索。

3335490.name: SkyFab
3335490.desc: 擱淺在神秘立方體星球陰影下的浮島上，你必須憑智慧和工程學求生。建造複雜的自動化流水線，管理電網，並將一棵樹變成一個龐大的工業太空站。你能找到回家的路嗎？

4095800.name: The Failed
4095800.desc: As a failed experiment, you’re marked for disposal. That was the plan until the lab descended into chaos. Seize your chance and find a way out!

5121070.name: Circle to another motion
5121070.desc: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

5265620.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
5265620.desc: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

4945970.name: Mia's Journey
4945970.desc: Help Mia, a curious and adventurous girl who loves helping others, no matter the situation. She is trapped in the cat kingdom and wants to return to her human body, but she will have to overcome various puzzle challenges to achieve her goal.

4949290.name: Dead Prints
4949290.desc: PSX style psychological horror where you run an overnight print shop. Identify sinister customers, manage print supplies, make copies, and manage your insanity as your mind gets more and more unstable.

5399160.name: 67 hidden 67´s
5399160.desc: 67 Hidden 67's is a hidden-object game set in a hand-drawn meme village. Search for the hidden 67s, zoom in on the small ones, and click each mark until you have found all 67.

4794110.name: Anomalous Veil
4794110.desc: You are trapped inside an endless house shaped by memory and guilt. Use mysterious masks to reveal hidden layers of reality, identify anomalies and escape a psychological time loop.

454410.name: GIGA WRECKER
454410.desc: 化身成為超能戰士，拯救人類免於滅亡！由鼎鼎大名的 Game Freak 一手打造，前無古人的動作冒險遊戲。背負起世界的命運，粉碎邪惡的亞積特！

7800.name: Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse
7800.desc: 當個殭屍，大開殺戒，摘取腦髓。

compare.en: Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse

307570.name: A Golden Wake
307570.desc: The rise and fall story of a real estate agent in 1920s Miami. Based on historical events. From Francisco González, creator of the Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator series, Shardlight, and Lamplight City.

301640.name: Zombie Army Trilogy
301640.desc: The cult horror shooter series comes to an apocalyptic conclusion with an epic new third chapter, a heart-pumping new horde mode, and remastered editions of the best-selling Nazi Zombie Army 1 & 2.

movies.name: FREE Left 4 Dead Character Update Trailer

1191900.name: Say No! More
1191900.desc: 《Say No! More》是全球首款NPG（說NO！扮演遊戲）。玩家將扮演一位對所有人和事都懷著強烈說「不」欲望的實習生。快來自訂你的角色，用各種風格和語言盡情說「不」，暢快反擊那些尖酸刻薄的同事，最終改變世界！

1077970.name: Dry Drowning
1077970.desc: Dry Drowning is a psychological investigative visual novel set in a futuristic dystopian city. Follow the story of Mordred Foley, unscrupulous private detective haunted by his dark past, and look into a series of macabre serial killings inspired by Greek mythology.

1271700.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™
1271700.desc: 收集Hot Wheels™世界裡最棒的車輛、建造壯觀的賽道，並一頭鑽入令人屏息的競賽中。

698670.name: Scorn
698670.desc: 《Scorn》是款氛圍獨特的第一人稱恐怖冒險遊戲，故事發生在由詭異形體和陰闇聚合所組成的噩夢宇宙中。

movies.name: Gameplay and Release Date Announce Trailer

510420.name: The Hex
510420.desc: In a creaky old tavern, in a forgotten corner of the video-game universe, a storm is raging. An anonymous caller suggests that there is a murder plot. Six video game protagonists are the only plausible suspects...

dlc.name: The Hex - "Vicious Galaxy II" Original Soundtrack
The Hex - "Secrets of Legendaria" Original Soundtrack
The Hex - "Combat Arena X" Original Soundtrack
The Hex - "Super Weasel Kid" Original Soundtrack

1099500.name: The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets
1099500.desc: 體驗一個孩子般奇妙的互動故事！透過探索從頭開始為VR製作的精彩微縮世界，幫助你的祖父解決被盜寵物之謎。在寒冬的景緻中使用吹風機融化冰雪！搜尋部分隱藏在水面之下的海盜船殘骸！每個世界都獨一無二，充滿了互動和豐富多彩的生活。

compare.en: The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets

416680.name: Zombie Night Terror
416680.desc: 準備好了嗎？夜幕即將拉下，毛骨悚然的故事就要展開！發生了可怕的事情！大家都變成了嗜血如命的行屍走肉。知道是誰在指揮這支殭屍大軍嗎？是你！來吧！盡情擴散瘟疫吧！將人類從這個世界抹除吧！在殭屍浩劫中生存下來的唯一方式，就是親手製造這場浩劫！

movies.name: Zombie Night Terror - Moonwalkers Update Launch Trailer

1386900.name: Observer: System Redux
1386900.desc: 第一人稱賽博龐克恐怖偵探故事，以霓虹燈下千瘡百孔的黯淡未來為背景。身為透過潛入他人意識來追蹤線索的觀察者，你將層層剖析被侵蝕的記憶，並在追捕神祕凶手的過程中，直面自身黑暗的過往。

1297300.name: The Shore
1297300.desc: THE SHORE is a first person story driven game with an atmospheric environment and narrations, You will encounter mysterious creatures and unravel the secrets behind them. Strong elements of horror, struggle to survive an unknown world that will make you question your own sanity.

1087760.name: The Gunk
1087760.desc: 《The Gunk》的主角 Rani 是勇敢的太空搬運工雙人組之一，靠著辛勤工作勉強維持生計的他們偶然來到了一個生機勃勃的未開發星球。他們來此尋找值錢的資源，看起來這次是中了大獎……

1898290.name: LEGO® Bricktales
1898290.desc: 在《LEGO® Bricktales》中，通過一磚一瓦的創意性搭建，乘著想像力的翅膀，解開重重謎題。在美麗的LEGO世界中，賦予你的傑作蓬勃生命力。在這裏，一切問題都有一個“建設性”解決方案。

movies.name: LEGO® Bricktales - Release Date Announcement Trailer

596000.name: The Shattering
596000.desc: The Shattering is a first-person, story-driven, psychological thriller. Its defining features are the dynamic environments, beautiful aesthetic and intriguing story. The gameplay is meant to submerge you in the mind of John, as you take each step forward into the twisted mystery of what happened.

1318970.name: This Way Madness Lies
1318970.desc: Shakespeare and Magical Girls, what could be better? Save the worlds of Shakespeare from the forces of Nightmare in this fast-paced turn-based JRPG comedy.

480490.name: Prey
480490.desc: In Prey, you awaken aboard Talos I, a space station orbiting the moon in the year 2032. You are the key subject of an experiment meant to alter humanity forever – but things have gone terribly wrong. The space station has been overrun by hostile aliens and you are now being hunted.

1903620.name: Killer Frequency
1903620.desc: 《Killer Frequency》是一款第一人稱恐怖冒險遊戲，您將會扮演深夜電台主持人 Forrest Nash，他的聽眾遭到神秘殺人魔盯上。點唱機播放著 80 年代的歌曲，而您要一邊聆聽這些復古的曲調，一邊解開謎題、拯救人命，掌控交換台！

1414250.name: CORPSE FACTORY
1414250.desc: Discard your sense of morality and enter the world of CORPSE FACTORY. An obscure website allows users to request a death. Victims supposedly receive a photograph of their own corpse before they are killed! With English voice acting by an all-star cast.

264710.name: Subnautica
264710.desc: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

233290.name: Murdered: Soul Suspect
233290.desc: MURDERED: SOUL SUSPECT™ takes players into a whole new realm of mystery where the case is personal and the clues just out of reach, challenging gamers to solve the hardest case of all… their own murder.

movies.name: Murdered Launch Trailer EN NO RATING

440880.name: 盧卡諾伯爵
440880.desc: 從《薩爾達傳說》與《沉默之丘》等經典作品中吸取靈感而創作的像素冒險遊戲。

313780.name: Conarium
313780.desc: Conarium is a chilling Lovecraftian game, which follows a gripping story involving four scientists and their endeavor to challenge what we normally consider to be the ‘absolute’ limits of nature. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s novella "At the Mountains of Madness", but largely set after the original story.

501320.name: The Shrouded Isle
501320.desc: Your Excellency, in this short systems-management survival game, we prepare for the awakening of our Lord. He hungers for human sacrifice. Sinners try to hide their dark secrets, but all must be purged...

6420.name: Nexus - The Jupiter Incident
6420.desc: 雄心勃勃的巨型企業壟斷了太空征服。在太陽系的邊緣，一項發現徹底改變了技術優勢並打破了平衡。一場新的衝突由此爆發：「木星事件」（The Jupiter Incident）。

1623940.name: Bramble: The Mountain King
1623940.desc: 《荊棘：群山之王》是一款受北歐傳說啟發的黑暗世界冒險的遊戲。為了拯救姊姊，探索這個美麗卻又危險的扭曲荊棘之地。遊歷奇妙的美景，遭遇《荊棘》中致命又猙獰的生物，掙扎吧！求生吧！。

movies.name: Bramble: The Mountain King - Launch Trailer
Bramble: The Mountain King - Release Date Trailer

1532690.name: BLACKTAIL
1532690.desc: 締造芭芭·雅加的傳奇，化身一名被指控為女巫並被逐出村莊的女孩， 一邊體驗刺激弓箭戰鬥以及沉重黑暗的故事， 一邊在這五彩繽紛的童話世界中親身體驗斯拉夫傳說的起源。

1016930.name: The Great Perhaps
1016930.desc: 《The Great Perhaps》是一款穿梭時空的謎題遊戲，故事關於一名太空人返回被大災難摧毀的地球。 在一片廢墟之中，他發現了一件不尋常的神器：一盞舊燈籠，燈籠發出的光可以讓他窺見另一個時空並回到過去。

1123770.name: Curse of the Dead Gods
1123770.desc: 為了尋找無人知曉的財富、永恆的生命與超越凡人的神力，你來到了這處遭受詛咒的神廟，一座彷彿永無止盡的迷宮，遍布無底深淵、致命陷阱和駭人怪物。

movies.name: Curse of the Dead Gods - Curse of the Dead Cells Update Trailer
Curse of the Dead Gods - Launch Trailer

871420.name: Lovecraft's Untold Stories
871420.desc: Lovecraft’s Untold Stories is an action roguelite with RPG elements. Explore randomly generated levels based in Lovecraft's stories, fight cultists and all kinds of monsters from the Mythos, improve your gear, solve puzzles, and find clues and knowledge to defeat the Great Old Ones.

275180.name: Costume Quest 2
275180.desc: A sequel to the popular Halloween adventure from Double Fine Productions!

1302050.name: Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star
1302050.desc: A visual novel about an abusive relationship, idealization, and intimacy. Live a summer of dysfunctional love through branching storylines, twists, sudden changes, and an innovative mechanic where you choose which senses to use with your boyfriend.

compare.en: Milky Way Prince  The Vampire Star

1298140.name: Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel
1298140.desc: 過去、現在和未來在生存恐怖遊戲《Fobia: St. Dinfna Hotel》中相互碰撞。在不同的時間線中探索一家破敗的酒店，揭開一個狂熱邪教組織的黑暗歷史，並找到自己在他們計劃中的作用。

286480.name: Black Mirror III
286480.desc: Help Darren continue his search to uncover his clouded past. What do his torturous nightmares really mean? Who is the mysterious person that posted the bail to set him free? What demons lie waiting in the crypt?

601430.name: The Evil Within 2
601430.desc: 賽巴斯汀‧卡斯特拉諾警探失去了珍視的一切，包括他的寶貝女兒莉莉。為了拯救莉莉，賽巴斯汀不得不潛入STEM的夢魘世界。這世界的每個角落都藏著駭人威脅，他必須展現過人智慧才能殺出一條生路。這是救贖的唯一機會，而深入夢魘則是唯一出路。

4688700.name: Project Exhibitionist
4688700.desc: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

4438600.name: Tiny Capsule Collector
4438600.desc: Run a cozy capsule shop at the bottom of your screen. Attract adorable animal customers, collect charming capsule toys, create and decorate a relaxing, ambient world. This desktop companion brings you small moments of joy making your desktop a place you’d rather be. All hand-crafted, no AI used.

4287040.name: Vampy's Big Day
4287040.desc: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

3986340.name: When the Embers Wake
3986340.desc: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure about Emmie and the relationship with her mother. You play as a red panda as their story unfolds, raising awareness of the urgent and very real threats facing wildlife today.

4864900.name: Dyson Sphere: Desktop Factory
4864900.desc: Automated Production Lines + Roguelike Modifiers + Tower Defense Combat + Desktop Wallpaper Ignite your base on Tpler and forge your Dyson Sphere industrial wonder. Build automated desktop lines, deploy drone logistics, launch units to orbit. Draw tech perks for your build and boost output.

4849240.name: Duel: The Game Show
4849240.desc: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 varied mini-games testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?

5247240.name: MEGA TAG PANIC
5247240.desc: 抓人遊戲——但鬼會不停變大。巨大的鬼鑽不過窄門，那就是你的出路。蓄力拍擊，在紅色區域放開，把朋友打飛。2-10 人，12 張地圖，6 種模式，10 個角色配 10 種特殊能力。線上沒人？機器人可不會手下留情。

5320010.name: One More Commit
5320010.desc: Build your dev studio one commit at a time. Upgrade your setup, manage Technical Debt, ship projects, and survive bugs, demanding clients, overheating servers, and security breaches in this incremental developer sim.

5042370.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
5042370.desc: A physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Octbuster has over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart that follows you, a kitten army that helps, an arcade buried under the mess, co-op multiplayer, Twitch chat in your store, and no generative AI.

dlc.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup Playtest
Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup Demo

3560890.name: Rushmark
3560890.desc: Your dash is your weapon. On the ground it's back in under a second. In the air you get one, and only a kill buys another. A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer: wall-kick, chain and strike through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

5267500.name: Warlock: Age of Entropy
5267500.desc: A power-hungry warlock descends fifteen floors to unearth a malevolent energy sealed deep in a dungeon. He'll have to use items sparingly, spells tactically, and even recruit the help of forgotten gods to get there in this brutally difficult traditional roguelike.

5194510.name: TETRIC
5194510.desc: Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in T É T R I C. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.

movies.name: T È T R I C Launch Trailer

5140020.name: Junkyard Astronauts
5140020.desc: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

5038060.name: Medieval Bust
5038060.desc: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

4882240.name: A Dark Cave
4882240.desc: 在殘酷的世界中求生，建造並擴展你的村莊，深入下方的黑暗。在這款黑暗文字增量遊戲中收集資源、做出艱難抉擇，並揭開隱藏於洞穴深處那難以言說的真相。

5083960.name: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
5083960.desc: 你在一座空寂的機器人物流廠上夜班。備貨、打包、送出。流程看似單純，但每一夜都有什麼東西偏離得更遠一點。十個夜晚。兩種結局。免費試玩版：前 3 個夜晚。

dlc.name: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol Demo

3608290.name: The Last Fireman
3608290.desc: Race the clock in an arcade firefighting game. Plan your route, manage your extinguisher and dodge explosive hazards across five levels. Master each route, beat your best times and take on the entire campaign in Speed Run mode.

5129850.name: Rate & State
5129850.desc: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

5227440.name: RealSub Full Version
5227440.desc: 解鎖 RealSub 的翻譯與歷史匯出:即時雙語字幕(中/日/英互譯,中文可選簡體或繁體)、按會話儲存的轉錄歷史、SRT 與 TXT 匯出。本體的即時轉錄字幕永久免費,這份 DLC 只加不減。

5227410.name: RealSub
5227410.desc: 看無字幕的日語影片,螢幕上即時浮出中文字幕。語音識別全部在你自己的電腦上跑,GTX 10 系列、2GB 顯示記憶體起跳就能跑(推薦 4GB 更穩),沒有 N 卡可嘗試 Vulkan,還有 CPU 模式備援。可以只捕獲某一個應用程式的聲音,不被通知音打斷。免費版提供完整的即時轉錄字幕,翻譯與匯出由完整版 DLC 解鎖。

fullgame.name: Time O'Clock: The Mask of Crime

5309430.name: Time O'clock: The Mask of Crime Demo
5309430.desc: The mask of a legendary thief has been stolen. Follow Detective Time in a point-and-click investigation using her watch to witness key moments and uncover who is behind this new wave of robberies. Observe the past. Investigate the present. Uncover the truth.

movies.name: Time O'clock: The Mask of Crime - Trailer

4883600.name: Necromancer: Ash & Bone
4883600.desc: Raise an army of destruction and carve through massive enemy swarms. Combine powerful abilities and artifacts, experiment with countless build combinations, and transform from a lone necromancer into a force of death.

5293180.name: CUTAWAY!
5293180.desc: Cut the board, avoid the balls, and reveal anime artwork. Master increasingly challenging levels, earn stars, and unlock new images and special illustrations.

5342720.name: ENROQUIA
5342720.desc: Chess in a 3D club room. James, your coach, tests you, gives you lessons, and comments on your games. The Academy adapts to your level and turns your mistakes into exercises. Twenty opponents move the pieces by hand and press the clock. In 13 languages, no account needed.

5349250.name: WarSlice Demo
5349250.desc: Fight for the glory of battle in WarSlice! Try out some turn-based tactical combat with the demo, which offers both offline campaign missions and online PvP!

4405820.name: Broken Soccer
4405820.desc: 從38支荒唐的球隊中選一支，擲出骰子，放出恐龍衝撞、殭屍感染、牛市（真的有一頭牛）或從板凳殺出的尼采。終場哨響還是平手？脫掉球鞋，亮出拳頭。支援單人、合作和最多4v4的線上對戰。

5170000.name: Tainted Tide
5170000.desc: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

4780520.name: MaMills
4780520.desc: The 3D four-in-a-row game I played with my grandmother - now in a digital form. You can outsmart the Machine across five difficulties, solve 40 one-solution puzzles, or challenge a friend on the couch, over LAN or with Steam Remote Play Together.

4508110.name: CYBERLIFE
4508110.desc: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

4898890.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
4898890.desc: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

2825110.name: 科技烏托邦
2825110.desc: 《科技烏托邦》是一款城市營造類卡牌遊戲。你將扮演人工智慧AI，任務是建造完美城市。構建不同區塊，滿足各群體的需求，平衡覬覦你的各方勢力！

1329260.name: 嗜血印 Bloody Spell DLC 清凉泳装系列
1329260.desc: This is a martial arts action role-playing game. The core of the game is battle-oriented, and it combines many fighting elements. If you are a player who pursues blood and is brave enough to challenge the limits, it will definitely inspire your adrenaline and bring you the best combat experience.

1329262.name: 嗜血印 Bloody Spell DLC 婚纱系列
1329262.desc: This is a martial arts action role-playing game. The core of the game is battle-oriented, and it combines many fighting elements. If you are a player who pursues blood and is brave enough to challenge the limits, it will definitely inspire your adrenaline and bring you the best combat experience.

3322630.name: Culdcept BEGINS（卡爾朵聖譜 起源）
3322630.desc: 融合了桌上遊戲與卡牌遊戲的傳奇作品 《Culdcept》。 嶄新且獨一無二的遊戲系統，自發售之初便讓無數玩家為之著迷。 玩家將化身為能夠自由操控卡牌的<聖譜使>，運用運氣與策略，與對手展開激烈對決。 歷經十年，全新的故事即將展開。

dlc.name: Culdcept BEGINS 早期購買特典

4922630.name: The Long Dark: Iron Road
4922630.desc: THE LONG DARK Survival Expansion. Welcome to Cauldron Island. Lost to history, hiding a mystery. Restore & activate a century-old train to journey deep along the caldera’s spine & uncover a dark secret. What you discover in the end will change how you survive in this Aurora-changed world, forever.

2223980.name: Nomad Drive
2223980.desc: 修復您破舊的房車，單人或1–4人合作駛向程序生成的末日後世界。收集資源，自訂您的房車，並盡可能長時間生存。

movies.name: Nomad Drive: Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

4268960.name: Catgirls Rhythm Game
4268960.desc: A relaxing game with pleasant music. Press the buttons in time to unlock hot videos with beautiful catgirls.

3979950.name: Wonder Catgirl XXX
3979950.desc: A three-button banger where landing the cues unlocks catgirl adult videos. Fast arcade, zero fluff.

4163150.name: SEX ORCgasm
4163150.desc: Me Orc-Gruk smash out rhythm game for elf-lovers like you! Tap-tap-tap to thumping beat, make pointy-ear girls wiggle wild and unlock steamy adult bang-fest. All-new soundtrack slap like orc club to elf butt, perfect groove for your... special rhythm sessions!

3915860.name: Voiceless
3915860.desc: An interactive FMV slasher. Emma's sister is gone. The only lead: a serial killer locked in a psychiatric ward. Enter. Find answers. Get out alive.

5004590.name: Darcnia Monster
5004590.desc: 放下一張卡，怪獸就從卡面走上場。Darcnia 是一款戰術卡牌遊戲：每一場決鬥都在全 3D 的場上展開，每一張卡都是一個活著的像素藝術靈魂。登上懸在虛空之上的十層高塔，擊敗每一層的守護者，再把它們封印進卡裡——每一場勝利都變成你卡組裡的一張新卡。掌握咒喚、力量、蟄伏、領域與儀式五種符文：在這裡，魔法不是抽出來的，是刻出來的。100+ 隻怪獸等你封印，從 F 到 SSS，全都由一個人一格一格畫成，而且還在增加。

5030570.name: Supermarket Organizer
5030570.desc: 將空蕩蕩的日本便利商店打造成溫馨舒適的便利商店。擺放家具、整理商品，享受親手打造完美小店的輕鬆與滿足。

5423900.name: Cashflow Empire
5423900.desc: Build your fortune from the ground up in this colorful idle business simulator. Grow from dog walking to a global empire, buy businesses, hire managers to automate profits, and unlock upgrades. Then claim mogul prestige, reset your empire, and return stronger for your next run.

3712150.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
3712150.desc: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

2471800.name: Something Something Spaceship
2471800.desc: 探索一艘出故障的太空船，收集修復飛船所需的物品，同時躲避五花八門的敵人。 一款受8位元時代遊戲啟發的等距平台解謎遊戲。

4011930.name: Pigslaughter
4011930.desc: Pigslaughter is a indie top-down roguelike wave-survival shooter. Clock in as one of four fed-up employees and defend twelve floors of a corrupt office tower against a hundred waves of pigs in suits, armed with weaponized office supplies, black market upgrades and a lot of resentment.

4027820.name: Asylium
4027820.desc: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

5031360.name: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
5031360.desc: Become a pumpkin on Halloween night! Absolute zen, midnight melancholy, and zero fuss. The perfect evening plan!

4244190.name: Guinea Pig Runaway Together
4244190.desc: 最多四隻天竺鼠。一個氣球。無盡的混亂。 在這款基於物理的合作跑酷挑戰中，要麼齊心協力，要麼寸步難行！

movies.name: Guinea Pig Runaway Together | 1.0 Release Trailer
Guinea Pig Runaway | Early Acces Release Trailer

dlc.name: Guinea Pig Runaway Together - World Nations Cosmetic Pack
Guinea Pig Runaway Together - Supporter Pack

5312160.name: Ocean Dynasty Tycoon
5312160.desc: Build your own shipping company, plan global routes, and guide a fleet through a dynamic trading network. Take on transport contracts, trade goods, upgrade ships, and react to market opportunities and unexpected events.

4651700.name: Off Course
4651700.desc: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

4038280.name: BULLETJUMP
4038280.desc: Jump with one hand, shoot with the other. BULLETJUMP is a fast arcade score-chaser: weave through bullet storms, skim close calls to push your multiplier to x5, and chase the player one rank above you. Watch any run back, take on a new Daily Challenge every day, and climb the global leaderboards.

5167700.name: This Game Socks
5167700.desc: Find, match, and toss 3,000 socks into the basket with friends. Buy absurd gadgets and upgrade them to make the task easier (or not).

5366000.name: Halloween (2018)
5366000.desc: 40 年過去了，麥克‧邁爾斯對鮮血的渴望絲毫未減。換上這款取材自 2018 年電影的造型，扮演剛從史密斯格羅夫療養院逃脫的「面具殺人魔」(The Shape)。

5365980.name: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
5365980.desc: 化身以《月光光心慌慌 5：復仇夜》為靈感設計的麥克邁爾斯，向哈頓菲爾德展開復仇！從長達一年的昏迷中甦醒，化身令人聞風喪膽的夜魔。*可立即使用長柄鐮刀

5310110.name: Halloween - Civilian Pack 1, Michelle and Eugene
5310110.desc: 今年十月，蜜雪兒‧布蘭頓與尤金‧凱利都將加入可供玩家操作的平民角色陣容，協助保護哈頓菲爾德的居民。尤金的專屬特性「潛伏者」讓他能躲在灌木叢中，提高體力恢復速度，並加快潛行跟蹤的消退速度。蜜雪兒的專屬特性「療癒」則能將治療道具恢復的一部分生命值分享給附近的其他角色。

4404590.name: the collective
4404590.desc: Build and optimize the factory systems keeping people alive aboard a generation ship. Form relationships with a crew that remembers everything, and uncover the truth about your past. A factory-building life sim set 300 years into a 750-year voyage.

5183750.name: Tidy Arcana
5183750.desc: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

4815540.name: 1930: Tinta & Balas
4815540.desc: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

4850250.name: MixVerse
4850250.desc: Mixverse is a survival game featuring 4 unique stages: fight hordes of Zombies, risk your life jumping across explosive boxes, battle Monsters, and fight enemy Agents. Each stage offers a different challenge. Survive them all.

5061100.name: Smiley Steel
5061100.desc: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

3690370.name: Senior Survival Club
3690370.desc: 在殭屍末日降臨的世界裡，一位奶奶為了尋找孫子，拿起了電鋸。這是一款生存動作遊戲，您將在其中消滅緩慢但頑固的殭屍，收集武器和裝備，並透過鍛鍊來強化自己。即使在越來越強大的殭屍群中，也要堅持不懈地前進，再次找回年輕時的力量。

movies.name: Senior Survival Club Official Launch Trailer

5338720.name: Guild of Souls
5338720.desc: 組建英雄公會，每位英雄都能親自操控，重溫經典MMO風格的冒險。戰鬥中隨時切換自己的角色，帶領他們挑戰地下城與40英雄團隊副本，體驗40種職業的Tab鎖定目標戰鬥。24種專業技能、拍賣場，以及終局Roguelike英雄職業「混沌之子」。支援單人遊玩或1–5人合作。

5373470.name: 棋路旅人
5373470.desc: 技能象棋 × 肉鴿冒險。三十六計，大招象棋！帶上萌系旅人擲骰子闖過春夏秋冬，用 36 件被動「棋計」火燒、冰凍、倒戈、反客為主，把正統象棋下成連鎖大招。精英跟你鬥計，Boss 擺連環殘局，精力就是血量，後悔藥省著吃。另有六款象棋迷你遊戲。

5091700.name: Special Delivery
5091700.desc: Take the night shift at a crusty motel with strange guests. They might be weird... or they might not be human. Use their odd behavior to deduce which guests are hiding their true forms. Features randomly generated guests and monster behavior.

3151060.name: 星核防線
3151060.desc: 一款主打極致深度策略的 2D 像素風塔防遊戲。在人類文明的能源前線，你將透過佈署防禦模組規劃敵人路徑，運用戰術晶片系統掌控戰局，搭配多路線塔升級與改造機制，守護維繫人類存續的星核能源。

252750.name: MouseCraft
252750.desc: Ever wondered what a cross between Tetris and Lemmings would look like? Well, wonder no more, 'cause... MouseCraft is here! MouseCraft is an A to B puzzle game where players help Schrödinger, the crazy cat scientist, in completing his mysterious, mice-powered invention.

1668190.name: Once Upon a Jester
1668190.desc: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!

1458300.name: The Gap
1458300.desc: 一種罕見的神經疾病正在威脅著喬許一家，他只能透過既視感穿梭平行現實，藉此找回失去的記憶。似乎唯有直面過去最深處的回憶——那些快樂與痛苦交織的時刻——才能讓他重建生活，讓家人重聚。

3932010.name: UNSEEN LAND: INTO THE MIST
3932010.desc: 動作RPG與塔防的結合。化身可在近戰、遠程、魔法之間自由切換的英雄投入戰鬥，建設領地、築起防禦塔，抵擋從次元裂隙中傾瀉而出的數百隻怪物。

5246480.name: TaskTown
5246480.desc: Turn your everyday clicks and keystrokes into in-game currency! Collect cute and stylish animals, help them find their tools, and build a peaceful village of your own.

4540040.name: 琉隐：将魂千军
4540040.desc: 遊戲是一款古風無雙Roguelike 動作遊戲，玩家將與強大的盟軍小隊一起，衝殺敵陣，抵禦侵略。隨著玩家的深入也將揭示更多的神秘事件和最終的挑戰。

3690240.name: Project Android
3690240.desc: 為了解決種種未來的難題，人類制定了仿生人計劃。請進行各種實驗，將法姆培養成人類的救世主吧！

3612660.name: Hatters
3612660.desc: Hatters 是一款最多 4 人合作的彈幕地獄 roguelike。隨機五元素法術、魔法神器、新英雄和輕鬆幽默的劇情。混亂的戰鬥中，魔法與笑聲四處飛舞。

4248630.name: Crateball
4248630.desc: Crateball is a 3v3 arcade football game. Crates drop onto the pitch during the match. Some give you a gun, a homing bazooka or a shield. Others freeze you, reverse your controls or explode. The arena changes after every goal. Play online with friends, and bots take any empty spots.

3982450.name: HITLER WAIFU 2
3982450.desc: Hitler Waifu 2 - is a parody third-person 3D shooter with satire and black humor

5173940.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
5173940.desc: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

4475480.name: Shattered Void Online
4475480.desc: One war, three ways to fight it. Take the bridge of a warship in 5v5 fleet battles, board an enemy outpost and fight for it on foot, or command a whole fleet across six star systems. Vanguard against Ironsworn: pick your side and get on the line.

5255000.name: HypnoX: Steel Riders
5255000.desc: An arcade racing action game where you'll face challenging tracks, dangerous obstacles, and a race against time. Ride different motorcycles, fight bosses, use weapons, powerups and overcome crazy challenges.

5247800.name: Cozy Associations
5247800.desc: A cozy card puzzle about finding what belongs together. Match words and pictures, gather them into categories, and tidy up the board. Get comfy with 100 levels, 10 charming settings, and a little daily puzzle just for you.

5260500.name: ELFGIRLS DO PORN
5260500.desc: ELFGIRLS DO PORN - is a relaxing Arkanoid-style game where you destroy tiles to unlock hot animations with beautiful elfgirls.

4944480.name: Incrementable Craps
4944480.desc: Roll the dice, grow your bankroll, and reshape the table in this incremental strategy game inspired by craps. Unlock side bets, improve payouts, reduce risk, earn rerolls, chase milestones, and climb the Steam leaderboards—one roll at a time.

5044910.name: Destined Dungeon Quest
5044910.desc: By tracing lines across matching tiles on the gameboard to battle foes and gather resources, Dungeon Quest delivers a dungeon‑crawling turn‑based RPG with an old‑school soul. Explore the depths, uncover secrets, gather loot, and grow your arsenal of unique abilities.

3636460.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
3636460.desc: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

4259950.name: ANU: Tablets of Thoth
4259950.desc: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

5121870.name: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
5121870.desc: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats挑戰你拯救100隻倖存的貓咪！牠們在殭屍爆發後躲藏於廢棄街道。仔細尋找，小心點擊，善用提示，與時間賽跑，登上全球排行榜之巔！

5467180.name: Ludus Magna Demo
5467180.desc: Thirty days. One Ludus. Your chance at glory. Recruit, train and equip gladiators. Watch auto-battles or intervene with quick-time events. Reach 300 Fame to unlock the Primus, then risk your finest fighter in a battle to the death.

5322960.name: Abyss Ring Soundtrack
5322960.desc: The following 5 tracks are included: ・PV BGM ・Boss Battle BGM 1 ・Boss Battle BGM 2 ・Opening BGM ・Home BGM

4429720.name: Deductopia
4429720.desc: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Little Problems and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

4806270.name: What The Cluck
4806270.desc: 射出雞蛋。雞蛋爆炸。你向上飛。整個計畫就這麼簡單。一款 Foddian 風格的精準平台跳躍遊戲，講述一隻母雞和牠被偷走的金蛋。

4866860.name: Curatio
4866860.desc: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

4997370.name: 棋2
4997370.desc: 西洋棋，但是……   無回合,  無將軍或將死,  同一棋子不能走兩次,  10×10棋盤,  額外2個馬和兵,  兵可向任意方向移動

1496590.name: Tchia
1496590.desc: 一款熱帶開放世界冒險遊戲。在你探索這物理驅動的沙盒世界時，你可以攀爬、滑翔、游泳和划船造訪美麗的島嶼們。控制你能找到的任何動物和物品，還有完整支援演奏的烏克麗麗可供彈奏。

1693040.name: Synthwave Burnout
1693040.desc: 迷失的高速公路正等著你帶你超越地平線。 放鬆一下，讓 synthwave 的聲音打開通往霓虹世界的道路 - 一個充滿想像和幻想的世界，比現實本身更真實。

1585440.name: They Always Run
1585440.desc: 成为艾丹，一个猎取银河系中最危险赏金的三臂变种人。在这款以太空西部为背景的刺激的2D平台游戏中，捕捉、切开和消灭敌人。

761620.name: Beholder 2
761620.desc: You are an intern at the central ministry of a totalitarian state with your whole career ahead of you. Work your way up the ladder by scheming against employees, spying on your boss, and completing paperwork. Or do you turn against the state and expose corruption. The choice is still yours to make!

2187290.name: 牆世界
2187290.desc: 騎乘巨大機械蜘蛛探索神秘世界之牆：挖掘珍貴資源、升級裝備以擊退大量怪物，以及在襲擊之間發掘異地生物群系。你能夠生還並揭開世界之牆的秘密嗎？

395570.name: We Are The Dwarves
395570.desc: We Are The Dwarves is a real-time tactical adventure where you take control of three Dwarven astronauts and lead them through the hordes of enemies in the depths of their Universe. Tactical Adventure Sci-Fi Space Dwarves

movies.name: We Are The Dwarves — Update Is Live

906100.name: Observation
906100.desc: 《觀測號》是一部科幻驚悚遊戲，透過在空間站內的AI-山姆的視角，帶領玩家發掘艾瑪·費雪博士以及她的船員們在一次任務中到底遭遇了什麼。

3886200.name: 破碎怪談：切勿欺騙
3886200.desc: 《破碎怪談：切勿欺騙》 是一款日本心理恐怖遊戲，探討創傷、孤立，以及一個在眼前逐漸崩解、使人無法再信任自身感知的現實。

5344440.name: Beamline
5344440.desc: 將精心調校的 CRT、LCD 和 VHS 風格套用至支援的遊戲。在 Beamline 中設定遊戲後，照常啟動，即可透過遊戲內面板調整畫面。

4882100.name: The Library Assistant
4882100.desc: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

2747660.name: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
2747660.desc: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

5340680.name: Tiny Ring Defense
5340680.desc: 一款在你工作時待在桌面一角的小型自動戰鬥塔防遊戲。怪物沿著棋盤外圈的環形道路繞圈，像素角色們會自動迎戰。召喚、合成、升級、強化武器，按自己的步調闖過十個世界。

5123790.name: Timopet
5123790.desc: Register your to-dos as quests and focus with a timer. Cute desktop pets keep you company right on your screen! Complete a quest and your pets will give you coins as a gift! Open boxes with the coins you collect and gather all kinds of pets.

4520990.name: ZipRush 凌界: 逐浪破界
4520990.desc: VR 多人跑酷競速——打造專屬賽道，創造你的路線，競逐最佳解法。

4022710.name: Shadows Of Thornkeep
4022710.desc: A dark fantasy, grid-based dungeon crawler where every step hides peril. Loot, adapt, and survive in turn-based battles as you lead lost souls through cursed halls in this rogue-lite descent into madness.

5313790.name: Terafom
5313790.desc: 降落在明亮的海洋星球，打敗可愛的史萊姆，從大海中種出新土地，和家人一起打造城市。沒有 PvP，是全家人都能安心遊玩的線上世界。

5188720.name: MachineGunner3 : Cosmos Ascending True
5188720.desc: MachineGunner 3 is a casual 2d racing shooter game that Player moves AIM and accelerates or decelerates to take down the enemys. Rush through the space, Use proper type and carry proper speed for more score, And finish the stage!

4804240.name: METAL QUADRIGA
4804240.desc: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech “QUADRIGA” and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikes—dominate the battlefield with your machine.

5345040.name: Stick A Fork
5345040.desc: 游標移過去就好。插在地上的叉子紛紛彈起，再次扎進巨大的水果，每一次落地，金幣都嘩啦啦噴出來。買進更多叉子、熬果醬轉生，最後連一切都超越，餐桌只會越來越失控。這是一款用手感養大的主動式增量遊戲。

5026130.name: Cable Arrange
5026130.desc: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

5002190.name: Fly&Goal
5002190.desc: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

5388750.name: Portolan
5388750.desc: Build your trading company in the 16th-century Age of Discovery. Trade goods across global ports, plan profitable routes, and manage voyages and automated fleets in this text-based trading and management simulation.

5313750.name: RainBook Lite
5313750.desc: 一款輕量的雨天寫作軟體。在雨窗前寫作，或在玻璃上隨手塗畫，讓大腦放鬆一下~

4741590.name: Sketch Kingdom
4741590.desc: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

4878090.name: Hentai Senpai: Things That go HUMP in the Night
4878090.desc: 今年萬聖節，釋放你最黑暗的欲望！解開拼圖，解鎖美麗的超性感怪物娘，她們渴望在夜間盡情做愛。從飢渴的魅魔到滴著黏液的尤物，多種拼圖模式、合作模式，以及一張恐怖性感的絕殺原聲帶。

movies.name: Hentai Senpai Things That go HUMP in the Night Launch Trailer

5388610.name: The Price of Empire
5388610.desc: Grand strategy on the real Earth: found your nation anywhere you like, build cities and mines, wage war with tanks and artillery and forge alliances – against up to 20 AI rivals or with friends. But every new territory comes at a price.

movies.name: The Price of Empire Trailer Deutsch

5004570.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
5004570.desc: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

4725110.name: ぺちぺちハクスラ
4725110.desc: A hack-and-slash RPG where you defeat monsters, gather materials, and grow stronger through equipment crafting and skills. The more you upgrade, the faster your material farming becomes! Watching your stats steadily rise is irresistibly addictive!

5157760.name: 商店街的外星房客想要色色能量
5157760.desc: 一名從天而降的外星房客，帶來了超乎想像的神祕科技。當不可思議的外星道具闖進商店街的日常，你與她們之間的距離，也開始悄悄改變……一場充滿意外與誘惑的非日常生活，就此展開。你，準備好迎接了嗎？

5422130.name: Heretics Amulet Demo
5422130.desc: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

4360290.name: 天降災異：倖存者
4360290.desc: 地球危在旦夕，召集好友，在一切為時已晚之前擊敗邪惡勢力！在這款全新的橫向卷軸倖存者遊戲中，你將在危機四伏、敵潮洶湧的關卡中跳躍、攻擊，打造屬於你的終極Build。支援最多4人線上合作，擊退入侵者，在《天降災異：倖存者》中活下去！

4698170.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
4698170.desc: 把現實世界的賽馬，換成在奇幻世界讓怪物互相較量的養成SLG。養育、出戰，目標是2000隻競爭對手的頂點。賽程表、分級賽制、五代血統都照搬賽馬，所以要從零開始學的東西不多。一年576戰，最多8隻同時上場，全自動進行。怪物自己移動、互相放技能，自己決出勝負。養大的怪物可以上傳到創意工坊，和世界各地的主人對戰。

4348910.name: 深空當鋪：可能是偷的 Probably Stolen
4348910.desc: 《深空當鋪：可能是偷的》是一款以反烏托邦太空站為背景的賽博龐克商店經營模擬遊戲。製作、交易，並走私各種來路不明的商品，在各方派系之間周旋。為了維持生計，你願意突破多少底線？趁房租不斷飆漲、把你逼到走投無路之前，賺夠錢買下自己的店面吧。

4836460.name: Portentum
4836460.desc: 神祕生物牌組構築自走棋。帶著大腳怪、吉摩西、尼斯湖水怪、卓柏卡布拉等神祕生物，找出誇張到破壞平衡的連段。只要有誰的叔叔在 1973 年的林子裡見過牠，牠多半就是《Portentum》裡的一張卡。

4894800.name: NeoRunners
4894800.desc: 《NeoRunners》是一部可玩的賽博龐克漫畫，也是一款輕度肉鴿牌組構築遊戲。組合🔥燃燒、⚡電湧和💧流湧，觸發爆炸性反應；建立關係，解鎖新卡牌、改造、服務與劇情路線。

4017880.name: 異界揭蹤／ANOMALITH
4017880.desc: 《異界揭蹤／ANOMALITH》是一款以帶著閾限空間氛圍與昭和懷舊感的日本為舞台的求生TPS遊戲。為了找到失去音訊的友人，少女選擇踏入異形橫行的世界。

373420.name: Divinity: Original Sin - Enhanced Edition
373420.desc: Gather your party and get ready for the kick-ass new version of GameSpot's PC Game of the Year 2014. With hours of new content, new game modes, full voiceovers, split-screen multiplayer, and thousands of improvements, there's never been a better time to explore the epic world of Rivellon!

movies.name: Divinity: Original Sin - Enhanced Edition Trailer

dlc.name: Divinity: Original Sin Enhanced Edition - Official Soundtrack

1060600.name: Lair of the Clockwork God
1060600.desc: A fast-paced Point-and-Click adventure AND an indie platfomer in one! Join adventurer Ben and wannabe indie darling Dan in a race against time to stop all the Apocalypses happening at the same time.

dlc.name: Lair of the Clockwork God: A Soundtrack for the End of Everything

108710.name: Alan Wake
108710.desc: 來自黑暗的威脅在亮瀑鎮內悄聲四伏，使 Wake 在揭開謎團、尋回愛妻的苦戰中，瀕臨理智的崩潰邊緣。

20920.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
20920.desc: 兵荒馬亂的日子已然來臨。多方勢力暗中較勁，只為擁權並成為霸主。北方諸國已進入備戰狀態，但再多精良的軍隊也阻止不了一樁即將掀起腥風血雨的奸計…

movies.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Trailer

compare.en: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition

dlc.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition Soundtrack

46500.name: Syberia
46500.desc: Join Kate Walker as she travels to remote locations and time periods in this timeless voyage to discover her true destiny.

20900.name: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition Director's Cut
20900.desc: 化身被稱為狩魔獵人的傳奇屠魔者，利維亞的傑洛特，在企圖稱霸世界的各方勢力所交織而成的陰謀詭計中生存。左右為難地做出抉擇並品嘗隨之而來的後果，同時置身絕無僅有的非凡故事之中。

compare.en: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition Director's Cut

5256250.name: FableBrawl
5256250.desc: Draft a warband of storybook characters in this free-to-play fantasy auto-battler. Upgrade your recruits, collect treasures, and arrange your formation to outlast seven rivals. Learn against AI, play online, or host a private game with friends.

4646350.name: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition
4646350.desc: 一款輕鬆掛機網絡建造遊戲。鋪設連線、建立節點。代幣沿著你的網絡流動，不斷相遇、合併，最終帶著更高的價值獲得收益——收益用來建造更多節點，節點用來……你已經明白了。

3228900.name: The Kharzov Effect
3228900.desc: 1985年。你的朋友在哈爾佐夫教授那座霧氣瀰漫的莊園裡失蹤了。潛伏的怪物。密室逃脫謎題。神秘的傳說。現在，設法讓他活著逃出來。

movies.name: Official Gameplay Trailer - The Kharzov Effect

4614060.name: Exium: Theia
