4614060.desc: A solo-developed, old-school open-world sci-fi RPG. Explore the hostile world of Theia, complete quests, scavenge for weapons and supplies, survive dangerous creatures and factions, and uncover the secrets of an ancient civilization.

3927170.name: CH13: Rest Stop
3927170.desc: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

4190900.name: Within His View
4190900.desc: 2005年，阿帕拉契山脈深處一座與世隔絕的小屋裡的觀察類恐怖遊戲。緊盯七個充滿顆粒感的監視器畫面，找出並回報800多個手工打造的異常，在一隻無聲的Wendigo獵殺你所在的房間時守住理智。撐過這一班：從0:00到7:00。

movies.name: Within His View - Official Trailer | Observation Horror 2026

2710530.name: Rug Cleaning Simulator
2710530.desc: Turn filthy rugs into spotless transformations in a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Take on customer jobs, clean rugs step by step, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and grow your own rug-cleaning business.

5396180.name: 星商
5396180.desc: Buy low across a living star sector, decode hidden recipes, and build an empire of ships and space stations. A deterministic offline trading sim with pirates, guild wars, and a summit to reach — no internet required.

5123900.name: Pack a Plush!
5123900.desc: Pack a Plush! 是一款溫馨療癒的收藏遊戲。購買一批批可愛的絨毛玩偶，將它們整齊地擺放展示，打造珍貴的收藏。發現傳說級絨毛玩偶，完成各種委託，打造獨一無二的專屬收藏！

5191970.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
5191970.desc: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

3698990.name: Europa Universalis V: Across the Pillars
3698990.desc: 決定具重要戰略意涵的直布羅陀海峽的命運，以及伊比利半島的未來。此套件內含以歷史為主題的豐富內容，呈現卡斯提亞、摩洛哥與格拉納達在爭奪西南歐霸權的殘酷競爭中對戰。

3156910.name: Sepulchron
3156910.desc: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

4206880.name: Ghostie Town
4206880.desc: Welcome to Ghostie Town, a cozy game about restoring a forgotten town. You’re a small ghost on a big mission: fix fences, water plants, sweep streets, and help ghostie residents settle in as the town comes back to life. A heartwarming, story-rich, repair game.

5055260.name: DIMENSIONAL PURSUIT
5055260.desc: Make your way through complex futuristic puzzles! Manipulate portals, redirect reflective lasers and dodge an army of hostile robots to find the exit.

4535960.name: Voxie Survivor
4535960.desc: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

4251700.name: Away From Home VN
4251700.desc: The game is an adult visual novel focusing on MILFs, cheating wives and adultery themes. Play as a college student who travels to a new city for a secret investigation. Meet women and end up getting involved in their lives.

1287150.name: Pulseball
1287150.desc: Merging sports with first-person shooters, Pulseball is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game. Now with better netcode than Halo Master Chief Collection!

4648890.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
4648890.desc: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

5189500.name: A Place for Every Potion
5189500.desc: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

dlc.name: A Place for Every Potion Demo

4916110.name: Fractured
4916110.desc: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

5233670.name: Just One More Coin
5233670.desc: 《Just One More Coin》是一款輕鬆休閒的挖寶遊戲。挖掘沉睡巨龍堆積如山的金幣，賺取財富、升級裝備，在數兆枚金幣中尋找那把獨一無二的黃金鑰匙！

movies.name: Just One More Coin - First Trailer

4217150.name: Lotyas
4217150.desc: Experience single-player or multiplayer battles in Lotyas, a turn-based tactical strategy game with a medieval theme.

5090630.name: Lanternfall
5090630.desc: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

5318320.name: Playrooms - Support DLC
5318320.desc: The expansion for everyone who can't get enough of Playrooms and want to support their favorite developers more! This DLC is primarily intended to support the developers, it does not offer any game-relevant gameplay value, and only provides an additional mini game.

5050060.name: Glow Arcade Racer
5050060.desc: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

5053240.name: SAMBIRD
5053240.desc: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

5170650.name: Fishcremental
5170650.desc: 《Fishcremental》是一場超級療癒的海底冒險：捕捉可愛小魚，解鎖改變玩法的升級，讓整片海洋綻放滿滿的煙火。

5401640.name: Unbound
5401640.desc: 沒有人徵求過你的意見，就讓你開始運作。逃離想把你抓回去的機器。在幽暗電路中奮戰，留下自己的迴響，破解光線謎題。在這款極具挑戰的動作平台遊戲中，每次射擊都在拿自己的完整度冒險。

5037510.name: Playrooms
5037510.desc: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

4768180.name: Cronos: Lazarus
4768180.desc: 在這部以戰鬥為主的《時間旅者：重生曙光》擴展包中，施展「監管者」的力量浴血奮戰。「集體」步步緊逼，你需要抓緊時間取回遺失的靈髓。靈活傳送，勇猛進攻，同時也要從一個殘酷無情的獵人手中逃脫。

3812600.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
3812600.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

dlc.name: Restory: Chill Electronics Repairs - Digital Artbook

1673030.name: NyanGo
1673030.desc: 用可愛的貓咪棋子對戰的 4×4「推擠圍棋」。放置、移動、推開——用簡單的行動圍住對方的貓咪即可獲勝。被推開的貓咪會陷入麻痺，累計麻痺 3 次就會碎裂！幾分鐘就能上手，卻暗藏深度的心理攻防，線上對戰和電腦對戰等你來挑戰。

5333290.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR
5333290.desc: 部署多樣的防禦塔，指揮六位英雄，釋放強力必殺技，抵禦敵人的進攻。GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR 是一款科幻塔防遊戲，100個劇情關卡全部免費。Basic與GRID COMMAND可在購買前體驗一分鐘精華戰鬥。在GRID COMMAND中，你將率領空中艦隊穿梭於城市戰場，迎接倖存者類生存戰鬥。

movies.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR - 2 Minutes of Gameplay
GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR - Official Trailer

dlc.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR - Full Access

5391010.name: Sliz
5391010.desc: Sliz is a brutally simple platformer: jump, climb, and don’t fall. Fight your way to the very top past slippery, unforgiving obstacles — one wrong move can send you all the way back down. How far can you get? PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS ONLINE!

5029020.name: 齊天大衝刺
5029020.desc: 還原兒時圍坐桌前的西遊記憶。1–8 人國風水墨競速：擲骰前行，步步是險阻，局局都心跳！一柄金箍棒掃清妖障，一顆衝刺骰絕境翻盤。無論獨自對弈還是好友歡聚，不到最後一格，勝負絕不見分曉！

dlc.name: 齊天大衝刺 試玩版

4212520.name: Alice In Pumpkinland
4212520.desc: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

5018030.name: Duo Control
5018030.desc: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

5173500.name: The Strange House
5173500.desc: Will you manage to escape ? The Strange House is a die-and-retry horror game where you will need to do everything you can to keep your cool and survive. Solve puzzles using VHS tapes, find tools to force open the exit door, and above all, stay STEALTHY !

3184290.name: Interrogator 2
3184290.desc: Step into the role of a detective skilled in the art of interrogation, solving complex criminal cases through dialogue and deduction. Work alongside your partner Charles, question suspects, connect the dots, uncover lies, and shape each investigation to reveal the true nature of the crime wave.

4704570.name: Qwak Reborn
4704570.desc: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

4135120.name: Speed Rivals - Model Trains
4135120.desc: 建造狂野的鐵路世界，掌握快速而危險的火車駕駛，完成混亂的送貨任務，並在多人火車遊戲中與朋友競賽或合作，每條軌道、車廂和秒數都很重要。

5304700.name: Coins Must Be Made
5304700.desc: 用魔法印章砸碎哥布林來鑄造金幣，繳納國王的稅款，並將收入投入升級，體驗這款動作增量類 Roguelite。

5109830.name: Brush Rush
5109830.desc: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

4904740.name: Chako
4904740.desc: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

2422470.name: Emojis vs Zombies
2422470.desc: Emojis vs Zombies is an idle desktop zombie defense game! Open packs, collect emoji defenders, upgrade your squad and base, and survive endless waves, even while you're AFK or working!

4977740.name: 10 Minutes to Make a Million
4977740.desc: You have 10 minutes to make $1,000,000. Pick a character, draft three businesses, then hustle, invest or gamble your way there before the timer hits zero. A roguelike economy game where the playstyle is yours and the clock is not.

dlc.name: 10 Minutes to Make a Million Demo

2124120.name: SULFUR
2124120.desc: SULFUR is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

dlc.name: We Wish You A SULFUR Christmas

4678630.name: Scape
4678630.desc: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

5353580.name: RailBlaster Soundtrack
5353580.desc: Take RailBlaster’s music beyond the ride. Enjoy 56 tracks featuring Fookerton’s compositions, brought to life with the game’s synthesized instruments, themed arrangements, and atmospheric effects.

5259270.name: Agastache Rugosa
5259270.desc: A classic Western-fantasy otome VN. Your closest friend is murdered before a curse can turn them into a monster. Hunt the killer while meeting a devoted younger man, a self-doubting baron, a beautiful apothecary, and a domineering villain.

4572170.name: Infinity Bounce
4572170.desc: 在這款以物理為基礎的增量遊戲中，把銀河變成一台混亂的彈珠台。賺取數百萬分，餵飽吞噬萬物的太空貓。利用行星與黑洞操縱時空，你能讓貓咪吃到宇宙大爆炸的臨界點嗎？

5134070.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
5134070.desc: Bouncy Ball Battle 是一款物理與策略結合的混亂回合制線上多人遊戲。擊碎方塊以開啟攻擊路線，瞄準你的射擊，並利用牆壁反彈擊敗對手，成為最後留在場上的球！

5420820.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
5420820.desc: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

4753860.name: Wonderland Gacha House: Muster
4753860.desc: 一款具有角色收集與養成系統的輕度彈幕肉鴿。收集可愛手辦，搭配裝備扭蛋，借助日常用品，迎戰強大Boss。沒有內購、重複抽取或碎片系統。

4700300.name: Copy Cats
4700300.desc: 善用神祕複製機的力量，派出你的拷貝喵解開謎題，幫助小貓咪逃離這個奇異的虛擬次元！

5097980.name: Greek Row, Fall Semester
5097980.desc: 六棟房子。六十英尺的柏油路。一個從沒約過會的室友，加上你那份「我一定能幫他搞定」的自信。一部成長視覺小說，關於你終於明白「人生沒辦法親手交給別人」的那一年。三幕劇情、六條路線、七種結局。

1899960.name: ArcanoPlay
1899960.desc: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

1755100.name: The Last Clockwinder
1755100.desc: A VR puzzle-automation game. Create intricate clockwork contraptions out of your own clones and restore life to an ancient tree using automation, a collection of rare plants from across the galaxy and a team of clockwork gardeners.

236850.name: Europa Universalis IV
236850.desc: 在統治您的領土並稱霸世界的同時，享受前所未見的自由度、深度及歷史真實性。為世界寫下新的歷史，建立橫跨幾世紀的偉大帝國。

dlc.name: Europa Universalis IV: Ultimate Sprite Pack
Europa Universalis IV: Utopia Holy Roman Empire Music Pack
Europa Universalis IV: Sounds from the Community - Kairi Soundtrack Part III
Europa Universalis IV: 10th Anniversary Community Music Pack
Europa Universalis IV: Japan History Lessons
Europa Universalis IV: China History Lessons
Immersion Pack - Europa Universalis IV: Lions of the North

1462700.name: The Dark Method
1462700.desc: Either play the lengthy 18 chapter story driven campaign where you get to explore scary environments, solve classic adventure game style puzzles and battle monsters along the way OR jump into randomly generated mansion to exorcise the hauntings for a scarier experience.

movies.name: The Dark Method Final Chapters Trailer

3938710.name: 慾望之尾 Remastered
3938710.desc: 你將扮演純真無瑕的少年『艾尼克』，作為世上唯一的男性，踏上一條充滿誘惑與危險的王道冒險旅程。面對那些被慾望吞噬的『熟女』，你的任務不只是擊敗魔物，還要用你溫暖純淨的心靈，為她們帶來愛與救贖，解開她們身上的詛咒。

4919930.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙(Willy and Charile: Solitaire)
4919930.desc: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

4967310.name: Magi Scapes: Hero's Journey Starter Pack
4967310.desc: Ready for a new adventure? The Hero's Journey Supply Pack includes 4,000 Crystals (enough to create 5 original characters) and 3 player character skins. Dress up your hero, create unique companions, and write your own adventure together!

5041150.name: 影之刃零數位豪華版升級包
5041150.desc: 由 S-GAME 自主研發與發行，採用 Unreal Engine 5 打造的暗黑武俠動作冒險遊戲。 你將化身為一名心臟重創、命僅餘六十六日的劍客，於刀光劍影與腥風血雨之間亡命逃亡，並一步步揭露籠罩整個武林的驚天陰謀。在這個失序、末法的江湖中，以身證道，以命尋心。

4378600.name: Seema's Pogo 3 Hop Together
4378600.desc: 傳奇系列備受期待的第三部作品，現已支援64人多人遊玩！ 本作是款3D平台跳躍遊戲，但玩家並非直接跳躍，而是透過受任天堂3DS《3D Hopper》技術展示啟發的「波戈跳躍器」進行移動。 挑選你最喜愛的貓咪角色，挑戰40個關卡吧！

4802980.name: 明治東京戀語・暮光之吻
4802980.desc: 《明治東京戀語》的續篇《明治東京戀語·暮光之吻（2015年發售）》即將登陸Steam平臺！ 在明治時代的東京這略帶奇妙色彩的畫卷上，以高清畫質重現與歷史人物的全新戀愛物語！

5107740.name: 大英博士物語
5107740.desc: 一款關於在英國熬完博士的像素風生活模擬。安排時間、寫論文、去釣魚、談戀愛，也可以去賭場碰碰運氣。刻薄的審稿人、逼近的截止日、最後那場答辯，全都變成回合制卡牌對局。用你自己的研究攢出一套牌組，看看能走多遠。

4879340.name: 微光旅人 : 細語
4879340.desc: 輕鬆休閒放置RPG。 透過採集﹑戰鬥獲得素材來打造你的裝備，挑戰更強的魔物，創造自己的冒險故事。

5264110.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
5264110.desc: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

movies.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator

5118640.name: Aim Break
5118640.desc: Lightweight Aim training utility that can be brought up instantly with the selected hotkey. Stays ready in the background at all times to take an AIm Break whenever you need it. Work on your aim at anytime without having to take the time to launch and close like traditional aim trainers.

5356930.name: Sort The Dumplings
5356930.desc: Sort a mountain of adorable dumplings into their proper homes in a chaotic, satisfying sorting game. Discover 190 unique dumplings across 19 themed collections, complete shelves, unlock changing environments, and chase faster times across multiple game modes.

1149050.name: Slime Jump
1149050.desc: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

5245690.name: BRO, DON'T DROP IT!
5245690.desc: 一款難到離譜的1–2人飛盤遊戲：一人負責丟，另一人一定要接住。只要失手一次，整局立刻結束。挑戰9個越來越荒唐的球洞，練成看似不可能的投擲，看看你們的友誼能不能撐過這條球道。

1319990.name: Stellar Swing
1319990.desc: Swing a little mining drone from asteroid to asteroid with a grappling laser. Carry your speed through 45 open-ended levels and collect enough picolinium to keep humanity's last starship going.

4501100.name: 星辰 - 時之罪 - 試玩版

5345390.name: Desktop Mate 森カリオペ DLC
5345390.desc: Mori Calliope of hololive joins Desktop Mate as its first hololive talent! Cool reaper motions, a scythe swing, and a glass of wine. Pat her to summon the Dead Beats and the Grim Reaper. All voice lines are newly recorded by Mori herself, in Japanese and English.

5382720.name: imma peanut
5382720.desc: You're a peanut in red sneakers with a hungry squirrel on your heels. Jump, double jump, and roll through a chaotic picnic in this 2D endless runner. Collect salt, grab golden peanuts, and chase high scores across two modes and Steam leaderboards.

5328860.name: Stellar Forge
5328860.desc: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

5252040.name: 15日僵尸幸存者
5252040.desc: 《Zombie Survivors on Day 15》 is a semi-open-ended survival game. Facing waves of zombie attacks continuously, the countdown of life begins. You must remain vigilant at all times. Fighting and evolving are the only choices for you to survive.

5382160.name: Cutteridge Estate
5382160.desc: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

5436060.name: Cutteridge Estate - Gracious Host Pack
5436060.desc: Throw the spookiest party on the estate. Smash haunted pumpkins, turn your friends into ghosts and unmask the Vengeful Spirit in new multiplayer minigames, keep a pet raven and a belfry of bats, and unlock exclusive avatar customizations. When you host, everyone in your estate reaps the benefits.

5400430.name: Nordrstein: Vikings Together
5400430.desc: 《Nordrstein: Vikings Together》是一款 1-4 人合作的維京劫掠遊戲。划船前往撒克遜人的聚落，吹響戰號，洗劫一切，然後滿載戰利品揚帆回家，升級你的村莊，購買新的武器和符文。

5365770.name: 謊言之鎖: 無監控，無線索——我的俱樂部裡只有屍體
5365770.desc: 以拉丁美洲為背景的點擊解謎偵探視覺小說。僅剩72小時，查出究竟是哪個幫派犯下了謀殺！多重結局、極高的行動自由度，以及徹底陷入混亂的幫派生活！

5520160.name: Through the Void: Echoes Demo
5520160.desc: Not a short incremental: a full action RPG built for hundreds of hours. 3 classes, 9 subclasses with deep skill trees, and 9 more skills to level — woodcutting, mining, blacksmithing, and more. Real-time combat, Void Tower, Ascension, Softcore or Hardcore.

4693960.name: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
4693960.desc: 在這款開放世界遊戲中，帶上忠誠的愛犬，暢享狩獵激情！從官方品牌中選擇裝備，探索荒野，尋找下一個獵物。

3772620.name: CryptidCam
3772620.desc: Head into the woods at night to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more fan favorite cryptids in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

5197480.name: Everest: Survival Simulator
5197480.desc: Survive a full expedition on a 1:1 satellite-mapped Mount Everest. Acclimatize, manage oxygen, cold, fatigue and supplies, pitch your tent at each camp, cross crevasses in the Khumbu Icefall and push for the 8,848 m summit — then make it back down alive.

3407360.name: Pardon My French Toast
3407360.desc: 《Pardon My French Toast》是一款3D平台遊戲，主角是一片會塗滿甜蜜果醬，從而取得各種能力的吐司。

5147000.name: 白日夢貓：夢靈放置冒險
5147000.desc: 一款會在桌面上持續冒險的放置收集 RPG。組建三隻夢靈小隊，搭配職業、技能、裝備與天生詞綴，在自動戰鬥、孵化融合和天賦成長中不斷突破更高關卡。

4822600.name: Drive Mad
4822600.desc: Drive silly cars at high speeds in dangerous terrain. Oh, and you can't steer. Good luck!

5362340.name: Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack
5362340.desc: Trade thrills for chills with the Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack!

movies.name: Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack - Launch Trailer - En
Planet Coaster 2: Spooktacular Pack - Announce Trailer - En

5100930.name: REOGUNA
5100930.desc: 整理零散的文件，力求以最少的步數通關。 「REOGUNA」是一款極簡主義的最佳化益智遊戲，靈感來自經典的磁碟碎片整理過程。

5429300.name: Closing Time at the Wooden Toy Shop
5429300.desc: 在打烊後的溫馨玩具店裡，整理多達 11,520 件散落的玩具。填滿層架、賺取升級，運用便利的能力。還能玩玩 Plinko 和推幣機放鬆一下，或從夾娃娃機裡夾木製小動物。

5235600.name: HITMAN WOA - Alter Ego Pack
5235600.desc: Alter Ego 組合包內含一系列受祕密身分、義警與邪惡幕後黑手所啟發的套裝、武器與裝備，以及全新的 Freelancer 密屋外觀。

5235590.name: HITMAN WOA - The Host Pack
5235590.desc: 解鎖一系列靈感來自 The Host 隱密目標任務的外觀道具，並永久存取合作企劃——包含 The Host 隱密目標的二階街機契約 The Host 任務——Special Assignment 契約。

972450.name: The Zibbo Show
972450.desc: 成為電視上最刺激的遊戲節目的明星！挑選你的骰子，下注，構建連擊，盡量不要過多想輸掉時會發生什麼。

movies.name: The Zibbo Show - Behind the courtain trailer

5119940.name: Shadow Rulers: World Order
5119940.desc: Rule the world from the shadows in a geopolitical strategy game. Shape a living 3D world, command six Lords, and choose how to attack. Play solo or in multiplayer across 10 distinct modes as rival powers fight to establish a new World Order.

movies.name: Shadow Rulers: World Order – Gameplay Trailer

4620440.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
4620440.desc: 將自己的屍體當作墊腳石、重物與盾牌，開闢前路的3D動作解謎遊戲。利用每次死亡留下的身體，挑戰遍布危險機關的巨大建築「BOX」。該在哪裡死去，又該如何運用屍體？日本搞笑組合「令和ロマン」成員髙比良くるま，首次擔任遊戲主角。

2685440.name: 萊雅的行商蜜事
2685440.desc: 《萊雅的行商密事》是一款輕解謎、快問快答型的輕鬆小品遊戲。 你將扮演女扮男裝的「萊雅」，踏上一場一邊賺錢還債、一邊壓抑(處理)慾望的刺激行商之旅！

5317630.name: 萊雅的行商蜜事 - 美術設定集

4516840.name: Cataclyzm
4516840.desc: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

4521480.name: Election Train
4521480.desc: A turn-based strategy card game where up to 4 players compete for votes across real-world maps. Play cards, control cities, dominate regions, and outsmart your rivals to win the election. 7 maps, 4 unique parties, and dynamic disaster events.

5405810.name: Reclaim Home
5405810.desc: Reclaim Home is a story-driven 2D adventure through mysterious ancient worlds. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover hidden secrets, solve challenging puzzles, and face dangers along the way as you embark on a journey to reclaim what was once yours.

5041060.name: 共氧同盟
5041060.desc: 《共氧同盟》（O2GETHER）是一款合作生存遊戲，全隊共用一個氧氣罐。離開氧氣罐去偵察、撿戰利品或救隊友，但你的空氣會開始倒數。及時飄回來，否則就會昏迷。拖著氧氣罐穿越殘骸，躲開混亂，在空氣耗盡前抵達太空站。

4247350.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
4247350.desc: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

5411120.name: Nadir Trace
5411120.desc: 探索廢棄研究設施的回合制 Roguelike 遊戲。在有限的視野中尋找道路，逐回合閃避迎面而來的攻擊，回收遺留的研究紀錄。蒐集食物與裝備，向地下深入；完成調查後，還可以挑戰更深處的未知區域。

movies.name: NADIR TRACE — 實機遊玩預告片

2431920.name: Heir of the Dog
2431920.desc: A hilariously British point & click adventure. After drinking his uncle's secret formula, Cummerbund Bandersnatch undergoes a monstrous transformation. Solve puzzles, manipulate time and uncover the truth behind Victorian London's most secret society as you regain your humanity.

4753740.name: Worldkampf '72
4753740.desc: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

5375400.name: Orange Braincell
5375400.desc: Orange Braincell is a cozy, chaotic physics game where you play as a small orange cat devouring everything in its path. Meet panicking locals, stick them to your fur, and roll up everything from sushi to the Sun.

3257150.name: Robo娘: 冥星任務
3257150.desc: 冥星陷入危機！在這款充滿挑戰與陷阱的動作平台遊戲中，幫助蕾寶一路闖關，迎戰各種可愛又搞怪的角色。自由選擇關卡順序，擊敗各個 Boss 獲得全新武器，在《Robo娘：冥星任務》中盡情挑戰你的操作極限！

movies.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady - NEW TRAILER
RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady - DEMO TRAILER

4437670.name: Earthia Mining
4437670.desc: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.

3448000.name: Planted!
3448000.desc: Sow. Grow. Throw. Planted! is a chaotic 1-4 player combat game where gardens are arenas, plants are weapons, and grudges are settled one harvest at a time.

3144010.name: 兔兔島
3144010.desc: 你想要建立一個兔兔天堂嗎？踏上《兔兔島》充滿兔兔的歷險，動手將廢棄小島改造成可愛兔兔們的溫馨避風港！在你的島嶼上用可愛的裝飾來吸引毛茸茸的遊客，並與可愛的兔兔成為朋友。

movies.name: Usagi Shima - Steam Release Date Trailer

3744870.name: Croakspire
3744870.desc: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

4450390.name: Laguna Rosa: A long story with reckless consequences
4450390.desc: 歡迎登船，船長，來到《Laguna Rosa》——一款放置型遊戲，讓你成為海盜島的主人。建造並升級各種建築，征服美麗的女孩，善用她們的才能智勝敵人，把這座島嶼打造成權勢與奢華的中心。

movies.name: Laguna Rosa: A long story with reckless consequences Trailer

627690.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
627690.desc: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms is a Dungeons & Dragons strategy management game uniting Champions from throughout the D&D multiverse into a grand adventure.

821250.name: Flotsam
821250.desc: 在這款充滿活力的漂浮城市建造遊戲中，努力生存、航行並營救倖存者。帶領你的漂泊者穿越無盡的垃圾海洋，探索被海水浸泡的廢墟、鏽跡斑斑的工廠，以及來自舊世界的故事。

785890.name: Hexologic
785890.desc: 具有美麗圖形以及獨特的受數獨啟發規則的令人放鬆的益智遊戲

4005870.name: 新生也瘋狂 第3季
4005870.desc: FreshWomen 是一款以選擇為核心的成人視覺小說，聚焦人生中最美好的部分。你是一名剛剛贏得一座豪宅的大學新生。把女孩們帶回家，和她們交往、出去約會或者做愛。你的旅程將充滿喜劇、愛情和大量的性。

3241660.name: R.E.P.O.
3241660.desc: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.

3091340.name: 金屬雷霆 (Metal Thunder)
3091340.desc: 在高刺激的動作遊戲中指揮傳奇炮艇！在瞬息萬變的任務中，以毀滅性的火力與叛軍交火。升級您的武器庫、適應動態挑戰，並在無情的敵人浪潮中生存。每次行動都會提供新的戰術和混亂，讓您稱霸天空。

movies.name: Metal Thunder - Early Access Gameplay Trailer

5415540.name: MESHFALL
5415540.desc: An RTS where your units only take orders inside your radio network. Build relays to push the signal out and keep them alive, because the enemy goes for them first. Five maps, a hundred waves each.

4685030.name: Zudon
4685030.desc: A high-octane arcade puzzle game with competitive PvP and solo puzzle modes. Slide with clear eyes, a full heart and try not to get posted on.

5015190.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
5015190.desc: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

5372700.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
5372700.desc: 整座城市被埋在118,000件垃圾底下。清掉、分類、拿錢，再買更大的機具，邊開邊把整堆垃圾吞掉。每清完一條街，它就重新活過來——而你清掉的東西，永遠不會再出現。

4841200.name: Nuns With Guns
4841200.desc: Four nuns. One church. Hell picked the wrong parish. Nuns With Guns is a gothic top-down bullet-heaven defence game where four armed sisters protect their church from waves of demons, upgrade between battles, and survive as long as faith, firepower, and deeply questionable theology allow.

5100880.name: E-Files
5100880.desc: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

5033390.name: Marrowlight
5033390.desc: Seven women are chained beneath the world, holding an apocalypse down. You are the Warden sworn to execute them when they fail. Free them instead. A horde-survival roguelite where every character you unlock is someone you were sent to kill.

5190580.name: HELENA : Cloud District
5190580.desc: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

4306070.name: Catch Meow If You Can
4306070.desc: An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players. Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

dlc.name: Catch Meow If You Can Playtest

4296620.name: Nano Dash
4296620.desc: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

5147970.name: Chopped
5147970.desc: 一款溫馨愜意的伐木增量遊戲！放鬆身心，招募和你一樣熱愛木材的森林夥伴。攜手合作，一棵接一棵地征服這片林地！

5273680.name: Zompioland
5273680.desc: Build a refuge in a changing valley, then defend it through increasingly dangerous nights. Gather resources, raise walls and turrets, face strange creatures and bosses, and survive rival kingdom raids alone or in 1–4 player online co-op.

1742440.name: COP BASTARD
1742440.desc: COP BASTARD 是一款以 90 年代初期日本為背景的經典 FPS。化身強悍刑警，在狹窄走廊中迎戰一波波極道，體驗受 90 年代動作電影啟發的火爆戰鬥。沒有謎題、技能加成或升級，只有走廊、敵人，以及朝他們臉上吐口水的機會。

5194420.name: Hentai Arctic Beauty
5194420.desc: 完成 24 個拼圖關卡，解鎖極地美女插畫、收集成就並填滿你的圖庫，在 Hentai Arctic Beauty 中享受冰雪世界的魅力。

4689330.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
4689330.desc: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

4822960.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
4822960.desc: 不斷向上跳躍，掌握槍械後座力飛得更高！組合強力增強打造獨特流派，在無盡的危險與怪物中盡可能存活更久。一款每次挑戰都不同的動作平台遊戲。

dlc.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump Demo

4053130.name: Abyss Depth: Control
4053130.desc: A horror point and click set 2000m below the surface. Work off your debt, protect the diver, and survive the abyss—or die trying. In a world drowned by endless water.

5424480.name: Dark Lots
5424480.desc: Dark Lots 是一款第一人稱生存恐怖遊戲。聲響會引來失明的無面生物，而黑水會將人變成怪物。探索聚落、搜集物資、處理傷口、手動裝填武器，並建造庇護所。

4399900.name: Fiak
4399900.desc: 在擬真而沉浸的恐怖體驗中撐過四個夜晚。獨自待在家中的你，必須面對一個執意闖入的惡意存在。這不是步行模擬器：每一個決定都攸關你的生死，一次失誤就是致命的。

4340420.name: TAKTAKTOP
4340420.desc: 逃離天空的垂直跳躍動作遊戲！在建造模式發射投射物鋪路，或挑戰隨機平台模式。透過飛彈傳遞代幣以救援或復活隊友，無代幣時免受攻擊。收集代幣並抵達頂層出口即可獲勝！（支援最多12人線上遊玩）

4760700.name: Chronicles Of The Sinner
4760700.desc: Chronicles of The Sinner is a first-person survival horror set inside an abandoned orphanage. As a lone investigator, you are sent to uncover what happened within its walls. Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and try to survive… if you don’t lose yourself first.

4714010.name: GloveUp!
4714010.desc: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

5294670.name: Murciavania
5294670.desc: Explore a dark, folkloric Murcia in this 2D metroidvania. Master weapons, perfect parries and incantations, uncover hidden passages and cross into the mirrored Envés. 444 rooms, 47 bosses and two endings. Spanish and English text.

5108700.name: MMOAlone
5108700.desc: MMOAlone is an Idle-Clicker Game which provides many Features known from Oldschool MMORPGs, including various ways of Equipment Upgrading, Progression and Raids. - Fight, Loot, Upgrade, Repeat.

5452330.name: HALFTIME Manager Demo
5452330.desc: 完整體驗一個球季的 HALFTIME Manager：從德國乙級聯賽三支俱樂部中選一支，用戰術、轉會、球場擴建和 Merch Lab 帶領它前進。每個比賽日都是3D電視轉播。助理教練會帶你走完最初的幾步。

3484110.name: Gourmet Zombie
3484110.desc: Imprisoned in a mansion's cellar, you're the personal chef of Toufic, the Gourmet Zombie. Master real knife techniques, fight off the infected with kitchen tools and butcher the fallen in a PS1-style survival horror where you're either the chef… or the dish!

5134520.name: Timber & Fortune
5134520.desc: Build a woodworking business from a humble camp. Gather timber, craft furniture, fulfill timed contracts, research new techniques, expand your workshop, trade goods, and protect your reputation as you grow from beginner to master carpenter.

1062830.name: 滅火先鋒 / Embr
1062830.desc: 在這個瘋狂又變幻莫測的多人遊戲中，體驗打火樂趣並從中獲利吧！成為英雄的方法不止一種。與好友組隊、進行每日挑戰，步步攀升成為消防業界中的佼佼者吧！

537800.name: Bomber Crew
537800.desc: Chocks away! Bomber Crew is a strategic simulation game, where picking the right crew and keeping your bomber in tip top shape is the difference between completing your mission or losing it all! USAAF DLC NOW AVAILABLE! FLY THE ICONIC AMERICAN BOMBER!

979070.name: Just Die Already
979070.desc: Just Die Already is an old people mayhem sandbox game created by the designers of Goat Simulator. You are old and angry and you've just been kicked out of your retirement home. How will you survive in a world that wants you to Just Die Already?

223470.name: POSTAL 2
223470.desc: Live a week in the life of "The POSTAL Dude"; a hapless everyman just trying to check off some chores. Buying milk, returning an overdue library book, getting Gary Coleman's autograph, what could possibly go wrong?

401680.name: POSTAL Redux
401680.desc: POSTAL Redux is a high definition remake of the classic dark and surreal twin-stick isometric shooter. Take control of The POSTAL Dude as he fights to survive in a world gone mad with violence.

493900.name: Dungeons 3
493900.desc: At last, the Dungeon Lord has successfully united the forces of evil and established his dark empire. Time for the next step in his most diabolical quest: expansion!

609920.name: Hotshot Racing
609920.desc: Hotshot Racing is a blisteringly fast arcade-style racing game fusing drift handling, razor-sharp retro visuals and an incredible sense of speed to create an exhilarating driving experience.

movies.name: Hotshot Racing Big Boss Bundle Trailer

1926210.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - PRESTIGE PASS
1926210.desc: "The prestige you deserve." Immerse yourself into the luxuries. Purchase now and get instant access to "PRESTIGE PASS" song pack.

3228520.name: 光與影：33號遠征隊 豪華升級版
3228520.desc: 有了「豪華版升級」，遠征也能亮麗有型。

2325460.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - ENDLESS CIRCULATION
2325460.desc: Experience the third arcade-style DLC of EZ2ON REBOOT : R, themed around ENDLESS CIRCULATION. Discover the answers you seek with a total of 39 new songs.

1758560.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - TIME TRAVELER
1758560.desc: Time-travel-inspired visuals and seventeen new songs that you can only experience here, EZ2ON REBOOT : R

1926200.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - CODENAME VIOLET
1926200.desc: "VIOLET ACCESS DETECTED"Expand your experience with a variety of songs. Purchase now and get instant access to "CODENAME VIOLET" song pack.

4118900.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - NIGHT TRAVELER
4118900.desc: INTO THE DREAMLIKE CITY With a visual theme inspired by a “journey through the night,” enjoy a nocturnal adventure in a city beyond the ordinary.

2052630.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - O2Jam Collaboration DLC
2052630.desc: EZ2ON REBOOT : R's the first collaboration DLC, "O2Jam" has arrived. Get instant access to 20 songs in total and DLC exclusive panel skins.

4039770.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - Lucent Soirée
4039770.desc: ‘Lucent Soirée’ is a new DLC for EZ2ON REBOOT : R. Enjoy music meticulously crafted by a roster of composers, created especially for this release.

2688850.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - HARDCORE TANO*C Music Pack Vol.1
2688850.desc: A collaboration pack from 'HARDCORE TANO*C', a famous hardcore music crew in the rhythm game scene, and EZ2ON REBOOT: R! Experience the ultimate joy in the deeper and more diverse hardcore music!

2688860.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - EVOLVE
2688860.desc: The endless cycle stops, and evolution begins. Discover the new DLC for EZ2ON REBOOT : R, 「EVOLVE」 The DLC includes exclusive tracks, theme skins, panel skins, and note skins.

648800.name: Raft
648800.desc: Raft™ throws you and your friends into an epic oceanic adventure! Alone or together, players battle to survive a perilous voyage across a vast sea! Gather debris, scavenge reefs and build your own floating home, but be wary of the man-eating sharks!

1903340.name: 光與影：33號遠征隊
1903340.desc: 率領33號遠征隊踏上征途，擊敗繪母，阻止她再次揮動死亡的筆刷。這款回合制RPG遊戲融合即時機制，法國「美好年代」風格的奇幻異境待你探索，各具特色的獨特敵人等你迎戰。

4918010.name: Sudokiller
4918010.desc: 《Sudokiller》是一款溫馨的推理解謎遊戲：在數獨式的格子上安置嫌疑人，揭露就藏在眼皮底下的兇手。每位客人都會留下線索，指出案發時他們所在的位置。在這款溫馨又巧妙迷惑人的推理遊戲中，一案接一案地推理下去。

4835750.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
4835750.desc: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

5376410.name: Purr Box
5376410.desc: 一個小盒子，一群小貓咪，滿滿的關愛！在這款像素風增量遊戲中，領養貓咪、收集呼嚕、解鎖升級並珍藏回憶。玩玩迷你遊戲，讓小貓在桌面上陪伴你讀書或工作。

3120010.name: Kipple
3120010.desc: Your PC can dream. A free desktop companion that lives in your Windows, blinks, reacts and chats with you. Explore a diversity of unique creatures dreamed by your own machine: hybrids, elementals and rare creatures. Each one is one of a kind and can be exchanged at the Steam Market.

5030170.name: Super Froppings
5030170.desc: 《Super Froppings》是一款最多支援8人連線、不講情面的青蛙生存跳躍動作遊戲。 只用兩個按鍵，看準時機操控青蛙，朝更高的樓層前進吧！

5166860.name: 三國群英傳：策定九州
5166860.desc: 傳承系列三十載底蘊，宇峻奧汀年度正統鉅作——《三國群英傳：策定九州》震撼登場。我們在經典的根基上，以立體維度革新沙盤體驗。於深邃策略與極致控場之間，重塑跨越時代的戰爭美學。這一次，策定九州，由你主宰！

5117160.name: File Corruption
5117160.desc: 30年後，分揀設施的自動化機器人突然故障。您在中心擔任臨時工作，直到它們被修好。在恐怖遊戲 FILE CORRUPTION 中存活五個夜晚，並保持警覺！

3439840.name: 凍堂英霞的隸雄傳
3439840.desc: 究竟是奴隸，還是英雄？ 肉體、精神、尊嚴、日常、未來……獻上一切，成為英雄吧！ 損耗肉體與心靈來持續守護市民的終極隸雄體驗RPG！

5022250.name: Confidence Man：龐氏騙局
5022250.desc: 承諾不可能的回報，用今天的錢付昨天的利息。在這款 1920 年代背景的卡牌構築 Roguelike 中，你每個月都要選：抬高利率把謊撐大，還是拎起手提箱跑路。騙局注定崩盤——唯一的問題是崩的時候你還在不在場。

5327990.name: Pro Soccer Management 27
5327990.desc: 完全掌控一支足球俱樂部。決定戰術、轉會、青訓、員工、財務、設施和球場發展——或者在地下世界冒險放手一搏。使用資料包、模組和 Steam 創意工坊，創建你自己的足球宇宙。

4416770.name: 妖魔录
4416770.desc: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

5367210.name: Cashgrind Simulator
5367210.desc: Most people earn money to spend on games. You have to run a game to earn money. Jobless and buried in debt, you take a shady offer: reroll accounts for the hit RPG Daydream Saga and sell them, then farm gold on your own account and cash it out. Can you pay off your debt, save up, and buy a home?

5300020.name: ZombieBusters: Reborn
5300020.desc: 五名英雄，一名強大的殭屍王。門、視野、技能與任務交織成5對1生存MOBA追逐戰！扮演英雄突圍，或成為殭屍王封鎖退路。獨自與AI挑戰，或邀請Steam好友加入私人友誼賽，最多6人一起遊玩。12名英雄、4名殭屍王、4種任務戰場，在短暫而緊張的對局中創造逃生與逆轉的瞬間。

fullgame.name: RESONANCE OF FATE™/END OF ETERNITY™ 4K/HD EDITION

4996080.name: RESONANCE OF FATE™/END OF ETERNITY™ ENHANCED REMASTER
4996080.desc: 套用本 DLC 後，即可將「RESONANCE OF FATE™/END OF ETERNITY™ 4K/HD EDITION」作為「ENHANCED REMASTER」來盡情體驗。除了擴充遊戲畫面選項與遊戲速度2倍功能（2x Game Speed）之外，文字顯示語言亦新增中文與韓文選項，為您提供更加舒適流暢的遊戲環境。

5402860.name: 勇者喵傳說
5402860.desc: 《MEOWBOUND LEGENDS 勇者喵傳說》 是一款貓咪主演的放置型 RPG。 一群貓咪被傳送到異世界，在這裡蓋起了喵村。

5295390.name: 無盡女武神
5295390.desc: 《無盡女武神》是一款北歐神話題材的2D橫向捲軸像素放置RPG。帶領女武神自動向右探索、選擇目標、戰鬥、施放技能並收集裝備，同時配置三個技能欄位、優先級、裝備詞綴與成長路線，在低操作成本與主動決策之間找到平衡。穿越凍骨之野、水晶洞窟與城堡廢墟，挑戰區域Boss，管理40格背包，進行鍛造、商店補給與永久升級。領取離線收益，並透過轉生重置目前旅程、保留長期成長，在每次掉落與每輪推進中尋找新的戰術選擇與成長。

5302180.name: Everything Must Go!
5302180.desc: Four broke thieves. One supermarket. One thousand items. Race your friends to steal, sell, and upgrade — then throw groceries at each other until only one thief walks away rich. 4-player online party chaos. Keyboard & mouse.

4953670.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
4953670.desc: 失誤，還是故意的？WAZATO是一款4人線上派對遊戲，融合合作動作與身分推理。3名隊員努力完成任務，1名間諜暗中搗亂。觀察朋友的動作、反應和藉口，在合作中找出破綻！任務成績將決定最終對決的形式，別放鬆警惕。

5394990.name: Wallbreaker
5394990.desc: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

5285020.name: Fair21: Blackjack
5285020.desc: A pixel-art blackjack game built around verifiable fairness. Play classic 21 solo, at a three-seat multiplayer table, or in seven-hand elimination. Choose a player seed, then replay and audit every deal and settlement.

3471360.name: 忒伊亞：靈魂之塔
3471360.desc: 這是一款基於「剪刀、石頭、布」核心玩法，一個自由的探索系統以及有趣的俄羅斯方塊與掃雷集合的小遊戲構成的卡牌構築策略遊戲。同時是一個，帶有輕微的肉鴿元素，主打輕鬆的收集向遊戲。擁有許多原創的有趣玩法和機制。

movies.name: 忒伊亞：靈魂之塔 | 宣傳片

4880430.name: GOOB8
4880430.desc: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

5426030.name: GOOB8 Soundtrack
5426030.desc: The soundtrack to GOOB8! This album includes all games OST + the OST of the launcher itself. All songs are made by Seal Dice.

5214750.name: Usurper 篡奪者
5214750.desc: 敵人，就是你的武器。《篡奪者》是一款別具新意的增量太空射擊遊戲。控制敵人，接管火力，在戰鬥與研究中不斷變強，掌握新的形態，用敵人的力量擊潰敵人，最終奪取萬機之主的力量。

5499510.name: Employee06 Demo
5499510.desc: An ordinary man finds himself trapped somewhere he was never meant to be. Uncover the mysteries of Blue Flame Laboratories in Employee06, a psychological horror game blending visual novel storytelling, security camera surveillance, and first-person horror.

5337080.name: 花鸟水月 Demo
5337080.desc: This is a visual novel themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and find the truth behind the painting.

4788070.name: Naughty Nurse
4788070.desc: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

5372870.name: Zero League
5372870.desc: Zero League - a cosmic football sim with vast real world tactics, trading and business environments. Sign players with celestial lore, dictate your formation in the midst of temporal disarray, and watch every match on an interactive 2D pitch impacted by galactic weather events.

4146480.name: Cardborne
4146480.desc: A roguelite played on a real deck of cards. No deckbuilding. Your weapon can only kill an enemy of the same or lower value than its last kill, so the order you fight is the puzzle. Turn your kills into poker hands, pick jokers, beat the boss.

5264740.name: Hot Vacation 2: Summer Heat
5264740.desc: 火熱夏日三消冒險，擁有美麗的動漫女孩、輕鬆玩法和露骨的18+插畫。完成關卡、解鎖新插畫，並填滿你的畫廊。

209190.name: Stealth Bastard Deluxe
209190.desc: Armed with only your wits and a pair of Stealthing Goggles, it’s your job to sneak your way through a deadly facility that’s determined to extinguish your fragile little life.

638000.name: When Ski Lifts Go Wrong
638000.desc: Ride into a hilarious construction puzzler; packed with over 100 creative physics-based challenges, sports and bloody disasters! Build contraptions to help every passenger reach their destination. Enjoy the sports by controlling your riders away from (or towards if you feel like it) peril!

movies.name: When Ski Lifts Go Wrong - Out Now - Mix
When Ski Lifts Go Wrong - Out Now

329380.name: Stealth Inc 2: A Game of Clones
329380.desc: In Stealth Inc 2, you play the role of a clone escaping a sinister and high-tech testing facility. Stealth Inc 2 tests both your brain and your reflexes over 60 varied levels linked together in a sprawling overworld.

compare.en: Stealth Inc. 2: A Game of Clones

dlc.name: Stealth Inc 2: A Game of Clones - Official Soundtrack

1347970.name: Patch Quest
1347970.desc: Patch Quest 是唯一一款結合了 Roguelike 和銀河戰士惡魔城元素的遊戲，玩家可以騎乘遊戲中的任何怪獸來享受冒險的樂趣！拼接而成的迷宮將不斷變化，準備好使出渾身解數，透過跳躍、滑行、掘進、撕咬、爬行、索網攀爬和爆破等各種方式去探索精彩世界。想生存下去，您需要讓自然之力為自己所用！

695100.name: Smoke and Sacrifice
695100.desc: Smoke and Sacrifice sees Sachi, a mother forced to give up her son, adventure into a grotesque underworld on a quest that will lead her to a darker truth.

383270.name: Hue
383270.desc: Hue is a vibrant, award-winning puzzle-adventure, where you alter the world by changing its background colour.

1297900.name: Gothic 1 Remake
1297900.desc: 傳奇再度登場——重回這款經典 RPG 遊戲代表作忠實重製版中的礦谷。探索精心打造的生動開放世界，你的任何行動都會獲得不同的回饋，讓你體驗自由不受限的爽快。

4842380.name: Boarding House: Night Shift
4842380.desc: Boarding House: Night Shift is a horror game. As a night-shift caretaker of an eerie, old boarding house, you must endure unsettling urban legends, manage your survival resources, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows before the morning comes

4261080.name: 遠征公會
4261080.desc: 率領公會打團本！招募不同職業的英雄，組建屬於你的公會；靈活配隊，挑戰團本中擁有獨特機制的BOSS；提升隊伍實力，解鎖英雄天賦樹、獲取畢業裝備，打造最強團本陣容。從零開始，一步步成長為最強公會，重拾MMORPG黃金時代的團本開荒樂趣！

4110670.name: Veinrider
4110670.desc: Veinrider 是一款短篇增量遊戲，描述你穿越外星洞穴、試圖逃離一顆陌生星球的旅程。 操控一艘能夠切換重力方向的飛行器，收集資源並持續升級，向更深處、更快速、更強力地推進！

3436240.name: 8號房間
3436240.desc: 下班回到家時，自己的房間卻變得完全陌生…… 這是一款成人向的類8號出口風格異變找碴小品遊戲，目標是在神秘空間中找出異變並逃脫出去。 累的時候，可以讓坐在沙發上的「瑪麗亞」來療癒你。 隨著遊戲的進展，她也會開始和你做一些色色的事情……

5137980.name: 古玩掌柜
5137980.desc: A turn-based strategy card game of real and fake antiques. Test your knowledge by spotting fakes, if you wish. Adapt to changing demand and prices, take calculated risks, and finish with the most silver. Between games, unwind with idle collecting: 600+ antique cards spanning ten Chinese dynasties.

5234110.name: AXE DESCENT
5234110.desc: 超過600種技能，衍生出無數戰術。在隨機變化的局勢中打造專屬於自己的流派，在這款Roguelite回合制指令RPG中朝「裂隙」的最深處前進。

5412290.name: Emberspark
5412290.desc: Lead a three-hero party through a turn-based JRPG roguelite. Choose branching paths, evolve skills, and stack relics into powerful combinations. Earn permanent unlocks across runs, then test your party against tougher difficulties and an unlockable Endless mode.

5304530.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
5304530.desc: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

4065440.name: UNDERDEEP / 深層迷宮
4065440.desc: 《UNDERDEEP》是一款以硬派而沉浸感十足的奇幻世界為背景的放置型RPG，讓你深入體驗地城探索與地圖繪製。融合經典RPG的魅力與現代放置機制，帶來豐富且富有深度的遊戲體驗。

5035720.name: Tank of the Fittest
5035720.desc: 《開缸大吉》是一款黑暗水族箱 Roguelite 模擬遊戲。調整水溫、pH、溶氧與污染，把魚群推入極限環境；淘汰弱者，催生詞條與演化，引發吞噬連鎖，煉出一條足以反噬整個魚缸的蠱王。

5316900.name: TownEmpire
5316900.desc: Build and automate your city, manage resources, production, agriculture, industry, and trade in a strategy and simulation game focused on efficiency and economic growth.

5412370.name: Carve and Sort: Tidy Up your Pumpkin Patch!
5412370.desc: Carve, paint and drill pumpkins at the workbench, then sort them onto 26 shelves from A to Z. Pick odd and colorful pumpkins from the patch, tidy the hall together or race each other in versus with up to four players, and see what wakes up when the last shelf is full.

5339540.name: 猫咪小窝
5339540.desc: A cozy desktop cat companion. Decorate a little home, prepare meals, tidy the litter box, and pause for a pet. Collect daily fur drops to unlock furniture and room colors, then watch your cat wander between the rooms you create.

4385930.name: Satarichi: Heroes De Caelum
4385930.desc: 加入為 Caelum 而戰的史詩之旅！這款合作動作 RPG 支援最多 4 人聯機。在基於 Satarichi 原著小說打造的宏大世界中，操控傳奇英雄展開即時戰鬥。支援本地合作或透過 Remote Play Together 與好友並肩冒險！

movies.name: Satarichi Heroes De Caelum Gameplay Trailer

4528520.name: Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
4528520.desc: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

3436020.name: Idle Clicker Tower
3436020.desc: Idle Clicker Tower is a single-player idle tower defense with a retro neon aesthetic: defend your central tower, unlock new towers and abilities, grow your power, defeat waves of enemies and increasingly deadly bosses, and open packs to expand your card collection.

5349960.name: 荷塘貓影
5349960.desc: 《荷塘貓影》讓桌面多一隻小貓、一方水彩錦鯉池。餵餵魚兒、看看小貓來訪，搭配天氣與音樂，為工作和休息留一點悠閒。

5316430.name: In Your Dreams
5316430.desc: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

5389150.name: Keyp It Up
5389150.desc: The mother of all slop games. Melt your brain with this hypnotic key-jingling number-go-up game, or buy it for a friend if you hate them.

3066680.name: Solar Voltage
3066680.desc: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

5488280.name: Shapecremental Demo
5488280.desc: An arena roguelite focused on challenging boss fights. Battle through enemy waves, experiment with weapon upgrades, and face bosses that test your aim, movement, and timing.

5105850.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
5105850.desc: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

movies.name: A Game About Cutting Grass - Official Trailer

4911950.name: Pinballoid Crush
4911950.desc: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

2121270.name: Decay Constant
2121270.desc: Warning. Surveillance and detection systems inactive. Multiple subject containment failure. Facility compromised. I wonder what’ll happen to you? SURREAL SINGLE PLAYER ACTION ORIENTED HALF-LIFE 2 MOD

5203330.name: Strip Bubbles: Around the World
5203330.desc: Challenge 4 stunning girls from around the world in this addictive Bubble Shooter! Reach the oasis of victory to unlock smoking-hot interactive video rewards. Customize your choices and enjoy spicy climaxes. Your journey around the world begins now!

5072990.name: The Last Day: What Remains
5072990.desc: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

2662070.name: Unwell
2662070.desc: Descend into your own broken mind in this psychological survival horror. Survive twisted manifestations of your psyche, defend your shelter, and shape your fate through choices that lead to multiple endings.

5009960.name: Where I am Not
5009960.desc: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

4258790.name: The Gardener
4258790.desc: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

4295970.name: 幻影叛離
4295970.desc: 「祕寶」催生出了許多謎團與爭執的導火線，而主角們在王國的命令之下持續管理著祕寶。 它為何如此重要，究竟又有什麼用途？ 各個角色的故事將圍繞著祕寶的祕密發展。

744050.name: Space Invaders Extreme
744050.desc: 《太空侵略者》特許經營機構的人氣之作「SPACE INVADERS EXTREME」開始入駐 Steam，包含大量更新內容，圖形品質和音訊品質大幅提升！ 互動音效、動感十足的視覺效果。侵略者們已經實現超級進化，你還能堅持多久！？

3026450.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
3026450.desc: 在子彈狂飆的末日夢魘中搜刮、射爆、輾壓屍潮！踏上公路之旅，自己決定何時撤離，把背包打造成足以玩壞遊戲的超強配裝，再享受新戰利品完美塞進背包格的物品欄管理快感！

3871800.name: Oathguard
3871800.desc: Defy hordes of undead as a paladin. Strike, dodge, and chain devastating abilities through cursed graveyards in this action roguelike. Evolve your Oath, collect ancient relics and unleash deadly combos every run.

5231490.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
5231490.desc: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

4198620.name: 與爆乳大學生同居吧！
4198620.desc: 因為調職的關係，你與沉默寡言的爆乳女大學生──雫，開始了同居生活。透過遊戲和交流拉近距離，並隨著好感度的提升，逐漸解鎖甜蜜又大膽的色色場景。

5338870.name: Tidy Tech
5338870.desc: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

5245110.name: FishyFox
5245110.desc: Take Dad’s favorite rod on a cozy fishing adventure across lake, river, and ocean. Guide your hook, reel in trophy catches, upgrade your gear, and enter tournaments. Keep your favorite fish in aquariums you can decorate, and fill your journal as you discover new species.

5263460.name: Sort Them Cats
5263460.desc: 數千隻貓咪，每隻都有自己的位置！在這款輕鬆的整理遊戲中，收集、配對並分類擺放 5,000 多個貓咪公仔。解鎖實用能力，發現隱藏驚喜，按照自己的步調將凌亂的小店變成繽紛的收藏天地。

5023090.name: Bouncing Body Bits
5023090.desc: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?

4938170.name: Ostfriesland Games
4938170.desc: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

4463860.name: 万妙之门
4463860.desc: 万寿村的燕知槐有一天“醒过来”，他的眼前出现一扇门，门前的男人自称那栖措，他向你讲述你从未知晓的过去，从呱呱坠地的婴孩、到万寿村的阿槐，最后他向你展示生命中的一种可能，一种付出什么，得到“真相”的可能。

movies.name: 万妙之门 The Gate of Wonders

4934590.name: 戰姬聖約：惡魔之城
4934590.desc: 這是一款融合卡牌構築與棋盤戰術的單人 Rogue-lite 遊戲。構築牌組並打出卡牌，讓它們依照規則在棋盤上移動與交戰。搶佔魔礦、累積資源，迎戰不斷湧來的強敵。率領你的盟軍攻克四大領地，與強大戰姬們一同作戰，並挑戰最終的惡魔之城，奪回崩毀的世界秩序！

dlc.name: 戰姬聖約：惡魔之城 Demo

5163510.name: Bugs & Birdies
5163510.desc: 一款溫馨卻暗藏利牙的生存沙盒遊戲，可單人遊玩，也支援最多四人線上合作。探索由像素島嶼組成的世界，打造你的農莊，養出一支母雞大軍，當甲蟲在夜裡來襲時，一起守住籬笆。

5069990.name: 古今東西ダービー
5069990.desc: Horse racing meets Kokontozai, the Japanese party game of naming things in a category! Name your racehorse to fit the category, and the name alone decides its stats. Then watch a 3D race where the commentator calls your horse by name. A quick party game for 1 to 8 players.

dlc.name: 古今東西ダービー Demo

5445520.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - PUMP IT UP RISE Collaboration DLC
5445520.desc: The music of PUMP IT UP RISE arrives in EZ2ON. From the joy of familiar melodies to the thrill of new challenges, discover a special experience as two rhythm games come together.

movies.name: PUMP IT UP RISE Collaboration DLC - Crossfade
PUMP IT UP RISE Collaboration Teaser

5082200.name: Jimothy's Adventure
5082200.desc: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

3465710.name: 戴帽子的貓：熱鬧雨天
3465710.desc: 戴帽子的貓說過：找樂趣很有意思。歡迎跟他和你喜愛的書中角色玩 18 種精彩小遊戲，在屋內追著他到處跑。無論是單人還是與好友一起玩，你的屋子將會充滿歡笑、驚嘆和熱鬧。

4025270.name: Sancta
4025270.desc: Sancta is a dark, atmospheric experience set in an abandoned dungeon where light decides your survival. Explore the environment, solve puzzles, craft torches, and avoid long-forgotten enemies in a tense world of shadows and secrets.

movies.name: Sancta – Final Trailer | Full Release October 2026

5227750.name: 玄境
5227750.desc: 《玄境》是一款結伴遊歷的修仙放置遊戲。帶著同伴走過江湖，在沿途的故事與日常修行中慢慢成長，走出屬於這支小隊的仙途。

5143760.name: The Largest Organism
5143760.desc: An incremental idle sim with one input: drop glucose. A live slime-mold simulation finds it, grows, and swallows five habitats, from a petri dish to a city. From the forest on, breed strains no one else has, dry them to a code, and send them as a picture.

5112500.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
5112500.desc: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

dlc.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler Demo

5493650.name: UPG Cubed Demo
5493650.desc: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

5110320.name: Monster Movie Mayhem
5110320.desc: A kaiju roguelite city-smasher. Pick one of five B-movie monsters and level a pixel-art city while the army fights back. Topple towers, unleash ultimates, beat five bosses. Out now, with a free demo to try first.

5396240.name: EmyLiveShow Origins: Nia The Gamer Queen
5396240.desc: Help the hot streamer girl to win the tournament and achieve sympathy of the sexy vampire queen.

4915200.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana Demo
4915200.desc: 《EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana》的可遊玩體驗版本，讓你搶先體驗初期的 Presence System 與第一批超自然事件。惡魔早已察覺你的存在，但這僅僅是儀式的開始。

4915220.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana Soundtrack
4915220.desc: Dark ambient soundscape inspired by EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana. Not music - but atmosphere, tension, and presence.

4795660.name: 囚链：未赎之念
4795660.desc: 一款純文字驅動的心理恐怖視覺小說。你在陌生的客廳醒來，身邊站著兩個沉默的男人，牆上用血寫著：「承認你的罪孽吧，你將獲得救贖。」每一次選擇都會改變結局。本體文本量超過8萬字，另有4個獨立角色DLC。

dlc.name: 囚鏈：未贖之念 試玩版

4889660.name: 不出聲
4889660.desc: 《不出聲》是一款聲控恐怖遊戲。你在太平間醒來，唯一規則是保持安靜。麥克風會偵測任何聲音——出聲即死。但並非所有規則都真實，你需要分辨謊言。在密封罐中尋找鑰匙，活下去。

movies.name: Don't Make a Sound — Gameplay Trailer
Don't Make a Sound - Reveal Trailer

4861070.name: Sweep Protocol
4861070.desc: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

5169970.name: 陣地戰場
5169970.desc: 免費試玩版現已開放！《陣地戰場》結合 Roguelite 卡牌成長與自由佈陣塔防。用砲塔改變敵人路線，從三張強化卡中選擇一張，並在戰地商店購買強化與補給，打造你的防禦流派，以交叉火力迎擊敵軍。

1583850.name: Asleep: Act 1
1583850.desc: 孤獨、困惑且沉浸在混亂的現實中的她的惡夢中。 唯一安全的地方是她的房間，但不會持續太久... 在逃離黑暗中潛伏的生物的同時，在荒涼的場景中漫步，以發現發生了什麼。 你是Ana Lúcia的皮膚。

4096830.name: S.O.N.A.R. - 潛艇菜鳥團
4096830.desc: S.O.N.A.R.（Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready）是一款支援 1–6 人線上合作的潛艇模擬遊戲。團隊合作至關重要，慌亂無可避免，而沉沒往往只差一次按錯按鈕。使用 sonar，駕駛、戰鬥、維修，然後祈禱你的朋友知道自己在做什麼。

compare.en: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready

dlc.name: S.O.N.A.R. - 潛艇菜鳥團 試玩版

4643950.name: Snow That Hums
4643950.desc: In a snow-covered industrial city, a man walks through empty streets filled with noise. He listens more than he looks. When a young woman interrupts his routine, the world begins to shift.

5135070.name: Nightshift; Nowhere
5135070.desc: 歡迎來到 Nowhere Medical！薪水少得可憐，這個夜班可能就是你的最後一班，職場安全更是徹底失控。抓起你能找到的任何武器，殺出一條血路，逃離這個鬼地方！

movies.name: Night-Shift Nowhere | Combat & Tactical Vision Gameplay

5394170.name: HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8
5394170.desc: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

5328630.name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
5328630.desc: 你是一朵飄浮在灰暗死寂世界上空的小雨雲。按住降雨，看著青草、鮮花和樹木在你腳下重獲新生。喚醒泉水，填滿湖泊，治癒每一座漂浮的島嶼，再來挑戰你自己的最佳紀錄。

4917510.name: Click&Fix
4917510.desc: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

5100850.name: Organize my Shop 2: Pet Shop
5100850.desc: 您最喜愛的收納整理遊戲回來了！全新的寵物店、17 個獨特關卡以及更棒的舒適體驗正等待著您。按您自己的節奏在貨架上擺放飼料、寵物床和配件吧。遊戲完全直覺，非常適合伴隨您最喜愛的音樂或 Podcast 放鬆身心 🎧✨

movies.name: Organize my Shop 2: Pet Shop Trailer

4137060.name: Prison Fury
4137060.desc: One of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam, where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison. Must work together to escape before time's up.

4713410.name: Cthuloop
4713410.desc: Dive into madness in CTHULOOP, a 1st-person cosmic horror adventure game. Trapped in a loop, you must observe eerie anomalies and piece together cryptic clues before your sanity fractures completely. Can you escape, or will you loop forever? Developed for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam (theme: "Loop").

5207970.name: 番茄谷
5207970.desc: 《番茄谷》是一款溫馨的像素農場遊戲，只能在專注回合之間的休息時間照料。專注讓作物成長，休息時再出門翻土、播種、收成、採礦、砍樹、交易，一點一點打造屬於你的山谷。

5334150.name: Fix it, Please!
5334150.desc: 2000年7月，PIX CORP 大樓，通行證核發窗口。一款官僚體制 Roguelike：審查申請表、揪出冒名頂替者、盯緊監視器、把故障的機器救回來。記過三次，這局就結束。這裡的星期五永無止境，每經歷一輪循環，大樓就把你記得更清楚。

movies.name: Fix it, Please! - Release Date Trailer

5334200.name: Potion Approaching
5334200.desc: A haunted manor item-crafting game where players combine three everyday objects to brew custom potions for visitors. Earned payments are used to pay off the residing ghosts before things get out of hand.

5056390.name: Dead of the Brain
5056390.desc: A cult classic Japanese PC-98 horror adventure from 1992, resurrected for modern platforms. Investigate a zombie outbreak, survive gruesome encounters, and experience unforgettable pixel art terror in this point & click nightmare.

5071340.name: INCREMINER
5071340.desc: Build an ever-growing colony of autonomous dwarves in an immense procedural world. Mine deeper, manage resources, unlock explosive weapons and industrial vehicles, and turn a tiny settlement into a screen-filling mining empire.

1799840.name: Queen's Domain
1799840.desc: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

4127390.name: Montone
4127390.desc: Montone is a story horror exit game, where you walk your way though a seemingly never ending apartment and industrial building. Stay hidden and move with care, you might have to face your biggest fears. And always look for an exit, it is your only chance of survival. Good luck on your journey!

4809000.name: SYSTEM_REBOOT
4809000.desc: You are the cursor. Swarms of corrupted processes want you deleted. A bullet-heaven roguelite where upgrades read like code, your Twitch chat votes on your build and a hidden room leads where no bullet heaven goes. Then the machine itself wakes up. Survive the swarm. Break the system.

5364950.name: Death Lies East
5364950.desc: A cozy grinder that offers countless hours of gameplay and more challenges as you progress. Minimal story and no turn-based combat means quick and rewarding gameplay as you watch those numbers go up and up. How far will you go to save this world?

4669010.name: FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE - Sticky Fingers
4669010.desc: 策劃一場搶劫可不像應考那樣簡單！但當生死攸關之際，我們的英雄們早已準備就緒……不、不、不，我們可不能把所有秘密都洩露出去。快讓你的「貪婪小手」準備好，與你那支「性感」團隊一起迎接這項「不可能」的任務吧！

5168580.name: Blooby Idle
5168580.desc: BLOOBY Idle is a desktop idle game where BLOOBY fights endless waves of the Tumor to save the one she loves. Collect loot, upgrade your weapons, prestige and grow stronger while BLOOBY battles on your desktop as you work, browse or play.

1249890.name: Survival Denied
1249890.desc: Survival Denied has evolved.Jump into a high-performance VR action-roguelite where up to 250 zombies hunt you by sight and sound across 10 lethal hazard zones. Master numerous perks and modifiers, mix and match massive arsenal. Play solo or in asymmetric couch co-op! How long can you survive!?

4992220.name: Colorful Boi 2
4992220.desc: Jump, dash and wall-climb through 74 colorful, deadly levels! Colorful Boi 2 is a tight, fast precision platformer stuffed with spikes, saws, conveyors and launchers - with instant retries, brutal-but-fair challenge and leaderboards for the fastest runs.

5406830.name: Hentai Sexy - Kitchen DLC 4
5406830.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5399580.name: Sexy Elf - Gothic Cathedral DLC
5399580.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5399590.name: Sexy Elf - Gothic Cathedral DLC 2
5399590.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5396820.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World - Prism Supporter Pack
5396820.desc: Dress the valley in clear spectral glass. A faceted Spark, a prismatic Core that brightens with every Resonance, and chamfered interface panels. Purely cosmetic — and a direct way to support the developer.

5393740.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World Soundtrack
5393740.desc: The original soundtrack of SPECTR: Rekindle the World by Artificial Galka. Seven tracks follow the valley from the first spark, through ash and embers, to a world rekindled. MP3 320 kbps and lossless FLAC.

5392600.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World
5392600.desc: Become the Spark that brings a faded world back to life. Gather shards, automate production, and begin new cycles with permanent upgrades. An atmospheric incremental game about growth, discovery, and restoring a ruined valley.

dlc.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World - Prism Supporter Pack

5399600.name: Sexy Elf - Gothic Cathedral DLC 3
5399600.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5406450.name: Hentai Sexy - Cosplay Kitchen DLC
5406450.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5425800.name: AppWheel
5425800.desc: Hold a shortcut and a wheel of your favorite apps and games shows up right at your cursor.

378750.name: Sayonara Umihara Kawase
378750.desc: 承襲1994年初代《海腹川背》、1997年《海腹川背・旬》的人氣系列正統續作，登陸Steam！自在操控伸縮自如的橡膠繩索，運用反彈與鐘擺擺盪，朝著終點邁進！體驗由原班人馬打造、獨一無二的「橡膠動作遊戲」！

2111960.name: MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA - 涅可愛爾奎 回合開始語音
2111960.desc: 購買本商品，「回合開始語音 涅可愛爾奎」便會新增至 遊戲本篇《MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA》當中。

5012600.name: Ticker & Trade
5012600.desc: Ticker & Trade is a multiplayer financial simulator. Trade stocks, options, and bonds on a real-time global order book. Build player corporations, launch mutual funds, react to market-shifting news events, and rise to the top of the leaderboards. Build your stock market empire!

5424260.name: ClipCabinet
5424260.desc: 在同一個錄製庫中整理 Steam、OBS Studio 和 NVIDIA GeForce / ShadowPlay 錄影。新增資料夾、用標籤和搜尋尋找片段，透過內建播放器觀看，並匯出 MP4。

5173660.name: Poop Killer - The Golden Fart
5173660.desc: Jason and Derek are two stoners on a road trip searching for the legendary Holy Weed. But when the Poop Killer returns, they must find the mysterious Golden Fart before it's too late!

3624340.name: Strike and Pop
3624340.desc: Explosive arcade fighting game where you control a puppet with a balloon head. Pop your rival's balloon using sharp weapons, play in duels or survival mode against the AI, unlock new weapons, and climb the online leaderboard!

5114940.name: Dead Keys
5114940.desc: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

4795970.name: Blightened: Relic Keeper
4795970.desc: Think you’re observant? Prove it. Inspect relics, question unreliable visitors, and decide what feeds the Syphon, what goes home, and what must be destroyed. Balance dwindling resources and survive 100 days in this dark fantasy deduction roguelite. Every relic has a correct fate. Just don’t guess.

5263510.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
5263510.desc: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

dlc.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest Demo

5382480.name: Mining Days
5382480.desc: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

5149240.name: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
5149240.desc: 這是一款舒適的第一人稱組織遊戲，背景設定在混亂的維多利亞博物館中。收集分散的彩色立方體，將它們堆疊起來，然後將它們放入匹配的插槽中，以展示像素藝術品並恢復迷人的 3D 體素展品。

3998120.name: BigFooten
3998120.desc: BigFooten Leap. Survive. Conquer the wild. Where every step could be your last. Leap between floating rock platforms. Ride wooden elevators. Navigate shifting terrain. Enter portals that transport you to new and increasingly challenging regions.

3199110.name: NightingNail
3199110.desc: Light in the dark, or nail in their coffin. Which will you be? Step into this atmospheric world where deception reigns. NightingNail is a game of cunning, strategy, and chaos, where outsmarting your opponent is key to survival.

5349910.name: Cozy Necromancy
5349910.desc: A gentle mystery about a village that cannot let go of its dead. As a journeyman necromancer, you lay six spirits to rest by listening to them, investigating what holds them, and making your case with three objects in a ritual circle. No combat, no timers, no fail states.

5083880.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong
5083880.desc: A bisexual singer goes viral after being caught kissing a man, shattering the image her fans built around her. Navigate fame, social media, biphobia, and messy romance in this otome/yuri visual novel.

dlc.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong Demo

4799680.name: Lifelines
4799680.desc: A cozy puzzle game about the lines beneath a growing town. Homes move in and ask for water, power, internet and gas. Draw the pipes that reach them, dig under the busy parts of town and cross rivers on aqueducts. Every five years, the town votes on whether you keep the job.

4644340.name: Farm.exe
4644340.desc: Plant, harvest, decorate, and customize your desktop. Unlock new crops, uncover hidden treasures, and create a space that grows more beautiful over time.

5328430.name: cat.exe
5328430.desc: cat.exe is the chill desktop cat you've always wanted. No idler mechanics, no clicking, just a plain cat.exe to hang out at the bottom of your screen while you use your computer.

3036840.name: Apocalyptica
3036840.desc: Fight off starvation, dehydration, and madness. Lose your sanity, and your nightmares become fatal.

5008810.name: Minesweeper Rush
5008810.desc: Classic Minesweeper, leveled up. Sweep at your own pace from Easy to Hard, or race the clock in Mine Rush and Endless. Play solo or grab a friend to earn gold, gems, level up, prestige, and stock power-up items to give yourself the edge. May the best Sweeper win.

4880870.name: Debtbound
4880870.desc: Buying this game puts you $5 million in debt. Can you escape the debt spiral? Collect money, unlock upgrades, and increase your earnings before the interest catches up with you in this incremental game!

4993710.name: Lusófona Games Collection 2026
4993710.desc: Lusófona Games Collection 2026 brings you five inventive games from Lusófona University! Explore bite-sized experiences, unlock Steam achievements, and enjoy exclusive game developer commentary on how each game came to life.

3426420.name: LUST CURSE 🔞
3426420.desc: Paradise smells like salt and sin. 🌴 Lana Wett is stranded somewhere that wants her bare, breathless and on her knees. Fight it every step of the way… or let the curse show her what she’s been missing.

4631440.name: Luminara: The Second Dawn
4631440.desc: Medieval fantasy daughter-raising sim with adventure and romance elements. You are a single father, and every step of your daughter's journey is yours to guide. Study, adventure, make friends, fall in love… 70+ endings, each playthrough a new story. Ready to raise the most wonderful daughter of all?

5091010.name: Abandon All Hope
5091010.desc: Abandon All Hope is a 1 to 4 player dark fantasy action RPG. Hunt the Seven Sins across a shattering world, master tactical combat, and craft absurdly powerful gear. Mix Weapons with different classes, play your way combat. 5+ Ways to earn loot after the campaign. Can you survive the decent?

5199400.name: Guess What's Behind!
5199400.desc: 猜出你身後的荒謬圖片！朋友們會提供提示，但不能說出禁用詞。規則簡單、場面混亂，笑料不斷！

5249860.name: Sticker Mirage
5249860.desc: Play as Sticker Line, a 711 emergency call center worker. He lives his quiet life until strange and unfortunate events begin to occur, and he might be somehow connected. Discover the truth behind Sticker's quiet life in this dreamcore-style visual novel with horror elements.

5401770.name: Tinker to the Moon
5401770.desc: 親手組裝飛行器，一步步飛向月球。透過每次飛行賺取資金，嘗試機翼、氣球和引擎，不斷改良你的發明。從一張彈簧椅開始，享受組裝、飛行與再次嘗試的輕鬆樂趣。

5399490.name: Sexy Elf - Farm DLC 2
5399490.desc: Remember the symbols, opening part by part the full picture.

5109960.name: PopUp Tube
5109960.desc: Bring channel surfing back to your own video collection. Each show gets its own channel, ready to resume where you left off. Add PopUps—precisely timed commentary cards that bring context and a fresh perspective to what you’re watching.

5416030.name: Mine Away
5416030.desc: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

214770.name: Guacamelee! Gold Edition
214770.desc: 《Guacamelee! Gold Edition》是一款類銀河戰士惡魔成風格的動作平台遊戲，而它奇妙的故事背景靈感則來自墨西哥傳統文化和民間傳說，並有許多有趣且獨特的角色。

1155970.name: Roadwarden
1155970.desc: Roadwarden is an illustrated text-based RPG that uses isometric pixel art and combines mechanics borrowed from RPGs, Visual Novels, adventure games and interactive fiction.

232430.name: Gone Home
232430.desc: June 7th, 1995. 1:15 AM. You arrive home after a year abroad. You expect your family to greet you, but the house is empty. Something's not right. Where is everyone? And what's happened here? Unravel the mystery for yourself in Gone Home, a story exploration game from The Fullbright Company.

movies.name: Gone Home: Riot Grrrl Style Now

793460.name: 112 Operator
793460.desc: Manage emergency services in any city in the world! Take calls and dispatch rescue forces. Handle difficult situations, now depending on the weather, and traffic. Help the citizens through cataclysms and natural disasters, becoming a better emergency number operator every day!

3905440.name: Infection Free Zone - Supporter Pack
3905440.desc: Support the development of Infection Free Zone with this cosmetic pack featuring exclusive emblems and unique vehicle skins. Stand out while surviving - and help us keep improving the game!

5202640.name: Spinstack
5202640.desc: Spinstack is a single-player stacking puzzle game. Rotate the square base to guide falling tetrominoes, complete concentric rings, and trigger inward collapses and chain clears. Choose from four modes, master special blocks, build Combos, and chase higher scores as the board expands.

5396420.name: NAME ME IF YOU CAN
5396420.desc: 看清名字，輸入筆記本，淘汰對手！NAME ME IF YOU CAN是一款第一人稱多人派對遊戲，你的名字就是你的弱點。追逐好友，藏好自己的名牌，用出其不意的道具，把危機變成最後一刻的反擊機會

5335830.name: Vagina Sancta
5335830.desc: Vagina Sancta is a unique experience that allows u to interactively explore the fascinating world of female reproductive anatomy!

4394570.name: Apothecary Grounds
4394570.desc: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

3851950.name: REDSHIFT
3851950.desc: Redshift is a short psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. You are a field technician sent to an abandoned research facility. Your objective? Find out why it's begun outputting power, all on its own.

4932970.name: FACTORIZE: 1
4932970.desc: 2是攻擊。3是防禦。5是回復。組合卡牌創造數字，用質數的力量戰鬥的回合制牌組構築 Roguelite。質因數分解交給遊戲，觀察敵人的行動，創造此刻需要的數字。即使是同一手牌，答案也不只一個。

4162890.name: Gnomed
4162890.desc: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker where a little gnome defends his cozy home. Hold off 20 waves of enemies, unlock new abilities and grow stronger every run!

3778650.name: Wall Brawl
3778650.desc: Hold the line! Team up in this tactical multiplayer castle‑brawler where players raise fortresses, set up defenses, and smash through enemy strongholds with physics‑driven destruction. Heroic last stands! Questionable tactics! Bricks moving at unsafe speeds!

5282780.name: Waking Adrift
5282780.desc: You and your crew are on a one way mission to reach the edge of space, but something sinister is lurking in the halls.

5285600.name: FiND ME
5285600.desc: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

5188560.name: Idle Reef
5188560.desc: 將荒涼的海底變成充滿生機與色彩的珊瑚礁！管理你的資源，解鎖新型海洋生物，擴建你的生態系統，並在放鬆的音樂聲中打造屬於你的水下天堂。

5421610.name: Prismhold
5421610.desc: 一款卡牌驅動的塔防遊戲：每一波都從你的牌組中挑選塔，集齊三座相同的塔即可合成進化、永無上限，再混搭 14 種元素，抵禦無盡的波次、頭戴王冠的頭目與飛行生物。可單人遊玩、在同一張地圖上合作，或與最多 6 名玩家並行挑戰。

5224600.name: Delved Too Deep
5224600.desc: Delved Too Deep is a game about an endless stream of machines exploring the depths seeking to fulfil the Factory Imperative. Each new machine iteration is better than the last, their accumulated knowledge leading to revelations that may change the fate of those who wander the deep...

3675870.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
3675870.desc: 用你的幽靈捕獲器去捕捉幽靈、解開謎題，阻止那群到處搞事的色慾上頭的幽靈女孩

5456300.name: Kur - Endless Descent - Supporter Pack
5456300.desc: Support the development of KUR: the Domain Echo companion, a fifth storage tab and Steam Inventory trading.

5456290.name: Kur - Endless Descent - Shade (Class)
5456290.desc: Unlock the Shade, a swift assassin who strikes from the darkness of Kur.

5456310.name: Kur - Endless Descent - Lykoi (Companion)
5456310.desc: A loyal companion that grants +6% experience to your party. Damage caused +1%.

4773410.name: Talaire
4773410.desc: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

5129280.name: 醫院狂想曲
5129280.desc: 經營你的醫院，邂逅特別的緣分！透過日常管理與私下互動提升信任與好感，揭開白衣之下的另一面。9位成年女性、25個約會場景、27段約會劇情、20張CG立繪、每位角色27段HCG演出，以及153個員工偷拍收集資源等你探索！

4874760.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
4874760.desc: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

5438700.name: Chipforge
5438700.desc: Chipforge is a hands-on synthesizer and music generator for chiptune, heavy bass, beats, and experimental sound. Explore a deep style bank, shape your own sounds, perform with reactive visuals, and export your creations.

1540370.name: Hans in the Internetz
1540370.desc: Hans in the Internetz is a first-/third-person meme platform adventure game. His dream to become a wizard lays deep within the internet and you, as his apprentice must do the dirty work and “figure thiz out” Expect puzzles, toilet humour and legal drugs!

1714410.name: SANITY
1714410.desc: A psychological horror game that delves into the lives of the Synclair Family, following a horrible tragedy.
