2527810.name: BEATVISTA
2527810.desc: 小朋友與硬核玩家都能玩。BEATVISTA 是一款節奏遊戲，每首歌都配有來自 AI 影像創作者的音樂與 MV，並擁有專屬舞台。既能玩一個按鍵就能上手的小遊戲，也能用四個按鍵挑戰 HELL 難度的密集譜面。遇到難點，隨時倒帶練習。

2515760.name: KRAPHIS : DRILLER
2515760.desc: Mining roguelite. The detector pulses. Dig deeper. Find it and it's yours. Fuel is your only limit. 2041 you're a contract driller for STRATUM Corporation. How deep you go, when you return every decision is life or death.

2563780.name: Rift Saviours
2563780.desc: Rift Saviours is a sword-fighting roguelite where you battle endless waves of enemies. Survive longer to earn upgrades that offer great build customization. Step into the rift and fight for your survival!

3227750.name: Spartacus Blood Arena
3227750.desc: Fight for freedom through intense, tactical battles, crafted with the expertise of archaeology departments and reenactors from Rome, Capua, and Pompeii. Prepare for glory. Prepare for blood!!!!

movies.name: SPARTACUS BLOOD ARENA | DEDICATED SERVER PLAYTEST | 60 FPS

812550.name: The King's Bird
812550.desc: Escape into a world kept secret by a tyrant, and discover the truth about your freedom. Run, jump, and fly through forgotten lost kingdoms with a uniquely momentum-based flying mechanic.

562500.name: Warstone TD
562500.desc: Warstone是一款塔防遊戲，結合角色扮演、策略、以至城鎮建築元素。高解析度，華麗的畫面，加上深入的故事情節，帶你進入遊戲世界。

5116540.name: Turn Limit 100
5116540.desc: A speedrun-focused deck-building roguelike set in Nagoria, where East meets West. You have exactly 100 turns — run out, and it's a forced defeat. Play fast, not safe. Three characters, branching paths, and 28 achievements await.

4670040.name: Blackboard Ponies
4670040.desc: A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives.  In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

5431750.name: MINESWEEPER ARCADE
5431750.desc: A classic Minesweeper that also incorporates many modern gameplay elements.

5288230.name: MiniRacingOnline
5288230.desc: Online racing for up to 32 drivers with over 8,500 vehicles and 300 tracks. Tune your setup, plan your tyre strategy and adapt to dynamic rain. Over 20 years of evolution and a community that has never stopped racing.

4374510.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1
4374510.desc: Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment. A psychological horror ADV depicting the twisted pure love between a girl who dies without drinking blood and a boy who dies without eating human meat.

5456270.name: Kur - Endless Descent - Ashipu (Class)
5456270.desc: Unlock the Ashipu, the exorcist-healer of the underworld.

5253800.name: The Planet Miner
5253800.desc: 一台小小的採礦艇，最後會強到一鑽下去就削掉一整層地層。往下挖穿色彩繽紛的地底世界，疊出犯規的強化組合，再派無人機自動開採，讓財富日夜不停滾進來。閃亮礦脈、可愛居民，還有大到讓你說不出話的地底奇景，都等著你挖出來。

5196280.name: JOYSTICK JAMMERS: One Prawn
5196280.desc: Use your controller joysticks to smack the drumset as One Prawn, creating your own style of freeform rhythms.

5408670.name: YOU
5408670.desc: Wander through the mysterious forests surrounding you; explore places you would never otherwise venture into. Discover interesting things and things that might make you rethink the decisions you’ve made regarding him.

4980350.name: Everdeep Idle
4980350.desc: An ARPG-inspired Idle game where the fighting happens automatically, but the build is yours. Choose up to six classes, reshape skills with augments and build-changing loot, and set up triggers and loadouts that react for you. Let it run while you’re busy, or dig into the numbers to min-max.

5351540.name: The Pasture
5351540.desc: You are a mouse cursor, summoned by an entity called The Shepherd into a simulation drawn entirely in ASCII text. In this difficult point-and-click puzzle adventure, you solve puzzles, collect items, fight the dangerous Bound, and piece together what happened to a strange world.

3052820.name: DarkBlood -ReVerse-
3052820.desc: 規則簡單的卡牌構築回合制RPG，以精美的像素風畫面描繪出黑暗奇幻的世界。 透過完成各種任務，可解鎖近20位可操作角色。依據角色的個性客製化戰鬥風格與裝備，挑戰潛藏兇惡魔物的未知地城吧。

5287260.name: 契約師物語
5287260.desc: 《契約師物語》是一款回合制戰棋遊戲，其中的每個角色都有特殊技能和元素屬性。在「冒險模式」中贏得戰鬥並締結契約，即可將其招入麾下——遊戲內全部 60 多種單位均可免費獲取。你可以挑戰故事模式，與好友同屏對戰，或是在 PvP 模式中與線上對手一較高下。所有單位均可透過遊玩解鎖，絕無抽卡、付費角色、或 DLC 限定角色。

5404630.name: 忌質物管理局　第七保管室
5404630.desc: Welcome to the Ishitsubutsu Management Bureau. Earn ¥10,000 an hour inspecting cursed objects. Compare each item with its inspection record, identify anomalies, and choose to Store, Incinerate, Seal, or Report it. A job-simulation horror game with a seven-day mystery. Japanese only.

5147030.name: World Note
5147030.desc: WorldNote 是一款為創作者打造的視覺化世界觀整理應用。繪製地圖、塗繪地形、放置標記與地區，並將地點、角色、勢力和事件文件相互連結。在同一個空間中管理你的整個架空世界。

3919400.name: 黄莓C HuangmeiC
3919400.desc: 《HuangmeiC》: a cute, laid-back modern daily visual novel. Play as a new grad, enjoying funny daily life in another world—a light, silly romance! Stress-free job, little to do, great coworkers. No dark stuff or bad endings; just love, growth! Worldview not real—don’t use 3D logic!

4603280.name: Triad of Victory
4603280.desc: Turn the world’s most familiar hand game into an addictive strategy adventure. Combine skills, gear, and progression choices—every decision can change the course of a run.

4451190.name: Thou Shalt Be Rich
4451190.desc: Interpret the crystal ball's prophecies to find tomorrow's soaring stocks and bet your entire fortune. Survive the madness of skyrocketing and crashing prices to become rich. You need to take revenge on the Fortune Teller Corp that fired you just for a little bit of embezzlement!

5097500.name: Bearing 2889
5097500.desc: Orsivellum paid your team well for ninety days at a remote lighthouse. Now you're waking up on the floor of a locked room, the last few weeks are blank, and the building is empty. A first-person co-op escape room for 1 to 4 players.

3235390.name: Ballerspiel
3235390.desc: 一款滿是小丑、漫畫風格的混亂第一/第三人稱射擊遊戲。大逃殺、Ballerball 和小丑對決,包括原子彈在內的 13 種武器,載具,增益道具,還有一個什麼都能打碎的世界。可線上遊玩、在無網路的區域網路對戰,或離線對戰電腦玩家。

2294890.name: Dark Tonic's Blunderbusted: Guns Out, Bluns Out
2294890.desc: BLUNDERBUSTED is a fast paced roguelike shooter for lightgun, mouse, or touchscreen! Dive into wild arcade action with crazy customized weapons and ridiculous powerup combos, destructible stages, and just... too many enemies.

1651240.name: 請別叫它糞作啊主播大人：HAPPY NANARU
1651240.desc: [實況主，請別叫它垃圾遊戲] 是一款隨著關卡推進不斷獲得「能力喪失」的逆成長型2D平台跳躍遊戲。控制可愛的童話風麵包店少女「娜娜露」，突破惡魔「雅可」的重重考驗。某個祈願冒險永不結束之人所設下的陷阱，以及逐漸被剝奪的控制感，將不斷挑戰你的極限。

4618460.name: Shadows of Gloaming
4618460.desc: Shadows of Gloaming is a social deduction party game where 19 unique roles and 3 rival factions clash across tense day votes and hidden night actions. In Party Mode, one player hosts the GameArena while everyone else joins for free through the web app.

3814510.name: 白线
3814510.desc: 《Hakusen》is a campus and racing-themed romance visual novel developed by PlanC. Told from the perspective of the protagonist, Jiang Yao, the story chronicles his journey of mutual growth alongside the heroines as they join hands to make their youth shine with a unique brilliance.

3412590.name: Mystic 6
3412590.desc: A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. Along your journey, weapons, potions, skills, runes, and much more will shape every run.

4969270.name: Jarkeeper
4969270.desc: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

3819330.name: Den: A Short Horror Story
3819330.desc: Den is a short survival horror, where you rent a small cabin for a weekend getaway, deep inside the woods, hoping to escape reality and find joy in life.

5382580.name: Rakuworld
5382580.desc: Draw your own hero and play as it. Your drawings come alive to face hordes of enemies across 11 worlds made of paper and crayon. 36 heroes, 22 bosses, evolving weapons and 1-4 player co-op.

4618670.name: 掛機放置修仙錄
4618670.desc: 組建五人修仙小隊，掛機迎戰怪海、刷寶配裝。搭配功法、天賦與裝備秘法，讓技能變招、隊友聯動，養成你的戰鬥流派；突破大境界後，從三個候選中選擇一個境界詞條，持續強化角色。肉鴿式構築遇上長期掛機成長，買斷制單機，離線也有收穫。

4715160.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
4715160.desc: 這是一款支援 1–4 人遊玩的多人合作作弊模擬遊戲，你將和朋友一起努力熬過最後一週的考試。偷看答案、躲避老師的追查，並使出渾身解數，運用各種作弊手段，讓你們即使一頁書都沒讀，也能順利畢業！

5140550.name: Extravalence
5140550.desc: 帶領一支由活生生化學元素組成的隊伍，穿越一個支離破碎的世界；每一道化學鍵都會改變戰局。切換各具特色的英雄、組合他們的能力、掌控不穩定反應，並恢復世界的穩定。

4612060.name: Sex Idler
4612060.desc: 在罪惡之城打造你的享樂帝國！招募熱辣美女，與隨從一同壯大事業並賺取豐厚收入。關係越深入，激情越火辣。這座城市已經在等待著你了！ ❤️‍🔥

5159930.name: ODD ODDS
5159930.desc: 一款在一間房間內展開的單人 Roguelike 賭博遊戲。 為了償還巨額債務，你必須在抓娃娃機中賺取本錢，透過小遊戲下注賺取更多收益，再利用 ATM 將金幣兌換成現金。 用賺來的錢強化設備，在打字機上磨練技能。 門鈴突然響起。來訪者究竟是想趁火打劫，還是準備向惡魔露出獠牙？ 接受哪一筆交易，又該如何與對方周旋——你的每一個決定，都將決定你能否逃離這間房間。

5381050.name: FIVEFOLD
5381050.desc: Build a party of five by combining jobs, skills, and sub jobs in this turn-based party-building roguelite. With no exploration or traditional level grinding, the focus is on party building and combat. Adapt your formation and skills to each enemy and develop your own strategy to overcome them.

5370640.name: Nodes
5370640.desc: Build the network. The network is the weapon. Wire a node-based hacker rig, balance power, heat and bandwidth, and breach 21 escalating targets, from a branch post office to NASA's Deep Space Network. A calm automation game with no timers and no fail states.

5143070.name: IAI // BREAKER
5143070.desc: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

2157490.name: 无名勇者见闻录
2157490.desc: This is an action adventure game. You are a nameless adventurer, taking on bounties, exploring the world, and honing your skills. When a nation's fate hangs in the balance — join a faction to shape politics, or stand alone against the mightiest foes? The world won't wait. Ready to become a legend?

4974600.name: Hidden in Plain Cake
4974600.desc: Sculpt, slice, and paint real cake into perfect copies of everyday objects — then invite your friends online to spot the fake. Every cut reveals the sponge layers inside. Fool them, or get sliced open trying.

5121170.name: Mine The Core
5121170.desc: An idle mining game with a world of exactly 1,006,632,960 blocks. Hire a crew, upgrade, mine, kill bosses and prestige!

4962120.name: INSERT COIN DIE
4962120.desc: Classic arcade action meets roguelike depth: battle through escalating 1vN rounds using pure, retro-influenced controls. Draft upgrade cards after every win to build fleet support, slow-moving bullet tanks, or agile killers. Die, learn, repeat—how long can you survive?

5117230.name: Spell Death
5117230.desc: A roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters and spell words to strike, block or hex. Print them on paper stocks that change the rules, and learn each demon's true name to banish it from an art deco city that stopped reading.

5431510.name: ONE MILLION CRABS
5431510.desc: How many crabs can your PC handle? Start with one, buy upgrades, and multiply your way into a deeply unnecessary hardware test. Push your crab count, tank your framerate, and find out what that expensive graphics card was really for.

3183540.name: Corrupted Worlds
3183540.desc: Corrupted Worlds is a sci-fi puzzle adventure that tasks you with navigating a dying solar system full of perils. Survive, solve intricate puzzles, and scavenge for vital resources. Uncover ancient artifacts to reveal the past and saveguard life in the universe.

4610720.name: Thunder Tie
4610720.desc: Thunder Tie is an unsettling mascot horror puzzle game. Navigate through the power station to uncover the unsolved mystery of the people who disappeared 10 years ago. Watch out though, as you will may be greeted by some... creations.

5180770.name: GhostLine - Origin Zero
5180770.desc: Breach the networks of Helix Dynamics in a cyberpunk routing puzzle. Recalibrate modules, inject pulses, and outsmart Firewalls, viruses, and ICE as GHOST uncovers a conspiracy that can erase people from records—and from their own memories.

5207740.name: 英雄对决
5207740.desc: Heroes Duel is a turn-based strategy card game built around tactical board control and powerful card synergies. Choose the Human, Elf, or Demon faction, build your deck, battle other players in real time, or challenge AI opponents and campaign maps.

5448940.name: Liberate : escape game à deux
5448940.desc: Two prisoners, two neighbouring cells, one wall between them. Each on their own device, no network: describe what you see, listen, guide your partner. 52 co-op puzzles played by voice, in an abandoned laboratory.

4501140.name: Gimbap Heaven
4501140.desc: 和你的團隊一起經營一間韓式小吃店！招募員工、分配廚房任務、規劃菜單，在這款卡牌餐廳經營模擬遊戲中兼顧薪資、壓力和帳單。忙不過來時，親自下廚、上菜，撐過15天。

1007490.name: Gladiator: Blades of Fury
1007490.desc: 角鬥士: 憤怒之刃是中世紀時期設置的近戰戰鬥遊戲。玩家可以扮演來自四個不同氏族的角鬥士, 即野蠻人、刺客、騎士和矮人。所有的英雄都是獨一無二的, 都有自己的武器、技能和戰鬥風格。

2912680.name: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia
2912680.desc: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia is Quiz Game for kids for age 5 and above. This game helps everyone to increase their knowledge by completing various different trivia challenges.

370910.name: Kathy Rain
370910.desc: Set in the '90s, Kathy Rain tells the story of a strong-willed journalism major who has to come to terms with her troubled past as she investigates the mysterious death of her recently deceased grandfather.

3170.name: King's Bounty: Armored Princess
3170.desc: King’s Bounty: Armored Princess builds on the foundation of The Legend, expanding the classic formula with deeper turn-based tactics, a huge hand-crafted world, and new mechanics that change how you approach battles and progression.

1838980.name: Polyion
1838980.desc: Build and manage your town, it's resources, residents, animals and more in this simple and minimalistic town builder.

5343280.name: X-Ninja
5343280.desc: Take control of X and fight your way through 42 VERY challenging levels! Every enemy on the screen must be defeated before you can escape, but the time limits are tight, so don't hang about! If you really want to push it, try grabbing a gem before making your exit

3680760.name: Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween
3680760.desc: A stylish 2D boss-rush hack & slash where every member of the Halloween Gang fights by their own twisted rules. Discover their secrets, master flashy combat, and take them down one by one to destroy Halloween itself.

4922230.name: 拯救餐厅
4922230.desc: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

5431590.name: TrenchFin
5431590.desc: TrenchFin is a 3rd person behind the character 3D platformer melee combat game that follows Asha Trenchfin, an anglerfish on a mission to reach the top of a spiraling reef to save the magic coral tree from a terrifying Leviathan by using her light to reveal invisible platforms and enemies.

3571980.name: Keymaker
3571980.desc: This game is a chill puzzle game, with stories of people daily lifes in 90's and millennium. The game features two types of locks: Locks with "Damaged Zones": repair by dragging components horizontally or vertically to create match3. Four-Way Security Locks: These require you to maintain a balance.

5311510.name: 崩老头模拟器
5311510.desc: An absurd conversation card game and life sim. Build your deck, read the room and chain cards into combos while balancing affection, suspicion, time and rent. Your next outrageous request might earn a transfer or an awkward reply. Simplified Chinese only.

movies.name: 教授牌局（概念演绎，非实机）

4699020.name: INTUS
4699020.desc: Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done. Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

4848220.name: Jolly Junction: Chapter 1
4848220.desc: As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

movies.name: Jolly Junction: Chapter 1: CHANNEL ZERO - Promo Trailer
Jolly Junction: Chapter 1: CHANNEL ZERO - Trailer

3698670.name: My Name Is...
3698670.desc: Survival horror about sanity balancing affecting gameplay in a steampunk world of phobias, full of dangerous entities, anomalies and randomly generated puzzles.

4838150.name: 橙子妹妹
4838150.desc: Orangie is a 3D AI desktop companion for RPGs! She watches your gameplay, follows the story, remembers past adventures, and chats with you on her own. Explore, laugh, and share every moment together!

movies.name: Orangie — Your AI Desktop Companion for Every Adventure.

5399880.name: Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up
5399880.desc: 在 1–4 人第一人稱線上合作中，整理一間亂成一團的東京漫畫店！抱起成疊的漫畫和周邊，找到正確的貨架，把漫畫丟進格位，解鎖團隊技能。每一卷，各歸其位。一起！

movies.name: Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up - Trailer

4068850.name: Candy Rush!
4068850.desc: A roguelike survivor where the clock is your own greed. Fights never end on their own — the waves loop, and every loop makes enemies stronger. Bank your build and leave, or stay one more round. Choose your route, evolve your weapons, and meet the boss with whatever your greed built.

5002040.name: Stellacore: Mining Odyssey
5002040.desc: Stellacore: Mining Odyssey blends twin-stick combat with deep resource mining in a fast-paced 2D space shooter. Shatter block-built enemies piece by piece, crack asteroids for precious ores, and forge your loot into powerful ship upgrades!

4790400.name: Operative Division
4790400.desc: Command your forces from above or take direct control on the ground. Operative Division is an intense RTS-TPS hybrid set in a post-apocalyptic world. Manage finite resources, execute surgical tactical maneuvers, and unleash devastating superweapons in a battle for humanity's future.

3058550.name: REWOLBOROUGH VOL.1
3058550.desc: Welcome to Rewolborough, a hard-boiled metropolis whose faceless facade hides the reeking wastes of the human psyche.

5373980.name: Find The Clover
5373980.desc: Search a vast clover meadow for 50 rare specimens. Harvest by hand, upgrade to tools and garden machines, carry your crop to the buyer, and pour it out yourself. Bring special finds to your display cabinet.

3081070.name: MOLY
3081070.desc: MOLY is a VR puzzle-solving immersive rowing simulator that uses VR rowing gameplay to represent the authors' perceptions of the world and their aspirations for the future as they come of age.

4799130.name: Phantom Grind
4799130.desc: Phantom Grind is a minimalist pixel-art action RPG you can play entirely with a mouse. Click to fight monsters, earn XP and gold, upgrade four stats, and reach Level 30 to face the final boss.

4703560.name: Soviet Backrooms
4703560.desc: 一款生存恐怖遊戲，背景設定於充滿後蘇聯室內空間的邊界世界，從地板到天花板都瀰漫著陰鬱的懷舊氣息。探索空蕩的走廊，傾聽身後的聲音，並試著從這場惡夢中找到出口。

4922860.name: PingPongDart
4922860.desc: PingPongDart is a Game between PingPong and Dart. Hit the rotating Dartboard using a navigator for precise hits from any 3D space. Play alone or with friends or family up to 4 players. It is particularly well-suited for teens, as the game is based on physics rather than shootouts and explosions.

5322070.name: Zero Hour Deadfront Demo
5322070.desc: A cooperative zombie game for four players with roguelite elements. Choose cards between waves, survive hordes of ice, fire, lightning, or rock, and endure Zero Hour: every five x, the power goes out, a boss appears, and you must defeat it. Since this is a demo, gameplay is limited.

320300.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2015
320300.desc: New cars, new tools, new options, more parts and much more fun in the next version of Car Mechanic Simulator! Take your wrench! Create and expand your auto repairs service empire. Car Mechanic Simulator 2015 will take you behind the scenes of daily routine in car workshop.

25900.name: King's Bounty: The Legend
25900.desc: 《英雄大帝》是一款融入了回合戰鬥與角色扮演元素的冒險遊戲。

63910.name: King's Bounty: Crossworlds
63910.desc: King’s Bounty: Crossworlds is a standalone expansion that includes Armored Princess, two additional campaigns, and a world editor, expanding the classic King’s Bounty formula with new challenges and content.

489630.name: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
489630.desc: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence. Four factions will engage in a brutal war for dominance over the planet’s resources. In the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in Warhammer 40,000 you will lead one of four unique factions.

movies.name: Warhammer 40.000 Gladius - Relics of War in 2 minutes

1107300.name: Down in Bermuda
1107300.desc: 一場意外的暴風，讓一名愛冒險的飛行員在惡名昭彰的百慕達受困長達數十年。戰勝深淵裡的生物並揭開島嶼的秘密，找到回家的路。

1190000.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
1190000.desc: Work your way to a service empire. Get your hands dirty in a highly realistic simulation game that pays major attention to details. Pay a visit to a new Auction house and buy cars in various conditions. Expand your range of services by investing in a new work space and equipment.

203350.name: King's Bounty: Warriors of the North
203350.desc: King’s Bounty: Warriors of the North is a standalone entry of the beloved tactical RPG series set in the world of The Legend, generations after its events. You will lead a Viking hero, wield Rune Magic, command Valkyries, and defend the northern lands of Endoria from an undead invasion.

compare.en: King's Bounty: Warriors of the North

1395030.name: Kathy Rain: Director's Cut
1395030.desc: 《Kathy Rain》這款屢獲大獎的冒險遊戲推出導演剪輯版，故事情節更加充實，謎題與場景也更加豐富。走進看似平靜的鄉村小鎮，揭曉表面之下的駭人真相，見證一位偵探的誕生。

289520.name: King's Bounty: Dark Side
289520.desc: Time has come to begin a Dark Journey to the other side of Teana and explore a mysterious region never before seen by royal bounty hunters. King’s Bounty: Dark Side lets you play as the villains in a full standalone campaign with new heroes, dark factions, and a fresh tactical perspective.

270850.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2014
270850.desc: Now you can own and operate your own auto repair service with PlayWay’s Car Mechanic Simulator 2014. Car Mechanic Simulator 2014 gives you the behind the scenes view of the daily dealings at local garages and dealership repair shops.

407130.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator
407130.desc: Renovate & build II World War tanks. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

dlc.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator - First Supply DLC

2288621.name: Train Simulator: Tokyo Commuter: Keihin–Tohoku & Utsunomiya Lines Route Add-On
2288621.desc: Return to Japan and embark on bustling and world-leading commuter operations in the heart of Tokyo – be right on time and master modern EMUs on local and rapid duty. The ultimate capital city service awaits with Union Workshop’s Tokyo Commuter: Keihin–Tōhoku & Utsunomiya Lines.

3321460.name: 赤血沙漠：強化版
3321460.desc: 以帕衛爾大陸為舞台展開的開放世界動作冒險遊戲——《赤血沙漠》。 你將化身灰鬃的克里夫，踏上奪回失去的一切、並從迫近的威脅中拯救世界的旅程。 在遼闊的原野上馳騁、深入隱藏的古代遺跡、踏入神祕的「阿比斯」領域，在戰鬥、探索與發現之中，開創只屬於你的道路。

movies.name: 赤血沙漠：強化版 - 官方預告片

5412430.name: ORUNKA
5412430.desc: An online RPG on the island of Moruah. Catch dinos and raise them as pets. Your pet attacks whatever you attack, and Auto Battle keeps the hunt going. Pets raised from Lv 1 grow strongest, and an appraisal reveals their Bloodline. Party up with other hunters on one island. In English and Korean.

5188570.name: A Rover's Journey
5188570.desc: A Rover's Journey is a 3D, narrative, exploration game, set in space! Play as Roo-ver, and help your astronaut companion discover all the lunar landscape has to offer. Traverse difficult terrain, avoid crashing meteors, and uncover tech from previous expeditions. Can the moon sustain human life?

5437880.name: Domain-Controller
5437880.desc: You're the new IT hire at Kelmore, a research lab that keeps the dead. Work the helpdesk queue with real PowerShell and Active Directory, go one floor deeper each day, and find out what the last admin left running.

4512150.name: SICRUN
4512150.desc: A first-person arcade horror game about greed. Every level's exit costs SicCoins, and the goal is to buy your way out as fast as possible. Collect coins in the dark while something hunts you, gamble to multiply them, and spend them on upgrades and companions. High risk, high reward.

3459340.name: Lacey's Flash Games
3459340.desc: These are the REAL girls’ games. Charlie (Charchar887) discovers Lacey's mid-2000s Flash games and their disturbing secrets. Enter the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the website's missing creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey and her friends!

4819580.name: Case Analyst
4819580.desc: A retro-terminal detective game. Crack cases, analyze evidence, unmask a conspiracy. Step into the chair of an FDI forensic data analyst. Case Analyst is an investigative OS-sim where you crack cases from a retro CRT terminal -- issuing commands, analyzing evidence.

5417330.name: Sort Sort Yokai
5417330.desc: A cozy sorting simulator set in a little Japanese shop full of spirits. Pick up 640 yokai figures and give every one its place on the shelves. Light up the cabinets one family at a time, and keep an eye out for trouble!

5392290.name: Too Many Orbs!
5392290.desc: You fell asleep in magic class. Your punishment? Sort 3,493 magical orbs. Explore a magical orbirary, find where each orb belongs.

5246020.name: Sex Shop Chaos
5246020.desc: 要維持店內整潔，變得越來越困難了！在《Sex Shop Chaos》中經營一家充滿趣味的成人用品店：拿起商品，把它們放到正確的貨架上，千萬別讓自己也手忙腳亂！

5132750.name: RuinsGate Survivors
5132750.desc: Explore vast maps with companions, bring treasure home, and build your party in this RPG-flavored survivors-like. Fight hordes and powerful foes, then explore your manor, talk with companions, complete quests, and unlock weapons, outfits, furniture, and more.

631570.name: Whispers of a Machine
631570.desc: Whispers of a Machine 是一款具有濃郁北歐風格的黑色科幻作品。它以後人工智慧世界為背景，講述了一位擁有強化人工大腦的偵探維拉，針對一系列謀殺案展開調查，並且揭開一場以禁斷科技所引發的黑暗衝突的故事。

movies.name: Whispers of a Machine - Launch Trailer
Whispers of a Machine - Deep Dive Trailer

1328350.name: Turbo Overkill
1328350.desc: Enter Paradise as Johnny Turbo—half-metal, half-human, all-murder machine. Clean up the streets with a chainsaw leg, 15+ weapons and your hovercar as you battle the rogue AI Syn, rival bounty hunters and cyberpunks aplenty. Apogee’s most outrageous FPS since Duke Nukem 3D. Good hunting, Sir!

5367090.name: 基因織女 Gene Weaver
5367090.desc: 進入最小的尺度 在分子視野下重新編織 編織生命的故事 盡情穿梭在基因宇宙中尋找編織超能力的基因素材 編織一塊專屬的神奇魔毯吧！ Enter the smallest scale. Re-weave life’s narrative at a molecular level. Freely explore the genetic universe for superpower genes. Create your own magic carpet!

movies.name: 《基因織女—基因魔毯編織》互動指南

dlc.name: 基因織女 Gene Weaver Playtest

3808500.name: Undertaker
3808500.desc: The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns. As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary. Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

5370520.name: Anubis Temple: La Perla de Egipto
5370520.desc: 你能征服這座神殿嗎？一款高難度 2D 平台遊戲，真正考驗你的勇氣。選擇男孩或女孩探險家，踏入阿努比斯神殿——每一次跳躍、每一個陷阱、每一扇門都藏著 La Perla de Egipto 的秘密。

movies.name: Anubis Temple: La Perla de Egipto - Trailer

dlc.name: Anubis Temple - Skin Robot de Cartón (Niña)
Anubis Temple - Skin Robot de Cartón (Niño)

4980490.name: TDM : Task Drill Maniac
4980490.desc: Mine ores on your taskbar, craft equipment, and trade the materials you collect on the Steam Community Market in this idle mining game.

5236180.name: City Contractor
5236180.desc: Take on construction contracts, control heavy machinery, and watch every project take shape step by step. Earn profits, expand your fleet, and grow your construction company.

5427930.name: 離島旅程
5427930.desc: 從長洲出發，展開香港離島釣魚旅程。觀察浮標、掌握揚竿時機，在收線與卸力之間取得平衡，逐步完成170種魚類圖鑑。走訪海岸景點，收集明信片與旅途物件，挑戰小遊戲，並透過撿拾海洋垃圾認識海洋保育。

movies.name: 離島旅程 — 遊戲實錄 / Gameplay

824530.name: 鴨鴨賭場：賭博模擬器
824530.desc: 假錢隨便梭，輸了不心疼！12 款賭場玩法一次玩個夠：骰子、Plinko、踩地雷、21點、輪盤、拉霸、Crash……一把梭哈百萬也無所謂，輸光了再儲點假錢繼續玩。

5282040.name: Myriad Auction
5282040.desc: Blind-bid an entire warehouse in a roguelike auction. Spend resources to uncover clues about what is really inside, sharpen the appraiser's estimate, then make the one call that matters: bid or pass? Win the lot, then crack it open item by item to find out whether you struck gold or got fleeced.

5406040.name: BANDA SHAFT DUEL
5406040.desc: A first-person arena shooter where you duel a bot that moves and aims like a real player. Practice Lightning Gun duels anytime, train with randomized settings, and fight in a full 3D air-duel mode.

5420170.name: N in One 益智小游戏合集：2048、连连看、泡泡龙、消灭星星
5420170.desc: A quick break, with a little overtime for your brain. Enjoy 20 minigames, including 2048, tile matching, bubble popping, box pushing and mazes. Pick from four difficulty levels per game, learn with illustrated guides, and play offline with local autosaves. Supports eight interface languages.

5409790.name: Slime Splitter
5409790.desc: A pixel art incremental game about popping slimes. Sweep your jelly ring across the arena and split every slime into smaller pieces until the screen overflows, then spend the jelly on a huge skill tree and card deck to push past 15 bosses and into endless mode.

5380410.name: Tower Hero Survival
5380410.desc: A tower-defense roguelite with automatic attacks. Choose from 60 towers and combine 95 weapons with 100 upgrades. Survive 30 waves or challenge other players online. Every run brings a new build. Whose tower will stand the longest?

5320830.name: Beastforger Autobattle
5320830.desc: Forge an army from the monsters you defeat. Build a team of ten, combine Heroic creatures into powerful fusions, and reclaim a fallen kingdom in this fantasy incremental autobattler. Push deeper for better loot, rebuild your citadel, and grow stronger through reincarnation and New Game+.

5398190.name: Fish with Friends
5398190.desc: 一款支援1至4人的合作釣魚遊戲。釣魚、賣魚，購買更好的釣竿和更大的船。駛向遠海能釣到更大的魚，但要留意重量：釣到的魚全都要上船，裝太多船就會沉。

5417030.name: Find The Gold
5417030.desc: A mountain of sand. Gold hidden somewhere inside. Dig, haul and sell your first loads, then build the machines that take over the hard work. Connect conveyors, power a growing factory and uncover natural gold specimens in a first-person digging and automation game.

4875500.name: Dice in Wonderland
4875500.desc: 擲骰湊出撲克牌型的 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲。親手鍛造每一顆骰子，疊加籌碼×倍率，讓分數爆發到連王后的計分官都放棄計算。柴郡貓注視下的殘酷而奇異的仙境——再來一局。兔子洞深不見底。

4066570.name: Half Faith Tower
4066570.desc: Ascend an endless tower in this dark fantasy roguelite where strategy meets luck. Arrange your weapons, drop the orb, and unleash powerful attacks, defenses, and magic. Face increasingly deadly enemies, grow stronger, and fight to survive. Every floor is a new challenge. How high can you climb?

5362630.name: Vesper Vector
5362630.desc: Blast through space and fight on the ground in Vesper Vector, a sci-fi arcade shooter. Dodge projectiles, battle bosses, and upgrade your ship and equipment. Play solo offline or team up with a friend in online or LAN co-op.

5230310.name: Cradle of Ash
5230310.desc: Co-op survival horror for one to four players, or solo with companions at your side. In Ashbrook the dead get back up unless what is left of them burns. Ration the fuel. Leave no corpse whole. Then open Bloodthirsty Demon Baby Mode, and up to eight friends join as the litter to hunt you.

5403010.name: 魔塔
5403010.desc: Explore two classic pixel-art towers where every step matters. Plan routes, collect keys and weigh battle costs across the 21-floor and 50-floor adventures. Choose visual themes and character appearances, with local saves. In-game text: Simplified Chinese.

5057320.name: Is This Reversi?
5057320.desc: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

5306640.name: DOOD
5306640.desc: 親手畫出身體，裝上眼睛、腳和翅膀等部件，創造生命並把牠們放進廢品星球——這是一款繪畫×生態箱模擬遊戲。讓生物交配、融合，創造意想不到的新生命，在完成博士們古怪研究委託的同時，把失落故鄉的生態系重現在廢品星球上。

4645180.name: Elecade
4645180.desc: 用連鎖電擊擊倒失控的機械。 《Elecade》是一款 1bit 增量動作遊戲，你將在不斷強化中挑戰宇宙設施的最上層。

4844820.name: DARK PGT 2: The Red Death
4844820.desc: DARK PGT 2 is a dark post-Soviet action game with souls-like elements and black humor. Max Panin wakes up from a coma in a world of mutants, robots, and Soviet experiments. Survive, fight, and figure out who turned everything into this hellish mess.

4844090.name: Suits of Fantasia
4844090.desc: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

5451170.name: 捕捉小动物
5451170.desc: A casual simulation game where you upgrade different nets and abilities to catch animals with various abilities, and experience the thrill of scratching off a scratch-off ticket to win a big prize.

4451770.name: 手動提款機
4451770.desc: 在這款上班模擬器中，你將扮演一名躲在ATM背後的員工，負責處理主管交辦下來的大小事。透過完成各種任務、解鎖獎勵，甚至是爭取加薪！同時還要管理好每一天的時間，兼顧食材跟身材，也別忘了用你的薪水好好犒賞自己。

296910.name: 8BitBoy™
296910.desc: Huge classic platformer with several power-ups and 8-12 hours of main story & 300+ hidden locations just begging for exploration · 56 big Levels · 5 huge worlds

3499380.name: Easy Red 2: Shanghai - Nanking
3499380.desc: 探索 1937 年中國關鍵衝突中的詳細戰役。全新的武器、制服、載具和任務，等待著你在新的 DLC 上海-南京。

115800.name: Owlboy
115800.desc: Owlboy 是一款劇情驅動型跳臺冒險遊戲。其中，你可以飛去探索雲端的全新世界！邀上好友三五人，帶他們一起去探索開放的天空。

3323460.name: Relictor
3323460.desc: Relictor is a strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Manage a mobile base. Create AI-driven modules like tanks and gliders for exploration, resource gathering, and tactical battles. Survive, trade, and uncover mysteries in a dangerous world.

5284390.name: Wildfire Command '98
5284390.desc: The year is 1998 and you're the Air Attack Supervisor. Read the wind, the slope and the fuel, then draw the lines your tankers and helicopters will fly. Ten authored fires, endless generated incidents, two-player co-op, and a shareable replay of every run.

4213320.name: Wheel Make It
4213320.desc: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

4950720.name: Kill The Frog
4950720.desc: Build an army against frog bosses in this pixel-art incremental/idle game. Earn gold, gems, honey and cheese, grow through skill trees, and equip the BugiVugi King with boss loot. Four rooms, different systems, and an ever-growing force!

3017040.name: Kando Realm
3017040.desc: Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you.

4530170.name: Run, Ronald, Run
4530170.desc: 《Run, Ronald, Run》是一款增量式競技場射擊遊戲，講述一個小圓圈努力在一大群憤怒的幾何圖形中生存下來。

2754480.name: Exitus
2754480.desc: You have found the job you were looking for. Your only concern is your quota. or else? Protein was always the problem. The HFU solved it. Keep your head down, Do your job, you are here for a reason. Exitus is a terminal-style decision game. Pull up each case, then decide their fate.

4923480.name: FRAGLINE: Esports Manager
4923480.desc: Build an esports org from a scrappy roster into a world champion. Scout raw talent, design your own set plays, and outcoach rivals who adapt to your tactics. Grind from open qualifiers to grand finals in a scene where every win and loss makes headlines.

4567920.name: Bull Run
4567920.desc: Trade stocks, short the market, and outsmart AI rivals. Play a match, a 13-scenario campaign, the Daily Challenge, or a Career from your mom's basement. Online with friends on Steam.

5172270.name: John Whisk
5172270.desc: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

5021730.name: Loadout Rush
5021730.desc: Build the perfect loadout — before the wave hits. Cram items into a grid backpack, buff them with neighbor synergies, and merge them into something greater. Chicken + Molotov + Heart = Dragon. We had rules. It happened anyway. Monster waves are coming, and your bag IS your weapon.

5014710.name: Idle Survivor
5014710.desc: 你被困在太空中。太空船的武器是你抵禦一波波敵人的唯一防線。組合元素能力、解鎖新太空船，在戰役或無盡模式中盡可能長久地生存。

5349660.name: I'M DEFINITELY IN A BASEMENT
5349660.desc: You wake up tied to a chair. Again. Dig underground, avoid whatever hears you digging and descend into the house where a woman in white hums your lullaby. First-person Japanese horror: don't look back when they sing kagome kagome.

5448060.name: Sea Train
5448060.desc: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

4217360.name: Magic Fruit World
4217360.desc: 《魔法水果世界》是一款結合深度探索與戰術戰鬥的激烈平台冒險遊戲。掌握魔法水果的力量擊敗無情強敵，在廣闊世界中尋找秘密，並在高重玩性的關卡中磨練你的技能。

5370330.name: Desert Springs
5370330.desc: A cozy puzzle builder where one endless spring of water turns a floating desert island green. Play shape cards that raise, lower and flatten the land, and the water finds its own way down. No timer, unlimited undo. Plant, build a town and earn new cards by score across 70 levels in seven lands.

5228470.name: Hotpot Party
5228470.desc: Run a hotpot restaurant solo or with up to three friends. Queue ingredients, grab them from the conveyor and serve dinner before it burns. Buy better ingredients and upgrades between days, and try to keep your friends from filling the belt with tofu.

4781790.name: Deadly Match
4781790.desc: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

4923370.name: Studs Up!
4923370.desc: 第一人稱足球，由你親自操控雙腳，沒有預設動畫決定球的去向。支援 1v1 至 5v5 線上對戰，可扮演前鋒、守門員或裁判。沒朋友？在「杯賽征程」類 Rogue 模式中組建陣容，升級球員、挑選強化，一路闖過淘汰賽。

4453280.name: Compacted
4453280.desc: A slot machine roguelite where every spin is a fight for survival. Upgrade five symbols, choose run changing items, trigger jackpots, and repay escalating debts before the walls crush you.

1858720.name: 異星來信
1858720.desc: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

3552240.name: LEGRADA
3552240.desc: LEGRADA is a tactical board game with online 1v1 duels. Place walls, force your opponent to take a detour, and reach the opposite side first. Collect Lekamon figurines, wield abilities from seven elements, or play Classic mode without abilities.

5100760.name: Obolus
5100760.desc: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

5465220.name: Whack a Friend
5465220.desc: Your friends bring the faces. You bring the hammer.

5091340.name: Reveria: Act 1
5091340.desc: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

4719010.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
4719010.desc: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

4536760.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
4536760.desc: In this single-player strategy game, you will lead a stranded Antarctic research station against terrifying odds. Manage your crew, stretch scarce resources, and balance progress against survival as an unseen cosmic threat tightens its grip.

812140.name: Assassin's Creed® Odyssey
812140.desc: 在這款動作冒險遊戲中，啟航前往古希臘改變它的命運。投身於陸地與海洋的激烈戰鬥，從流浪者蛻變為傳奇，並揭開你的身世之謎。

40350.name: Lost Horizon
40350.desc: 1936: Soldiers of the Third Reich roam the world seeking occult weapons for their insane plans of conquest. When Fenton Paddock, a former British soldier and hapless smuggler, is asked to look for his friend Richard, who went missing in Tibet, he has no idea that this search will lead him across three continents to a secret that could...

307960.name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad
307960.desc: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad is the continuation of the legendary IL-2 Sturmovik series that has set the standard for PC combat flight games for more than ten years. This new entry into the series will offer virtual pilots an even more accurate simulation of the most famous air battles.

movies.name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad - Join the Fight!
IL-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad - Trailer #2

2810.name: X3: Reunion
2810.desc: X3：重聚 延續了史詩般的太空傳奇，融合了深空貿易和激烈的即時戰鬥。探索廣袤的宇宙，建立自己的帝國，開闢新的疆域。通過增強的圖形和複雜的經濟，這是一次戰略、模擬和星際陰謀之旅。

movies.name: Discover two milestones in the X series history!

2840.name: X: Beyond the Frontier
2840.desc: The Human Race had advanced to the point where we could travel among the stars, we developed giant automated machines to help us colonise other worlds, but there was a fault in their programming and they turned and attacked. Forcing us to lay a trap to protect Earth and exiling the Human race to stay on Earth once again.

40340.name: Secret Files 2: Puritas Cordis
40340.desc: The sequel to the award winning adventure hit Secret Files Tunguska. Famine in Africa, floods in Southeast Asia, economic crisis in Europe, and civil wars in South America, the world is on the brink of disaster.

2911770.name: EVERSPACE™ 2 - Supporter Pack
2911770.desc: EVERSPACE 2 支援者包為遊戲系列的超級粉絲提供全新的裝扮選項，可以自訂船艦外觀。

2016980.name: Highway Driving
2016980.desc: Highway Driving is 3D racing game for everyone. Players will be amazed with the overall gaming experience in this game. There are various different tracks and game modes in the game. Players can select many different types of vehicles.

660900.name: Dark Mystery
660900.desc: Dark Mystery is a Puzzled Platformer Game in which player faces different types of difficulties to find his true love.

3751950.name: 刺客教條：黑旗 同步重置
3751950.desc: 經典的單人海盜冒險強勢回歸。在這款忠實強化的重製作品中，於海盜黃金時代化身「愛德華．肯威」，揚帆橫越加勒比海，感受令人驚豔的視覺表現、升級的遊玩體驗與全新內容。

dlc.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Map Pack
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Dragon Storm Naval Pack
《刺客教條：黑旗 同步重置》- 龍之風暴角色組合包
《刺客教條：黑旗 同步重置》- 海蛇航海組合包
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Sea Serpent Character Pack
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - Hellfire Naval Pack
《刺客教條：黑旗 同步重置》- 地獄火角色組合包
《刺客教條：黑旗 同步重置》刺客大師航海造型

5213710.name: 回到风吹过的地方
5213710.desc: Homeward on the Wind is a story-driven life simulation set in the town of Clearbrook in 1992. Return to the past as Shen Mingzhu, revive her mother’s old general store, manage stock and upgrades, explore the town, meet its residents, and shape relationships through your choices.

5329940.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
5329940.desc: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or co-op!

4691490.name: 冒險家生活
4691490.desc: 《冒險家生活》是一款開放世界角色扮演遊戲。在這裡，你可以培養冒險家、組建冒險團、收集裝備、升級技能，體驗冒險家的日常生活。

5388040.name: HexScrawl
5388040.desc: HexScrawl is a collaborative hex-map cartography program for running and playing hex crawl TTRPG campaigns and Westmarches-style games.

5354800.name: 名畫修復室
5354800.desc: 名畫修復室是一款解開數織碎片、修復黯淡名畫的解謎遊戲。《蒙娜麗莎》《星夜》、金弘道的《摔跤》、葛飾北齋的《神奈川沖浪裏》等112幅東西方名畫，被分成從10×10到20×20共2,597道謎題。

5039650.name: Nightwire
5039650.desc: Wire up a data-theft rig, launder stolen bytes on a live black market, and climb the netrunner underworld one burned identity at a time — until a ghost of who you used to be logs on, learns how you fight, and comes for the only chair that fits one of you.

5378430.name: WW.Heaven
5378430.desc: Only the perfect go to heaven. WW.Heaven is a short first-person collectathon where you set out on a quest to fulfill your sister’s dying wish.

4971300.name: Touhou Smash
4971300.desc: A 2D platform fighter where the girls of Gensokyo go at it. There are no health bars: damage builds as a percentage, and whoever launches the others past the blast zone wins. Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya and more each fight with their own moves. Up to 4 players, local or online.

4369080.name: SYSADMIN Hell
4369080.desc: You're the sole sysadmin for a company scaling from 10 to 100,000 employees. Everything breaks. Everything. Automate your way out of ticket hell or watch it all burn.

5115790.name: JETGRAVE
5115790.desc: JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up for 1-3 players inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Blast through hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, massive war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

5181410.name: Lucky Debt
5181410.desc: A roguelike about debt. Eight deadlines, one rigged slot machine, and a simple problem: the money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger. Build a deck of symbols and charms, chain multipliers, and pay what you owe — or don't.

5086700.name: bar-hopping-bear.
5086700.desc: Bar by bar, a young woman wanders through the night. Conversations with bar owners and patrons, along with little things that catch her eye, bring back memories of her father, mother, grandfather, and family trips in this narrative exploration adventure.

4247570.name: contract of the ninja
4247570.desc: Contract of the Ninja is a stealth arcade game. Study enemy routes, strike with precision, and escape without being seen. Master precise controls, optimize your path, and complete contracts with maximum efficiency in fast, challenging stages.

5062950.name: Guild of the Tower
5062950.desc: 一款隊伍制RPG：建立公會，用戰術（Gambit）系統為英雄編寫戰鬥策略，再派他們攀登一座神秘高塔。這裡的死亡是永久的，並非人人都能歸來。

5330720.name: Survive 10 Waves
5330720.desc: The aliens have arrived. It's your time to defend the planet. Shoot the aliens, upgrade, be faster, stronger, smarter. Repeat.

5507550.name: 修仙：我有一个按钮 Demo
5507550.desc: 按一按按钮就能掉出天材地宝，绝世神兵，大妖妖丹，攒修为、渡天劫……每件宝物都有独特的机制，每按一次按钮你都会变强！坐化之后参悟天道，转世重来。五位红颜陪你斩妖、结为道侣，或者，被你炼成只听你一人的蛊……

4916190.name: Silent Protocol
4916190.desc: Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

5305650.name: Learn To Rock - Học Cách Chơi Nhạc Rock
5305650.desc: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

5130990.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
5130990.desc: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

5403210.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
5403210.desc: Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies. A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills. There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

5098820.name: Cute Kitty WAR
5098820.desc: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

movies.name: Cute Kitty WAR — Official Trailer | Co-op

582160.name: 《刺客教條：起源》
582160.desc: 在這款動作冒險遊戲中探索古埃及。面對強大敵人、揭開陰謀，還可以探索「刺客兄弟會」的起源。

48190.name: Assassin’s Creed® Brotherhood
48190.desc: It’s time to join the Brotherhood.

33230.name: Assassin's Creed 2
33230.desc: An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy. New low price!

2396240.name: SteamWorld Heist II
2396240.desc: 跟隨 Leeway 船長，參加史上最盛大的搶案，拯救機器人免於一場水資源危機！遊戲包含戰術回合制戰鬥，搭配招牌的彈射玩法，超過 150 種武器和道具，全新的職業系統，還有即時海戰。超過 30 小時的遊戲內容，準備好迎接一場史詩級的《蒸汽世界》冒險吧！

1337010.name: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
1337010.desc: 即使是最渺小的人物，也能帶來巨大的改變。與Alba一起拯救她美麗的島嶼以及野生動物，並引發一場大改革。

2800.name: X2: The Threat
2800.desc: 《X²: The Threat》是新一代的宇宙模擬遊戲，您扮演 Julian Gardna，承接了前作《X: Beyond The Frontier》的故事。 遊戲採用了更新過的繪圖引擎，整體宇宙有更新的觸感，並有全新設計的船艦和太空站，提升整個世界的複雜度。 探索：您可以探索超過 130 個設計華麗的區域，其中有影響船艦與太空站的星雲，也有能夠採掘礦物賺取利潤的小行星。 新船艦：從偵察艇級至母艦級戰艦，共有超過 60 種船艦供您探索宇宙。 全新升級項目：船艦系統有更多種升級項目，並可下載採用了 X² 專用指令碼引擎所設計的全新升級項目。 全新武器：為船艦配置全新武器，包括離子干擾器和質量驅動器等等，也可以蓋工廠生產這些武器進行販賣，賺取利潤，擴張您的宇宙帝國。

1128920.name: 永恒空间2
1128920.desc: 《EVERSPACE 2》是一款快節奏快的單人太空射擊遊戲，你可以在太空及行星上深入探索、大肆搜刮，體驗RPG元素、採礦及製造玩法。在生動的手繪風格開放世界中體驗刺激的科幻故事情節，踏上充滿秘密、謎團與危險的旅程。

745920.name: Temtem / 腾兽
745920.desc: Temtem is an online creature-collection adventure. Tame 165 unique creatures across 7 vibrant islands, battle other tamers, tackle mythical Lairs, chase Luma & Umbra variants, and breed your favorite Tems - with friends by your side! Dive into a colorful monster catching adventure, so Temtem up!

2820.name: X3: Terran Conflict
2820.desc: It is the year 2938. The long wished-for encounter of the X Universe and the Earth holds both joy and sorrow for the people. Despite flourishing trade, the clash of the diverse races, cultures and life forms creates new tensions, mistrust and open conflict that need to be overcome!

40330.name: Secret Files: Tunguska
40330.desc: Unravel one of the greatest mysteries of our time! On the 30th June 1908 an explosion with the combined energy of 2000 Hiroshima bombs rocked the region of Tunguska in Central Siberia and felled over 6,000 square km of trees. The explosion could be heard from as far as 1,000km away.

396750.name: EVERSPACE™
396750.desc: 《EVERSPACE™》結合快節奏戰鬥、Roguelike 類型元素、華麗視覺效果與扣人心弦的劇情。遊戲將帶你踏上充滿挑戰的旅程，穿越變化無窮、驚喜不斷的美麗宇宙。一路射擊強敵、製作武器、劫掠資源，在極其不利的條件下奮力奪得勝利。

movies.name: Early Access Launch Trailer 60 fps PEGI

5204070.name: Compact Racing: Dirty Trucks 4x4
5204070.desc: Race compact 4x4 trucks through challenging off-road tracks, master their unique drifty handling, and compete locally with up to 4 players, including 2 players sharing the same keyboard, or take on dynamic AI drivers.

4687930.name: Creative Aquarium
4687930.desc: 如果你筆下的每一筆塗鴉，都能在桌面一角獲得生命呢？《創意水族館》是一款充滿想像力的休閒桌面放置遊戲，也是一片由玩家共同創造的水下世界。親手畫下想像中的魚兒，為牠取名，看著牠擺動獨一無二的輪廓游進水族館，在你工作、學習或放鬆時靜靜陪伴。這裡沒有範本，也沒有「畫得不好」這回事：天馬行空的怪魚、隨手勾勒的小傢伙，都可能成為讓人過目不忘的明星。發現其他玩家的奇妙作品，收藏彼此的靈感，把喜愛的魚兒匯聚成專屬魚群；自由裝扮水下空間，讓每座魚缸都展現主人的個性。當越來越多創意匯入其中，你面對的不只是一塊畫布，而是一片充滿奇思妙想、永不重複的玩家海洋。畫一條魚，為這個世界增添一個新生命。

3929380.name: Golf 5 MAX
3929380.desc: Launching November 2 on Steam! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust, where every hole is all or nothing. Play solo or challenge rivals worldwide. Try the free demo now!

5009390.name: BOB LOGISTICS
5009390.desc: 歡迎來到鮑勃公司！核對訂單、搬運貨物，用自動化設備讓工作一點點變輕鬆。在這款悠閒的第一人稱倉庫模擬遊戲中，從實習生晉升為總監。隨著職級提升，公司的新區域與背後隱藏的故事也將逐漸展現。

5045650.name: Redline Rookie: A 4WD Racing Career
5045650.desc: A mini 4WD career racer where setup is everything — no driving once the race starts. 75 parts mapped to real physics (no fake buffs), 9 AI rivals playing by exactly your rules, an F1-style 8-round season with sponsors, paddock drama and post-race brawls. Tune, watch, learn, win.

5333990.name: Habet
5333990.desc: 你曾被賣進競技場，卻以自由之身走了出來。如今站在那裡的，是你名下的人。買下他們，操練他們，送他們上場流血。你當年得到的，他們個個都想要。至於你，不管還能撐多久，競技場都等得起。

4986750.name: Sabado
4986750.desc: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

5038720.name: Iron Void : Silent Space
5038720.desc: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 120 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 10 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your fighter, and master every star.

4832770.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
4832770.desc: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, allow for bullet drop and land the perfect heart shot across 120 levels, plus Endless, Daily, Gauntlet and Clay modes.

4721020.name: The Last Ores
4721020.desc: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

5325180.name: Little Pagan Land
5325180.desc: 讓魔法林地恢復生機，讓森林在螢幕底部慢慢長大！收集莓果和錢幣，餵食、輕撫魔法生物。有的白天活動，有的晚上才出現；即使你忙著做別的事，林地裡的生活也不會停下來。

4764420.name: 童話清道夫
4764420.desc: 《童話清道夫》是一款增量型打怪冒險遊戲。核心玩法相當直覺：痛快斬殺怪物、通關任務，賺取滿滿的金幣與素材；並利用這些戰利品來投資龐大的技能樹、鍛造神兵利器、購買藥水，為下一場冒險做好萬全準備！

1593970.name: The Haunted House : Dark Island
1593970.desc: 你的朋友已被黑暗吞噬……現在，你是他們唯一的希望！ 收集並培養你的鬼靈，對抗強大的敵人！

4820800.name: Black Market Dealer
4820800.desc: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

5389120.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
5389120.desc: 一台小巧的 VPet 裝置住在你的桌面上，你每按一次鍵，螢幕裡的像素寵物就會跳一下。邊工作邊賺 Bongo Points，餵點心，開 Bongo Box，蒐集可在 Steam 上交易的稀有 Color 寵物、造型和裝置。

5315120.name: Corrupted Skies
5315120.desc: Command a fractured army against two rival factions in this tactical turn-based card battle. Every unit has a story, every spell has a cost, and only one commander walks away.

4933450.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
4933450.desc: 你被困在一座日本地鐵站的地下深處，在這款 rogue-lite 夾娃娃機卡組構築遊戲中，你必須償還一筆天文數字的債務。

4947930.name: 英雄变美
4947930.desc: 《英雄變美》：美貌就是力量的卡牌肉鴿。招募源自現實歷史與神話的英雄，最多4人同場。每位英雄擁有3張普通牌與2張限定牌，限定牌每場戰鬥各限用一次。每回合3點能量，未使用的手牌於回合結束時棄置。變美後切換形象，全部專屬卡牌同步強化。每位英雄皆有歷史或神話淵源。

4362170.name: Feed The Forest
4362170.desc: 在這款主動型增量遊戲中，利用蝸牛的力量將沙漠化為茂密的森林，再把它的獲利能力增大到瘋狂的境界。用最佳的方式配置植物，使多種資源能夠自動生產。雇用手下、解鎖缺德的植物、賺到多得要命的財富，還要記住：血也是一種果汁。

5051190.name: Collapse Vector
5051190.desc: Pilot an experimental probe through collapsing celestial fields in a fast-paced rage arcade space game. Push deeper into the Transfer Gauntlet, build your probe, chase records, and see how far you can get before the Vector ends your run.

5536780.name: Zero Hero Demo
5536780.desc: Zero hero is an endless roguelike, each wave of enemies and unique combinations. Collect Waboshi to buy new weapons and upgrades outside the game and get further and further in the challenges with the number of kills and waves. Challenge yourself with new weapons, new powers and challenges!

5447020.name: 程式農場 原聲帶
5447020.desc: 盡情享受由 Floris Demandt 製作的《程式農場》原聲帶。無論你是在寫程式、忙著下一個專案，還是只想稍作休息，都能將程式冒險中的音樂隨身帶著走。

5037130.name: The Day I Became a Werewolf
5037130.desc: Your latest scientific research has gone horribly wrong. Fix it before it catches up to you, or face the consequences.

4887440.name: Cooking Carnage
4887440.desc: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !

4521700.name: 程式礦場
4521700.desc: 為你的無人機取得採礦升級！透過程式設計讓它挖掘、探索並開採地下資源。使用一種簡單、類似 Python 的語言，自動化挖掘流程、最佳化採礦路線，並找出深藏於地表之下的珍貴礦物。

2982710.name: Barely Alive
2982710.desc: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

5443280.name: The Arcane Archive
5443280.desc: 走進《The Arcane Archive》的神秘殿堂！在這款舒適的3D解謎遊戲中，你的任務是在古老的書架上整理100多種發光的魔法藥水。在終極放鬆的巫師圖書館中，將混亂化為秩序，盡情放鬆身心。

5046340.name: Hotel 13
5046340.desc: 走廊每次看起來都一模一樣。但真的是這樣嗎？也許有什麼東西已經改變了。仔細觀察你的周遭。

5062340.name: Sort My Comics !
5062340.desc: 漫畫散落得到處都是。現在，該由你來整理這套收藏了！分類、歸位、補全系列，並解鎖各種能力，讓這片巨大的混亂一點一點變得井然有序、令人無比放鬆。

2891370.name: Pieced Together
2891370.desc: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

15100.name: Assassin's Creed™: Director's Cut Edition
15100.desc: Assassin's Creed™ is the next-gen game developed by Ubisoft Montreal that redefines the action genre. While other games claim to be next-gen with impressive graphics and physics, Assassin's Creed merges technology, game design, theme and emotions into a world where you instigate chaos and become a vulnerable, yet powerful, agent of...

2238040.name: 瞎鬧獵車手
2238040.desc: 小泰瑞想要用自己的新車把他送進星辰大海！幹這麼一件又酷又莽的事情肯定能讓他成為全城的焦點明星！在達成這個目標的小小旅程中，通過奔跑、駕駛和滑行來找出那些潛藏的大發現吧！

4740930.name: 守城英雄傳
4740930.desc: 超爽塔防，輕鬆掛機，戰力無限飆升，享受零內購的純粹單機體驗！排兵布陣，防線自動阻擊洶湧怪潮，後台掛機也能積累資源。利用摸魚間隙或碎片時間招募角色、升級塔防，提升你的防線戰力，讓你的城堡從臨時搭建的防線逐步成長為固若金湯的要塞！ P.S. 遊戲支持老闆鍵一鍵隱藏，隨時隨地安心守城！

49520.name: Borderlands 2
49520.desc: The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.

movies.name: Borderlands 2: Game of the Year - Celebration Trailer

323190.name: 冰汽時代
323190.desc: Frostpunk is the first society survival game. As the ruler of the last city on Earth, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

282070.name: This War of Mine
282070.desc: In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

movies.name: This War of Mine: Final Cut trailer

323580.name: Jotun: Valhalla Edition
323580.desc: 《Jotun》是一款以北歐神話為背景的手繪動作探險遊戲。在這款遊戲中，你將扮演維京戰士索菈，她死得毫不光榮，因此必須向眾神證明自己的價值，才能進入英靈殿。打動眾神的心吧！

movies.name: Jotun Launch Trailer - Impress the Gods!

4655130.name: 天堂戀愛王
4655130.desc: 找服裝，與天使談戀愛，建立後宮！ 在天堂戀愛王開啟一場輕鬆的旅程，並建造一個獨一無二的後宮。

4387610.name: Clearance Defence
4387610.desc: Defend the clearance shelf. When the lights go out, the seasonal war begins. Lead your unsold Easter stock against waves of full-price enemies — before morning reveals the secret.

4310350.name: Siren's Call: Second Wind
4310350.desc: A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

movies.name: Siren's Call: Second Wind - The Void Is Getting Bigger

5005480.name: Castellan
5005480.desc: A real-time roguelite castle defense made by a solo developer. Shoot from your castle, drag soldier cards onto the field and cast spells to hold the line. Lose, upgrade, return: 13 chapters, 33 different soldiers, 85 different enemies.

4285270.name: marblebuilds
4285270.desc: 一款充滿創意的彈珠實體沙盒遊戲。在無限網格上放置方塊，搭建你想像中的任何東西：彈珠軌道、計算機、精準的平台跳躍關卡、可玩的小遊戲、彈珠機、等等。

4719710.name: 六艺中文填字
4719710.desc: 经典填字游戏的中文版。《六艺中文填字》是一款以中国古代“君子六艺”为核心框架的纯正中文文字解谜游戏。游戏有丰富的关卡数量、贴心的UI交互和趣味的主题设计，在这里，你可以穿梭于“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗，挑战包罗万象、纵贯古今中外的海量知识点。

4964260.name: Cabin in Time
4964260.desc: Incremental game where you get to continually break an increasing speed of light across many universes in order to make the 100th gear of a googol machine spin

5437500.name: Order, My Lord! Tidy Up the Dungeon
5437500.desc: 你是黑暗領主。英雄們把你的地城翻得亂七八糟，現在它不肯讓你靠近王座，除非你把一切整理好！在這款第一人稱整理模擬器中，將10個房間裡的4,500件物品各歸其位，解鎖魔法能力，再讓哥布林和骷髏替你幹活。

movies.name: Order, My Lord! Trailer 1 Wishlist Now

3383900.name: Frankie Freako
3383900.desc: Smash robots and upgrade your Freako in this freaky Roguelike Action-Platformer

4134760.name: Void Havoc
4134760.desc: In this sci-fi action/strategy game, you're the only trump card left to stop the Contingency in their destructive march. Man your ship, build your arsenal and blow away the waves sent to stop you in your tracks.

5414350.name: Plunder & Booty
5414350.desc: 十六個海盜女王、塞壬、幽靈船長和海軍軍官都想跟你賭。在公海上用牌打敗她們，簽進船員，再往船艙裡倒蘭姆，解鎖96段動畫。一次購買。沒有內購。

4805930.name: Marketfield Idle
4805930.desc: Marketfield Idle 是一款溫馨的增量農場遊戲，種植作物、販售商品、烹調食譜、自動化生產，並透過聲望重置展開更強大的下一輪。內含 1200 多項升級、策略路線與大量協同效果。

4687990.name: VOID PROFIT
4687990.desc: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

5410560.name: MAKAI CITY CHI-BA
5410560.desc: Four high school students and the spirits of Chiba fight monsters that suddenly appear in their hometown. A fantasy RPG where modern Japan meets local legend, built on real Chiba folklore. One developer, ten years. Turn-based, 3-6 hours. Japanese & English.

5194540.name: Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm
5194540.desc: A story-driven retro JRPG where you build a party, explore a fantasy world, fight in classic turn-based battles, complete side quests, craft equipment, and uncover the legacy of the Primal Heir in a handcrafted pixel-art adventure.

movies.name: Primal Heir: The Mortal Realm - Gameplay Trailer

5221880.name: Keepers of the Farkle
5221880.desc: Roll the dice, and challenge the CPU or Freinds in a fast-paced game of risk and strategy. Unlock colorful characters and custom dice, conquer tournaments, and compete with friends in local multiplayer without an internet connection! Will you bank your points? Or risk everything on one more roll?

4314390.name: I Trust You Buddy
4314390.desc: One body. Two players. One controls movement; the other sees the way. Communicate, solve puzzles, and survive dark corridors, shifting mazes, and dangerous platforming challenges. Your next step depends on your buddy.

3832030.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
3832030.desc: 跑得比任何人都快！掌控“矢量大师”，在极限史诗级赛道上驰骋。体验真正的跑酷竞速。磨练你的风格，凭借强劲、迅捷的操控成为最强者。在矢量世界杯中夺得冠军。你够快吗？

4946250.name: Hallow
4946250.desc: In Hallow, your goal is to uncover the mystery behind your father's disappearance and put a stop to the cruel cause.

4857490.name: PlankTap
4857490.desc: 這裡有一隻住在你桌面上的卡通水母。它漂浮在你的視窗之上，你打字它賺錢，然後炒炒海底股票、解鎖更多造型。不會打擾你工作，只負責可愛，就是這樣。

5461240.name: Reticle Range
5461240.desc: Reticle Range is an offline aim trainer with six modes for practicing accuracy, tracking, target switching, and reaction speed. Build training routines, review your results, and track your progress over time. Warm up before playing or focus on beating your personal best.

4835060.name: SoundRoom
4835060.desc: Guess the type of instrument being played.

5478590.name: First Person Basketball
5478590.desc: 第一人稱連線籃球對戰，從1v1單挑到5v5組隊。只用WASD、空白鍵和滑鼠，就能運球突破、傳球配合、投籃與防守。和好友同場競技、挑戰AI，或在自由練習中磨練手感。

5250740.name: 我在乱世当流民 Demo
5250740.desc: 一款以亂世為背景的平民生存模擬遊戲。你可以砍樹、敲石頭、採藥草、務農——但這不是悠閒的農耕遊戲！為了活下去，你必須拼盡全力取得糧食。村民也不是用來刷好感度的，這裡只有利益交換、欺騙與掠奪。為了生存，你會選擇作惡，還是堅守善良？

5074450.name: 万象回廊：元素 Wanxiang Corridor: Elements
5074450.desc: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements is a 2D roguelike action shooter. Wield a bow through procedurally generated corridors, switching between Water and Ice to trigger Freeze and stun your foes. Clear rooms, pick randomized buffs, forge your build across five stages. Pixel art, a fresh run every time.

4687030.name: Ribbit Riot!
4687030.desc: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

4733590.name: 極上人妻在我身邊
4733590.desc: 只要受到邀情，就可以進去。合法進入住戶家中、掌握監視網路──這是你在「帷寓」大樓裡當常駐維護員的特權。眾多住戶中，那位溫婉的寂寞人妻根本就是你的菜，與此同時，這棟大樓的其他女人也紛紛對你展露興趣……

4832630.name: Royale Smith
4832630.desc: Open your shop as a novice blacksmith and raise your reputation all the way to royalty. Assassins, archers, knights, and peasants will visit your shop as customers, demanding common, rare, or legendary swords, axes, daggers, bows, arrows, and various other goods.

5223600.name: De Potrero
5223600.desc: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

397540.name: 邊緣禁地3
397540.desc: 射擊掠寶遊戲的鼻祖回來了，為您帶來數以億計的武器裝備和一段混亂至極的全新冒險旅途！扮演四位全新的尋寶獵人之一，在新世界中橫行霸道並擊敗敵人吧！每一位都擁有頗具深度的技能樹、能力以及自訂選項。您可以單人遊玩或是和好友一同與瘋狂的敵人作戰奪取成堆的戰利品，並從星系最為殘忍的邪教領袖手中拯救家園。

236730.name: Anomaly 2
236730.desc: Anomaly 2 is a sequel to the critically acclaimed Anomaly Warzone Earth. Maintaining the core elements of the original, Anomaly 2 adds plenty of new features: unit morphing, over million tactical combinations, post-apo world and tower defense vs tower offense multiplayer mode.

1067540.name: Röki
1067540.desc: 《洛基》是一款感人至深的冒險遊戲，故事設定在白雪覆蓋的荒原之中。扮演托芙，在未知的世界里，你需要探訪隱藏的傳奇與被遺忘的怪物。解開謎題、收集珍奇物品，並在前往救贖的途中揭露一段關於失去的悲劇故事。

200710.name: Torchlight II
200710.desc: 到 Torchlight II 繼續冒險！這套動作 RPG 充滿史詩級戰鬥，有豐富的寶藏，還有完全隨機的世界。線上與 LAN 多人遊戲模式，邀集朋友一同走上這趟旅程吧。

330020.name: Children of Morta
330020.desc: Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

606150.name: Moonlighter
606150.desc: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

1335230.name: 堇的天空
1335230.desc: 一天的旅程，一生的冒險。《Sumire》是一款魔法敘事冒險遊戲，主題是做出的選擇，以及失去和找到的夢想。在一天結束，天色轉為黃昏之前，踏上神秘的旅程，幫助少女蘇彌爾實現她內心深處的願望。

261640.name: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel
261640.desc: Launch into the Borderlands universe and shoot ‘n’ loot your way through a brand new adventure that rockets you onto Pandora’s moon in Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel!

movies.name: Introduction by Sir Hammerlock & Mister Torgue

1502560.name: 藍精靈：邪惡葉子大作戰
1502560.desc: 踏上冒險旅程，拯救心愛的森林！ 巫師 賈不妙 將魔掌伸向塵封魔術書裡邪惡的植物配方：邪惡毒葉。 這種植物會產生「邪惡毒籠草」種子，吸引並困住藍色小精靈……而且這些 邪惡毒籠草 是有毒植物，對森林，尤其是菝葜田來說也是一大威脅！包含 4 個經典藍色小精靈：小美人、小壯丁、小聰明 和 小廚師 在 5 個不同世界 !

461950.name: Beat Cop
461950.desc: A retro, pixel art style adventure in New York, inspired by ’80s cop shows. You are Jack Kelly and you’ve been framed for murder. Now as a regular beat cop you have to find out, who did that. Expect thick crime story, a lot of black humour and all the other things you can find on the streets of Brooklyn.

294750.name: Anomaly Defenders
294750.desc: Anomaly Defenders is the closing installment of the Anomaly series. The original incarnation of the Tower Offense sub-genre had players controlling humans fighting alien invaders. Now, the tables have turned. The human counterattack is underway and the alien homeworld is under threat.

movies.name: Anomaly Defenders out now on Steam
The Guide to Defending Against Human Invasion Part I

41500.name: Torchlight
41500.desc: 在这款屡获殊荣，由Runic Games呈献的动作RPG游戏中，冒险在等待着你来开启！在这座新兴的城镇深处随机探索，收集战利品，并且获得升级来拯救火炬之光 - 可能的话，你还将拯救世界。

710920.name: Darksiders Genesis
710920.desc: DARKSIDERS: GENESIS gives players their first look at the world of DARKSIDERS before the events of the original game. Furthermore, it introduces the fourth and last horseman STRIFE, as well as Co-op gameplay for the first time in the history of the franchise.

711660.name: 毛線先生 (CHUCHEL)
711660.desc: 《毛線先生（CHUCHEL）》是《機械迷城（Machinarium）》開發者創造的喜劇冒險遊戲。加入遊戲中毛髮茂盛的英雄"毛線先生"的冒險任務，面對許多謎團和挑戰,並獲得寶貴的櫻桃！

787810.name: Rogue Heroes: Ruins of Tasos
787810.desc: 《Rogue Heroes》是具有現代 Rogue-lite 元素的 4 人經典冒險遊戲。玩家可與朋友組隊，勇闖程序化生成的地下城，探索充滿秘密的遼闊世界，並打敗泰坦巨人來取回泰索斯昔日的和平！

589780.name: The Red Strings Club
589780.desc: 紅弦俱樂部是一款關於命運與幸福的賽博朋克風格游戲，需要玩家運用陶藝、調酒和在電話中模仿他人聲音等手段破解一個驚天秘密。

1449320.name: 亞佛列德·希區考克 — 迷魂記
1449320.desc: 你能相信自己的心智嗎？ 走入一種全新類型的心理驚悚世界，玩味幻覺與真實之間的邊界。 自由借鑒亞佛列德·希區考克的創作天地。

1205170.name: Super Magbot
1205170.desc: 一款別出心裁的 2D 平台遊戲。不能跳躍，而是要運用磁力，以速度和技巧跨越每一個關卡。享受經典的 16 位元遊戲氛圍，完成具挑戰性的成就，一路爭奪全球排行榜上的霸主地位。

5077310.name: Darrell 3D
5077310.desc: Darrell 3D is an idle third-person dungeon crawler where you play as the spectator: watch Darrell fight and level up, choose his patches and loadout, send him back down, rescue dogs, witness bizarre FMVs, DMs, and events, and watch him fight his way through the dungeon to break free from his prison.

4179280.name: Moonshiner Simulator
4179280.desc: 這是一款深度模擬釀造酒精飲料的遊戲。從零開始，將您的事業發展成繁榮帝國，精通釀酒工藝的奧秘，創造獨特配方。但請記住：總有人想阻撓您的成功之路。

1892100.name: 修羅的殺陣
1892100.desc: 《修羅的殺陣》是一款日式風格的快節奏砍殺平台遊戲。遊戲中你化身為一位半人半狐的“忍狐”，踏上尋找失踪姊姊的復仇之旅，遊戲強調快速而激烈的戰鬥節奏，挑戰玩家的反應與策略，在激烈的廝殺中化身修羅，斬殺一切擋路者吧！

4978010.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
4978010.desc: 爽快上癮的街機式增量遊戲：用滑鼠操控黑洞，橫掃滿屏彩色方塊，越吞越大！每顆方塊都變成經驗值和金幣：局內猛長，局外把錢全砸進永久升級樹。再吞幾本魔法書，讓磁吸、複製與方塊雨把畫面攪成繽紛大亂鬥。倒數歸零？再來一局！

4134310.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil
4134310.desc: A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons. Elham’s search pulls her through visions and entities rooted in Arabian folklore, and family secrets that should have stayed buried.

2443590.name: Diecast
2443590.desc: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

5336550.name: Hivetide
5336550.desc: Hold a mining outpost on an alien world while thousands of insects pour through the rock tunnels like a flood. Place towers on the high ground, aim their firing arcs, and spend the biomass from every run, won or lost, on upgrades that let you hold a little longer next time.

4312860.name: BOOTH BUTCHER
4312860.desc: No backup. No easy way out. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the shift from hell in this retro slasher horror experience. Uncover the theater's dark secrets and survive the night, or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

5015420.name: RIA 26
5015420.desc: Enter the storm-covered desert arena of RIA 26 and fight to be the last buggy standing. Battle rival drivers with cannons, rockets, mortars and mines, collect weapons, and master the terrain. Complete Wasteland Contracts, earn XP, level up your career, and Play solo or over LAN.

1779750.name: The House Before
1779750.desc: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

5265910.name: 永恆電路板
5265910.desc: 在6×6的棋盤上放置晶片，組成迴路來產生能量的益智遊戲。完成的迴路會留在棋盤上，每回合產生能量，還能用於下一個迴路。在有限的回合內連接迴路，挑戰目標分數吧。

3645540.name: HAVKER-MAN X
3645540.desc: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

5110170.desc: 50/50/50 is a competitive Bo5 Rock Paper Scissors game with a mind game twist as you can identify players patterns by interpretating their moves history.

5210500.name: No Scope CEO
5210500.desc: 《No Scope CEO》是一款 FPS 電競戰隊經營遊戲：白手起家，只為一個目標——世界第一。簽下並培養隊員，管好預算與贊助，承擔每個選擇的後果，然後在比賽中看著自己的決定成真。

5064010.name: The Secret Society
5064010.desc: Uncover hidden objects, solve clever puzzles, and explore magical worlds as you investigate your uncle’s mysterious disappearance!

movies.name: The Secret Society: Hidden Object Adventure

5432220.name: 耕读传家
5432220.desc: A family simulation set in China, 1500–1850, in the canal and rice country around Suzhou: land, exams, shops, courts, lineage feuds, combat. Your family may live through the late Ming, the Manchu conquest and the Opium War — or it may not. It does not have to be honest.

5123700.name: TRACE//5
5123700.desc: 一款短篇心理恐怖遊戲。你將在陷入黑暗的辦公室裡，僅憑一台相機探索，拍攝並回報靈體留下的痕跡。交替使用閃光燈與夜視功能找出異常——但並非所有異常都是「應該拍下的東西」。

4995480.name: Desktop Pet Aquarium
4995480.desc: 這是一款放置在電腦桌面上的療癒系小水族館。 看著寵物在水中悠閒悠游，聆聽溫和的泡泡聲與水下音效，為你營造一片寧靜的時間。 這裡沒有倒數計時，沒有勝負，也沒有每日必做的任務。它只是在你工作、學習或看影片時，安靜陪在螢幕一角的小小水族館。 此外，還內建了計時器、提醒事項與待辦/備忘錄等實用小工具，需要時即可隨時使用。

4556080.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
4556080.desc: A first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ). No AI.

4621810.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
4621810.desc: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

4589160.name: Aptamirror
4589160.desc: Aptamirror is a meditative physics-based puzzle game inspired by molecular biology. Manipulate RNA strands by grabbing, mutating, cleaving, and ligating to match increasingly complex target structures. Challenge yourself with 50 handcrafted puzzles designed by a PhD Biochemist. Think. Fold. Repeat.

4844510.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
4844510.desc: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

4459220.name: Agile Team
4459220.desc: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner. Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

5465890.name: Just Hearts
5465890.desc: Familiar Hearts at a quiet green felt table. Pass three cards, avoid the queen of spades, or shoot the moon. Play offline against three computer opponents with traditional cards, a pace you choose, and a clear view of every trick.

5122860.name: Broken Rift: Dominion
5122860.desc: Lead a fractured human frontier in a 4X strategy game powered by a fully offline, locally embedded LLM. Build colonies, design warships and tanks, command tactical battles, and face rival empires that plan, remember, negotiate, and wage war without relying on the cloud.

5147670.name: Rolling Fortress
5147670.desc: Command a colossal mobile fortress through a 10-sector post-apocalyptic campaign. Aim its cutting laser, manage automated heavy weapons, intercept enemy salvos, salvage scrap, and build a devastating arsenal between escalating waves.

5210430.name: Break the Piñatas
5210430.desc: 一款以打碎1000個皮納塔為目標的放置類遊戲!賺取糖果,購買升級,解鎖獨特技能,成為最強者。那麼,我們要在最後一個皮納塔前停下嗎?

4431860.name: Hex Seculum
4431860.desc: Explore a perilous hex map, delve into tense dungeons where time and torchlight run out, and fight turn-based battles where distance and positioning decide survival. Plan your expedition, manage supplies, and escape with treasure.

5094370.name: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas
5094370.desc: 揚帆出航，在 Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas 中尋找無盡財富吧。駕馭浪濤、爭奪失落的寶藏，成為海上之王。內含全新居住地、全新型態、4 本新魔法書、野生動物以及全新貿易文化。

3891470.name: Construction Store Simulator
3891470.desc: Build and run your own construction supply store from the ground up! Arrange products, keep shelves stocked, serve customers, manage employees, set prices and expand your store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving business and make your store the go-to place for builders!

1771360.name: Gerda: A Flame in Winter
1771360.desc: You have five days to save your husband, who has just been arrested by the Gestapo. Investigate, explore and form allegiances in this story-rich RPG-lite. Who will you trust?

212030.name: Kung Fu Strike - The Warrior's Rise
212030.desc: Taking its inspiration from ancient Chinese tales of revenge and retribution and then adding a dash of over-the-top martial arts and old school arcade fun, Kung Fu Strike features 28 stages of fast-paced combo-based fighting.

compare.en: Kung Fu Strike: The Warrior's Rise

984800.name: Automachef
984800.desc: 欢迎使用 Automachef，这是一个资源管理益智游戏，您可以在这里设计厨房、编程机器并尽情发挥自己的才能！现在，是时候设计未来的厨房了

682990.name: Drug Dealer Simulator
682990.desc: 您有沒有想過創造自己的犯罪帝國，而不需承擔法律和道德上的後果呢？模擬它！ 在這款 OG 毒品交易遊戲中，爬進街頭生意的黑暗小巷，賺大錢！合作模式續作 - DDS2 - 即將推出。

1293460.name: 諸神灰燼：抉擇
1293460.desc: 在不斷變化的戰鬥中解決戰術難題，並克服始終對你不利的情況。保衛你的指揮官，贏得決鬥，佔領據點，嘗試不同策略以擊敗更強大的敵人，並做出影響你故事的決策。

456670.name: Hand of Fate 2
456670.desc: 一位新的英雄前來挑戰「命運之手2」的莊家了！通過無數百玩不厭的任務，征服這款虛擬桌面遊戲吧！解鎖新的卡牌，寫下你自己的冒險之旅，然後在殘酷的實時戰鬥中擊敗你的敵人吧！

266510.name: Hand of Fate
266510.desc: Deckbuilding comes to life in Hand of Fate! An infinitely replayable series of quests - earn new cards, build your deck, then try to defeat it! In a cabin at the end of the world, the game of life and death is played. Draw your cards, play your hand, and discover your fate.

1410640.name: Syberia: The World Before
1410640.desc: 踏上一段聯接不同大陸與時代的旅程，重新組合人生的拼盤。

movies.name: Trailer Syberia : The World Before - Août 2021

926580.name: Broken Lines
926580.desc: 《Broken Lines》是一款以第二次世界大戰野史為背景，並由故事情節推動的戰術 RPG 遊戲。遊戲的主角為在敵方防線後方緊急降落的八名士兵。您要率領他們回家，同時抵禦敵人的圍追堵截，並幫助他們應對戰爭所帶來的恐懼。

210770.name: Sanctum 2
210770.desc: Sanctum 2 is the sequel to the world’s first Tower Defense/FPS hybrid game. Pick from four unique character classes and embark on a mission to protect the oxygen-producing Cores from hordes of deadly aliens who are threatened by their existence.

1154810.name: Going Under
1154810.desc: 《Going Under》是一個諷刺意味的地城探險遊戲，探索失敗科技創業公司被詛咒的遺跡。作為反烏托邦城市尼奧卡斯卡迪亞的一位無薪實習生，你將手握辦公垃圾作為武器，穿行於企業園地下標新立異的程序性地城。

853050.name: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale
853050.desc: 《El Hijo》是一款令人興奮的通心粉西部片風格（Spaghetti-Western）潛行遊戲，玩家將引導一名 6 歲小男孩踏上尋找母親的旅程。

movies.name: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale - Trailer
El Hijo - A Wild West Tale // Release Trailer

compare.en: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale

1138850.name: Heavenly Bodies
1138850.desc: 用二十世紀七十年代太空人的雙手和手臂進行推動、拉動和扭轉，穿越一系列愈加危險的物理模擬星空場景 – 不過在失重狀態下，一切都不是靜止、固定的，任何事都不簡單。

1286680.name: 小蒂娜的奇幻樂園
1286680.desc: 展開異想天開、驚奇萬分、滿是強大武器的史詩冒險！骰出屬於自己的多重職業英雄，踏上阻止巨龍領主的任務旅程，盡情掠奪、射擊、砍殺與施法。

movies.name: Gameplay Trailer noNLE - EN - No rating

606280.name: Darksiders III
606280.desc: Return to an apocalyptic Earth in Darksiders III, a hack-n-slash Action Adventure where players assume the role of FURY in her quest to hunt down and dispose of the Seven Deadly Sins. The most enigmatic of the Four Horsemen, FURY must bring balance to the forces that now ravage Earth.

1000010.name: Crown Trick / 不思议的皇冠
1000010.desc: 《不思議的皇冠》是一款策略回合Rogue類RPG游戲。游戲用純手繪的美術風格開啟一段耐玩有趣的奇妙冒險——探索多種風格的地下城，挑戰充滿危險的敵人與BOSS，經歷死亡與成長的輪回，對抗無盡深淵。

2111090.name: 揭謎而起!
