2111090.desc: 《Let’s! Revolution!》是一款配色鮮明的 Roguelite 兼解謎遊戲，你必須阻止一個自戀的國王毀掉自己的世界。翻開磚格揭開隱藏道路，一步一步逼近國王。善用推理避開國王的爪牙，或是透過回合制策略戰鬥打倒所有敵人。

1003890.name: Blacksad: Under the Skin
1003890.desc: 充滿魅力的偵探 John Blacksad 深入紐約市黑社會核心，揭開黑暗腐敗的醜聞內幕

movies.name: BLACKSAD: Under the Skin - Launch Trailer
BLACKSAD: Under the Skin - Story Trailer

369990.name: Gremlins, Inc.
369990.desc: This is an intense strategy board game in a steampunk world of corrupt capitalist gremlins who compete for money, political power and prestige. Save and invest, steal and extort, arrest and get arrested – in single-player and multiplayer, with ranks and ladders, team mode and spectator mode.

1091870.name: 兩個世界的過客
1091870.desc: 恐龍橫行、敵對部落來襲，天外來客墜入史前世界，你將與意外夥伴踏上一場拯救族人的像素冒險！ 點擊探索叢林與遺跡，觀察環境、智取猛獸、破解機關，在危機中尋找線索，揭開這片土地隱藏的秘密！

617290.name: Remnant: From the Ashes
617290.desc: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.

1966420.name: Harmony: The Fall of Reverie
1966420.desc: The fate of humanity is at stake. Use your gift of clairvoyance to see into the future and stop an apocalypse that threatens the balance between your world and the deities'.

278360.name: A Story About My Uncle
278360.desc: A Story About My Uncle is a first person platforming adventure game about a boy who searches for his lost uncle, and ends up in a world he couldn’t imagine existed. The movement is a crucial part of the games core gameplay – focusing on swinging through the world with a grappling hook that gives the player a wonderful sense of speed and...

movies.name: A Story About My Uncle - Official Gameplay Trailer
A Story About My Uncle - Teaser Trailer

253150.name: Halfway
253150.desc: Halfway is a turn-based strategy RPG taking place a few hundred years into the future. Humanity has started colonising new worlds. Until now, they were alone ...

2602020.name: The Smurfs – Dreams
2602020.desc: 藍精靈村莊的命運取決於您的夢境：踏上奇妙旅程，拯救瀕危村莊！

3265290.name: Swan Song
3265290.desc: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

1069530.name: Narita Boy
1069530.desc: 在《Narita Boy》中奏出交響樂！這是一場激進的動作冒險，一位傳奇的像素英雄受困 Digital Kingdom 境內，化為區區一道回音。探索 Techno-sword 背後隱藏的祕密，拔劍對抗腐化污穢的惡勢力「Stallions」。拯救世界！

1226670.name: Rosewater
1226670.desc: A thrilling Western adventure in the alternate 19th century world of Lamplight City! Embark on a harrowing journey across the frontier with Harley Leger and her ragtag posse, encountering bandits, rebels, visionaries, eccentrics, and many more friends and foes on your quest for fame and riches.

1311070.name: Greak: Memories of Azur
1311070.desc: 《Greak: Memories of Azur》是單人解謎平台冒險遊戲。Azur受到敵人侵略威脅，他們手上控制著感染土地的奇怪生物。玩家要扮演三兄妹：Greak、Adara和Raydel，利用他們的獨特能力一起從敵人侵略中逃出生天。

1162280.name: Eternal Hope
1162280.desc: 《Eternal Hope》是一款解謎平臺遊戲，跟隨一個必須展開一段有關愛與希望的旅程的男孩提比，幫他找到自己摯愛之人的靈魂。

1717020.name: Ed-0: Zombie Uprising
1717020.desc: “大江戶×喪屍×Rogue-like”傳統日本角色（武士、相撲選手和忍者）摧毀成群殭屍的類流氓動作。 由於一切都是隨機生成的，因此沒有運行是相同的。 決策是必不可少的，但也有一些 RPG 元素。

movies.name: Ed-0: Zombie Uprising Launch Trailer WW
Ed-0: Zombie Uprising Pre-order Announcement Trailer WW

2304440.name: 生靈之境：亞娃
2304440.desc: 身懷同情之心體驗一款以拯救生物為主題、緊張刺激的動作冒險遊戲，瞭解並馴服亞娃的生物，讓牠們引領你穿越多樣生態系統——只為從一場吞噬眾多生命的傳染病中拯救這個星球。

3653040.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - Blue Archive PACK
3653040.desc: DJMAX RESPECT V - Blue Archive PACK! Now enjoy the songs of Blue Archive in DJMAX RESPECT V.

3424250.name: 餓殍：明末千裏行-藝術設定集
3424250.desc: 本書是遊戲《餓殍：明末千裏行》的藝術設定集，需要在 Steam 上擁有基礎遊戲 餓殍：明末千裏行 才能暢玩。

1398770.name: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition - Digital Artbook
1398770.desc: This artbook chronicles the artistic journey of Spiritfarer® the cozy management game about dying, of our small team of artists and how we ended up making what became Thunder Lotus’ most ambitious game ever. Now includes artwork from the heartwarming base game and its three major content updates!

3008130.name: Dying Light: The Beast
3008130.desc: 你是凱爾·克蘭，多年來遭受了各種慘無人道的實驗，被改造成一個半人半獸的怪物。在開放世界和恐怖動作生存結合的獨特遊戲體驗裡，追殺把你變成這個樣子的罪魁禍首。

dlc.name: Dying Light: The Beast - Castor Woods Prepper Bundle
Dying Light: The Beast - Wallpaper Pack
Dying Light: The Beast - Castor Woods Tourist Map
Dying Light: The Beast - Official Soundtrack
Dying Light: The Beast Definitive Upgrade
Dying Light: The Beast Standard to Deluxe Upgrade
Dying Light: The Beast - Discharge Weapon Pack
Dying Light: The Beast - Fire Lotus Weapon Pack

2320980.name: Loftia
2320980.desc: 歡迎來到「Loftia」！在這款溫馨的多人互動遊戲中，你可以打造一個更美好、更永續的未來。帶上新老朋友們，一起來種植、做手工藝、四處探索、裝飾房屋、為世界帶來充滿意義的影響吧！

5266240.name: Potato Please
5266240.desc: 一款第一人稱削馬鈴薯遊戲。你有一把刀。你有一個桶。你有一座馬鈴薯山。用真實物理削皮。削薄一點，不要浪費。購買更好的工具。一直削到馬鈴薯山消失。沒人削得像你一樣好。

2909400.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
2909400.desc: 克勞德一行人脫離魔晄都市米德加，踏進廣袤的世界展開旅程。 本作有全新的故事、在廣闊世界中的自由冒險以及增進與夥伴間情誼的戰鬥， 帶來繼《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》之後更加進化的遊戲體驗。

dlc.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Original Soundtrack Plus
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH ACOUSTIC ARRANGEMENTS
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Orchestra World Tour LIVE 2024.09.08
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Orchestral Arrangement Album
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Original Soundtrack
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade

3793800.name: Pulse Drive
3793800.desc: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

3994790.name: DJ Life Simulator: Learn to DJ for Real
3994790.desc: 使用 USB DJ 控制器或滑鼠鍵盤，真正學會 DJ 混音。透過 26 堂互動課程掌握對拍、EQ 和效果器，從家庭派對一路登上音樂祭舞台，現場觀眾會對你的每一次混音做出反應。

compare.en: DJ Life Simulator: Learn to DJ for Real

5056410.name: The Pass
5056410.desc: A clicker "game" that is also a meta commentary and parody about you purchasing it for yourself or your friends. Get Achievements, show them on your user profile. Laugh and see just how regarded you and your friends are.

3194960.name: Distant Trails
3194960.desc: Explore open forest, steep mountains and muddy singletrack in this easy-paced outdoor adventure. Take a crew of trail runners out to remote locations to repair damage, protect nature and investigate unexpected events with only their feet for transport and a backpack to carry supplies.

3529090.name: Astra Bestiary
3529090.desc: 在這款2D怪獸/養成RPG中，從蛋中孵化你的奇獸，培養成強大的戰鬥夥伴。透過餵養與訓練，進化你的奇獸，探索危機四伏的多路線世界。掌握快節奏的策略戰鬥，揭開世界逐漸衰敗的秘密，傳承奇獸的榮耀。

4380090.name: HELLO HACKER - Project Daybreak
4380090.desc: A story-rich hacking sim played inside a real Linux desktop. Recon networks, break web apps, crack crypto, and extract hidden data with tools that behave like the real thing, while an autonomous AI watches the network, learns, and hacks back. The commands are real. So are the consequences.

5029430.name: Empty House
5029430.desc: 最多4人的線上合作恐怖生存遊戲。模仿殭屍，騙過牠們的眼睛，穿梭於空屋之間，回收疫苗並返回據點。殭屍認不出模仿牠們的人類。別逃跑，大膽地從屍群中間走過去。但別掉以輕心，各種殭屍仍會威脅你的安全。備齊各種裝備，與隊友合作，完成配額。

5243610.name: BugPot
5243610.desc: BugPot 是一款休閒類 Roguelike 遊戲，每次轉動都會改變戰局。配對武器與護符、升級武器、打造強力組合，並針對各種古怪蟲子靈活調整策略。

5430760.name: LASKA: Column checkers
5430760.desc: Laska is a checkers variant where captured pieces are taken prisoner, forming columns. Play against the computer or a friend on the same device, set up your own positions in the editor, play through the story or fight for relics in roguelike mode.

5415860.name: Beach Volleyball VR
5415860.desc: Beach Volleyball VR brings 2v2 beach volleyball to virtual reality. Pass, set, spike, serve and block using natural VR movements, play complete matches against bots, or jump online and play with friends.

5442520.name: Blocade
5442520.desc: Race your pawn across the board and drop walls to cut off your rival, but never seal them in. Blocade is a free two-player strategy board game: ranked matches against real people on PC and mobile, a daily 128-player tournament, puzzles and a ladder of bots.

5361480.name: 塗鴉決鬥
5361480.desc: 把隨手塗鴉變成真正的勇士！《塗鴉決鬥》是一款手繪風格的 2D 動作 RPG：從空白畫布畫出角色，再親手繪製武器、防具與技能，搭配八種元素顏色。讀懂關主的攻擊規律，切換隊伍、利用屬性剋制，在競技塔中連續挑戰並解鎖顏料、材料與配方。管理裝備欄與技能配置，調整每位勇士的戰鬥方式；線上服務可用時，還能挑戰非同步玩家隊伍。你也可以儲存自己的畫作，離線推進核心冒險。每一條線都由你決定，每一場決鬥都屬於你的隊伍。

4688870.name: Purrfect Bliss
4688870.desc: 《Purrfect Bliss》是一家建立在黑暗歷史之上的貓咪咖啡館。你能在夜班中倖存下來嗎？在這款心理恐怖遊戲中，為顧客提供服務，照顧貓咪，並揭開可怕的真相。

5026450.name: 《鬥陣特攻®》：攔路豬完整神話英雄造型組合包
5026450.desc: 獲得完整神話攔路豬英雄造型以及推進 20 個等級！

5176710.name: Be a Pirate!
5176710.desc: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath. Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan. Think, don't just click!

5163190.name: Tumble Tavern
5163190.desc: Farkle with enchanted runes. Throw six dice, bank your points or push your luck, and cast the runestone that turns a losing throw around. Take on 12 tavern regulars, run the roguelite gauntlet, or pass the dice to a friend on the same screen.

4757720.name: The Wake Event
4757720.desc: Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

4608850.name: Aetheris Core
4608850.desc: A fast-paced top-down sci-fi bullet-heaven roguelite where you pilot distinct ships, stack abilities, upgrades, and 50+ relics into screen-clearing builds, then prove your strategy against multi-phase bosses and unstable Rift encounters.

4281480.name: Mandala: Type To Defend
4281480.desc: Type to survive. Defend a glowing mandala against swarms, shooters, and incoming projectiles in a fast-paced typing arcade game. Choose from four attack forms, combine upgrades, unleash devastating chains, and fight through escalating waves.

3053950.name: Dungeon Rampage Remastered
3053950.desc: 在這款支援 1～4 名玩家合作的打殺地牢探索遊戲中，一路披荊斬棘，最終取得勝利。扮演一群活力四射的英雄，在地牢中殺出一條血路，贏取武器和戰利品。橫掃重重敵人和破壞，終結邪惡的\"Dinglepus\"獨裁者的統治！

5199430.name: PLOW
5199430.desc: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

3218230.name: 上古世紀編年史
3218230.desc: 探索奧羅利亞，走進這個廣闊且活力十足的世界，解鎖各種傳說和令人驚嘆的動作。《上古世紀編年史》提供身臨其境的體驗，無論玩家是新手或經驗老道的冒險家，這款遊戲都能擄獲你的心。

5213270.name: 靈田修仙：煉丹模擬器 Demo
5213270.desc: 《靈田修仙：煉丹模擬器》是一款融合國風修仙、增量成長、策略經營、輕度 Rogue 的修仙遊戲。在這裡，你可以執靈瓶，培育一方靈田；或是持靈扇，煉就一爐仙丹。你可以深入迷霧丹圖，尋回失傳殘方；也可以參悟功法，直至破境飛升；還可以結識不同道友，共同經營這方洞府。行至最後，你是會獨自飛升，還是與道友攜手同赴仙界？

5015250.name: Hearts Extreme
5015250.desc: 把經典卡牌遊戲《紅心大戰》重做成了一個人解的謎題。 每一關的目標都不一樣，去精確達成它。 十種構成各異的牌組，可以在四人、五人、六人桌上遊玩。 還有排位賽，與全世界的玩家一較高下。

4946100.name: SIDExLINES
4946100.desc: SIDExLINES is a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder where synergistic side bets and card combos are how you clear rising wagers and survive run-ending pit bosses. Play solo or with friends and try to take down the house.

4553780.name: 晶靈覺醒
4553780.desc: 一款輕量級增量遊戲，透過摧毀浮空水晶、釋放以太來餵養水晶元素精靈。升級技能樹，解鎖新能力以提升收集效率，打造出屬於你的終極水晶夥伴。

1786720.name: Entropic Decay
1786720.desc: After being caught up in a mysterious experiment on an alien pathogen brought to earth on a meteor you gain unexpected abilities, but are now property of an unethical mega corporation hell bent on weaponizing the very thing that's keeping you alive. Survive a world falling into Entropic Decay.....

5319550.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
5319550.desc: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

5062560.name: Pathos
5062560.desc: 《Pathos》是一款致敬復古地牢探索類遊戲的回合制奇幻冒險作品。你可以體驗深度十足、充滿動態變數的玩法，搭配現代風格的畫面、音效與觸控優先的操作界面。你還能對角色進行高度自定義，開啟一場由程序隨機生成的史詩級冒險旅程。

2221490.name: Tom Clancy’s The Division® 2
2221490.desc: 於這款開放世界戰術射擊遊戲，加入國土戰略局。投身激烈的掩體對戰、與好友組隊、打造你的終極特工，拯救華盛頓特區。

5466320.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing
5466320.desc: A co-op arena survivors roguelike for 1–4 players where the leftovers fight back. Pick a food, pick a class and survive 20 waves of germs, mold and expired dairy with a ridiculous loadout of kitchen weapons. Fuse, evolve, synergize — and vote with your friends on what horror to open next.

5500000.name: 罪惡海岸
5500000.desc: 追逐危險的財富，開上夢想中的座駕，走近藏著秘密的女人。《罪惡海岸》是一款以人物插畫、文字選擇與分支故事展開的都市敘事角色扮演遊戲。經營車輛生意、累積人脈、應對槍火，在野心與感情之間，爭取由自己作主的生活。

5000980.name: Gunship Incremental
5000980.desc: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

5416440.name: The Last Debugger
5416440.desc: The Last Debugger is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you collect equipment cards, combine powerful set effects, and plan around card speed and enemy intentions as four distinct characters fight through a broken game world.

4286110.name: 妹调教日记
4286110.desc: ○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

5402790.name: Austin lost in maze
5402790.desc: Guide Austin through a twisting maze, solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and find a way out before the corridors swallow him whole.

3700350.name: 喜歡你
3700350.desc: 正當你要邀請你愛慕的圖書館女孩──汐里約會時的那個瞬間，突然被捲入舞夏、凜、葵這三個壞心眼女孩策畫的新遊戲「告白遊戲」。你是否能抵抗她們的魅力，忠於自己所愛的人呢？

5436750.name: 101 Cats: Copenhagen
5436750.desc: 加入這場冒險，在精心打造的哥本哈根風景中，尋找101隻小貓咪🐾的藏身之處。 🏆贏取眾多成就。你能找到多少隻呢？ 😺快來抓緊時間！ ⏱️

movies.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in Copenhagen - PLAY NOW!

5318810.name: 双修破万法
5318810.desc: An adults-only visual novel rooted in authentic Chinese xianxia. Sects, karma, desire and ritual shape a living cultivation world, while dual cultivation drives its relationships, progression and long-form story.

movies.name: Sex Cultivation: Shatter Every Law — Official Trailer

4877740.name: IT Outage Desk
4877740.desc: Start as a help desk technician and build your way to the top. Resolve tickets, hire staff, automate your department, and survive the increasingly absurd chaos of corporate IT in this humorous incremental clicker.

movies.name: IT Outage Desk - Game Play Trailer

2100410.name: The Last Trophy
2100410.desc: A space explorer receives a strange signal from an unknown planet. What is in this place? Help Mell discover the mysteries of this new land in this retro platformer with an arcade feel.

4999620.name: Banners of Bramble
4999620.desc: Banners of Bramble is a turn-based fantasy tactics game. Lead warriors, archers, lancers and monks, capture castles and villages, and spend your gold wisely. Fight rival kings and the monsters of the Wilds, where shamans turn knights into pigs and fish throw bombs.

5074480.name: Sunday Fighter Pilot
5074480.desc: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

2175160.name: Tirade
2175160.desc: 一款在16張棋桌上同時對弈的放置點擊遊戲。你會下西洋棋嗎？在這裡用不到。

5290910.name: Sump
5290910.desc: 一款短篇巴洛克風氛圍恐怖遊戲。操控拉桿與非自然阴影的迷宮。在唯有下行之處，尋找勇氣。

3889990.name: rest: in a dark room
3889990.desc: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

movies.name: rest: in a dark room trailer

5335160.name: NIGHTWARD
5335160.desc: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

4295520.name: 美少女不想让你死
4295520.desc: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a strategic tower defense game with a strategy board game style. In the game, you continuously recruit pretty girl warriors, establish defensive positions by leveraging advantageous terrain, and defeat waves of enemies.

5245950.name: Main Bastion
5245950.desc: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

4287400.name: The Maiz
4287400.desc: Lost in a living forest maze, armed with little more than a pistol. Hunt for the lost wanderer through ever-shifting paths. Fight off hostile wanderers, gather gems and keys, and unlock ancient doors. Every maze is new, and every run is a fresh path through the trees.

5071520.name: Xenobiome Command
5071520.desc: Build a colony on a fungal alien world and keep it alive. Explore the fog, expand across the map, exploit the land, and exterminate the alien packs before they reach your people. Xenobiome Command goes hard - from planetfall to last stand.

4917630.name: ERLIK
4917630.desc: 植根於突厥神話的類倖存者遊戲。每一局都在兩位神祇之間擺盪，餵養 Erlik 的腐化，換取兇殘力量與吸血；或攀向 Tengri 的聖光，獲得護盾與重生。

5221650.name: Heroes & Co.
5221650.desc: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes, and impossible choices to save the day.

4503110.name: Circuit Pulse
4503110.desc: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

4937060.name: ERLIK Soundtrack
4937060.desc: ERLIK 完整原聲帶：薩滿戰鼓、口簧琴（temir komuz）、呼麥低鳴，以及長夜中步步逼近的恐懼，從月光草原與 Kül-Kurgan 的狂怒，一路深入 Karaorman 的根脈深處。共 32 首，320kbps MP3，附完整專輯封面。

733790.name: Not Tonight
733790.desc: Person of European Heritage #112: Welcome to Relocation Block B, your new home. Your designated role is 'Bouncer'. Work hard, stay out of trouble, and we might let you stay in the UK.

323850.name: Move or Die
323850.desc: Move or Die是一款快節奏的4人單機和多人在線網絡遊戲，遊戲玩法每20秒變換一次。這絕對是一款讓友誼的小船說翻就翻的遊戲。

898650.name: The Shapeshifting Detective
898650.desc: 化身侦探是一个黑暗风格，带超自然元素的悬疑FMV（全动态视频）交互式电影游戏。在此游戏中您扮演一位能够随意变形的侦探，通过变身成为其他角色以寻找解开谜团的钥匙，解锁更多对话场景以及神秘的线索。

844590.name: Hypnospace Outlaw
844590.desc: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village. These virtual streets aren't going to police themselves!

1600370.name: Not Tonight 2
1600370.desc: Immigration Enforcement Case #112: You are under arrest. Unless your friends can cross a broken America, retrieve your identifying documents and stay out of trouble... this is the end of the American dream for you.

1115690.name: Yes, Your Grace
1115690.desc: These are troubling times, Your Grace. The petitioners’ petty matters exceed our limited resources, to say nothing of the war. A careful balance must be struck. Your throne awaits.

270150.name: RUNNING WITH RIFLES
270150.desc: RUNNING WITH RIFLES 是壹個具有開放世界 RPG 元素的俯視角戰術射擊遊戲。 在遊戲中，玩家會和身邊的人壹樣，以壹名普通士兵的身份加入軍隊作戰。

movies.name: RUNNING WITH RIFLES - Steam Launch Trailer

334080.name: 100% Orange Juice - Saki & Kyousuke Character Pack
334080.desc: 100% 鮮橙汁 - Saki 與 Kyousuke 角色包增加了兩名全新的來自開發組“橙汁”的遊戲中的全語音可玩角色：紗季與京介。

376200.name: 100% Orange Juice - Krila & Kae Character Pack
376200.desc: 100% 鮮橙汁 - Krila 與 Kae 角色包增加了兩名全新的來自開發組“橙汁”的遊戲中的全語音可玩角色：玩偶使克里拉拉莉絲與熱血戰士佳愛。

2130530.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - GROOVE COASTER Collaboration DLC
2130530.desc: EZ2ON REBOOT : R's the second collaboration DLC, "GROOVE COASTER" has arrived. Get instant access to 10 songs in total and DLC exclusive panel skins.

2459810.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - FORTRESS Collaboration DLC
2459810.desc: Experience the collaboration DLC of EZ2ON REBOOT : R, 「FORTRESS Collaboration」 It includes a total of 14 new tracks, exclusive theme skins, exclusive panel skins, and exclusive note skins.

1764300.name: Kingdoms and Castles - Parks & Statues
1764300.desc: 為你光榮的王國添點綠色！本 DLC 包括各種尺寸的 15 座公園及 9 座新的雕像。您甚至能在其中一座雕像上刻字！

2688870.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - HARDCORE TANO*C Music Pack Vol.2
2688870.desc: EZ2ON REBOOT : R's second collaboration pack with HARDCORE TANO*C Feel the maximum pleasure once again with specially curated hardcore music!

1267250.name: The Coin Game - Supporter Edition
1267250.desc: This Supporter Edition DLC includes NO ADVANTAGES in the game and only unlocks extra cosmetic items. It will help me to further develop the game and add even more features.

425360.name: 100% Orange Juice - Sham & Sherry Character Pack
425360.desc: 本 100% 鮮橙汁追加角色包包含了兩名全新的來自開發組“橙汁”的遊戲中的可玩角色——開朗的操作員夏姆與奔放的駕駛員雪莉。新角色都帶有完整語音！

3681010.name: 仁王３
3681010.desc: 黑暗戰國動作RPG「仁王」系列第三作。於兼具自由度與緊張氛圍的開放式地圖上，以「武士」與「忍者」兩種風格迎擊各路強大難纏的妖怪。

5079090.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
5079090.desc: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

4540280.name: Sinful Survivors
4540280.desc: 一款類《吸血鬼倖存者》的生存動作遊戲。🎮 包含30+個配音🗣️且動畫✨的場景！💦 😈三位罪孽深重的女主角為了生存而奮力拼搏！🔥指揮魅惑的魅魔💋、母性的史萊姆🟢與虔誠的修女🙏，與從四面八方湧來的龐大軍隊作戰吧！⚔️

3273260.name: Lost Host
3273260.desc: 一輛玩具小車能成為電子遊戲的主角嗎？ 某個夜晚，它的主人神秘失蹤，了無音訊。 被留在寂靜房間的小車，為了尋找那個男孩，踏上一段詭異且動人的旅程……

4427790.name: Total Blade: Mythology
4427790.desc: 率領超過 3,400 名士兵，在橫跨歐洲至日本的廣闊 16 世紀世界中展開史詩般的即時戰爭。征服城鎮、招募傳奇歷史人物，建立屬於你的帝國，展開一場自由無拘的沙盒 RPG 冒險。

4003400.name: Somebody Save Snuffles
4003400.desc: Snuffles the cat has gone missing. Save Snuffles by traversing various perilous 2.5D landscapes, and make sure the final boss gets sploded. You can choose a cosy pathway, or a medium-difficulty pathway, or even attempt the nightmare mode level.

4904200.name: Civitas: World Simulator
4904200.desc: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.

4762960.name: Outbreak: Dead City
4762960.desc: 加入 H.A.D.E.S. 特種部隊，空降至被殭屍佔領的城市，目標是回收珍貴的研究資料、護送重要科學家撤離，甚至可能找到疫苗來終結這場末日浩劫！《Outbreak: Dead City》是一款以電影式敘事的第一人稱射擊遊戲，以低多邊形3D風格呈現。

5105360.name: Fjordal
5105360.desc: 建立一座北歐村莊，加工這片土地的資源。向國王進貢，或是變得強大到足以反擊。一款維京殖民模擬遊戲，擁有完整的生產鏈與資源管理。

1868410.name: Movie Night
1868410.desc: Movie Night is a casual online multiplayer game giving players the ability to create their own virtual cinema to watch youtube with their friends in sync.

5412340.name: Orbit Reminders
5412340.desc: Close the window & the reminder still lands. Orbit keeps your tasks, habits & ideas on your own devices, encrypted, so you never forget. One purchase covers your PC, your laptop & your phone, on Windows, Linux & Android. No account.

4414460.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
4414460.desc: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

5459170.name: Bustbound
5459170.desc: 《Bustbound》是一款以二十一點為靈感的 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲。在回合制戰鬥中選擇要牌、停牌或加倍，利用效果卡牌與遺物打造自己的組合。探索六大關卡的分岔路線，在戰鬥、事件、商店與休息點之間做出選擇，為下一位首領做好準備。透過勝利贏得成就籌碼，解鎖永久強化、新角色與起始牌組，再以不同策略挑戰小丑夫妻。每一張牌都可能改變戰局：繼續抽牌爭取更強的手牌，還是及時停手避免爆牌？讀懂局勢、衡量風險，讓每場勝利成為下一次冒險的力量。

4811700.name: Mancalero
4811700.desc: Plan one perfect move and watch it chain into millions of points. Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, the board game of moving stones from pit to pit. Collect marbles that burn, multiply and swallow whole pits, build a combo engine and climb 8 tables, each with a boss that changes the rules.

movies.name: Mancalero v1.02 Demo Trailer - October NextFest

5030500.name: Slammer Soccer: Football Management
5030500.desc: Manage a prison football team, trade inmates, develop your squad, survive prison politics, and lead your team from the yard to glory.

4996220.name: Dunjin
4996220.desc: Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

5233410.name: Wildixir
5233410.desc: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

5183430.name: Artifact Tracer
5183430.desc: 每一件文物，都是一道來自歷史的謎題。《文物尋蹤》是一款中國文物視覺推理遊戲。觀察器形、紋飾與工藝，在地圖與時間軸上追尋答案，挑戰 1,000+ 件真實文物，解鎖館藏檔案，並在每日挑戰中與其他玩家競逐排名。

5130070.name: Wonderful Time 燦爛時光
5130070.desc: 在這款第三人稱視角的解謎遊戲中，操控時間來控制物體的移動。利用時間的流動，到達原本無法抵達的地方。等待著你的，是你所尋找的獎勵。

5466190.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay - Supporter Pack
5466190.desc: Support the dev team of Horses of Hoofprint Bay! This Supporter Pack DLC contains a digital art book, coloring pages and grants you an exclusive Discord role, for anyone who wants to further support the dev team on top of their game purchase!

5205270.name: Knight's Party
5205270.desc: Knight's Party 是一系列致命又混亂的錦標賽。人人都想成為騎士，卻根本沒人知道自己在幹什麼。和朋友一起開砲、倒酒、爭奪王冠，再順便丟掉幾條手腳。想活下來，可沒那麼容易。

3727090.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
3727090.desc: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!

4088720.name: Pogo Together
4088720.desc: 一起跳、一起摔、一起崩潰、一起往上爬。Pogo Together 是一款支援 1-4 名玩家的物理精準平台遊戲，一群肌肉誇張的動物將踩著彈簧高蹺挑戰殘酷的障礙。互相幫忙、把朋友一腳踹下去，或獨自面對這場攀登。

4334530.name: Cold Rails
4334530.desc: 《Cold Rails》是一款以列車為背景的恐怖冒險遊戲。你將扮演酒保，為乘客提供飲品，並在穿著洋裝的神祕女子徘徊於列車之際，逐步揭開背後的故事。

4358660.name: Hull Rupture
4358660.desc: 船艦停擺之時，即是人類滅亡之日。 在這款結合了基地管理與塔防要素的輕度 Rogue 遊戲中，你將掌管一艘太空船，把渺小的人類視為耗材，並抵禦外星生物無情的猛攻。你會發現，每一個導致滅團的決定，在當下看起來都是那麼地合情合理……

3509080.name: Forged: Reconquest 鍛造：收復
3509080.desc: 《Forged: Reconquest》是一款支援最多4人本地與線上合作的鍛造題材RTS遊戲。化身鍛造大師，打造強大的魔法裝備，武裝軍隊，迎戰來自異界的侵略者，奪回失落的世界。

3603900.name: Drunkonauts
3603900.desc: Drunkonauts is a chaotic multiplayer party game with hilarious physics-based combat, crazy weapons and JETPACKS! Battle friends in local or online matches, use unpredictable movement and wacky attacks to send opponents flying, stay on the map, avoid dangerous hazards and claim victory!

4687440.name: Project President
4687440.desc: Run a country under pressure. Pass laws, negotiate Congress, survive scandals, control the media, face protests and win elections in a deep political strategy sim where every decision has consequences.

914890.name: 猫城谜案
914890.desc: 伸展双腿，清洁胡须，然后沉浸到《猫城谜案》的故事中来。还请体验这款传统的“指向-点击”游戏。这里处处充满着幽默感，亦不乏疯狂的角色和引人入胜的好去处。解决富有挑战性的谜题，才能回答一个长久以来就已存在的问题：要舔舐多少物品，才能解决一桩谋杀案？

2615540.name: VOID/BREAKER
2615540.desc: 令人血脈噴張的Roguelite第一人稱射擊遊戲 🔴 對抗敵對AI所駕馭的無情機器。 逃離無止盡的循環。 深度槍枝改造，打造出無極限的變種武器。 鍛造致命的協同作用。 破壞環境以開闢生路 /打破系統 /打破循環 /打破束縛

1677110.name: Lightyear Frontier
1677110.desc: 體驗輕鬆愜意的開放世界農耕遊戲，讓機甲為你一肩扛起粗重活。建造理想中的農場，將日常照料交給自動化系統。調校機甲、清理整片森林、耕耘廣大田地，或與最多三位好友一起放鬆，欣賞日落美景。

1619520.name: 縱橫命途
1619520.desc: 縱橫命途是一款風格獨特的RPG卡組構築遊戲，以快節奏的策略戰鬥為特色，可收集大量的卡牌並且發揮協同作用。在內容豐富的Roguelite模式和令人耳目一新的交錯式的冒險中帶來該類型的精華。探索、升級、製作新的卡牌並構築出完美的牌組，開闢自己的勝利之路！

movies.name: Cross Blitz | V1.0 Launch Trailer | TCH
Cross Blitz | V1.0 Release Date Trailer | TCH

4938300.name: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
4938300.desc: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

5433310.name: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing
5433310.desc: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing creates a fantasy world of greyhound racing. Buy, name and enjoy your own record breaking champion. Select between pups to buy, trainers, and optionally gamble away your fortune. Achieve cup wins, track records and top the asset value list.

2265280.name: Kill King 2D
2265280.desc: 《Kill King 2D》是一款黑暗奇幻風格的1v1策略自走棋。祕密排好命令、消耗行動點，然後看著你的棋子自行執行計畫。進化你的軍隊，比對手預判得更準，斬殺敵方國王。

5460640.name: Rockhound Hollow
5460640.desc: Dig at 24 real rockhounding sites, crack open geodes, run a real 4-step rock tumbler and fill your Rock Journal from a cozy pixel-art cabin with Pebble the cat. A relaxing collecting game where every site, tool and fact comes from real rockhounding.

4347370.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
4347370.desc: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

movies.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany - Announcement Teaser Trailer

5371500.name: Cats Here
5371500.desc: 😺 在色彩繽紛的風景中發現 100 多隻隱藏的貓咪🐾。 🏆 贏取大量成就。你能找到多少隻貓咪🐈呢？ 🔎 快行動吧！ ⏱️

4962500.name: Dread Rune
4962500.desc: A roguelike RPG inspired by Pixel Dungeon. Choose from 12 heroes, explore ever-changing dungeons, and master 130+ items that wear down with use. Every run is a test of combat skill, strategy, and knowing when to use what you've got.

5366060.name: A Personal Winter
5366060.desc: A short visual novel about a boy and his senpai spending a night together in a snow-covered city.

4269100.name: What'Sub
4269100.desc: What'Sub is a 1–4+ player Co-op Extraction "Looter". Band together as a crew of rugged submarine pirates, on a deep-sea quest for power and glory! Loot the ocean for treasure, fulfill requests for the odd denizens of the Subyard, upgrade your submarine, and above all, dive deeper into The Well.

4677370.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining
4677370.desc: Just Keep Defending And Mining是一款獨特的增量遊戲，結合了戰鬥與資源收集。平衡採礦與生存，投資升級，每一輪變得更強，解鎖新區域，並繼續Just Keep Defending and Mining。

movies.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Official Launch Trailer
Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo Trailer

dlc.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo

5243280.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
5243280.desc: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

dlc.name: A Game About Picking Fruits Demo

4513920.name: Axomorph Idle
4513920.desc: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

4832510.name: Trolley Dilemma
4832510.desc: 直面無解的兩難，結識一群怪咖，看每一次切換軌道如何改寫整個故事。電車永不停歇，你的選擇將決定你信任誰、背叛誰——以及你會不會變成那個你從沒想過要成為的人。

4710800.name: Endless Void: Idle Tower Defence
4710800.desc: Shoot. Upgrade. Die. Repeat. Defend against endless swarms in this minimalist idle tower defense. Construct an impenetrable fortress, research game-breaking tech, craft legendary gear, and harness cosmic abilities like Black Holes and Orbital Strikes. How deep into the Void can you survive?

movies.name: Endless Void Idle Tower Defence - Trailer

5234980.name: Wickwood
5234980.desc: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

4280450.name: Diskette Dungeon
4280450.desc: 一張神奇的軟碟會在你的辦公室打開一個門戶，將你帶入無盡的地牢，在那裡生存取決於適應、戰鬥和收集損壞的數據以解鎖下一個世界。擁有各種各樣的力量和武器，每次奔跑都會帶來不同的挑戰。

4916010.name: Shorted
4916010.desc: Balatro 式計分，在 9×9 網格上展開。你的牌組就是棋盤：將同色 Packet 連成得分形狀，安裝改寫規則的 Patch，並重構填滿網格的牌組。六道 Firewall 橫亙在你與爆表高分之間。

5091900.name: Prigod Idle
5091900.desc: 一款擁有數百小時內容的增量自動戰鬥遊戲。搭配不同的構築，挑戰敵人各不相同的100個關卡，資源則會自動累積。打不贏首領？換個構築，試試新招！38位英雄、99件遺物、22個小遊戲和4棵天賦樹。

4678050.name: Emotional Labor Laboratory
4678050.desc: Dive into virtual world and play emotions alongside your quirky, beautiful boss. A unique kind of 'Emotional Labor' begins, blending sweet chemistry with electrifying rhythm action.

3138400.name: IDOLZ
3138400.desc: Fight dirty, roast harder. IDOLZ is an online 1v1 fighting comedy where insults power your special attacks. Humiliate your rivals, charge your Flow and unleash absurd abilities to become the king of chaos.

4434580.name: Dust & Diamonds
4434580.desc: Head down to the mine and get away from it all. A calm pixel-art game: dig for gold and diamonds, rebuild a settlement at the edge of the desert, hire Workers and run a Shop that earns while you're underground. One more tunnel. Five more minutes.

3581230.name: Cozy Game Restoration
3581230.desc: 《時光電玩修復師》是一款風格靜謐的模擬遊戲。在這裡，你將親手喚醒那些被遺忘的懷舊卡匣。撕開包裝、撕掉舊標籤、刷掉厚厚的灰塵，將沾滿歲月痕跡的廢鐵，變回閃閃發光的收藏品。這裡沒有壓力、沒有失敗，只有重拾童年回憶的純粹喜悅。

5490650.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay Soundtrack
5490650.desc: The official soundtrack to Horses of Hoofprint Bay - original music composed and produced by Michal Sinka.

5211940.name: 九州
5211940.desc: "The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

3779560.name: 蒼藍魔導士露娜　～天才魔導士與傳奇魔導士～
3779560.desc: 來幫助露娜結成反抗軍，打倒黑魔女露西亞，解放暴政下的飄浮之國朱彼特諾吧！

5411580.name: Block Guy
5411580.desc: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

5194660.name: Caesar: The Gallic Campaign
5194660.desc: 58 BC. You are a nameless ranker of Rome's Tenth Legion, crossing eight years of Caesar's Gallic campaign at spear height. No turns: one click is your movement and your strike. Build out of affixes and runes, hunt the titled elites, and see eight chapters through to the epilogue.

1001800.name: KUNAI
1001800.desc: 一場大災難破壞了世界的平衡。邪惡的A.I. Lemonkus幾乎消滅了所有人類生命。機器人在地球上四處肆虐。操控Tabby，一個注入了上古戰士靈魂的殺手機器人。

373970.name: Letter Quest: Grimm's Journey Remastered
373970.desc: The grim reapers Grimm and Rose need your help to defeat a legion of monsters, ghosts, and evil bunnies using the power of words! Letter Quest Remastered is the remake of the Bacon Bandits' first game, now with an endless mode, new soundtrack, and fully animated monsters!

2991310.name: 夢幻櫻樓閣
2991310.desc: 磨利刀鋒，踏入櫻花飛舞的永恆迷宮──「夢幻櫻樓閣」吧！這裡是無法安息的怪物四處徘徊的夢幻迷宮。在不斷變化的領域中殺出重圍，以獎勵道具強化自己！以華麗的戰鬥與機智策略挑戰「高難度內容」的 Roguelite 3D 動作遊戲！

5348470.name: CrossVeil
5348470.desc: A card battler across four painted worlds. Hire guardians in the Exchange, build a deck for each world and battle through lantern-lit swamps, a neon arcade city, a crooked carnival and storm-torn sky islands. Every guardian brings its own ability to the fight.

5279240.name: FarmLife
5279240.desc: Build a farm and shape a life in this single-player, text-based simulation. Grow crops, raise animals, pursue careers, build relationships, and manage your finances through choices that shape your future.

5008320.name: Bit Footballer: The Career
5008320.desc: You're the player — not the manager. Start on the bench at a fourth-division village ground and play your way up to the title. Every career runs in its own generated world: 74 clubs, four divisions, and a scout who sees everything.

5139380.name: Marble Stars
5139380.desc: Marble Stars is a challenging platformer made by one person. Explore 55 handcrafted levels suspended above the ocean, discover special abilities, speedrun each course to compete on the global leaderboards, and earn prestigious medals as you progress.

5237060.name: 遮天：帝路争锋
5237060.desc: 《遮天：帝路争锋》是一款获得《遮天》动画正版授权的群像修仙游戏，游戏基于辰东所著网络小说《遮天》的背景设定。

4188260.name: 喵！一起摸魚吧~
4188260.desc: 這是一款輕鬆療癒的放置掛機釣魚遊戲。你可以在電腦桌面的角落悠閒釣魚、自訂可愛的虛擬形象和場景背景，以及餵食並收集不同品種的貓貓，逐漸解鎖更多精美的場景，讓你的工作與學習更加有趣。支援多人連線，來一起悄悄摸魚吧喵！

4318080.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+ [AB+]
4318080.desc: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

5365860.name: 殭屍燒烤屋
5365860.desc: 殭屍燒烤店是一款 1~8 人的線上合作經營模擬遊戲。認出偽裝的殭屍，拆解、燒烤、上菜。打錯人，警察會來。烤焦了，晚餐會起來打你。賺到錢，賭場就在對面。與夥伴顧一間店，總有一個在偷懶，也總有一個在找麻煩。

5018790.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
5018790.desc: 沒有槍，沒有劍，武器只有你走過的一條線。腳步畫出的軌跡持續切割敵人，線一閉合，圈內的敵群同時爆炸。撐過15分鐘，擊敗BOSS，培養護符牌組，再次出發——走路就是攻擊的倖存者類遊戲。

5235010.name: TURF FIGHT
5235010.desc: Command specials. Command throws. In a beat 'em up.

1114290.name: Windjammers 2
1114290.desc: 史上最棒的飛盤遊戲已強勢回歸！《Windjammers 2》擁有超棒的手繪插圖、瘋狂的全新招式、遊戲玩法機制及超讚的角色與關卡，絕對是你夢寐以求的續作。 新的更新帶來可操控的新角色、新訓練模式、全面支援跨平台遊玩等內容。

4436470.name: 《漫威宇宙入侵》——獨眼龍與石頭人
4436470.desc: 兩位全新超級英雄將加入對抗殲滅者的戰鬥！ 在《漫威宇宙入侵》的首個DLC更新中，化身石頭人及獨眼龍加入戰鬥。

3205060.name: Lil Gator Game: In the Dark
3205060.desc: The world just got a whole lot bigger for this Lil Gator!Lil Gator Game: In the Dark is a game sized DLC expansion to the wholesome adventure that is Lil Gator Game!In this charming DLC you’ll find that new adventures and friends are just beneath the surface—literally!

1485420.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator - First Supply DLC
1485420.desc: Renovate & build vehicles from First Supply DLC. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

2427370.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R - DJMAX Collaboration DLC
2427370.desc: DJMAX × EZ2ON DJMAX Collaboration is the DLC for EZ2ON REBOOT : R

1386616.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - So Happy Gear Pack
1386616.desc: If you purchase this product, you can play game with new note and gear. Please check following contents.

868280.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018 - Ford DLC
868280.desc: Ford DLC includes 4 licensed Ford cars: - 1971 Ford Mustang Mach 1 - 2017 Ford F-350 Super Duty - 2017 Ford Mustang - 1964 Ford GT40

5372430.name: Neuroflip
5372430.desc: 一款卡牌記憶 Roguelike。翻開卡牌，記住每張臉孔出現的位置，配對成功，擊敗書記官、夫人和國王。翻錯從沒看過的牌完全免費；忘掉已經看過的一對，可能讓你付出慘痛代價。

4135930.name: 斯凱爾的烏鴉
4135930.desc: 《斯凱爾的烏鴉》是一款在 5×5 方格牌桌上戰鬥的 Roguelite 卡牌構築遊戲。為每張卡牌貼上最多三張能力貼紙，將不同能力層層組合，讓普通卡牌也能成為整套構築的核心，打造你專屬的構築。每週 Boss 到來前，自由選擇戰鬥、恢復、獲取新卡或繼續改造卡牌；通關後，挑戰其他玩家留下的成型構築，衝擊排行榜。

5102640.name: Pawn'd Chess
5102640.desc: Pick up a controller and play chess against human-like CPU opponents with adjustable difficulty. Make yourself comfortable with extensive accessibility options, explore freely with undo and redo, and create or revisit your own positions.

4914750.name: Sweet Corn Desktop Pet
4914750.desc: Interface Name Core Functions Desktop Floating Window Stands on the desktop; click to expand the primary function panel Primary Function Entry Panel Displays the core entry points for raising, dressing up, online play, and settings Raising Operation Panel

dlc.name: Sweet Corn Desktop Pet- 星星扩展包

5240400.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten - Supporter Pack
5240400.desc: 如果您喜愛《喵！一起摸魚吧~》並希望助力Lumenex團隊的開發旅程，這款支持者包便是您的理想之選！其中包含一套貓貓主題的環境裝扮。

5426370.name: Junkbloom
5426370.desc: 一款關於清理垃圾場與自動化的溫馨增量遊戲。用撬棍敲碎堆積如山的洗衣機、輪胎和舊冰箱，派出勤勞的無人機幫手自動清理，再建造分揀機、粉碎機和發電機，把垃圾變成金屬、聚合物和零件。一邊慢慢擴大自己的小工坊，一邊為博物館收集四十件古怪又各有故事的小玩意兒。隨著土地被清理乾淨，四周的雲層也會逐漸散開，露出新的區域和新的秘密。這裡沒有時間壓力，只有溫暖的音樂、晝夜交替和螢火蟲。最後，去找出在垃圾場中心的雲層之下究竟沉睡著什麼吧。

4931720.name: Camera 5
4931720.desc: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

4446030.name: Stellar Smash
4446030.desc: 在这款打砖块游戏中,逐块击碎砖块,拯救宇宙免于陷入无尽的黑暗.挑战强大的首领,精通球体操控,并升级你的飞船.让主角阿斯特拉(Astra)带领你踏上这段冒险之旅.

5052450.name: 挂幣英雄
5052450.desc: 這是壹款桌面放置RPG，在符文之地組織遠征隊，招募英雄，升級裝備，打怪掉寶，最關鍵的是不會妨礙妳工作看劇或者玩其他遊戲！

4171800.name: Storm Grill
4171800.desc: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

5402190.name: Digging Up Together
5402190.desc: 挖遍埃及沙漠。在 1–4 人合作中用金屬探測器搜尋，用鏟子和鑽機穿透層層地層，清理古代寶藏和真實尺寸的恐龍骨骼，用手推車或礦車運回營地，打造屬於你自己的博物館。

3810240.name: In Full Bloom
3810240.desc: 餵養並照顧你的小寶寶，看著牠慢慢地長大，然後把世界萬物都吞進肚子裡。《在吃億口》是一款靈感來自《塔麻可吉》，風格有點像《塊魂》的遊戲，講的是一隻對這個世界永遠吃不飽、充滿食慾的生物的故事。而牠的成長之路，只有一個方向可以走。

movies.name: In Full Bloom | Gameplay Trailer | Demo 2026

5337120.name: Monster Club League Manager
5337120.desc: 擔任怪物俱樂部的總教練兼經營者，從低級別聯賽挑戰一級聯賽冠軍。這是一款俱樂部經營模擬遊戲：招募並培養新人，安排9名怪物上場，管理合約、轉會與俱樂部資金。比賽自動進行。隨著球員成長與世代交替，持續經營你的俱樂部，迎接一個又一個賽季。

4908020.name: Love Joy Happiness
4908020.desc: 一款關於人生中重要型態的簡短增量（放置）遊戲。

3573120.name: SpellChain
3573120.desc: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

718590.name: Dark Devotion
718590.desc: 你將探索神秘的墮落聖殿，挖掘其中的秘密，接受聖殿騎士信仰的考驗，並獻祭自身予黑暗，犧牲將是你對聖殿之主最大的讚美。

985900.name: 雙子星：盛氣淩人
985900.desc: Young Souls is a gorgeous 2D brawler meets story-rich action RPG. Fight hordes of belligerent goblins, level up with hundreds of weapons and accessories, explore, and journey between worlds, as rebellious twins battle their way to save their foster father.

985890.name: 怒之鐵拳4
985890.desc: 人氣動作遊戲《怒之鐵拳4》（又譯：格鬥五人組/格鬥三人組4/格鬥四人組4）是對 EDM（電子舞曲）和橫向卷軸動作遊戲產生了深遠影響的知名動作遊戲《怒之鐵拳》系列的最新作。4代在承襲傳統的遊戲方式的同時加入現代的遊戲系統、新繪的美麗畫面，並收錄知名作曲家參與創作的音樂。

609110.name: Blazing Chrome
609110.desc: 在Blazing Chrome中，機器統治著全世界。剩下的極少數人則處於滅絕的邊緣，無力對抗金屬電路的霸主地位。

2784180.name: Seleka-san who Exposes unnoticed with Naked Coat
2784180.desc: “I want to flash more!” vs “The bolder I get, the easier it is to get spotted!” Face this ultimate human dilemma for yourself! Keep track of where people are and where they’re looking, go as far as you dare, and complete flashing missions in this fresh 3D stealth-action game.

571310.name: SteamWorld Dig 2
571310.desc: SteamWorld Dig is back! Dig deep, gain riches and unearth the terrors of the underworld in this platform mining adventure influenced by classic Metroidvania style games.

412020.name: 戰慄深隧：流亡
412020.desc: 逃離莫斯科地下隧道殘破的廢墟，在末日後的俄羅斯荒野踏上史詩級的跨大陸旅程。探索廣大的非線性關卡、迷失在身歷其境的沙盒式生存體驗裡頭，以及在史上最偉大的地下隧道冒險中，享受歷時整整一年的精彩劇情。

203140.name: Hitman: Absolution™
203140.desc: The original assassin is back! Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world.

1449850.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
1449850.desc: 史上最強的數位卡牌遊戲！

4794170.name: Swarmslam
4794170.desc: 看著成群的小小重擊者撲向行星，一路開採，直到將其擊碎。再把礦石投入虛空，讓蜂群變得更龐大、更迅捷。 重擊。擊碎。再來。

movies.name: Swarmslam Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

3575280.name: Build A Bot
3575280.desc: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

4551150.name: 陛下，請蓋章！
4551150.desc: 一款由二元決策驅動的城市建造遊戲。你將扮演一位外星弄臣，機緣巧合成為臨時皇帝，透過為法令蓋章做出各種離奇決策，並想盡一切辦法阻止帝國崩潰。

5474530.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
5474530.desc: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

movies.name: Halloween Tidy Up | Official Launch Trailer

4556050.name: Tzelem
4556050.desc: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

5298390.name: Who Earns More
5298390.desc: 跑商買賣、經營仙產、資助冒險。三個世界，三種賺法，在有限天數裡累積財富！這是一款單人回合制交易經營遊戲；選擇 20 至 100 天一局，安排本錢、欠款、倉位與行程，看看你能賺多少。

5402950.name: Gate Singular
5402950.desc: One logic gate. Unlimited possibilities. Build circuits of millions of gates and run them on a blazing-fast simulator. Follow a guided tutorial from the basics to a working CPU, or design devices of any complexity on your own. Co-op included.

5146340.name: Arma Reforger - Rally
5146340.desc: 拉力賽正式登陸《Arma Reforger》：新增三輛拉力賽車、三座島嶼共六條檢查點賽道、可自訂比賽條件，以及能跑出當前最佳紀錄的幽靈車。

5013150.name: Nonet Concerto R
5013150.desc: 用魔法將成群的魔物一掃而空！第三人稱3D刷寶動作遊戲。從約100種魔石中搭配裝備，挑戰50多個關卡。支援單人或最多4人線上合作。在Twitch・YouTube直播時，觀眾的聊天留言會引發魔物增援、暴風雨等事件。

4865360.name: Novalex Project Zero
4865360.desc: 回合制車廠經營遊戲。從底盤開始設計每一款車，管理工廠、壓價搶客，在橫跨一個世紀的車市裡，靠技術壓過不斷加入戰局、最多可達 30 家的 AI 對手。打造屹立百年的車廠，或者在半路宣告破產。

5000880.name: Coverage
5000880.desc: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

5196990.name: The Super Seven
5196990.desc: The Super Seven is a mixed media visual novel in the style in the style of 80s and 90s sitcom television shows. The Super Seven follows Cheng, a new student who has recently moved to Sydney to begin university. He is quickly swept into an eccentric group of seven students.

5365300.name: yoruneko - Living Soundscape
5365300.desc: A living ambient workspace for focus and rest. Mix your own soundscape from layered environmental audio, set a focus timer, and watch the night sky shift with the real lunar phase. Five atmospheric moods with original music, designed by a producer for long, quiet hours of work.

4932800.name: Love n Life: Happy Student - Winter Embrace
4932800.desc: You have worked hard, Hero. Now winter has come, and the ladies are ready to reward you with the warmth, love, and comfort you deserve.

movies.name: Love n Life: Happy Student - Winter Embrace Trailer

5418550.name: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths
5418550.desc: A light-hearted adventure that whisks you around the micro-fantasy land of Bargvia, join The Mages Guild, meet The First Mage, explore The Undercroft, engage with colourful locals and grind in enemy-filled Micro-Dungeons.

4633120.name: Voxotron
4633120.desc: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

4599480.name: Soulstack
4599480.desc: 卡牌堆疊RPG：採集、鍛造武器，一路闖過地城。為你和寵物各選一條進化路線：48種職業（其中9種受詛咒），140種寵物型態。300多種武器，從綁石頭的木棍到手持弩砲。儘管如此，看起來卻像是一個活過來的規劃工具。

5329800.name: Hide No More
5329800.desc: Hide No More is a sound-driven Blindfold Hide and Seek game,Supports up to 8 players online. Blindfolded Hunters can sense their surroundings within just 5 meters, but sound can lead them to their targets. Hiders must use distance and the environment to evade capture.

5294200.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
5294200.desc: 一款休閒德州撲克遊戲，支援單人闖關與 2–8 人 Steam 連線遊玩。一次買斷，無需儲值。僅使用虛擬籌碼，無現實貨幣價值。

4835870.name: Table Of Truth
4835870.desc: 你的朋友到底是怎麼看待你的？ 在這款混亂又爆笑的合作派對遊戲中，投票選出最有趣的正面與負面評價。跟著多數人的想法就能得分，但也準備迎接終極友情考驗。你會成為團隊中的天才，還是行走的災難？

5463810.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator
5463810.desc: Break through 50,000 bricks. Time to escape the walls. Punch your way to freedom! Break through walls, punch out the walls and escape prison one punch at a time! Smash through tougher walls, discover new areas, and become the ultimate wall-breaking machine in WALL PUNCH: ESCAPE THE WALLS SIMULATOR

movies.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator - Trailer

3402800.name: Train Simulator: Northampton Loop Route Add-On
3402800.desc: Branching off the West Coast Main Line just north of Wolverton, the Northampton Loop runs for just under 24 miles before rejoining near Rugby. It routinely carries freight, selected express services, and many stopping trains to and from Birmingham and London.

3456660.name: PAYDAY: Aces High
3456660.desc: 戴上面具，刺激快感全開。大膽策劃、製造狂暴亂局，完成一場又一場驚天劫案。《PAYDAY: Aces High》是終極 VR 合作搶劫遊戲，最多可四人組隊，大幹一票。

3591900.name: 騎士盤騎士
3591900.desc: 《騎士盤騎士》是一款節奏緊張的三消型動作Roguelite遊戲。在網格狀的戰場上即時考驗你的反應速度與協調能力：閃避攻擊、組合地塊為武器充能，並尋找最佳時機發起進攻。

4140700.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
4140700.desc: 從零開始，在陽光明媚的邁阿密海灘打造屬於你的商業帝國！賣檸檬水、經營販賣機、讓你的事業自動化，在這款輕鬆悠閒的第一人稱模擬遊戲中，把小小的副業變成豐厚的利潤。

2831000.name: Faraway
2831000.desc: 《Faraway》是採用無限程序化產生設計的技巧型街機風遊戲，描寫一顆藉由創造星座延續生命的流星。

5440550.name: Cash is King! - The Official Book
5440550.desc: 想進一步了解 Cash is King! Business Simulator 的世界，探索遊戲中的一切嗎？官方書籍帶你超越遊戲玩法，更深入地認識這座城市、其中的角色，以及它的秘密。

5444160.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
5444160.desc: 化身小小的仙子，在巨大的工坊中飛翔，按顏色、鑰匙頭和結構整理3200把鑰匙。獨自遊玩或最多4人合作，學習魔法、修復工坊、收集畫作碎片，還能寵愛工坊裡的貓。

4992940.name: Rogue Belt
4992940.desc: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

2411200.name: Underkeep
2411200.desc: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear, and explore a fully handcrafted world.

3204330.name: 財富郡：貿易與生產
3204330.desc: 在中世紀的背景下從零開始發展您的郡，這規模遠超單個城市。在廣闊多變的地形中確定合適的定居點選址，沿著河流與道路編織貿易網絡，並在您的區域逐漸成形時，管理市長、貴族和不同的文化分佈。這是一款規模大得多的城市建造遊戲，而你治下的每一個定居點的發展和表現，都由你完全定義。

3900.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® IV
3900.desc: Sid Meier 的 Civilization (文明帝國) 系列在全球已售出逾六百萬套，並獲各地支持者與媒體好評，被視為是史上最經典的電腦遊戲系列之一。 現在，Sid Meier 與 Firaxis Games 更把這一款引人入迷的有趣遊戲帶往另一高峰，加入新的遊戲方式，新的勝敗條件，新的工具來管理擴張您的文明，並用全新的方法，讓自訂遊戲更簡單，多人模式更有趣，選項更多。 Civilization IV 有細緻的畫面，彷彿活著的 3D 世界，把遊戲體驗提升至全新的境界。 Civilization IV 已受玩家讚為 2005 年十大遊戲，是全球玩家都一定要擁有的遊戲！

4560.name: Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition
4560.desc: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. This legacy version also grants access to the latest version of COH, just called "Company of Heroes".

527230.name: For The King
527230.desc: For The King是一款結合桌遊和 roguelike 類型元素的跨越領域戰略型 RPG 遊戲。可以在線和單機進行單人或多人合作的遊戲體驗。

4262460.name: ROB RUN
4262460.desc: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

5312540.name: WinterClan: Hex Tactics
5312540.desc: Command the frozen frontier—one hex, one hero, and one decisive move at a time.

4926360.name: UBAI Ending
4926360.desc: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

3060830.name: 降臨之地
3060830.desc: 如果你喜歡打造獨一無二的牌組，用簡單的操作觸發瘋狂連鎖，看著數字不斷暴漲狂跳—— 那你或許會喜歡《降臨之地》。 在這個使徒降臨後的絕望世界中，用超過300種卡牌與遺物構築你的組合，最終引爆令人上癮的瘋狂聯動。

5019170.name: 桌面殺蟲
5019170.desc: 以电脑桌面为战场的射击增量游戏。各类机械虫子从屏幕四周不断涌出，摧毁你的电脑本体，你需要手持各式武器射击，抵御虫群一波波猛攻。每局击杀虫子可获取金币，用于局外解锁庞大技能树，持续强化武器、伤害、防御与特殊能力，也可以从美女助手中得到援助，解锁桌宠伴侣，共你出战！

5157730.name: 蓬萊的雪
5157730.desc: 《蓬萊的雪》是一款中國古代背景的GL向視覺小說，玩家將通過人偶璇花的視角，直面巫師祝寒川的一切。 或者說，親歷一場浴血化生的新蓮之旅。

4338800.name: 山海之痕
4338800.desc: 🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS、逆天改命的Idle RPG。闯关升级、打BOSS爆神装、结婚生子、组队讨伐、PVP竞技……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！

5465860.name: ANOMIA: Listening Post K-7
5465860.desc: ANOMIA - 1977. Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

5437530.name: RETRO NIGHT CHASE
5437530.desc: RETRO NIGHT CHASE is a top-down highway escape game. Drift, shoot, drop oil slicks and deploy spike strips. Keep police behind you. The longer you hold out, the tougher things get!

5057340.name: 水族箱時光
5057340.desc: 《水族箱時光》是一款療癒系養魚收集遊戲。遊戲中有 60 種可愛的魚、117 種外觀和 18 個魚缸場景。你可以把魚缸縮成桌面小窗，也可以把它設為動態桌布。

4611550.name: Artificial Ambition
4611550.desc: Artificial Ambition is a real-time management sim. Start an AI lab in 2017, hire researchers, buy GPUs, train models, and grow from a chatbot or a vision API to robotaxis and humanoid robots. Decide what your AI values, keep your board onside, and beat four rivals to the frontier.

fullgame.name: 下海灘–賭博之聖傳說 DX

5397040.name: 下海灘–賭博之聖傳說 DX - Artbook
5397040.desc: 《下海灘-賭博之聖傳說 DX》官方美術集

4651930.name: 下海灘–賭博之聖傳說 DX
4651930.desc: 被稱為新世代「賭聖」的男人，為了打倒傳說中的「賭魔」，踏入了由她掌管的海上非法賭場。在那裡等待著他的，是千金城麾下的三名美女幹部。賭上性命與快樂的勝負，將從這裡開始！

movies.name: Sexy Gamblers_ Kakaitan Legend PV TC
Sexy Gamblers_ Kakaitan Legend PV HK

3422590.name: 琥珀末日
3422590.desc: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.

movies.name: 策略卡牌RPG《琥珀末日》首发预告片
策略卡牌RPG《琥珀末日》玩法预告片

5136450.name: 十萬僵屍衝過來啦！
5136450.desc: 《十萬僵屍衝過來啦！》是一款自由規劃路線的增量塔防遊戲，沒有固定的路徑，自由放置牆壁與火力，為十萬僵屍大軍規劃一條「必死之路」。你可以設計蜿蜒的迷宮，也可以構築層層防線，每一局的地圖都由你親手創造。準備好了嗎？開始消滅十萬僵屍組成的屍潮吧！

5179280.name: 女神養成：掛機型RPG
5179280.desc: 《女神養成：掛機型 RPG》是一款支援桌面掛機的王道美少女幻想 JRPG。在魔物肆虐的奇幻大陸，玩家以契約者的身份踏上征程，與來自不同文明的美女武神締結羈絆契約，組隊討伐哥布林、牛頭人等邪惡魔物軍團，逐步揭開災厄背後的驚人陰謀。

4608230.name: 我的蟲子賣瘋了
4608230.desc: 150+ 像素抽象昆蟲在桌面飛舞， 多種多樣的造景物可供自由裝扮。 讓桌面變成你的飼養箱，繁殖出更多稀有蟲子放置賺錢吧！

4960570.name: 小贼修仙记
4960570.desc: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

5455830.name: Wrong Mine
5455830.desc: Trapped deep underground by a broken excavator, you must scavenge labyrinthine mines for parts to escape. Avoid a relentless alien spider uning electric traps, or betray your crew to claim every reward. Will you work together to survive the dark depths, or leave them behind for the loot?

4982850.name: Captive 3000
4982850.desc: 第一人稱即時戰鬥科幻迷宮探索遊戲。探索龐大的太空基地與太空站，採用格狀移動及傳統精靈圖像。靈感源自 Dungeon Master、Eye of the Beholder、Grimrock 與 Amiga／Atari 經典作品 Captive。

4770220.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
4770220.desc: 在經典奇幻RPG中探索漂浮大陸！

movies.name: 天空の世界シェルテーラ　PV

5466500.name: Hazzard Hearth: Emerald Zombies
5466500.desc: Zombie DLC for Hazzard Hearth. Still stranded, willingly or not, you remember there's a nearby resort to loot. But when you arrive there, there's a surprise. More danger, but more resources.

4658010.name: The Resonance Initiative
4658010.desc: In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

movies.name: The Resonance Initiative - Early Access Trailer

5128890.name: 奇怪的三国模拟器
5128890.desc: This is an AI-driven story-driven strategy card RPG. In "Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator", you are not a spectator you are the one who rewrites the script. The Peach Garden Oath may not come to fruition, but if it fails to materialize, the course of the Three Kingdoms will be completely rewritten.

4506030.name: 聶小倩
4506030.desc: 《聶小倩》是一款古風志怪視覺小說。跟隨書生寧采臣借宿金華荒寺，與受困的少女亡魂聶小倩相逢，在試探、信任與生死危機中逐漸相知。透過關鍵選擇改變劇情走向，探索不同結局，為這段人鬼相逢尋找歸處。

5300980.name: Webbound
5300980.desc: Dive into a minimalist incremental game where you weave luminous webs with tactile string-vibration mechanics. Spare glowing fireflies to enhance your silk, close geometric regions for high-scoring chains, and evolve your modular spider across successive tiers into an apex predator.

5449750.name: 終末街区
5449750.desc: 在殭屍橫行的城市蒐集物資，與夥伴守護家園的生存動作RPG。探索街區、即時戰鬥、製作道具、耕作、防守據點與回收車輛，在崩壞的日常中求生。決定何時繼續前進，何時帶大家平安回家。

movies.name: ゲームプレイ予告編2（日本語）
ゲームプレイ予告編（日本語）

5340660.name: オーダーバーガー
5340660.desc: [Overview]"Order's Burger" is a fast-paced action game where you stack ingredients to match incoming orders. [Key Features]Fast-paced ingredient stacking Increasing difficulty levels Time attack & high score rankings Test your reflexes and become the ultimate burger master!

movies.name: さくっと作ってスコアをぶち上げろ！

5271040.name: Junkyard Reseller
5271040.desc: Explore junkyards, find rusty figurines and collectibles, and restore them with a laser. The better you restore an item, the more it sells for. Deliver orders to villagers and grow your resale business.

4907430.name: GrindFall
4907430.desc: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

1342620.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest
1342620.desc: Explore the myths and monsters of Europe’s last primeval wilderness. Play as Maia, who arrives at the ancient Białowieża Forest looking to explore her family history. Discover Rage in an adventure game inspired by the experience of the legendary tabletop roleplaying game Werewolf: The Apocalypse.

compare.en: Werewolf: the Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest

9340.name: Company of Heroes: Opposing Fronts
9340.desc: The next chapter in the #1 rated RTS franchise thrusts players into a hellish war torn landscape to command two battle-hardened armies in relentless campaigns for honor and country. Players lead the tenacious British 2nd Army during the heroic World War II liberation of Caen, France, and command the German Panzer Elite as they struggle...

movies.name: Company of Heroes: Opposing Fronts Trailer

1004750.name: WRC 8 FIA World Rally Championship
1004750.desc: 最完整和真實的WRC官方賽車模擬遊戲。賽道路面的全新物理機制、完全重新設計的職涯模式、動態天氣、50隻車隊、14個國家、100個賽道，每週挑戰和eSports模式……

355790.name: Styx: Shards of Darkness
355790.desc: Styx returns in a new stealth adventure! Explore and master huge open environments, sneak past or assassinate new enemies and bosses, and experiment with the new array of lethal abilities and weapons in our goblin assassin's arsenal.

movies.name: Styx: Shards of Darkness - Launch Trailer
Styx: Shards of Darkness - Art of Stealth Trailer

8800.name: Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword
8800.desc: Sid Meier's Civilization IV®: Beyond the Sword is the second expansion pack for Civilization IV - the 2005 PC Game of the Year that has become a worldwide hit.

458770.name: WRC 6 FIA World Rally Championship
458770.desc: On a race track, the car makes all the difference. In a rally, it's the driver. Fog, mud, punctures... you have to deal with it all. WRC 6 includes all of the official 2016 content, 11 Super Special Stages on a 1:1 scale, local split-screen multiplayer and free access to the entire 2017 eSports WRC.

8930.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® V
8930.desc: Create, discover, and download new player-created maps, scenarios, interfaces, and more!

movies.name: Civ V DLC Explorers Map Pack Trailer

1283400.name: Steelrising
1283400.desc: 巴黎，1789 年。路易十六與他無情的機械大軍，血腥鎮壓了法國大革命。在這個充滿挑戰的動作 RPG 遊戲中，神祕的自動機曠世巨作艾吉絲必須獨自面對國王的軍隊以拯救歷史。

1600.name: Dangerous Waters
1600.desc: S.C.S. -《Dangerous Waters》提供現代海戰舞臺,讓您完全控制多個空中、海面與潛艇平臺。 直接控制個別單兵戰鬥位置，也可從指揮官的視點來企劃執行海軍聯兵戰鬥。

16810.name: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization
16810.desc: Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is the third offering in the award winning Civilization IV series. A re-imagining of the classic Colonization game Sid Meier created in 1994, Sid Meier's Civilization IV: Colonization is a total conversion of the Civilization IV engine into a game experience in which players will lead a European...

1058450.name: MY HERO ONE'S JUSTICE 2
1058450.desc: 比獲得好評的「我的英雄學院」對戰動作遊戲前作更加豐富許多， 「我的英雄學院 唯我正義2」即將登場！ 盡情在關卡奔馳，以來自「個性」的超人力量體驗充滿魄力的戰鬥吧！

1393750.name: Ocean's Heart
1393750.desc: Ocean’s Heart is an epic top-down action RPG in which you explore a beautiful archipelago as a young woman named Tilia. Take on contracts to fight monsters, descend deep into ancient dungeons, defeat menacing foes, and unravel the mystery of Ocean’s Heart. All done in beautiful, bright pixel art.

1211600.name: 隔離區-喪尸末日生存
1211600.desc: 大災變已經到來，執行任務的你不幸墜機被困在隔離區，這裡到處都是殭屍和變異怪物，想要逃離這裡，你必須努力蒐集原料，升級技能，建造避難所，擊敗屍潮和神秘的機甲，最終尋得一線生機。

4802170.name: EraStorm: SandStorm
4802170.desc: Explore ancient Egypt in EraStorm: SandStorm, an adult visual novel with romance, mythology, mystery, impactful choices, multiple routes, 12 endings, 5,000+ renders, 150+ revamped animations, Steam achievements, and no grind.

5042320.name: 企鵝之怒
5042320.desc: 《企鵝之怒》是一款混亂又上癮的 Roguelite 自走棋！招募企鵝，將三隻相同單位合成更強的戰士，再替牠們裝上越來越誇張的武器。搭配強力小丑牌、連續擊殺累積連擊，看看你的企鵝小隊能撐多久！

3954800.name: Campfire Harmony
3954800.desc: 在桌面上的營火邊烤棉花糖。你敲鍵盤、動滑鼠，狐狸就不打瞌睡，火苗也不熄；牠每烤好一顆棉花糖，你就能賺到星星。升級烹飪器具，烤得更快，賺得更多。最多兩位好友可以坐到火邊，陪你一起烤棉花糖。

3208460.name: Rogue Braver | 勇者ローグ
3208460.desc: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

movies.name: Rogue Braver | 勇者ローグ予告編

5481550.name: Circuits: VLSI
5481550.desc: Draw the layers of a silicon chip to build working circuits. Solve 100 puzzles, from wires and transistors to logic, memory, and small clocked machines. Inspect simulated signals, compare your layouts, and experiment freely in Sandbox.

5061070.name: One Line Wonder
5061070.desc: 一筆畫，熟悉的規則玩出新巧思。在錯綜的路徑中找到自己的走法，享受將複雜局面逐漸理順的滿足感。

4780820.name: 20 Floors Down
4780820.desc: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

5446410.name: Tikra Rida
5446410.desc: Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

5242350.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
5242350.desc: 一款以滑鼠游標為刀刃的動作 Roguelite。斬開蜂擁而來的敵群，死守正中央的水晶。40 種武器：甩連枷、擲輪刃、掄起戰鎚重砸。每局除了手上那把，還能再往槽位裝上兩把，三把武器的卡牌都能練到滿級。共有 13 個領域，等你一路闖過。

movies.name: I Only Moved My Mouse | Teaser #4
I Only Moved My Mouse | Steam Next Fest

4890840.name: IVAN (Iter Vehemens ad Necem)
4890840.desc: A roguelike classic. Gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes.

4953360.name: 藉口之王！
4953360.desc: 在這款 2–8 人派對遊戲中，用一張嘴化解所有危機！即興編造藉口，把意想不到的單字塞進你的故事，再讓朋友們為你評分。支援單台電腦輪流遊玩，也能透過 Steam 線上連線。線上遊玩需要使用外部語音聊天。

5088960.name: DISK-Y
5088960.desc: 帶領轉學生〈優〉參觀學校吧。這是一部在如夢境般毫無脈絡展開的故事中，描繪與她之間奇妙關係的短篇心理恐怖小說。 為收錄於一張3.5吋磁碟片中的實驗性復古遊戲之Steam版本。

5441740.name: Wonder Garden
5441740.desc: Grow a little garden on your desktop while you work or relax. Plant seeds, water your plants, raise butterflies and discover their varieties in your almanac. Arrange your own shelves on Windows and macOS, or let plants sit on window edges on macOS.

3499520.name: Piano Glow
3499520.desc: 在連線多人遊戲大廳彈奏鋼琴，挑戰排行榜，體驗遊戲化訓練模式：聽音、讀譜、節奏、4K/7K 和下落音符。使用電腦或筆電的 QWERTY 鍵盤，或鋼琴，演奏任意歌曲。可將任何鋼琴影片或樂譜轉換為下落音符教學或 MIDI 檔案。

movies.name: Works with QWERTY or piano! Multiplayer with AI tools to convert any piano video or sheet music into falling notes

5486310.name: Forbidden House
5486310.desc: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

5313690.name: It Will Open
5313690.desc: You are a newly hired night-shift employee at the Arden Hotel. While controlling access to the parking lot and responding to guest complaints, you begin to experience a series of suspicious and disturbing events. Uncover the secret hidden within the hotel—and survive.

5349900.name: Mystic Fog Maze
5349900.desc: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

4725170.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
4725170.desc: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.

4599470.name: Lost Media Agency
4599470.desc: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

4158610.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
4158610.desc: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven base-building RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

compare.en: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age

1380560.name: PENGUINS VS SEALS
1380560.desc: *Penguins vs Seals* is a side-scrolling strategy game combining RTS, tower defense, and unit deployment. Fuse units to unlock new troops, build defenses, launch attacks, and use battlefield abilities to break enemy lines and claim victory!

fullgame.name: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine

5267710.name: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine Soundtrack
5267710.desc: This is additional content for https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111040/ The base game is not included.

5421320.name: Infested DX Soundtrack
5421320.desc: The official soundtrack to Infested DX. Music by Orie Falconer Original Game by GrahfMetal and Komi Games Inc. Album Art by David Lopez

4561010.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
4561010.desc: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

3049140.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages
3049140.desc: Succeed in the modern world and know the value of your decisions. All or nothing!

4834760.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
4834760.desc: 《Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor》是一款以「被遺忘的國度」為背景、搭建隊伍制的回合制角色扮演遊戲。組成英雄隊伍，深入鬼魅盤踞的迷斯卓諾遺跡，運用戰術走位、法術與刀劍，阻止龍族巫妖腐化這片國度。

4860680.name: Deep Rise
4860680.desc: Colony management roguelite. After every combat, draft one of three cards to build your run. The surface world ended a thousand years ago. Now the road up is open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

5404030.name: No One Came Back
5404030.desc: 化身打倒勇者的一方——逆向 Roguelike。在鎮上散布謠言挑選獵物，在洞窟裡布下手下與陷阱迎擊。闖到魔王之間的人，就由身為魔王的你親手解決。一個都別放回去。

5524270.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages - Wallpapers
5524270.desc: Succeed in the modern world and know the value of your decisions. All or nothing!

5354780.name: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion
5354780.desc: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

435100.name: 2Dark
435100.desc: 2Dark 是一款由生存恐怖遊戲先驅和 Alone in the Dark® 製作人 Frédérick Raynal 研發的潛行冒險遊戲。穿越精神病患的巢穴、揭開瘋狂恐怖的陰謀詭計、最重要的是將孩子救出來！

735580.name: 11-11 Memories Retold
735580.desc: 1916 年 11 月，一位年輕的攝影師離開加拿大，加入歐洲戰線最前線。 就在同一天，一位德國技師被告知自己兒子在出任務的時候失蹤。 這兩位都有共同點：希望自己或自己的摯愛都能活著，並且平安無事地回到所愛的人身邊。

996770.name: Moving Out
996770.desc: 只支持本地聯機 《Moving Out》是一款無厘頭的物理模擬搬家遊戲，它將為「單機合作遊戲」帶來新定義！準備好體驗刺激的搬家工作了嗎？作為初出茅廬的家具規劃與搬家師傅，玩家將在熱鬧繁華的 Packmore 小鎮穿梭大街小巷、進行搬家工作。

365820.name: Company of Heroes 2 - The British Forces
365820.desc: This latest multiplayer standalone entry in the COH2 series features this iconic Allied army. Experience a unique tech-tree that challenges the player to balance the constant trade-off between mobility and defense. Surprise opponents with your development choices and an open end game configuration.

compare.en: Company of Heroes 2: The British Forces

20540.name: Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor
20540.desc: Company of Heroes®: Tales of Valor™ is the expansion to the Game of the Year winner and highest rated real time strategy franchise Company of Heroes®. Featuring new campaigns to overcome, units to command, and battlefields to conquer, Company of Heroes®: Tales of Valor™ delivers evolved gameplay mechanics and 3 episodic adventures...

movies.name: Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor Trailer
Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor Launch Trailer

compare.en: Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor

12330.name: Darkstar One
12330.desc: Darkstar One offers a fantastic amount of freedom of choice. The story-based missions gradually lead you deeper into the galaxy to new races, new technologies and ever stronger opponents. Explore a vast array of solar systems in search of hidden artifacts of ancient races, essential objects for upgrading your ship--the Darkstar One.

231430.name: Company of Heroes 2
231430.desc: Experience the ultimate WWII RTS platform with COH2 and its standalone expansions. This package includes the base game, which you can then upgrade by purchasing The Western Front Armies, Ardennes Assault and/or The British Forces. More info in the "About This Game" section below.

1983260.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
1983260.desc: 帶上一把劍與遊客導覽手冊，探索阿爾卑斯山上美麗的辛特堡村莊，揭開隱藏在地牢中的神秘面紗！學習魔法、解開謎題、砍殺怪物。一切盡在辛特堡！遊戲支持中文。

movies.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg - New Trailer EN

2085370.name: Classified: France '44
2085370.desc: 在這款野心勃勃的回合制戰略遊戲中，玩家可以在納粹占領的法國，指揮由特種作戰盟軍組成的菁英團隊在諾曼第登陸日前大鬧一番。挑戰德國強大的戰爭機器，並在佔領地發動勇猛突襲。你能為盟軍的勝利掃清障礙嗎？

324740.name: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain
324740.desc: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain is a tabletop adventure come to life! This fantasy solo RPG combines unique, simultaneous turn-based combat with a journey that changes based on each figurine you take into Firetop Mountain! Which hero will you take into Zagor's lair THIS time?

movies.name: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain Teaser

1641700.name: Moving Out 2
1641700.desc: 《Moving Out》回來了，並且比之前更古怪，現在還有線上遊玩模式！回到 Packmore 利用您的搬家技術在全新的次元與一些舊愛中穿梭。協助重建 Smooth Moves 並成為 F.A.R.T. (家具規劃與搬家師傅) 的明星員工！

897820.name: Reigns: Game of Thrones
897820.desc: “王權：權力遊戲”是熱門劃卡遊戲“王權”融合了HBO®獲獎劇集《權力遊戲®》劇情改編的遊戲，由Nerial工作室及Devolver Digital傾情呈現。

1690.name: Space Empires V
1690.desc: 《Space Empires V》是《Space Empires》系列最新版。 這全新的一章完全更新使用者介面，並帶領玩家進入即時繪製的 3D 世界。 玩家可欣賞華麗細緻且效果擬真的宇宙戰鬥， 並在龐大而生動的星系中擴張、探索、開發並發動戰爭。 遊戲新內容有多帝國間的政治聯盟，上而下的船艦設計系統，六角形地圖格，還有更多。 因應玩家要求，遊戲也完全模組化可自行修改，甚至還加入了可撰寫指令的人工智慧系統。 《Space Empires V》在宇宙策略遊戲領域，勇敢地跨出了一大步。 24 位元 3D 即時繪製圖形。 詳細戰術戰鬥 (並有戰鬥模擬器供您測試新設計！) 新載具類型及大小：船艦、基地、運輸艦、戰鬥艇、機雷、衛星、部隊、無人機、武器平台等。

992173.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ - Janemba
992173.desc: Janemba, the demon of pure evil joins the fight from the Underworld! This content includes: • Janemba as a new playable character • 5 alternative colors for his outfit • Janemba Lobby Avatar • Janemba Z Stamp

431621.name: Rabi-Ribi - Digital Artbook
431621.desc: 順手購畫冊，救濟可可亞。畫冊除遊戲中現役插圖外，亦包含早期開發階段之草圖、棄稿與設定資料（角色的設定資料、本篇沒有被使用的背景設定、開發歷程心得、與一堆沒必要的額外資訊通通都在裡面喔！）

2417760.name: 最後指令: B-Side
2417760.desc: 獨特的《貪吃蛇 x 動作彈幕》，加上全新內容！ 新地圖、新頭目、新挑戰！充滿特色和驚喜的彈幕關卡。 全新故事，探索角色的過去和內心。 穿越現實與虛擬世界的玩家，與女主角 - 實，協助彼此逃離被囚禁之地。 向長久以來的支持者表達感謝！

fullgame.name: JOJO的奇妙冒險 群星之戰 重製版

2382762.name: JOJO的奇妙冒險 群星之戰 重製版　DLC角色「U的奇蹟（透龍）」
2382762.desc: 將可以使用可遊玩角色「U的奇蹟（透龍）」。

2419041.name: Spirit Island - Jagged Earth
2419041.desc: The battle against the colonizing Invaders rages on! Jagged Earth brings more Spirits, more Powers, and more Island Boards. But the Invaders are more numerous and more capable than ever before. New Adversaries, Events, Fear, and Blight cards add more variety and danger than ever before!

3527290.name: PEAK
3527290.desc: 《PEAK》是一款合作登山遊戲，就連最微小的錯誤都能招致你的死亡。無論你是獨自一人，或是與其他童軍團成員一同迷失於大自然中，你從這座神祕小島獲救的唯一希望，就是攀上小島中心的山峰。你有攻頂《PEAK》的能耐嗎？

5365100.name: LetterZ: The paths of letters
5365100.desc: LetterZ – 字母之路是一款自動化遊戲，你可以提取、運輸並組裝字母來組成單字。優化你的生產線，解鎖新的可能性，一次一個字母，建造你的工廠。

4877750.name: Temporal Strike
4877750.desc: Time-loop defense shooter. Aim yourself or let your squad fire on auto as orcs, goblins, boar riders and mechs flood in. Spend the loot on a 38-node upgrade tree, unlock five units, beat the boss waves, then rewind time for permanent upgrades.

1825840.name: House Zero
1825840.desc: A social casino where the only thing at stake is bragging rights. Play 20+ games, from slots, Plinko and Crash to live poker and case battles with friends, using free play-money chips. Climb weekly leaderboards, finish quests and unlock cosmetics. No real-money gambling or payouts.

4986470.name: クイズ！罵倒ネア！
4986470.desc: This game is a quiz game that includes satire and jokes.

4248190.name: Sunborn
4248190.desc: 一款宇宙放置遊戲：餵養一粒微小的火花，直到它化為超新星。親手把燃料拖曳進恆星，讓殖民地與艦隊替你運送，或者兩者兼用。疊加 158 個升級，撞擊流浪行星，與死亡恆星合併，從黑洞中彈射物質。

3827390.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
3827390.desc: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

2278060.name: Timepaths
2278060.desc: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode, card editor, and infinite levels.

3529660.name: HOMEPAGE
3529660.desc: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

5458290.name: VRX3D
5458290.desc: Play your flat PC games on a giant 3D screen in VR. VRX3D captures the game window, works out the depth of every frame live on your graphics card, and shows it in stereo on a big screen in a dark room lit by the picture. Keep your keyboard, mouse or controller.

5379080.name: Vast Mines
5379080.desc: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

3914830.name: Compromised
3914830.desc: Two intruders are working together to get inside your home. Monitor cameras, manage power, and use your security terminal to fight off cyberattacks and sabotage. Keep your defenses running and the killer outside until 6 AM. Once he's inside, nowhere is safe.

4967370.name: Glyphforge
4967370.desc: Glyphforge is an magic roguelike with "anime style" spell-crafting. You write and compile nested spell formulas while kiting hostiles across an endless grid. In the most "I cant believe its another survivor-like game" manner possible.

4591470.name: Hush Hush: Bootleg Spirits
4591470.desc: Run a small-town store by day and a secret bootleg operation by night. Produce homemade spirits, take risky phone orders, deliver on time, and manage the chaos caused by drunk customers, growing reputation, and police patrols.

5342700.name: Just a Piece
5342700.desc: Just a Piece is a cozy puzzle game with 50 puzzles to solve at your own pace. Rotate the pieces, flip them, try something different. Take your time, enjoy the journey, and solve it piece by piece.

5333530.name: WILD SEX
5333530.desc: WILD SEX - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

1517770.name: Astrokicker
1517770.desc: Pilot the Mk19 through 100 fields of arcade space combat. Shoot down missiles, set off mine chains and line up shots on exposed starbase cores. Build your fighter as you fly, with Modern and Retro modes and four difficulty levels.

5467310.name: Decks of Valor: Fantasy Card Battles
5467310.desc: Choose a fantasy deck and battle through a branching campaign, 16-player tournaments, King of the Mountain, friendly duels and local network matches.

3977320.name: Grave Of Voices
3977320.desc: Ryan Morgan, a 21-year-old horror vlogger, thought he had found the perfect lead for his next video. But when he enters Ashfall, a town erased from the map, he realizes he's trapped in the catacombs below. To escape, he must solve puzzles, scavenge, hide from inhuman creatures, and fight to survive.

4673450.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
4673450.desc: 在空蕩蕩的道路上搭便車旅行，每輛車都可能成為你的救贖……或者你的終點。走過荒涼的地方，一路上遇到奇異的陌生人。隨著路邊殺手的謠言不斷傳播，在不可預測的遭遇中交談、做出決定並生存下來。在奔向未知的同時。

3293060.name: Fast Lap Racing
3293060.desc: 開著街上常見的汽車駛上賽道，挑戰計時。升級愛車性能，不斷縮短單圈時間，追求完美的一圈，並在全球排行榜上爭取更高名次。

5423940.name: Rubber Messiah: 18+ 慾望地堡模擬器
5423940.desc: 打卡上班，迎接物流噩夢！將貨物送交給沉迷於18禁荒唐行徑的地下邪教。閃避工業級性愛陷阱，找出「至高母胎」，並讓她在送貨單上簽名。保持你那厭世的撲克臉。總之，拿到簽名，然後快閃走人！

movies.name: Sex, Sex, and Sex Again Quick Preview

4913670.name: The Peg Mines
4913670.desc: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

5217960.name: Jewelry Keeper
5217960.desc: Sort 3,100 pieces of jewelry scattered throughout an elegant shop. Open each box, read its number, and place every ring, watch, necklace and more in its exact marked spot. Unlock helpful skills at your own pace—or race the clock.

4909100.name: Box Flow
4909100.desc: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

5055990.name: 魔物娘倖存者！
5055990.desc: 在這款生存遊戲裡，你將探索一個被魅魔所佔據的世界，蒐集各種資源、升級你的基地，並與敵人展開對抗。與遭到族群放逐的魅魔少女——莉莉建立羈絆，一同踏上這段求生之旅。你最終能逃出生天嗎？莉莉又是否會一直陪伴在你身邊？你的每一個選擇，都將影響最終的結局。

3725550.name: 淫魔王之環
3725550.desc: 由於封印被解除，隱藏於沙漠中的淫魔王之城再度現身。 為了追尋沉眠於此的淫魔王寶藏，眾多冒險者齊聚沙漠，紛紛踏上前往城堡的旅途。 為了守護主人——淫魔王馬爾迪克的寶藏，小淫魔选择與來犯的人類展開戰鬥。

3873760.name: 足球經理：自走棋
3873760.desc: 一款融合收集養成的足球經理遊戲。執教主題球隊，安排訓練、招募與聯賽，並在近即時比賽中使用教練卡指揮攻防，從基層聯賽一路挑戰更高舞台。

3435580.name: Noir Total : Deadly Party
3435580.desc: Noir Total是一款本地多人對戰的2D射擊遊戲。透過手柄震動在黑暗中定位自己，追蹤敵人，收集增益道具並設置陷阱，在最多4名玩家的競技對戰中保持領先。

movies.name: General Trailer Noir Total : Deadly Party / EN

5259730.name: Dub Party
5259730.desc: A voice acting party game: dub any video clip with your friends. Claim the roles, record every line in the booth, then watch the premiere together. On the couch, friends join from their phones while one mic goes round. Online, up to 16 players and five party games.

3681220.name: The Light Switch
3681220.desc: The shadow wants to play with you. It moves quickly, and you have to find it. Be patient, but don't wait too long. Light will be your friend. Don't make the shadow angry.

2017080.name: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
2017080.desc: 《Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2》讓你與迄今為止最龐大、最優秀的格鬥角色陣容一決高下！選擇你最喜愛的鬥士，掌握他們獨特的招式組合，並使用全新的強大超級招式，與朋友聯手或在獨特的 Roguelike 戰役中完成最終一擊！

279900.name: Soul Axiom
279900.desc: From the studio that brought you Master Reboot comes a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. Collect unique hand powers, discover multiple endings and choose your own destiny as you unravel the mystery of your digital afterlife.

102600.name: Orcs Must Die!
102600.desc: Slice them, burn them, skewer them, and launch them - no matter how you get it done, orcs must die in this fantasy action-strategy game from Robot Entertainment.

201790.name: Orcs Must Die! 2
201790.desc: You’ve tossed, burned and sliced them by the thousands – now orcs must die more than ever before! Grab a friend and slay orcs in untold numbers in this sequel to the 2011 AIAS Strategy Game of the Year from Robot Entertainment.

290340.name: Armello
290340.desc: 愛門羅是一款嚴肅且風格奇幻，栩栩如生的棋盤遊戲。充滿著虛張聲勢並結合了深度策略的冒險，戰術性紙牌行動，豐富的棋盤策略與RPG要素。進行史詩般單人模式或多人對戰模式，施放咒術，雇用特務，並且準備好毒藥與計謀來追求寶座任務吧！

584980.name: Late Shift
584980.desc: 《Late Shift》（中译作夜班）是一款全动态影像的犯罪悬疑游戏。游戏讲述一个数学专业的大学生——马特，莫名其妙被卷入一场拍卖所的盗窃中，并试图证明自己的清白。游戏中玩家将会面临一系列的抉择，有些决定甚是微小，但却会导致截然不同的结果。

movies.name: Late Shift - Announcement Trailer HD - New

1522820.name: Orcs Must Die! 3
1522820.desc: 在備受期待的獲獎遊戲系列《Orcs Must Die! 》的續作中，斬殺、焚燒、拋擲與電擊成群的討厭獸人吧。

3975950.name: 逐鹿漢末:三國
3975950.desc: 這款遊戲邀請您來到精彩刺激且充滿變革的東漢末年三國時代，以前所未見的自由、深度及歷史真實性，進行稱霸天下一統中原的征程。

compare.en: Striving for supremacy in the Three Kingdoms

5208460.name: 無基之談2D
