5208460.desc: 宅男蛋蛋一覺醒來，發現自己竟然變成了美少女？《無基之談2D》是一部由原真人互動作品重新繪製、重新演繹的2D視覺小說。跟隨宅男賈胥突如其來的「變身」生活，在室友、朋友與校園日常之間，經歷一段荒誕、輕鬆、曖昧又有點離譜的青春故事。遊戲保留真人版完整配音，並以全新的2D立繪、CG與場景重新呈現。熟悉原作的玩家，可以看看同一個故事換一種畫面會是什麼感覺；第一次接觸，也可以從這裡開始。

5047920.name: Blind Route
5047920.desc: Blind 無法看到路線；他們的隊友必須透過語音描述路線。扮演 Blind 和 Guide，在危險的 3D 障礙賽道中生存下來，並在單人、合作和競技在線模式中領先對手到達終點。

5268180.name: Bannerborn
5268180.desc: Build an unlikely army and push it to absurd extremes. Recruit troops, fuse their abilities, stack powerful upgrades, and watch your plans erupt into battle. Take on a branching fantasy expedition solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

5221200.name: Minefield Mayhem
5221200.desc: Dodge bullets in this new and exciting take on Minesweeper! Collect a variety of power-ups to even the playing field. Play with your friends in online and local multiplayer. You can even brag to you friends using the game's built-in score sharing features.

4959560.name: Wireframe
4959560.desc: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

5423390.name: A Little Soul Among Suns
5423390.desc: Catch drifting stars, solve celestial match-three puzzles and unlock colourful cosmetics across 1,000 levels in this pastel cosmic clicker. Build upgrades, brave black holes and guide a little star soul towards a home, one soft piano note at a time.

4995060.name: The Tally
4995060.desc: A PS2-style life sim about being a small, busy person in a mid-sized city. Get a job, buy a home, pet a dog, make some choices. Every one of them is being counted. You will die in about 90 minutes. Then you get the receipt, and the afterlife sorts you accordingly. A life, itemized.

5409320.name: Gweilo 1886
5409320.desc: Return to Victorian-Era Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest struggling with opium addiction. Your father made the family fortune in the opium trade. Now he’s dead. His letter mentions a jade ring that sends you back home, with a sharp-tongued cat named Xiao and some clearly unfinished family business.

5114030.name: Retro TV Tycoon
5114030.desc: 在《Retro TV Tycoon》中掌舵90年代電視台！購買熱門影集與經典電影版權，編排24小時節目表，簽署高額廣告合約，升級新聞攝影棚並擴展發射網路，徹底稱霸全球電視螢幕！

4332130.name: No Up
4332130.desc: No Up是一款第一人稱3D迷宮遊戲，牆壁和天花板都能成為道路。探索每座迷宮，啟動開關，找到出口。

5452260.name: Meow Dungeon: Idle Cat RPG
5452260.desc: 組好像素貓咪小隊，剩下的就交給牠們！貓咪們會自動戰鬥、一層層往下探索，攻略24座地下城，變得更強並把寶物帶回家。即使關閉遊戲，「看家周回」也會讓冒險繼續。用14種貓咪與18種技能培養隊伍，收集傳說裝備，擴建溫馨的貓客棧。破關故事後，還有無盡的深淵與9貓團戰等著你。4色像素風放置型隊伍RPG。

5338070.name: It Takes One To Gnome It All
5338070.desc: Darkness is spreading through the forest, corrupting everything in its path. And somehow, it's up to you, a small regular gnome, to turn the tides. Fight against the odds and grow stronger while uncovering the secrets behind the corruption.

4688280.name: Desktop Oasis
4688280.desc: 在桌面上，養一片自己的綠洲。打字、工作、學習時慢慢累積靈感，發現植物、船隻、生物和稀有收藏。忙時讓它安靜成長，閒下來收集物件、看看植物，或拖動水上的漂浮物，玩一會兒即時水體物理。

3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
3997770.desc: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

movies.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria Cinematic Trailer

5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
5471970.desc: 堆積如山的文件，正等著你蓋下簽核章。 駁回厚臉皮的「業務開銷」，比對手更拚命，從新人到董事長，一路工作到死為止！

5096660.name: 怪談寺
5096660.desc: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのはとある4人の人物だった。まともな人物はゼロ。もはや語り手のほうが怖い？聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る癖の強い物語たち。VHS風画面短編集邪道ホラーノベルゲーム。

3722820.name: Onlympic Up!
3722820.desc: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

5206500.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
5206500.desc: 宇宙中最具爽快感的三消遊戲！ 連齊三顆寶石，讓它們在璀璨閃耀中瞬間消除。 集滿 HEAT 能量槽，立刻開啟極致的狂熱連擊時刻！ 順利通關並挑選專屬升級卡片，獲得永久能力強化，迎接前方無盡的冒險旅途。

4886710.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
4886710.desc: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

242820.desc: 140是一款抽象豔麗、結合節奏元素的平台動作遊戲。關卡中的障礙物，將隨著澎湃的電子音樂擺動，挑戰你對節奏感的自信。

3432860.name: 異病偵探 Psycho-Sleuth
3432860.desc: 《異病偵探》是一款融合「認知障礙」與「本格推理」的殺人解謎遊戲，玩家將參與一場「殺人不可被發現」的死亡遊戲。13名參賽者皆罹患不同的認知疾病，且這些疾病還能傳染給他人。當凶手以「無法說謊」、「無法感知左側」、「辨識不了人臉」等異常規則犯案時，你能否在時限內找出真正的兇手？

4976270.name: 一個溫暖的故事
4976270.desc: 好像有人在“我”的房間！ 知名作家本葵在深夜中醒來，卻難以入眠…

5250630.name: Punch to Defend
5250630.desc: An incremental tower defense game made with love, bad decisions, beatbox, and questionable amounts of punching. Upgrade your units, survive increasingly stupid waves, and fuse literally everything with literally everything.

2763970.name: 超自然事件
2763970.desc: A 4‑player online co‑op paranormal horror game.Play as paranormal investigators, travel to haunted sites, use ghost‑hunting devices to collect clues, identify ghost types, and dial the correct frequency number to perform exorcism. Cooperate with teammates to finish investigations amid lurking terror

5230360.name: One Night at Kevin's VR
5230360.desc: One Night at Kevin's VR is a VR game that includes 6 mainline nights, 2 challenge nights, original mechanics, a cast of unique characters, and an interesting story to uncover as you survive your shifts at Highes.

movies.name: One Night at Kevin's VR Trailer

5451370.name: Legend of Cina 2
5451370.desc: This game is made from the foundations of Legend of Cina, it's a turn-based strategy game and has 10 stages and 15 OSTs, each map will introduce a new character. The maximum level is 20 and characters can promote after level 10, they can also learn skills once they reach level 5 and 15.

4911350.name: Gods of the Grid
4911350.desc: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelite. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

4795820.name: 夜航船
4795820.desc: 深夜的小巷，她从电台里走到了你面前，从那一刻起声音不再只是声音，它染上了温度，也变得更加沉重。你开始重新审视自己，他人，以及这座县城里被遗忘的烟火与孤独。这是一个关于倾听与理解的漫长航行，在无边的黑暗中，你与她一同探索，寻找那道或许并不存在的光。

4381150.name: Endless Dark
4381150.desc: A first-person survival horror game where you uncover the dark trail of a secretive corporation while searching for your missing sister.

5013580.name: Picrand
5013580.desc: Picrand 是一款功能強大的本機素材管理器，專為畫師、設計師、遊戲開發者、圖片收藏家等使用者打造。瀏覽、收藏、整理、搜尋、分析、參考，一站完成！

5184450.name: Just Kill
5184450.desc: A third person shooter about a detective investigating a police station which has been overtaken by a dangerous gang of bikers, use your quick wits, agility and deadly force to bring order back to the police station

5339950.name: GENNADIYYY
5339950.desc: A third-person comedy puzzle game about a vlogger. Gennady is trying to get through an ordinary evening: get some bread, feed his guests using whatever is in the fridge, and record a calm video.

4971330.name: Depth Charge
4971330.desc: Fate pulls your soul into the orange deep.

5459680.name: 建造太空基地
5459680.desc: 從一座小熔爐開始，逐一搭建模組，建造屬於你的太空基地。僱用工人，讓生產自動運轉，建造人造太陽、艦船與研究設施。透過聲望取得永久能力，在下一輪中更快地成長。

5338650.name: Breakneck Transmission
5338650.desc: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

2492040.name: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
2492040.desc: 時隔26年，《餓狼傳說》再次開始！新搭載了刺激感性的獨自「美術風格」、加速了戰鬥興奮度的「REV系統」。此外，以從初學者到熟練者都能充分享受的2種操作方式為首，也準備了各種新功能和新元素。以充滿慾望的南鎮為舞台，新的「傳說」即將開始。

compare.en: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves

1498570.name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV
1498570.desc: 粉碎！突破想像 突破一切的新生『XV』！

movies.name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV Trailer

5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor
5444410.desc: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.

4873800.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
4873800.desc: 與可愛的貓娘一起解開旋轉拼圖。舒適悠閒、帶有輕度增量成長的遊戲體驗。和貓娘聊天。不知不覺變得更會解謎。做出一些值得懷疑的選擇。解鎖出乎意料地實用的東西。

2540670.name: 秘境守衛軍
2540670.desc: 《秘境守衛軍》是一款3D倖存者遊戲，你將進入一片神秘但充滿危險的土地，你不知自己為何降臨此處，卻有無盡的敵人向你湧來，你要做的只有背水一戰，擊敗敵人，學習強大的新魔法，探索秘境，解鎖更多這裏的秘密。隨著不停戰鬥，你會越來越強，但敵人也是如此！

4453700.name: The Beckoning
4453700.desc: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.

4626180.name: INTERNS
4626180.desc: 一款以醫科實習生為背景的生活模擬遊戲——結交朋友、樹敵、捲入危險的陰謀，並在這個界線模糊的世界中，切勿迷失自我。遊戲中充滿魅力的人物、緊張卻又詼諧的劇情，以及充滿誘惑的真實氛圍。

4640760.name: Rent Out Together
4640760.desc: Run your own property rental business with friends! Renovate and furnish rundown homes, take photos, and list them for rent. Welcome unpredictable guests, earn five-star reviews, and deal with the chaos when they wreck the place. From tiny studios to seaside villas, explore 500+ homes!

5477320.name: Rockburst
5477320.desc: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.

4541310.name: Flirt Simulator
4541310.desc: 忘掉預設選項，讓你的話語主導遊戲！在這款第一人稱戀愛模擬遊戲中，你可以對擁有真實記憶的 AI 角色暢所欲言，獲得自然的回應，每一次都能體驗獨一無二的故事。

5273050.name: Your Friend's Mom 2
5273050.desc: 💕 你的新桌面伴侶，竟然是某位 Steam 好友的媽媽！與她聊天、發展戀情，自由改變她的外觀。玩迷你遊戲、完成拼圖解鎖照片，邀請好友一起線上合作遊玩，挑選喜歡的寵物，還有各種實用工具等你探索！🥵

dlc.name: Your Friend's Mom 2 - Anime Waifu Pack
Your Friend's Mom 2 - Retro Horror Pack

4596170.name: Raid of Lust: Match & Magic
4596170.desc: 沉浸在Raid of Lust: Match & Magic的魔法、SEXY HEROINES和史詩戰鬥的世界中！ ✨ 組裝你的熱辣動漫美女團隊，在match-3幻想RPG中踏上征程！然後在多人遊戲中用PvP和co-op與其他冒險者BATTLE！你能登頂嗎？

5218890.name: Go! Go! Shovelcar!
5218890.desc: 誰說挖土機只能待在工地？操控真實物理驅動的挖土機，體驗撈金魚、做便當、打狸貓、拆房子等荒謬打工！考取執照、自訂機體外觀，還能在沙盒模式中自由開挖！

3981890.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Unstable Towers
3981890.desc: Try to get as high as possible before one of the blocks falls out of the construction zone.

4900110.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳
4900110.desc: 好傢伙，這次可釣到寶了！你竟然釣上了一條笑容迷人的美人魚，但她可不會輕易放你離開。把她拉近，揭開深海秘密，探索 6 種結局，從甜蜜戀愛到更加黑暗的故事。

5435190.name: GomokuZero
5435190.desc: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.

5325220.name: DeskHugs: Desktop Friends
5325220.desc: 創造一個住在桌面上的人類或動物角色，隨心換裝，在工作或聽音樂時有個伴。還能送角色到朋友的螢幕上揮揮手、抱一抱，或送上一份小禮物。永遠免費遊玩，讓溫暖繼續傳遞。

1990250.name: SG Racing
1990250.desc: 四隻動物和一台機器人拿到了賽車。這是個天大的錯誤！《SG Racing》是一款節奏飛快、荒謬爆笑的像素風格街機賽車遊戲，充滿急彎、瘋狂道具，以及極度不負責任的用蛋方式。單人冠軍賽 • 2–4 人本機多人競速 • 透過 STEAM REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER 線上同樂

5437570.name: Cabin Life
5437570.desc: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.

5411310.name: Tiny Havoc
5411310.desc: 化身手握鎚子的小小回收機器人小錫，砸碎箱子，找回被鎖在十座金庫裡的記憶。從寥寥幾個箱子開始，一路演變成閃電、鋸刃與無人機齊飛的大混亂。這是一款約 5–7 小時、擁有真正結局的增量遊戲。

4475970.name: Prerolled
4475970.desc: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

4492500.name: The Cinder Throne
4492500.desc: 灰燼王座是一款Idler RPG，您通過被動地殺死敵人，提升等級，掠奪敵人，改變裝備部件並找到法術。創建強大的協同效應。重生並變得更強。

5463460.name: Veltarum
5463460.desc: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

5160800.name: Find The Needle
5160800.desc: 你有一把鏟子，還有一座大約六百萬根草的草堆。裡面某個地方藏著一根針。徒手把它挖出來、賣掉乾草，再把錢拿去買輸送帶和機器，直到你再也不用自己挖為止。

512790.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts
512790.desc: Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

5076430.name: Wandering Bard
5076430.desc: Carry a song from a quiet tavern to the Grand Concord. Meet townsfolk, earn their trust, build the right set for each crowd and perform on five instrument-themed rhythm boards in a story-rich medieval adventure.

5381260.name: Terrum DeepDrill
5381260.desc: Terrum DeepDrill is a single-player drilling game in a 2.5D side view. Terrum Corp owns your debt and calls it a contract. Win tenders against rival firms, drill through the rock, and haul enough ore to stay ahead of the bill.

4982580.name: 3 Estrellas
4982580.desc: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!

5289190.name: VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG
5289190.desc: VALHALLA ARCHIVE is a tactical fantasy CCG where matches are decided in 5 turns. Deploy a 20-card deck across front and back rows, master 3 unique win conditions, and conquer the roguelite 'Dimensional Corridor'. Harness unpredictable Mana Rifts and claim your place as the ultimate Archivist!

5472000.name: Cloverstead
5472000.desc: Your grandpa is giving you his old farm! Clean it up, plant vegetables, take care of the animals, and make friends in the small village of Lindenau. Go fishing, explore caves, and help the village fight back against a big scheme from the city. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

5484510.name: INTERNS - Wallpapers Pack
5484510.desc: This DLC contains various wallpapers for your PC desktop. It includes: story arts, backgrounds and h-scenes. To get this DLC you must own base game

5484500.name: INTERNS - Artbook
5484500.desc: This DLC contains Digital Artbook about the process of creating a game Interns. It shows sketches, early developments and more detailed info about characters. To get this DLC you must own main game.

5405270.name: Słownikowa Wyspa
5405270.desc: Słownikowa Wyspa is a Polish-language educational adventure game. Join Mizuki on a journey across a mysterious island, solve word puzzles, explore unique locations, collect missing book pages, and discover fascinating facts in an illustrated encyclopedia.

5472270.name: Backrooms Found Hentai
5472270.desc: 最扣人心弦的恐怖遊戲。在惡靈找到你之前，找到所有照片。

4646360.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
4646360.desc: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

755980.name: DEPLOYMENT
755980.desc: DEPLOYMENT is a fast-paced top-down arena shooter featuring five unique classes, randomly generated battlefields, tactical turret control, and intense multiplayer combat. Challenge real players or fight against AI bots in action-packed battles.

5455560.name: Command Base Assault
5455560.desc: Ten fortresses, one river, five against five. Build your base, train an army of up to a hundred units and break the enemy HQs with your team in fast real-time strategy battles. Free to play, with cross-play between PC, iPhone and Android.

4590950.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
4590950.desc: 以「El Shaddai」世界觀打造、每枚棋子都擁有 HP 的黑白棋。棋子每被翻轉一次就會變弱，HP 歸零即消失。收錄兩種模式：獨自解鎖 40 篇以上故事的「經典」，以及運用角色能力與世界各地玩家對戰的「線上」。

4755250.name: ROMUL
4755250.desc: ROMUL 是一款搭載人工智慧的合作戰利品恐怖遊戲。與一台具備語音控制和完整人工智慧的機器人一起，探索重力不穩定的廢棄太空站。從怪物之中活下來，拍攝目標點，並帶出珍貴貨物。

5404190.name: Bomb Disposal
5404190.desc: 觸摸解謎模擬遊戲。一枚新型炸彈上綁著一名女性,她的心率與引爆裝置連動。請解除遍布她全身的束縛與任務,讓她達到高潮,從而拆除炸彈。隨著關卡推進,束縛器具不斷增加,拆除手段也越發大膽。收錄3段動畫獎勵場景和2種結局,預計通關時間約30分鐘,並附帶畫廊模式。能否讓她平安生還,就看你的了。

3010300.name: One-Hour Hero
3010300.desc: A compact 2.5D pixel-art, turn-based JRPG designed to be completed in about an hour. Train as a hero, explore White Mountain, learn new skills, collect gear, and fight beside your companion on the road to the Dragon King.

5172830.name: Little Cat Goes Fishing
5172830.desc: This is a relaxing and cozy auto-fishing game. Choose your character, prepare your fishing rod, cast your line, watch the fish bite, collect your catches, and build your own fishing journey step by step.

2842720.name: ToonSouls Maker
2842720.desc: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.

4189160.name: On Love, On Monsters
4189160.desc: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

movies.name: On Love, On Monsters: Official Trailer

5201710.name: 研究生模拟器：毕业倒计时
5201710.desc: Read papers, build your thesis, join competitions, and manage stress, advisors, and peers. Meet your goals in 48 weeks and graduate with dignity.

5375770.name: Mox Nox
5375770.desc: 化身最後的收割者，在以殘酷劍術與超自然力量為核心的黑暗奇幻動作 RPG 中浴血奮戰。精通完美招架，以閃避銜接反擊，召喚幻影，撕碎追殺你血脈的聯盟。奪取敵人的靈魂、變得更強，奪回與生俱來的權利。

movies.name: Mox Nox: Early Access Launch Trailer
Mox Nox: Early Access Combat Compilation

4763220.name: ONE SKILL - Drive or Fall
4763220.desc: Test your skills on various platforms and obstacles built high in the sky! Master your driving as you maneuver through thrilling challenges and perilous situations to reach the finish line.

5490870.name: Horochi's Challenge
5490870.desc: Change gravity in six directions and guide crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Choose any of 100 stages from the start. EXTRA HARD adds XOR gates, water controls and floating platforms in larger mazes. Team up with Meguru and Bimba to earn minimum-move medals!

5335100.name: Halloween 2026
5335100.desc: It's Halloween night. The parents are out until midnight, and you're the babysitter. All you have to do is keep the porch light on and hand out candy.

5371810.name: Cozy Tent
5371810.desc: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

5494940.name: Yokai Night Bazaar
5494940.desc: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.

1222670.name: The Sims™ 4
1222670.desc: 享受在虛擬世界裡創造及控制人們的無上權力。 感受恣意控制的力量與自由、愉快玩樂，遊戲人生！

5312950.name: Lightkeeper: Frozen Bay
5312950.desc: You are the keeper of a lighthouse on a frozen northern island. Keep the lamp lit, the stove fed and the car fueled. And when the storm comes, don't step out where the light can't reach: a wendigo walks the island at night. And it is listening.

5323250.name: Starfall Defense
5323250.desc: 《星隕防線》是一款融合遠古神話與星際科幻的實時聯機策略塔防遊戲。部署盤古、哪吒、女媧、共工等傳奇神話英雄，構築六大職業羈絆與職業矩陣，抵禦潮水般的異星魔物圍攻！遊戲支持雙人在線合作守家與實時天梯對抗，免費開玩，體驗純粹的戰術搭配與清屏快感！

5100640.name: LYRA MAHJONG MANAGER
5100640.desc: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.

4643110.name: Garden Of Being
4643110.desc: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

movies.name: Garden Of Being - Steam Teaser - Trailer

4708030.name: Hamstr Protocol
4708030.desc: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.

3908970.name: Shit Coin Miner
3908970.desc: Mine every Shit Coin in the world.

4961250.name: みならい王子のみならい防衛
4961250.desc: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

5174600.name: ONE STEP WAR
5174600.desc: 《一步之戰》是一款現代極簡風格的戰術棋盤遊戲。不同棋子具有不同效果，創造出有意義的戰術選擇。遊戲包含標準戰鬥、戰役謎題和Roguelite遠征模式。

4621940.name: Leviticus
4621940.desc: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

4684790.name: Vossarium
4684790.desc: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

5389650.name: EVO RNG
5389650.desc: EVO RNG 是一款拉霸機式上帝模擬遊戲——選擇生物、按下轉動，看著你的生態系統自行狩獵、合併與進化。收集生物，追逐賠付線、食物鏈和神話生物。本遊戲不含任何真實貨幣賭博元素。

5403380.name: One More Piece
5403380.desc: 弟弟把你的玩具積木亂壓成一坨坨醜醜的團塊，丟在你的書桌上。把它們拆開，照著盒子上的圖案把每塊零件分好類，再跟著說明書拼出可愛的作品，每一步都會像小動畫一樣動起來。再拼一塊就好……

5465870.name: ゾンビ盛り！
5465870.desc: Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores! Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection. The higher you stack, the higher you score!

movies.name: ゾンビ盛り！ - 公式トレーラー

5312920.name: TCG Card Market Simulator
5312920.desc: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.

5087290.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber
5087290.desc: The unemployed Louis Thompson accidentally catches a glimpse of the private moments of his neighbor, Holly Phillips, through the surveillance. The two then fall into a forbidden love, while mysterious nano-insects quietly set their sights on them.

movies.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber

dlc.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber-DLC

4774370.name: 健身小狗
4774370.desc: 《健身小狗》是一款獸人題材的戀愛敘事遊戲，融合桌面掛機與視覺小說的玩法，在陪伴中見證主角從身體到內心的成長與蛻變

4901540.name: Brick Buddies
4901540.desc: 拿起一塊積木，拼出一個小世界。在這款溫馨的積木組裝遊戲裡，跟著說明書組裝、貼上貼紙，收集新的作品。獨自享受悠閒時光，或和朋友一起豐富收藏吧。

4978080.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal
4978080.desc: 將花色或點數相同的牌串連起來，規劃出牌順序，搭配道具，打出爆炸性的高分。在這款單人卡牌遊戲中，走進魔王醬的賭場，翻轉負債累累的人生。

3549030.name: 无尽地下城
3549030.desc: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

movies.name: Learn Every Class Skill | Romance Every Companion

402060.name: Californium
402060.desc: Taking the form of a first-person experience of a bad trip, Californium pays homage to sci-fi legend Philip K. Dick by transporting you into the life of a writer searching for his own identity. Explore, solve the riddles and conduct your investigation. Will you find what’s behind the simulacra ?

fullgame.name: 阿西, 美女室友竟然...？2

4745180.name: 阿西, 美女室友竟然...？2 : 冬日之旅 DLC
4745180.desc: 「明明我才是房東！為什麼整天像個傭人一樣被使喚啊！！」 被無止盡的打掃、洗碗和跑腿折磨到崩潰，忍無可忍的吳宥萬決定離家出走。 正當他以為終於重獲自由的時候—— 卻接連意外遇見秀智、久梨、有情； 室友們也開始四處尋找宥萬，全新的故事就此拉開序幕。 來迎接全新的戀愛故事與結局吧！

4920280.name: 喵呜风云
4920280.desc: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
4258970.desc: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

movies.name: 爬行桌宠 for Beta Testing

4861910.name: Pin-Finite
4861910.desc: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game. Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!

4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty
4947250.desc: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

1859550.name: Raise
1859550.desc: 從墳墓中起身，在這款精簡的第三人稱類魂遊戲中磨礪意志。迎戰不死生物與頭目，提升角色等級，挑戰計時競技場。每次受擊都會增加用時，成功招架則能縮短成績。熟悉敵人的動作、優化戰鬥節奏，不斷刷新個人紀錄，並在Steam排行榜上一較高下。

5465850.name: FLUX CIRCUIT
5465850.desc: 在16條賽道上體驗高速反重力競速。與15名對手同場較勁，征服傾斜彎道、垂直環道與飛躍路段，管理能量並掌握加速時機。解鎖12款各具特色的賽車，爭奪四項大獎賽盃賽的冠軍。

5279740.name: Claim Me After the Hurricane
5279740.desc: Four days after Hurricane Honora, catastrophe adjuster Arlo Fontenot arrives on powerless Corvina Key to make fast, final calls. Choose between three divergent romance routes as Vivienne, Tess, and Poppy force him to confront what he owes the island—and them.

5476770.name: 武装囚犯: 叁
5476770.desc: Armed Prisoner III 是一款以 Bot AI 電子小人使用現代槍械互相射擊打架為主要核心內容玩法的 2D 休閒增量掛機電子鬥蛐蛐小遊戲，戰鬥隨機、混亂、無限時

5463910.name: Gсhat
5463910.desc: A free messenger for friends, communities and teams. Chats, voice and video calls, voice rooms you can drop into anytime, screen sharing, community servers with roles, and a task board for your team. One account on PC and phone. Sign in with Steam.

3347830.name: HitTube
3347830.desc: HitTube is a 1-4 player horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

5473100.name: Ancient World Demo
5473100.desc: 體驗 Ancient World 免費試玩版，在開放世界沙漠中展開充滿劇情的生存冒險。收集資源、製作工具、探索古老遺跡、與哥布林戰鬥，並在充滿危險與謎團的世界中，踏上尋找失蹤妹妹的旅程。

5359660.name: StackOver
5359660.desc: 疊起來，等等，再疊高一點！ 在有限空間內投放各種物體，並儘可能高且平穩地將它們堆疊起來。 在堆疊時考慮物體的重量、平衡和碰撞問題，並使用各種增強機制來克服危險時刻。

2735560.name: Da Bridge Troll
2735560.desc: 在這款類Rogue生存模擬中，你將作為一位狡猾——或貪婪——的巨魔統治你的橋。吃掉、收稅或放行旅人，在飢餓、貪慾與聲望之間取得平衡，選擇成為令人畏懼的掠食者……或受人景仰的橋之守護者。

5469310.name: Haste Makes Waste
5469310.desc: 白手起家，親手裝卸最初的貨物。雇用並訓練員工，加掛車廂，擴建車站與倉庫。在這款鐵路題材的放置遊戲中，觀察貨物流動，找出瓶頸，選擇最能改善營運的升級。

4863180.name: Defend The HexCore
4863180.desc: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

4184810.name: 槍乳酪外星人
4184810.desc: 建造並自動化你的前哨站以在敵人浪潮中生存。使用強大的槍械戰鬥，建造城牆、陷阱、農場和工廠，招募單位防守你的基地，並在每次遊玩之間升級他們——否則當他們死亡時將永遠失去。

movies.name: Steam Next Fest Trailer 枪，奶酪，外星人

2806540.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
2806540.desc: 用這本藏滿貓咪的精彩降臨曆，讓聖誕倒數更加甜蜜！這是一款適合全家輕鬆遊玩的找貓遊戲，出自 Travellin Cats，爆紅找貓遊戲的原創開發者！

1227690.name: Severed Steel
1227690.desc: 獨具風格、發自肺腑的單人 FPS 遊戲，同時還搭配了流動特效系統、可破壞的立體像素環境、超多射擊時間、獨特的單手主角，還有黑暗的電子配樂。

966670.name: The Wanderer: Frankenstein’s Creature
966670.desc: Experience the Myth of Frankenstein through the innocent eyes of his creature. Make decisions and change people's view that you will meet on your way. Now, the myth is in your hands, so how are you going to end it?

446800.name: Transport Fever
446800.desc: Transport Fever is a railroad-focused tycoon game. Players start in 1850 and build up a thriving transport company. As an emerging transport tycoon, the player constructs stations, airports, harbors and makes money by connecting areas requiring transport services. Build up your own Empire!

3748520.name: SPRAWL zero
3748520.desc: 快節奏的射擊遊戲《SPRAWL zero》靈感源自黃金2000年代的第一人稱射擊遊戲。在因軍政府統治和狂熱邪教崇拜而逐漸瓦解的殘酷賽博龐克城市中，玩家必須設法生存。利用引力手套、加成和包含40多種武器的軍火庫，擊垮礙事的敵人。

1933000.name: Luna Abyss
1933000.desc: 《Luna Abyss》是一款劇情導向的單人動作冒險遊戲，玩家將駕馭流暢的平台跳躍動作，投身彈幕交錯的戰鬥場景。追隨月球囚徒 Fawkes 的足跡，在難解預言和流放判決之間掙扎求生。

1066780.name: Transport Fever 2
1066780.desc: 經典的運輸模擬類遊戲 Transport Fever 2 有了新的黃金標準。駕駛於陸、海、空運輸路線來探索全新的世界。願進步與繁榮能找到出路！

1709700.name: How to Say Goodbye
1709700.desc: How to Say Goodbye is a beautiful narrative puzzle game inspired by picture books. Reorganize the environment and solve puzzles to help a group of ghosts on their quest to finally move on.

3629430.name: 淵舟蝕影 | DREADMOOR
3629430.desc: DREADMOOR 是一款黑暗風格的第一人稱釣魚冒險遊戲，背景設定在一個因過往災難而滿目瘡痍的沉沒世界。 在渾濁的水域中垂釣，升級你的船隻，製作生存裝備，並對抗潛伏於水下與陸地上的怪物生物。

13500.name: Prince of Persia: Warrior Within™
13500.desc: Enter the dark underworld of Prince of Persia Warrior Within, the sword-slashing sequel to the critically acclaimed Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time™. Hunted by Dahaka, an immortal incarnation of Fate seeking divine retribution, the Prince embarks upon a path of both carnage and mystery to defy his preordained death.

movies.name: Prince of Persia Warrior Within™ Trailer

3314690.name: Cardalaxy
3314690.desc: 4X distilled into a card game with 5 different ways to win.

3936340.name: Hell Wait
3936340.desc: HELL WAIT 是混合Roguelike牌組構築元素的日本麻雀。利用鬼牌來強化你的牌型，然後打一場賭上手指的麻雀吧！

2385930.name: Gnart's Escape
2385930.desc: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

4916560.name: 便利商店倖存者
4916560.desc: 可疑的連鎖便利商店 SHIFT24。隨著夜色漸深，古怪的顧客源源不絕地湧來。泡麵、零食、咖啡，店裡隨手拿得到的東西，全都能變成武器。擊敗顧客的過程中，你會逐漸發現藏在世界各地分店裡的可疑線索。循著線索，一步步償還債務，SHIFT24 的真相也將逐漸揭曉。

4576490.name: 未知傷亡
4576490.desc: 《生死難判》是一款殘酷的洞穴探險生存模擬遊戲。身為俘虜的玩家以取回遺失貨物的藉口，受指派前往一顆陌生的星球。你得深入探索星球 11 層的不同地景，用盡所有辦法在難以想像的惡劣環境生存下去。才知你不過是成千上萬被送到這裡來試死的實驗對象之一。

2869560.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
2869560.desc: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.

4145780.name: Abracademia
4145780.desc: 成為一名魔法師，而且還是那種超厲害的魔法師！ 「魔咒學院」是一款溫馨又療癒的魔法師放置生活模擬遊戲，會常駐在你的螢幕上，陪你度過工作或遊玩時光。 選擇你的魔法師公會，安排每日生活，學習咒語，交朋友，展開冒險，並通過考試，一步步邁向畢業之路。

2532010.name: Territorial Hissing
2532010.desc: Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Something smells fishy. Save your home in this comedy adventure!

5116480.name: Ward Nine
5116480.desc: A first-person psychological horror game set in a derelict asylum in 1991. Search Ward Nine for five patient files while the Warden hunts you through the dark. Hide, ration your flashlight, and hold on to your sanity. No two players are given the same asylum.

4515500.name: Seferia Matrix
4515500.desc: 骰子 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲——用 Lock & Roll 擲出五顆骰子施放法術，再靠 300 多種強化讓傷害爆炸！

5153220.name: UFO98
5153220.desc: UFO98 是一款基於獨立 Win98 桌面環境的復古增量模擬遊戲。解密加密的外星訊號，洩漏絕密檔案，反抗壓迫性政府，喚醒全人類以揭示真相。

5307520.name: DREADMOOR Supporter Pack
5307520.desc: 此內容需要 Steam 上的基礎遊戲 DREADMOOR 才能遊玩。

4874380.name: 營地·遠征
4874380.desc: 奇幻放置型 RPG。經營營地、招募英雄，讓自動戰鬥替你出征。每場戰鬥刷取裝備與素材，強化、附魔、自訂詞條，鍛造專屬強力裝備，一關一關征服邊境！

4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun
4088360.desc: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

movies.name: Funeral for the Sun - Release Date Trailer

4611240.name: Music Manager
4611240.desc: 簽下藝人、培養人才、發行音樂，並在 1952 至 2026 年間引領職涯穿越巡演、音樂節與不斷變化的潮流。

5017960.name: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
5017960.desc: Run a corporate office in Hell. Hire, customize, and assign imployees, reject petty sinners, automate absurd punishments, and climb the infernal corporate ladder in this comedic incremental management game.

5472780.name: 絕世神劍
5472780.desc: 在鍛劍工坊把各式各樣的主劍與配件自由拼裝成獨一無二的飛劍，替每一把劍畫出劍意的飛行軌跡，再佈下陣容迎擊一波波來襲的怪物。主線之後還有試煉塔、劍塚、無盡模式，以及親自移動劍匣、一路升級組劍的劍途模式——連尖叫雞都能當劍。

5447060.name: Card Heroes: Rune Deck
5447060.desc: Fantasy turn-based card battler. Time your charges, chain five-element counters and rage-fueled ultimates. Conquer 15 dungeons across three difficulty tiers, brave the trial tower, duel a ranked arena, collect 541 cards and become the Rune Master.

3983230.name: The Cubiw Dungeon
3983230.desc: A free-to-play roguelike where a cube shoots to more cubes, explore the complex, find crazy combos, fight exciting bosses and dodge the thousands of projectiles than your enemies have prepared for you!

3041250.name: Remember Us Demo
3041250.desc: 「你是誰？」這是相愛五十年後，最令人心碎的一句話。Remember Us 是一段感人的旅程，你將努力找回 Dean 遺失的記憶，讓他重新認出自己的妻子。

5130930.name: Dice Mate: Desktop Dice Roller
5130930.desc: Desktop mate application that gives you dice for your needs right on your desktop. You can choose dice type, look and size and roll them whenever you want

fullgame.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG

4825990.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG Demo
4825990.desc: Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator.

4701880.name: Vida:Unslain - History Dungeons
4701880.desc: A standalone bonus dungeon that offers a different perspective from the main game.

5324310.name: 1999トコヨビル Soundtrack
5324310.desc: Featuring all 25 tracks that bring the world of "1999TOKOYO Building" to life. From the main theme of TOKOYO Building, an indoor amusement park on the verge of closing in 1999, to themes for its shady staff, enjoy nostalgic yet subtly unsettling music that evokes the era.

5256440.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN Soundtrack
5256440.desc: Celebrate the holidays with this free mini-soundtrack pack for HO HO HO SOKOBAN! Features the 2 festive original tracks composed by Joshua Liljeblad.

4987630.name: Billionth Soul
4987630.desc: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder. The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

4990720.name: Billionth Soul Soundtrack
4990720.desc: Listen to the music of Billionth Soul, from Main Menu and First Thaw to Galactic Empire and Danger. Includes all 12 game music tracks as tagged MP3s, totaling approximately 22 minutes 45 seconds. Included with purchase of Billionth Soul at no additional cost.

5427570.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男
5427570.desc: 一款以日本便利商店為舞台的第一人稱恐怖遊戲。深夜，你獨自值夜班。馬路對面，每晚都有一名男子站在那裡，直盯著你看。隨著怪事接連發生，你將追查一名過去失蹤的店員所留下的謎團。

4959600.name: Path to Catakombs
4959600.desc: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

415200.name: Motorsport Manager
415200.desc: 擔任頂尖賽車團隊的經理。 《Motorsport Manager》是賽車迷夢寐以求的高規格管理遊戲。你可以雇用車手，打造車輛，沈浸在賽車瞬息萬變的動態世界。 想奪得冠軍頭銜，就必須詳盡考慮每個細節。不僅要事先準備縝密規劃，賽道上也得當機立斷。從打造自訂賽車，到比賽當天的戰略，每個環節都會影響最終成績。你有可能迎向最終的勝利或者狠狠墊底。 別再光看不做，現在就管理你自己的賽車團隊，技壓全場，拿下冠軍寶座。

3230340.name: Wayfinder - Critical Role Supporter Pack
3230340.desc: 尋路者迎來機械之聲的世界！關鍵角色支援者包可解鎖超過 30 件外觀物品，讓您將埃山德里亞的世界帶到艾維諾。購買此禮包即直接支援尋路者與關鍵角色，繼續為玩家和發燒友創造精彩紛呈的體驗！

992171.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ - Videl
992171.desc: Videl, the daughter of Mr. Satan, joins the fight. Watch out! The Great Saiyaman is here to back her up! This content includes: • Videl as a new playable character • 5 alternative colors for her outfit • Videl Lobby Avatar • Videl Z Stamp

2584270.name: Mortal Shell II
2584270.desc: 他們的血肉就是你的武器。《Mortal Shell II》是一款獨立續作動作角色扮演遊戲其中包含滿滿的刺激和困難的戰鬥。附身在強大的戰士身上、擊敗假神並拯救這個破敗的世界。

movies.name: Mortal Shell II Official Gameplay Reveal Short
Mortal Shell II Rotten Autumn Trailer

475550.name: Beholder
475550.desc: 你是一名在極權社會中被政府安插的樓管。你必須監視房客，偷窺、偷聽並為房客建立檔案！你報告任何會違法或密謀顛覆政府的人。你必須！但你會嗎？

3405690.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26
3405690.desc: 在《EA SPORTS FC™ 26》中，以前所未有的方式體驗「The World's Game」。在 48 隊國際錦標賽模式中爭奪最高榮耀，挑戰主題領隊即時挑戰，並在球員職業生涯模式中啟用新的國際超級球星和英雄。

movies.name: EA SPORTS FC 26 | The World's Game - Trailer
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 | Official Reveal Trailer

1245620.name: 艾爾登法環
1245620.desc: 艾爾登法環是以正統黑暗奇幻世界為舞台的動作RPG遊戲。 走進遼闊的場景與地下迷宮探索未知，挑戰困難重重的險境，享受克服困境時的成就感吧。 不僅如此，登場角色之間的利害關係譜成的群像劇，更是不容錯過。

movies.name: ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree - Gameplay Reveal Trailer

5204140.name: a strange journey into the backrooms
5204140.desc: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

movies.name: Trailer: a strange journey into the backrooms

5380650.name: VOXFRAG
5380650.desc: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.

5311120.name: 寻宝地下城
5311120.desc: A free adventure idle single-player hero game where you defeat enemies, collect treasures, challenge dungeon bosses, enhance equipment, and forge your own combat style. With hundreds of talents to choose from, Please note that it is entirely in Chinese and not in English

5175310.name: 我帶過的最差一屆
5175310.desc: 最多支援8人連線的非對稱派對遊戲！1名玩家化身嚴格老師，對上其他7名玩家扮演的屁孩學生。學生們要混進數十名乖乖牌NPC之中，趁老師不注意，偷吃零食、偷滑手機，完成各種惡作劇任務；而老師要從人群裡把這些搗蛋鬼通通揪出來，守住課堂秩序！

5097530.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
5097530.desc: 按你組建的方式行動，按你組建的方式取勝。只憑你的設計來戰鬥的機體對戰。 組裝全高18cm的自律型模型機體「希格諾斯」，以流程圖式的「思考圖塊」構建行動邏輯。戰鬥中無需任何操作。希格諾斯只依循你所設計的邏輯，自動進行戰鬥。

5345780.name: 方塊妹妹
5345780.desc: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

5056320.name: Fantorob
5056320.desc: Fantorob is a futuristic take on classic monster-taming genre. Build robots and fight against your opponents to collect components and upgrade your team in this thrilling turn-based combat RPG with brain-twisting puzzles. Join the journey to become the greatest robot master!

5058180.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase
5058180.desc: 《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》 is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners. An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.

5036510.name: Kreabordis
5036510.desc: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

4841210.name: Coliseum Slap
4841210.desc: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.

4842910.name: Terrablox
4842910.desc: A voxel-based virtual tabletop with full 3D building, movement, and fog-of-war. Place voxels in any color with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc. Import any image as custom standees. Detailed GM control over player vision, teams, dice, and more!

4217650.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
4217650.desc: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

movies.name: Tome of Talis Release Date Trailer

4423270.name: Takeover 2
4423270.desc: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

5398160.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
5398160.desc: Gopher It 是一款第一人稱溫馨職場模擬遊戲。你是一間滿是動物的辦公室裡最新來的實習生。有人叫你，你就過去幫忙：影印、泡咖啡、送信，還有一張要傳給大家簽名的生日卡。可以單人遊玩，也可以和最多三位好友一起玩。沒有時間限制，也沒有 Game Over。

4010820.name: Eye of Darkness
4010820.desc: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.

4879470.name: A Needle In a Haystack
4879470.desc: Search a persistent hay pile with millions of candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.

4634660.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
4634660.desc: 1-6 人合作生存恐怖遊戲。錄下你真實的尖叫，當它帶走你時，這段尖叫會響起。探索程序生成的森林，直面恐懼將它逼退，在森林決定留下你之前逃出去。

movies.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind - Official Trailer

5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
5391510.desc: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

5345650.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
5345650.desc: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox and master melee, shield, or rune abilities; shape each two-stage, sixteen-area expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart and the Rift Warden with friends in online co-op or with AI companions.

4215660.name: TORAWASE ～被囚禁的偽妃夢寐以求的幸福～
4215660.desc: 在這款由Dark One！製作的視覺小說中，未婚妻因為工作而返回日本之後，主角開始夢見自己變成中世紀的女性。這樣的夢反覆出現，他在現實中的身體也漸漸變成女性。這種變化能否恢復？或者，他的人生將迎來新的轉折？

4934400.name: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator
4934400.desc: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

5232160.name: 鼠有餘地
5232160.desc: 移動形態各異的貓咪滑塊，讓每行每列都恰好留下一個空格。認識 40 隻可愛貓咪，並在 120 個充滿挑戰的關卡中考驗你的解謎本領。

2319360.name: Memento Dawn
2319360.desc: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.

5111280.name: Dear My Son
5111280.desc: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

4575700.name: Vida:Unslain
4575700.desc: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

4351380.name: 脫毛沙龍模擬器
4351380.desc: 開一間男士除毛沙龍！親手用雷射燒掉客人的體毛，盯緊疼痛值，再看客人的預算推銷保養方案。靠好評吸引新客人，把賺來的錢拿去升級設備、請店員，讓街角小店成為全城猛男的除毛聖地！

movies.name: リリース日発表トレーラー

4626050.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
4626050.desc: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

4380710.name: 克隆格鬥
4380710.desc: 3D 美少女換裝格鬥，在對戰中獲得 DNA，解鎖招式與服裝。本遊戲具備街機格鬥遊戲的操作手感，搭配原創格鬥系統，帶來爽快的無限連招與反無限連體驗。

501590.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
501590.desc: Step into the boots of Grayson Hunt after a crash landing on an old resort planet forces him to make a hard choice: survival or revenge. Execute masterful kills with Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition’s unique combat system that rewards you for performing the most creative and deadly kills imaginable.

movies.name: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition Accolades Trailer - PEGI
Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition Story Trailer - PEGI

252130.name: Divide By Sheep
252130.desc: Divide By Sheep is a mind-bending math puzzler about friendship and slicing sheep in half with lasers. The Grim Reaper flooded the world, and it's up to you to save critters stranded on islands. Insane math skills required.

movies.name: Divide By Sheep Press Quotes Trailer

1161490.name: MotoGP™20
1161490.desc: 今年就來體驗史上最完整的管理生涯模式帶來的所有刺激內容，並盡情享受新的技術改良項目和遊戲畫面吧。自訂您的摩托車和賽車服！與MotoGP™傳奇車手一較高下，或是在線上向好友發起挑戰！

598550.name: HUNTDOWN
598550.desc: In the mayhem-filled streets of the future where criminal gangs rule and cops fear to tread, only the bounty hunters can free the city from the corrupt fist of felony. Lay waste to the criminal underworld and make a killing in this hard boiled action comedy arcade shooter.

207140.name: SpeedRunners
207140.desc: Cut-throat multiplayer running game that pits 4 players against each other, locally and/or online. Run, jump, swing around, and use devious weapons and pick-ups to knock opponents off-screen! One of the most competitive games you'll ever play.

505640.name: Antihero
505640.desc: Run a Thieves Guild in a gas-lit Victorian city! Antihero is a fast-paced digital board game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory.

477770.name: Ride 2
477770.desc: The fastest and most iconic bikes in the world's biggest digital garage!

523780.name: Emily is Away Too
523780.desc: Emily is Away Too is a brand new story featuring new characters and multiple different endings. Message your friends, surf the web and choose your path through this branching narrative.

917840.name: Wintermoor Tactics Club
917840.desc: Wintermoor Tactics Club is a story about surviving high school, with gameplay inspired by tactics RPGs and visual novels.

1203710.name: UnMetal
1203710.desc: UnMetal is a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base using his wits and fists.

1924360.name: Lil' Guardsman
1924360.desc: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

movies.name: Lil' Guardsman Release Date Announcement Trailer (Spanish)

1383250.name: Please Fix The Road
1383250.desc: Please Fix The Road是一款色彩鮮豔、簡約、悠閒的休閒益智遊戲，而你顯然是在修路！你的修路不一定要漂亮，只要能完成任務就可以了！所以請修理道路，享受樂趣！你的媽媽也會喜歡這個遊戲的！

1610460.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 5
1610460.desc: 快握好摩托車的把手，因為本系列的新章節終於到來了。試試 Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 5，探究室內 Supercross 的精髓！

compare.en: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 5

397060.name: Faeria
397060.desc: 具備特殊的靈活戰場，Faeria 帶你挑戰真正的策略卡牌戰鬥。快來合成牌組、在戰場上運籌帷幄，並為勝利而戰吧！

403940.name: Dungelot: Shattered Lands
403940.desc: Dungelot: Shattered Lands takes you on an epic roguelike dungeon-crawler adventure to defeat zombie cows, splat giant evil mushrooms, and generally get back home in one piece. Deceptively simple, ever so addictive.

507490.name: Ashes of the Singularity: Escalation
507490.desc: A massive-scale real-time strategy game where you command entire armies on a dynamic battlefield. Conquer multiple worlds across several single-player campaigns; or play with your friends in multiplayer combat.

210970.name: The Witness
210970.desc: 你獨自一人在一座陌生的島嶼醒來，島上充滿各種令人意想不到的謎題，等你來挑戰。

1599020.name: Tinykin
1599020.desc: Catch hundreds of tinykin and use their unique powers to bring Milo back to his home planet and back to normal size!

397950.name: Clustertruck
397950.desc: Clustertruck is a chaotic physics based truckformer. Jump your way through insane levels in a game of "the floor is lava" on top of speeding trucks driven by terrible drivers.

2638080.name: Annihilated
2638080.desc: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

4618570.name: Booster Pack Heroes
4618570.desc: 拆開強化卡包，抽出你的下一位閃光英雄！《Booster Pack Heroes》是一款增量遊戲，每一個卡包都可能藏著你的下一位強力英雄。抵禦源源不絕湧向主塔的魔物，一路殺穿各個位面。

5446260.name: Lestvitsa
5446260.desc: Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of early 2000s Russia as you investigate the theft of a city relic. Interact with unique characters, make difficult decisions, and find your path. Save your hometown or feed it to the fiends.

5479230.name: 打工环游记
5479230.desc: Work, travel and build a life across five seaside cities. Take on jobs, explore neighborhoods, meet locals and enjoy an anime-style 3D life simulation as you search for an old friend.

4933810.name: 阿可與小白：大戰污染獸
4933810.desc: 這是一款結合了積木構築與Roguelite探索的自動戰鬥策略遊戲。你將選擇並控制不同的角色，探索隨機生成的迷宮地圖，通過收集和組合擁有不同屬性的「戰鬥積木」與具有特殊效果的「傳說積木」來強化角色。遊戲包含數十種敵人、獨特的角色腐化系統以及多結局劇情，每個角色和怪物的組合都有對應的戰敗CG，為你帶來常玩常新的策略挑戰。

movies.name: 阿可与小白大战污染兽
Akuro And Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters

4546340.name: One More Adventure
4546340.desc: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

5501550.name: The Little Cloud
5501550.desc: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

3172570.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
3172570.desc: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets in this 3D vehicular platformer.

5047230.name: Combustor
5047230.desc: Gas reaction simulator. Build the ultimate jet engine, solve puzzles, or just make everything explode!

3124570.name: Crosshair Overlay
3124570.desc: Design your own crosshair and see it in the centre of your screen in any game, drawn by Xbox Game Bar. Shape it with sliders or draw it pixel by pixel, animate it, and switch, hide or trigger animations with global hotkeys. Nothing is injected into the game.

5499630.name: Muscle Quest: The Swole Ones
5499630.desc: An idle RPG where muscle solves everything. Five ripped heroes who gave up on magic and swordplay smash through swarms of monsters. Enhance your gear, keep training, and push through 160 dungeons. Then take your muscles to the top of the world leaderboards.

5174560.name: Motive Power
5174560.desc: Run British Railways' locomotive fleet from 1955 to 1994. Order the classes history built — or take your own choices. Manage overhauls, depots, budgets and withdrawals across four decades, and answer for it in a graded annual report against the real record. Deterministic, deeply researched.

4963430.name: Lost Crystal Adventure
4963430.desc: When mysterious changes begin to affect the kingdom, the king summons a young adventurer to Xenopolis and entrusts them with a quest that could decide the realm’s fate. Journey through dangerous lands and uncover the secrets surrounding the crystal. What awaits you on the road ahead?

3014860.name: Icy Tower
3014860.desc: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

5100980.name: The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier
5100980.desc: 一款縱向太空射擊遊戲：你將扮演太空戰艦駕駛員，突破敵方艦隊並向母星示警。在砲火中穿梭，迎戰指揮官與頭目，升級你的戰艦，並打造強大的裝備協同效果。

5188050.name: Hell Dream 👺
5188050.desc: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!

1605370.name: Boxing Manager
1605370.desc: The definitive boxing management sim from the Boxing Manager series, rebuilt for Steam. The most-accurate boxing simulation ever from the team behind the critically-acclaimed sim. Watch any fight. Develop fighters with every save a unique, realistic, engrossing simulation of the sport and business.

3199530.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
3199530.desc: A dark fantasy auto battler with loot hunting and idle rewards. Combine gear, affixes and relics into hero builds. Field four heroes with reserves ready to take over. Earn offline rewards, forge mythic gear and push through new cycles, Boss Rush and the endgame boss.

5222230.name: CUBE - The 125 Chambers -
5222230.desc: You wake up in a surreal structure composed of identical cube-shaped rooms. Deadly traps lie in wait, and mysterious numbers are etched into the walls. Navigate through a 5x5x5 labyrinth of 125 chambers, solve the mystery, and find a way out alive in this grid-based psychological escape thriller.

2848990.name: Mates and Crates
2848990.desc: Steal crates, drop them on your crafting pad and turn them into guns, vehicles and squadmates. Team battles online or against bots: blow up the enemy HQ before they blow up yours.

5510940.name: Aztec Escape
5510940.desc: Aztec Escape is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in an ancient temple. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge deadly traps, collect ancient relics, and beat your highest score.

5560540.name: StellaCore: Mining Odyssey Demo
5560540.desc: Play the first sector — freeStellacore: Mining Odyssey is a fast-paced 2D space shooter and mining hybrid. This free demo is the opening slice of the campaign: take the helm of a nimble starfighter in a frontier mining sector overrun by hostile, block-built machines.

4976760.name: The Fixer
4976760.desc: Football star on Saturday, match fixer the rest of the week. Rig matches for the syndicate, buy the referee, and keep your suspicion from hitting 100. Free demo: play your first 10 weeks, then carry the save into the full game.

4652030.name: AI Apocalypse
4652030.desc: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Fight the AI apocalypse with melee, magic, or rifle — 3 weapon classes, 9 build paths, 140+ cards. Every run is a new tactical puzzle of stance, distance, and deck synergy.

4270780.name: Rally Shift
4270780.desc: Drive with a live bomb on your dashboard while a relentless alien anomaly stalks you at every turn. Rally Shift is an arcade first person rally time attack. Stay on the gas, master sharp turns, and beat your personal record before time runs out

4948940.name: Swarmbreaker
4948940.desc: 《Swarmbreaker》是一款增量式塔防遊戲，你必須守住基地，擋下外星蟲群匯聚而成的巨大活體浪潮。修築防禦工事阻斷牠們的去路，部署重型武器，升級你的武器庫，粉碎蟲群！

5355620.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
5355620.desc: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

5360360.name: Cozy Marbles - Jelle's Marble Runs Supporter Pack
5360360.desc: Play and race Jelle's way! Cozy Marbles partners with Jelle's Marble Runs, the world’s #1 marble racing channel, to roll out a treat for marble enthusiasts.

3042040.name: Project: Autumn
3042040.desc: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

394310.name: Punch Club
394310.desc: Train hard, fight crocodiles and find love. Earn your place in the Punch Club ranks, and discover who brutally murdered your father, in this choose your own adventure boxing management tycoon.

2933200.name: 圖科尼：森林看護者
2933200.desc: 呼——一陣裹挾著落葉的秋風吹過！背上圓滾滾的橡子背包，在踩著落葉的沙沙聲中探索林間，用奇思妙想的小遊戲幫助動物們準備過冬。為沿途的相遇煮一壺熱茶吧，讓這份穿透螢幕的暖意，驅散你現實中的所有疲憊

1432100.name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
1432100.desc: 《The Bookwalker》是一款敘事類冒險遊戲，你將在其中扮演艾帝安‧奎斯——他本是一名作家，後來成為了盜賊，擁有潛入書本的能力。透過這種力量，你將穿梭於現實和書本世界，竊取雷神之鎚、王者之劍等傳奇物品，以恢復你的寫作能力。

movies.name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales - Release Date Trailer

365770.name: Volume
365770.desc: Pure stealth action and infinite level creation from the award-winning studio behind Thomas Was Alone. Enter the Volume to halt Gisborne Industries' corruption and train the masses to rob from the rich.

233310.name: Avadon 2: The Corruption
233310.desc: Avadon 2: The Corruption is a huge, indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the second chapter in the epic Avadon trilogy. You will serve the keep of Avadon, working as a spy and warrior to fight the enemies of your homeland. As a servant of the Black Fortress, your word is law.

298630.name: The Escapists
298630.desc: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

1019590.name: Lovely Planet 2: April Skies
1019590.desc: A Very Cute First Person Shooter Game. Sequel to the most adorable and critically acclaimed FPS Gun Ballet of 2014.

489140.name: Mr. Shifty
489140.desc: Teleport, shift through bullets, and master lightning-fast takedowns in an all new kind of action game from tinyBuild and Team Shifty!

1500.name: Darwinia
1500.desc: Darwinia blends real-time strategy, action, and puzzles with a unique gesture-based control system. Save the Darwinians, battle viruses, and restore order in a retro-inspired digital world. Winner of multiple prestigious  awards, including the Seumas McNally Grand Prize at IGF 2006.

888530.name: Yaga
888530.desc: 您將扮演霉運連連的獨臂鐵匠伊凡，去執行沙皇安排給他的看似不可能的任務。與此同時，神秘的女巫芭芭·雅加見證著伊凡的命運。

1179210.name: Kill It With Fire
1179210.desc: 《Kill It With Fire》是一款獵捕蜘蛛並造成連帶損害的第一人稱動作遊戲。

movies.name: Kill It With Fire: Launch Trailer

298600.name: Lovely Planet
298600.desc: A First Person Shooter Gun Ballet set in a cutesy abstract world. Jump and shoot your way through five worlds full of treacherous enemies with your trusty semi-automatic!

1617030.name: tERRORbane
1617030.desc: tERRORbane is a comedic adventure where bugs are your FRIENDS! Enjoy exploring a crazy and outlandish world, full of unique, quirky characters and homages to the history of videogaming, challenge the Developer with your creativity and be the Bane of Errors!

435530.name: The Final Station
435530.desc: Travel by train through a dying world. Look after your passengers, keep your train operational, and make sure you can always reach the next station. Make your way through swarms of infected at each station. Explore mysterious and abandoned stations looking for supplies and survivors.

897450.name: The Survivalists
897450.desc: 《The Survivalists》中充滿生機的世界有許多驚喜、秘密和危險，是以《The Escapists》世界觀為舞台的冒險生存沙盒遊戲。與最多三名朋友探索、建造、製作甚至訓練猴子，拚命生存下去。您有本事成為生存高手嗎？

356570.name: Party Hard
356570.desc: It's 3:00 a.m. Your neighbours are having a loud party. Stop them. Party Hard is tinyBuild's award-winning stealth strategy game about ruining parties by any means.

movies.name: Party Hard - Life Of The Party Trailer

1164940.name: Trepang2
1164940.desc: 《Trepang2》是一款背景設定在遙遠未來、動作性十足的血腥第一人稱射擊遊戲。在這款硬派的瘋狂射擊遊戲中，對敵人釋放猛烈炮火、躲避子彈並留下毀滅的痕跡，成為一名頂尖狠角色。

265930.name: Goat Simulator
265930.desc: Goat Simulator is the latest in high-tech Goat Simulation technology.

1520.name: DEFCON
1520.desc: Inspired by the 1983 cult classic film, Wargames, DEFCON superbly evokes the tension, paranoia and suspicion of the Cold War era, playing on the fascinating aspects of psychological gameplay that occur during strategic nuclear warfare.

549100.name: GravNewton
549100.desc: Challenge all your skill and quick thinking ability in this precision platform game, where you are a bitrom who controller over gravity called Newton, who is trying to escape from a deformed creature that relentlessly follows him in subspace.

257120.name: Not The Robots
257120.desc: You are a robot in an office building. You have to eat furniture and not get caught. A mysterious story unfolds.Not The Robots is this year’s most exciting Roguelike Stealth Furniture Eating Simulator. It’s a game with random levels, permadeath, and the goal of eating furniture - which is also your stealth cover.

327890.name: I Am Bread
327890.desc: You are bread. Your mission, become toast! Take on all hazards to deliciousness as you head on an epic adventure in one of the the toughest games ever baked. All of the game modes (including Bagel Race) are now unlocked so there's sure to be something to suit everyone's taste!

434050.name: Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour
434050.desc: Frag like it’s 1996 – this time with even more asses to kick! Join the world’s greatest action hero in Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour as he saves Earth once again, kicking alien ass and saving babes across the globe along the way.

movies.name: Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour PEGI Launch Trailer

628670.name: Hellpoint
628670.desc: Hellpoint is an intense action RPG taking place on Irid Novo, a derelict space station soaked in an intoxicating dark sci fi atmosphere. Fight dreadful creatures, face the Cosmic Gods and unravel their twisted story. Should the challenge be too great, play with a friend in local or online coop.

1989320.name: 阿斯托：巨碑之刃
1989320.desc: Rip through hordes of enemies with fury and style in this fast-paced action RPG. Play as Astor, a young warrior determined to unveil the secrets behind his creators’ unforeseen demise. Wield an arsenal of runic weapons to hunt down the evil haunting the planet Gliese and save it from impending doom.

245450.name: Wizardry 8
245450.desc: A New Wizardry for a New GenerationThe universe is in the throes of violent upheaval and change. Vast and mysterious forces are preparing for the final confrontation. A small group of heroes from distant lands must plunge into the heart of the maelstrom, to uncover long-forgotten secrets, and bring about a new era.

400170.name: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut
400170.desc: Embark on an adventure in a gothic-noir world, where mad science threatens the peace between monsters and mortals. The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut is definitive edition of the trilogy with six playable classes and a new endgame mode with a huge variety of open missions!

movies.name: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut Trailer #2
The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut Trailer #1

compare.en: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing Final Cut

5373260.name: Ferro - 3D Audio Visualizer
5373260.desc: Sound in liquid form. Ferro is a real-time 3D audio-reactive fluid simulation. Shape liquid, light and motion with music, MIDI, automation, or even your microphone. Infinitely customizable, place on your desktop or add to your livestream for an expressive companion to your sound.

5142680.name: Expiration
5142680.desc: 第一人稱心理恐怖策略遊戲，糖尿病化為致命的桌上對決。用胰島素控制血糖、管理物資，並擊敗迪勒醫生，奪得治癒之法。

movies.name: Welcome to the Lesson — EXPIRATION Demo Trailer

3305190.name: 給我吃一口！
3305190.desc: 歡迎來到這個“要命”的星球！在《給我吃一口！》中，你必須接住掉落的食物，把它們穩穩投餵給飢腸轆轆的怪物——不然被吃掉的就是你！遊戲支持單人闖關、雙人合作及互坑對戰。快叫上你的朋友，在這場手忙腳亂的投餵冒險中活下去吧！要記得：顧客滿意至上，員工存活純屬走運！

movies.name: One More Plate! - Launch Trailer TC

4984400.name: Towers of Babble
4984400.desc: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

5379520.name: Smartest in the Room
5379520.desc: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.

4946550.name: 破塊
4946550.desc: 一款以打碎方塊為核心、短小而爽快的增量遊戲。解鎖新工具與升級，打碎更多方塊。

4887480.name: Gridiron Grit
4887480.desc: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.

movies.name: Gridiron Grit Trailer #2 - Next Fest Demo

999570.name: Latin Simulator
999570.desc: A school week full of Latin and a teacher with gallows humor, who is about to be replaced by AI. Survive five days of minigames, missions and bad decisions, expose the conspiracy, and find out what Friday's exam does to you. And to the school.

5440370.name: Meowstone Siege
5440370.desc: Command a customizable cat in this 3D tower defense game. Build elemental cannons, research new defenses, deploy cat-piloted aircraft, and repel waves of mice. Face bosses, tackle daily sieges, and create and share maps through Steam Workshop.

5444950.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator
5444950.desc: 收藏陀螺、混搭配件，挑戰對手與聯賽！經營自己的陀螺專門店，與好友合作打理生意，或帶上你的組合來一場一對一對決。

5326270.name: DAWN AEROWAR Original Soundtrack
5326270.desc: 《Dawn Aerowar》完全原創的原聲配樂，由Jose Pavli依據畫面譜寫。音樂為管弦樂風格，氣勢磅礴，節奏明快，加入了合唱、保加利亞人聲、古典吉他以及影片的兩首原創歌曲。提供MP3格式，另可選擇下載無損FLAC。

5217440.name: FailRooms
5217440.desc: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

2991650.name: DAWN AEROWAR
2991650.desc: A two-hour animated film. Follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire, across 12 episodes of 3D dogfights and hand-drawn 2D animation, with a full voice cast and an original orchestral score. Nearly five years of work by a handful of independent artists.

4623860.name: Netfall
4623860.desc: A hacking roguelike deckbuilder where you see exactly what the enemy plans to do, then rewrite it. Pick one of five hacker identities, build a deck from over 200 cards, and break through four sectors of a living network to reach the Mainframe.

4140210.desc: A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

4819620.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
4819620.desc: 融合MMORPG風格與塔防玩法的單人遊戲。招募英雄，建造造型奇特卻威力驚人的防禦塔，並肩投入即時3D戰鬥，抵禦一波又一波的敵人。

5173530.name: Soleil & Suspense
5173530.desc: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

2195710.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
2195710.desc: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

5487470.name: Parasite: Among the Guests
5487470.desc: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.

4683860.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
4683860.desc: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

5444340.name: Claw and Conjure Demo
5444340.desc: The Claw and Conjure demo is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG units. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. The demo offers free access to early game units, items, and abilities and allows PvP play for 8 rounds per run

4942010.name: Astrolobe OS
4942010.desc: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.

4598400.name: 12款棋盤遊戲
4598400.desc: 包含12款棋盤遊戲的合集，包括五子棋、井字棋、國際象棋、中國象棋、黑白棋、西洋跳棋、四子棋、將棋、鬥獸棋、軍棋、九子棋和播棋。

4514060.name: 對魔忍阿莎姬2
4514060.desc: 斬妖除魔的女忍──對魔忍阿莎姬再度出動！！ 阿莎姬與小櫻前往漂浮在東京灣上的人造島嶼，那裡是充滿魑魅魍魎與罪犯的非法之地。

3810960.name: Sting Operation
3810960.desc: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

4845020.name: 戀愛，我就借走咯
4845020.desc: 為了籌措妹妹高昂的學費，鐵公雞男主新海幸意外踏入了名為「人才租賃」的奇妙行業。在扮演男友、摯友乃至情夫的虛假契約掩護下，少女們不為人知的隱密慾望與真實心聲悄然綻放。以金錢維繫的脆弱羈絆終將面臨現實的考驗，當這層層偽裝剝落之際，究竟會是財盡緣散，還是假戲真做呢？一場充滿謊言與心跳的青春戀愛喜劇就此上演。

4750760.name: La Agencia del Riel
4750760.desc: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.

movies.name: Trailer de La Agencia del Riel

5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter
5471990.desc: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.

4975340.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
4975340.desc: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

5433870.name: 百鬼退散
5433870.desc: 《百鬼退散》是一款中式民俗題材的像素風生存動作肉鴿。化身道士、趕屍人或打更人，自動施法、走位驅鬼，搭配法器進階與五行相生，在荒村、鬼市和湘西義莊殺出活路。守過十分鐘長夜，再迎戰最終首領——這一夜，你能活到天明嗎？

312780.name: Way of the Samurai 4
312780.desc: Way of the Samurai 4 takes place in the humble port town of Amihama during the mid 19th Century, several years after the arrival of the “black ships” from the West ended Japan’s long history of cultural isolation.

5130120.name: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica
5130120.desc: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

451570.name: Demetrios - The BIG Cynical Adventure
451570.desc: A comedic point-and-click adventure where a hungover antique dealer must solve his own robbery in Paris, dragging himself and his friends into a wildly idiotic journey!

2780810.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Nordic Horizons
2780810.desc: 駛於斯堪地那維亞北部的迷人風光之中，運輸各式各樣的貨物！

movies.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Introducing Nordic Horizons

413410.name: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
413410.desc: Investigate murders, search for clues and talk to your classmates to prepare for trial. There, you'll engage in deadly wordplay, going back and forth with suspects. Dissect their statements and fire their words back at them to expose their lies! There's only one way to survive—pull the trigger.

1449200.name: AI：夢境檔案 涅槃肇始
1449200.desc: 新上任的ABIS特別搜查官瑞希與龍木， 將與眼球型AI機器人搭檔――瞳絆與環聯手合作， 在過去與現在、夢境與現實之間穿梭， 為了查明真相，開始調查這起【Half Body連續命案】。

compare.en: AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative

dlc.name: AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES –nirvanA Initiative– Complete Soundtrack
AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES –nirvanA Initiative–Instrumental Tracks

1029690.name: Sniper Elite 5
1029690.desc: 獲獎無數的射擊遊戲系列載譽歸來。時間回到 1944 年的法國，卡爾·費爾伯恩為揭露「海怪計劃」而奮戰。這款堪稱同類始祖的正統狙擊遊戲，如今加入了升級版擊殺鏡頭功能，玩家必須闖入多個沉浸式地圖，奮力制止納粹戰爭機器的圖謀，帶來前所未有的體驗。

dlc.name: Sniper Elite 5: Kraken Awakes Mission, Weapon and Skin Pack
Sniper Elite 5: Saboteur Weapon and Skin Pack
Sniper Elite 5: Death From Above Weapon and Skin Pack
Sniper Elite 5: Up Close and Personal Weapon and Skin Pack
Sniper Elite 5 : Concealed Target Weapon and Skin Pack
Sniper Elite 5: Target Führer - Wolf Mountain

13560.name: 《縱橫諜海》
13560.desc: 與《縱橫諜海》一同進入電影式的潛行動作世界，這款遊戲將此類型推向了經典地位。你將扮演「山姆．費雪」，他是隸屬美國國家安全局（NSA）最高機密單位「第三梯隊」的頂尖祕密幹員。

4530370.name: 《Football Manager 27》
4530370.desc: 選擇球會、打造陣容、制定戰術。放手追逐只有你才能看見的宏大藍圖。 在《FM27》中，你的足球信仰將成為現實。動手修改，做出屬於你的選擇。

movies.name: Gameplay Preview: New Features & Upgrades in Action (EN)

2792080.name: 股票：散戶
2792080.desc: 如果你對股票有想法，你應該買這個遊戲。在你用真金白銀驗證想法之前，來這裡驗證吧。這裡提供主流市場近20年的1分鐘數據，也提供條件單功能。當然還有完全脫離現實的模擬股票交易。

5330310.name: Shawarma Karma
5330310.desc: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?

5100140.name: 絕對音感 花園鰻
5100140.desc: 以可愛的小花園鰻伸縮的身體為線索，挑戰50道音高問答！收集全部50隻個性十足的小花園鰻，使用牠們標誌性的音色，創作並分享最長32小節的原創旋律。一款輕鬆又莫名上癮的「佛系」音感問答遊戲。

4696540.name: Working95
4696540.desc: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

4399360.name: 时光餐厅
4399360.desc: 《时光餐厅》是一款轻松休闲的餐厅经营游戏。你将从一家小餐馆开始，安排厨师做菜、服务员上菜，接待不断到来的顾客。随着生意越来越好，你可以扩展餐厅规模、解锁更多菜品，让自己的餐厅变得越来越热闹。

2350690.name: District Null
2350690.desc: District Null is a cyberpunk city simulation. Traffic, energy, fire services, police, schools and entertainment all run at the same time.

5006790.name: PopFarm Slime
5006790.desc: 繼承而來的是一座小小的史萊姆牧場和堆積如山的債務。三消賣出同色史萊姆，還清每回合上門的債務。用130+種工具打造你的連鎖組合，挑戰Boss與催債等級的三消Roguelike構築遊戲。

5105650.name: 《愛，死亡，我的女兒》
5105650.desc: 《愛，死亡，我的女兒》是一款免費的短篇像素敘事遊戲。穿過雨中的墓園，修復故障、翻閱記憶與檔案，在輕微的恐怖與失真中，理解一位母親留下的愛。

5409460.name: Beneath the Record
5409460.desc: Compare statements and evidence in old case files to uncover contradictions. Arrange character and object tokens across locations and time periods to reconstruct each case and reveal the truth buried beneath the records.

5323500.name: DEEP SEAL
5323500.desc: 《禁止打撈》是一款 1–4 人合作水下恐怖遊戲。潛入錯綜複雜的水下洞穴打撈遺體，在黑暗中尋找出路——以及躲開那條一直在尋找你們的鯊魚。帶上東西，找到隊友，活著游回來。

4430560.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island
4430560.desc: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

4727050.name: 全裸豸戦 ～BEAST PARADIGM～
4727050.desc: "Zenra-Taisen"is a twin-stick shooting + visual novel game set in a country inhabited solely by male beastmen. You progress through the story by reading the visual novel part, while simultaneously advancing through the battle part (twin-stick shooting) of each stage.

3850230.name: 99天生存指南
3850230.desc: 這是一款快節奏的合作殭屍生存動作遊戲，玩家在關卡推進中擊敗大量敵人，解鎖隨機能力強化，透過不同構築與團隊合作完成逃離。

4878710.name: 知夏
4878710.desc: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
4904730.desc: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

5333560.name: Ribbit Racing
5333560.desc: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.

4951630.name: Soundway
4951630.desc: 駕著自己的音樂出發！Soundway 能把任何歌曲化為在宇宙深處飛馳的霓虹雲霄飛車——每一次加速、爬升、俯衝與過彎，全由音樂親手打造。抓準節拍、疊出驚人連擊、閃避致命障礙，追著音樂衝向星海。

5476080.name: Definitely Safe Demo
5476080.desc: 用廢料零件組裝火箭、裝填火藥、剪好引線，然後看看會發生什麼事。拍下每一次飛行。上傳影片、追逐觀看次數，並攀升排行榜。完全合法。絕對安全。

5498880.name: Sylvaris: Black Reign Demo
5498880.desc: Power Has a Price. Sacrifice your health to unleash devastating power through the Overload System. Strike to reclaim your life, fight to survive, and push beyond your limits in Sylvaris, a dark steampunk Metroidvania where every battle is a gamble with death. Bleed to Reign.

movies.name: Sylvaris: Black Reign - Demo Gameplay Trailer

5308080.name: Neon Impact 360 - Muliplayer Arcade Action
5308080.desc: Four walls. Four paddles. One ball that never slows down. Defend your wall in a neon arcade showdown where every goal you let in brings you closer to defeat — across 30 levels of gravity wells, pinball chaos and mind-bending illusions, solo or with three friends.

2729450.name: Profiler Files - New Orleans
2729450.desc: 10 EPISODES. 8 HOURS+ OF GAMEPLAY. PROFILING, INTERROGATIONS & INVESTIGATION! HUMOR, CHOICES & MULTIPLE ENDINGS! Play as a young FBI agent in New Orleans: search scenes, interrogate and profile suspects. Make choices that shape a branching story mixing offbeat humor with a gripping crime thriller.

movies.name: Profiler Files New Orleans: Gameplay & Early Access Trailer

5100970.name: Castello
5100970.desc: Castello is a third person shooter game centered around a crime story. While progressing through the main story missions, you are also free to explore the open-world city at your own pace. Gunfights, driving, and a variety of unique missions are among the game's core experiences.

5110270.name: Ghost Express
5110270.desc: 《Ghost Express》是一款2D收納整理解謎遊戲，主角是一隻可愛到嚇不了任何人的小幽靈Spooky。把每家商店的貨物一件件塞進箱子裡，再送到隔壁的公寓。訂單越堆越多，空間越來越小，Spooky能順利完成任務嗎？

5187700.name: Confess To Me
5187700.desc: Confess to Me is a dark, kinetic novella rated 18+ about power, psychological pressure, and dangerous attraction.

312660.name: Sniper Elite 4
312660.desc: 在史上最大也最先進的第二次世界大戰射擊遊戲中，盡享無與倫比的自由狙擊。在波瀾壯闊的關卡中體驗戰術級別的第三人稱戰鬥、遊戲方式選擇，以及史詩般的長距離射擊，從法西斯主義的魔掌中讓戰爭時期的義大利得到解放。

dlc.name: Sniper Elite 4 - Cold Warfare Winter Expansion Pack
Sniper Elite 4 - Night Fighter Expansion Pack
Sniper Elite 4 - Urban Assault Expansion Pack

477740.name: Zero Escape: The Nonary Games
477740.desc: Kidnapped and taken to an unfamiliar location, nine people find themselves forced to participate in a diabolical Nonary Game by an enigmatic mastermind called Zero. Why were they there? Why were they chosen to put their lives on the line? And more importantly, who can be trusted?

3929740.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow
3929740.desc: 在這款潛行動作驚悚遊戲中潛入全球受到嚴密保護的地點。在獲獎肯定的《縱橫諜海》系列的第二部作品中，揭穿一項跨國陰謀，並阻止一場致命的生化恐怖攻擊。

compare.en: Tom Clancys Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow

13540.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six® Vegas
13540.desc: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six makes its next-generation hardware debut in the most dramatic installment of the renowned first-person shooter franchise to date. Rainbow operatives take to the chaotic streets of Las Vegas as an escalating terrorist siege in 'Sin City' threatens to take world terrorism to new, uncontrollable heights.

220160.name: Trials Evolution: Gold Edition
220160.desc: Trials Evolution: Gold Edition marks the Trials franchise’s triumphant return to the PC gaming platform. RedLynx’s signature franchise, the Trials series first made its mark in gaming with the 2008 release of Trials 2 SE for the PC.

movies.name: Trials Evolution: Gold Edition Launch Trailer PEGI

298110.name: Far Cry® 4
