298110.desc: 在這款開放世界第一人稱射擊遊戲中，為解放飽受戰火摧殘的喜馬拉雅地區而戰。使用致命的一系列武器，駕馭旋翼機與戰象征服陸空，並單獨或透過合作模式挑戰敵方領地。

311240.name: Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma
311240.desc: Nine participants awaken, trapped in an underground facility. To escape, they must play a game with deadly consequences. Who will live, and who will die? The choice is yours. Let the Decision Game begin…

33320.name: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands™
33320.desc: Prince of Persia The Forgotten Sands is the next chapter in the fan-favorite Sands of Time universe. Visiting his brother's kingdom following his adventure in Azad, the Prince finds the royal palace under siege from a mighty army bent on its destruction.

movies.name: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands™ - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands™ Gameplay Trailer

compare.en: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands

567640.name: 新槍彈辯駁V3 大家的自相殘殺新學期
567640.desc: 『槍彈辯駁』新章揭幕！ 『新槍彈辯駁V3 大家自相殘殺的新學期』簡介

2221920.name: Immortals Fenyx Rising
2221920.desc: 《芬尼克斯傳說》將帶來活靈活現的神話冒險。 扮演芬尼克斯，踏上拯救希臘眾神的任務。

260230.name: Valiant Hearts: The Great War™ / Soldats Inconnus : Mémoires de la Grande Guerre™
260230.desc: 《英勇之心：偉大戰役》的故事由四位主角的命運交織而成，訴說了一段迫於大環境而顛沛流離的愛情故事。 踏入2D漫畫風動畫世界，同時享受探險、動作和解謎遊戲的樂趣。 玩家可選擇扮演戰壕中的四位角色，重現第一次世界大戰的戰場。這四位陌生人的命運將會互相交錯，並且幫助一位年輕德國士兵找到他的愛人！

412830.name: STEINS;GATE
412830.desc: 由5pb.和nitroplus共同開發的《STEINS;GATE》曾被Famitsu雜誌授予年度優秀遊戲獎項，並在Famitsu讀者調查中被評為最煽情的“催淚遊戲”。如此扣人心弦的視覺小說遊戲，現已被改編為漫畫、動畫及動畫電影等。 如今終於登陸Steam！

939960.name: Far Cry® New Dawn
939960.desc: 於世界核災 17 年之後，深入在末日後徹底改變的蒙大拿希望郡。 領導對抗攔路強盜，不讓他們奪走僅剩的資源

1388870.name: Arcade Paradise
1388870.desc: 賺取利潤、撿口香糖、洗衣服並獲得硬幣來解鎖各個機台，將家庭式自助洗衣店改造成街機樂園！

2698940.name: 《飆酷車神：動力慶典》
2698940.desc: 《飆酷車神：動力慶典》是一款以夏威夷歐胡島為背景的開放世界線上競速遊戲。在激烈賽事中體驗汽車文化的精華、參與主題活動，同時收集數百款經典車輛。 免費暢玩遊戲 5 小時！

1324340.name: 來自深淵 朝向黑暗的雙星
1324340.desc: 無可救藥動作角色扮演遊戲

compare.en: Made in Abyss: Binary Star Falling into Darkness

229870.name: ShootMania Storm
229870.desc: ShootMania the FPS “Powered By Players”ShootMania Storm is revolutionizing the multiplayer FPS by adding a community dimension and unlimited replayability. Developed by the Nadeo studio, renowned for community racing game, TrackMania, ShootMania Storm boasts quick-fire matches and epic battles, where only your talent will distinguish you...

270880.name: American Truck Simulator
270880.desc: 體驗傳奇的美國卡車，在陽光明媚的加利福尼亞州、沙質的內華達州和亞利桑那州大峽谷州運送各種貨物。 American Truck Simulator將帶你踏上一段穿越美國各地令人驚嘆的風景和廣為人知的地標的旅程。

302080.name: Bus Driver
302080.desc: In Bus Driver, your job is to transport passengers around an attractive and realistic city. You must drive to a timetable on a planned route, whilst obeying traffic rules, and taking care not to upset or injure your passengers.

15300.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon®
15300.desc: Eastern Europe, 2008. War has broken out on the borders of Russia and the fate of the world hangs in the balance. That's when the call goes out for the Ghostsan elite handful of specially trained Green Berets, armed with the latest technology and trained to use the deadliest weapons.

1918370.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Ukrainian Paint Jobs Pack
1918370.desc: Customize your truck with your country flag! A choice of four unique paint jobs will come handy if you feel you need to show your affiliation...

1096940.name: Dream Ending - Drama
1096940.desc: 《Dream Ending》的催眠音聲廣播劇。包含wav格式（CD音質）與mp3格式（320kbps）。

1796170.name: Bunny e-Shop  The Art of the Game
1796170.desc: 《小白兔电商》的美术设定集，内容包括人物图集、事件图集、背景图集和制作感言等等，PDF格式，需要观看PDF格式的应用打开。

378400.name: Gaokao.Love.100Days - Original Soundtrack
378400.desc: 《高考戀愛一百天》原聲音樂集，由獨立音樂社團Days為本遊戲專門打造。

3872920.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - KRONE Agriculture Equipment
3872920.desc: 在此，向大家隆重介紹——Krone Agriculture Equipment！Krone Agriculture Equipment 將會帶來一系列全新的貨物種類，收錄了來自 Krone 的頂尖機器——一間享譽全球的農業設備領導廠商。

2339640.name: Caliber: Starter Pack
2339640.desc: Starter kit with items to speed up progress.

588600.name: American Truck Simulator - Valentine's Paint Jobs Pack
588600.desc: 表達你的熱情！展現你的情感，並用情人節主題塗裝來妝點你的卡車吧！不論是送給自己，還是獻給某位特別的人，這都是一份充滿愛意的選擇。

2569750.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - TIRSAN Trailer Pack
2569750.desc: TIRSAN總部位於土耳其，是滿足商業需求的高品質拖車的頂級生產商。他們擁有超過45年的經驗，以其創意設計、卓越的施工和出色的顧客服務聞名。

3129990.name: UBOAT - Supporter Pack
3129990.desc: Enhance your UBOAT experience with the Supporter Pack! Features wooden and metal decks, shark bow paint, new camouflage patterns, shark-themed torpedo skins, and four historical emblems. Support UBOAT's development while adding visual flair to your U-boats and arsenal.

1317160.name: Children of Morta: Paws and Claws
1317160.desc: This DLC adds new features to the game - like the Animal Shelter System, new boosts, animations and events - but it actually does far more than that. It directly helps the animals in need - not those virtual, but the real ones.

532021.name: Rabi-Ribi - Is the order a DLC?
532021.desc: 新的章節"Fairies Attack!" 與 "Finding Memories" 等待你的探索！ 探索未知的區域，拉比拉比山谷的頂點與記憶回廊的核心（？！）

876980.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Portuguese Paint Jobs Pack
876980.desc: Customize your truck with your country flag! A choice of four unique paint jobs will come handy if you feel you need to show your affiliation...

277740.name: Train Simulator: Union Pacific FEF-3 Loco Add-On
277740.desc: The final steam locomotive built for Union Pacific, the FEF-3, comes to Train Simulator from Smokebox with an extensive array of detailing and features.The FEF was a class of three steam locomotives built by the American Locomotive Company (Alco) and operated by Union Pacific Railroad.

4876650.name: 永不按顏色分揀
4876650.desc: 在那座積木山的下面某處，埋著你的地板。用磁力手套、篩盤和追蹤零件的視覺，分揀這座不可能的「大堆」。裝滿貼好標籤的抽屜，取出零件，看著 MOC 一磚一瓦地咬合成型。愜意、滿足，只受一條規則支配：永遠不要按顏色分揀。

5017820.name: 不正經的刷寶騎士
5017820.desc: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

4218360.name: Wall World Strategy
4218360.desc: 在無盡之牆的表面建立並領導你的殖民地。管理資源與居民，研發全新科技，抵禦無休止的澤雷克進攻，並派遣機械蜘蛛執行高風險探索任務。維持殖民地的運轉——在牆世界中，一切都很容易分崩離析。

5494730.name: 混亂足球
5494730.desc: 《混亂足球》是一款歡樂的多人物理足球派對遊戲。和朋友度過一整個歡樂的下午！

5342580.name: Bebesida
5342580.desc: BEBESIDA is a co-op sci-fi horror game aboard a spaceship. Choose from six crew classes, explore its decks, scavenge supplies, and fight alien creatures. Repair the ship, pursue personal objectives, and find a way to survive.

4908770.name: Rezonia
4908770.desc: Easy to pick up. Challenging to master. Rezonia is a rhythm game built around simple controls and precision-focused gameplay. Chase your personal best and compete on the online leaderboards.

4908110.name: Gas N Cars
4908110.desc: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

4096910.name: 虛空收割者
4096910.desc: 背包管理 + 割草體驗。在《虚空收割者》這款科幻 Roguelite 遊戲中，你的背包佈局決定生死。最佳化物品擺放以觸發強力羈絆，打造逆天流派，將平庸的武器庫化為毀天滅地的清屏風暴。收集 300+ 種物品，粉碎虛空！

5464210.name: Loamward
5464210.desc: Shape a living world one spadeful at a time. Dig, level and pave the land, fell timber, mine deep veins and smith your own tools, raise houses piece by piece and found a settlement with your neighbors. Every skill grows with use in a slow, open sandbox you share online.

5241700.name: Close the strait !
5241700.desc: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

5198270.name: 守住黎明
5198270.desc: 白天建造，夜晚抵禦屍潮。《守住黎明》是一款 3D 廢土塔防：特色自動戰鬥角色、戰術防禦塔、殭屍浪潮，支援 Steam、區域網路與本機多人。

5045380.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
5045380.desc: 操作模組化磁帶解碼機，挑戰互動解謎，修復受損資料，揭開醫院血腥慘案背後的真相。

5021520.name: Strap-On Me, Mistress!
5021520.desc: Choose your favorite Lady, customize her outfit, and experience immersive first-person strap-on encounters. Explore 6 locations, meet 6 unique Ladies, and discover 15 different outfits. Available on PC and VR.

4582370.name: Dream Riders
4582370.desc: Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world. Take on a series of high-speed boss encounters each lurking behind a themed high difficulty track, or just see how far you can drive.  Prove that nothing is off limits if you're fast enough!

4289450.name: PegLotto!
4289450.desc: PegLotto! 是一款融合了老虎機、彈珠機和牌組構築的Roguelike遊戲。挑選道具，放置到位，然後祈禱好運降臨吧！一邊欣賞車窗外的風景，一邊愜意地投身命運的浪潮！

4916290.name: Dream Glitcher
4916290.desc: Enter the fractured mind of Luna, an android learning to feel. Explore memories, solve puzzles, and influence her perception through your choices in a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click adventure where identity, control, and reality are never quite what they seem.

4862390.name: 尚武誌
4862390.desc: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

movies.name: Martial Art’s History Latest Promo Trailer

4825500.name: Kamiyo
4825500.desc: 採用live2d動態立繪和2D橫向捲軸的反烏托邦視覺小說。以弒神者之死，作為奉獻神明的祈禱。

5053940.name: Amusement Factory
5053940.desc: Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay the roads, place the rides, open the shops and keep every guest smiling from the gate to the last bus home. A bright, cozy park builder with a ten-location campaign, free play with no limits, and a front-seat view of every ride you put down.

5389200.name: Asteroid Watch
5389200.desc: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.

5451120.name: 正统三国：乱世之弈
5451120.desc: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.

4780870.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
4780870.desc: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

5333690.name: Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story
5333690.desc: Discover a world of adventure, fantasy, and magic in a vibrant hero quest, top-down retro-style pixel art action-adventure where fast-paced strategic positioning and well-timed attacks determine victory!

4967490.name: Catalyst Core
4967490.desc: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

4981810.name: 洪水求生 - Escape the Flood!
4981810.desc: 一款 1 至 10 人的合作生存製作遊戲。海水越漲越高，你的島正一點一點被淹沒。砍倒樹木，和朋友一起製作一艘船，駕船駛向外海。在水裡待太久，鯊魚就會找上你。

4390080.name: Bottled by Bears
4390080.desc: 加入熊熊一家，一起經營嗡嗡熱鬧的小小蜂蜜農場！收集並發現稀有蜜蜂，把蜂蜜裝進罐中，擴建農場，看花田在這款溫馨的放置經營遊戲中燦爛盛開。

4795460.name: The Citadel Project
4795460.desc: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

4989920.name: Thorn Beach
4989920.desc: Chill while piecing together jigsaw puzzles that transform into cozy, animated slices of life featuring the characters, creatures, and "monsters" of Thorn Beach.

5084410.name: 旅途塔防
5084410.desc: Journey TD 是一款輕度 Rogue 塔防遊戲，你的塔就是迷宮。選擇元素，從 168 座塔中挑選。將強化、裝備、符文與三大技能樹組合成致命構築。每週與其他玩家在相同的 Seed 下較量，爭奪排行榜第一名。

4939710.name: SYNTAX WARS
4939710.desc: A cyberpunk duel of pure reads. Both fighters lock in a move in secret, then flip at the same instant — no reflexes, no combos, just mind games. Strong eats Weak, Weak pierces Guard, Guard parries Strong. Matches are quick. Every choice is heavy. Step into the arena.

5283210.name: Crossfire 2D
5283210.desc: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

2536520.name: 《暗黑破壞神 II：獄火重生》煉獄版
2536520.desc: 重新體驗定義動作角色扮演遊戲類型的經典黑暗奇幻作品，現已完全重製，帶來全新職業、嶄新內容、遊戲體驗改善以及完全翻新的終局系統。搭配物品、施展強力技能，逐漸提升強度，最多八位玩家可一同組隊，斬除來自地獄的大軍。

movies.name: Diablo® II: Resurrected™ – Reign of the Warlock - Gameplay Launch Trailer (zhTW)
Diablo® II: Resurrected™ – Reign of the Warlock - Cinematic Trailer (zhTW)

dlc.name: 《暗黑破壞神 II：獄火重生》原聲帶

418460.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam
418460.desc: Red Orchestra Series' take on Vietnam: 64-player MP matches; 20+ maps; US Army & Marines, PAVN/NVA, NLF/VC; Australians and ARVN forces; 50+ weapons; 4 flyable helicopters; mines, traps and tunnels; Brutal. Authentic. Gritty. Character customization. And napalm in the morning.

movies.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Launch Trailer (Full Version)
Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Green Army Men Beach Party 2019

5461500.name: Football B-side
5461500.desc: Five a side, top down, thumbs on. Arcade football with a whole international season underneath it. 195 nations, one midfielder: you.

3759000.name: Beaver Creek
3759000.desc: A casual, water-physics puzzle game about building dams as a beaver (2 - 3 hours). Gnaw down trees, and grab and throw objects to organically build dams, back up water, and progress to the next level.

5305400.name: GLYPHTRIP
5305400.desc: A raycast ASCII roguelike. Ram a room of letters into itself and every kill raises the trip. The color turns first; later the letters stop agreeing with the room they describe. Twenty floors down. Five loops to the end of the book.

5191040.name: Teddy Store: Tidy Up
5191040.desc: 一款溫馨的第一人稱整理遊戲。2100 隻絨毛泰迪熊散落在玩具店的各個角落。把它們擺上正確的貨架，讓玩具店恢復整齊。

3159350.name: Match In Peace
3159350.desc: Match in Peace is a pair-matching roguelike. Monster pairs are hiding inside cursed tombstones, match them fast to unleash their unique effects. Use special Stone cards, powerful Statues and magical Potions to defeat haunting enemies ahead.

5304170.name: Monkey Overdrive
5304170.desc: MONKEY OVERDRIVE 是一款用飛碟撞怪的動作 Roguelike。按住蓄力、放開衝撞，把整群果凍史萊姆撞飛，再撞進車流、壓床和列車。打倒 24 隻首領，把牠們的招式一個個搶過來用。

5476640.name: FIRE CHESS
5476640.desc: FIRE CHESS is a serious strategy game that puts players in command of an emergency-response team to contain spreading wildfires. Recruit and manage units across a hex-grid map, use your limited resources to contain a spreading fire, protect residential communities, and respond to critical alerts.

4289830.name: Watch Eye
4289830.desc: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

5459270.name: Revenge on the 13th Floor
5459270.desc: A brutal top-down shooter inspired by DOS-era classics, ASCII graphics, arcade shoot 'em ups, and gloriously over-the-top '80s action movies. Fight through Campaign, Endless, and Horde modes, then create your own carnage with the built-in level editor and Steam Workshop support. NO MERCY!

4965130.name: Corridors
4965130.desc: 一款住在你檔案裡的射擊 / 寶石收集遊戲。《Corridors》將衝分動作與功能完整、直覺的檔案與媒體瀏覽器融為一體。在預設世界中競技，或讓你的電腦與檔案成為舞台。輕量、可攜，在多數系統上原生執行。

5010300.name: 你好! 君主大人
5010300.desc: 在可愛 Q 版的三國世界中，從涼州啟程，走訪八州、招募名將，與群英攜手打造繁榮城池。隨四季輪轉規劃建設、發展產業、完成委託，在城池成長與人物故事交織的旅途中，親手築起嚮往的太平天下。

movies.name: 實際遊玩：城池經營與三路戰鬥 en
君主大人－遊戲玩法介紹 繁

5411460.name: Overinflated
5411460.desc: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.

4408320.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
4408320.desc: An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC. Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!

5191540.name: The Keyless: Forbidden Door
5191540.desc: The Keyless: Forbidden Door is a dreamlike and surreal journey, witness bizarre metaphorical and surreal scenes in a world that changes shape as you overcome simple challenges.

4696920.name: Bumper & Thumper
4696920.desc: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

5415560.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket
5415560.desc: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?

5102300.name: STARLINERS
5102300.desc: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.

5467590.name: IRON FURY
5467590.desc: Neon-noir beat 'em up for 1-2 players. Includes PART I: STREETS OF VENGEANCE, PART II: OVERCLOCK and SURVIVAL MODE: two full campaigns, couch co-op, combos, throws, support strikes and 13 boss fights, told in painted comic panels.

movies.name: Iron Fury - Part I and Part II

5436520.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain
5436520.desc: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car.

5192820.name: Pull My Finger
5192820.desc: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...

4135440.name: Crown's Trial
4135440.desc: Crown's Trial is a Souls-Lite Boss Rush where each battle takes place in a different realm. Master tight combat mechanics to defeat legendary heroes inspired from various historical eras like Ancient Rome, Feudal Japan, the Crusades, and many more.

5367060.name: DPS - 倉庫擴展包
5367060.desc: 擴充倉庫空間，輕鬆分類整理各類道具的實用禮包。

5367070.name: DPS - 支持者包
5367070.desc: 專為支持開發團隊的玩家準備的特別禮包。

5374820.name: DPS - 角色組合包：喬珀
5374820.desc: 手持巨型剪刀的小丑處刑人「喬珀」正式加入小隊！靈活切換戰鬥姿態，揮舞巨剪斬殺敵人，體驗全新近戰輸出角色的戰鬥魅力！

5403100.name: DPS - 便利功能包
5403100.desc: 減少重複操作，快速切換裝備與技能配置的便利功能包。

5404040.name: Lewd Life
5404040.desc: Sneak past the guards, use the map gimmicks, and open every locked door. 14 beauties are waiting on the other side — with an animated scene to match. 30 stages. 30 adult animations.

5135440.name: 桌面-DPS：黃昏遠征隊
5135440.desc: 工作、讀書時也能自動戰鬥的放置型RPG！收集各種魔物，組建專屬小隊，奪回被人類搶走的地下城核心！

5531040.name: Touchline Standard
5531040.desc: This supporter pack contains themes and the Nuberry handset. The Standard membership card for Goodwin Mutual is unlocked. Purchase this pack to support the development teams ongoing work on Touchline.

5531050.name: Touchline Gold
5531050.desc: This package contains all primary themes, 3 overhaul themes, the Nuberry and PalmPal phones, and the Gold Goodwin Mutual Membership card. Purchase this pack to support the development teams ongoing work on Touchline.

2132890.name: Possessor(s)
2132890.desc: 《Possessor(s)》是一款靈感取自平台戰鬥遊戲的快節奏橫向卷軸動作遊戲，探索富有深度且錯綜複雜的遊戲世界，體驗多位危險角色交織而成的奇妙故事。

2378620.name: 時空叛客
2378620.desc: 《時空叛客》是一款賽博龐克平台動作遊戲，遊戲中玩家將置身於一個光怪陸離世界之中，在合成波的背景音樂下，踏上穿梭時間與空間的冒險，與千奇百怪的敵人作戰， 在世界徹底陷入的混亂之前拯救一切。

794343.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Rear Echelon Cosmetic DLC
794343.desc: Who are those stylish chaps, you ask? Rear Echelon, my friend. With this exclusive pack of support troop themed items, you too can lead from the rear! Provides a set of new items for the US forces.

1042390.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Sgt Joe's Support Bundle DLC
1042390.desc: This Cosmetic DLC pack is entirely derived from the work of community developer "Sgt Joe" (and friends) on the Gameplay Overhaul Mutator - and all revenue from this DLC is shared with that team, to help encourage their work.

1905180.name: OBS Studio
1905180.desc: 免費且開放原始碼的錄影及直播串流軟體。

3837450.name: Wizzy the Wood
3837450.desc: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

4122390.name: Ophelia's Paradise
4122390.desc: 《奧菲莉亞的樂園》是一款俯視角2D肉鴿動作遊戲。暗影正在侵蝕這片樂土，而你是最後的守護者。在不斷變化的戰鬥中，收集武器與道具，自由組合出屬於你的戰鬥流派。每一局都會帶來不同的選擇與升級路線，讓戰鬥持續變化。面對愈發強大的敵潮，在一次次輪迴中變強，在黑暗中守住樂園。

3721530.name: 摩托車經銷商模擬器
3721530.desc: 買下生鏽的機車，修復每個零件，換上自訂烤漆和貼紙，試騎後再賣出賺取利潤。把廢棄老車改造成頂級重機，讓你的小車庫成為全城最棒的機車行。

4809970.name: WARDOGS - Movember Pack
4809970.desc: 留鬍子做公益！《WARDOGS》攜手 Movember 支持男性健康，邀請你和隊友一起在戰場上蓄鬍，為公益盡一份心力。入手戰術小鬍子 DLC，整個 11 月都能邊玩邊蓄鬍，還能解鎖可永久裝備的 Movember 2026 計分板徽章。這款 DLC 的所有收益都將直接捐給 Movember。

5399270.name: World War Z - Vacation Heat Character Skins Pack
5399270.desc: 換上這套付費造型，化身當地居民來守住佛羅里達街頭、抵擋屍潮。

5270320.name: World War Z - Florida Episode
5270320.desc: 歡迎來到佛羅里達！末日初臨，全新劇情章節的舞台將在這片有短吻鱷、棕櫚樹，如今還有殭屍的土地上展開。

3751490.name: Sitter
3751490.desc: 為了調查祖母離奇死亡的真相，一名警探闖入她的家。然而，房屋開始戲弄他：空間扭曲、恐懼化為實體，出口無處可尋。每一步、每個房間、每次循環，都讓他離瘋狂更近一步。

4411720.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
4411720.desc: 執掌一家籃球俱樂部，全方位掌控球隊發展。 組成陣容，發掘新秀，培養未來巨星，貫徹戰術理念，打造出屬於球隊的獨特風格。

5452340.name: RAYBREAKER
5452340.desc: A neon twin-stick shooter with the loot heart of an action RPG. Burn down a glowing fuse in 5 to 8 minute runs, read the swarm, break its bosses and bring home gear that rewrites your build. Six bands of a shattered spectrum, solo or in co-op for two, side by side or online.

4303280.name: Some Type of Trip
4303280.desc: 一款探索心靈深處的簡單打字敘事遊戲。時而溫馨舒適，時而緊張刺激，始終引人入勝。

5378030.name: La Muraille 1806
5378030.desc: 拿破崙時代的肉鴿塔防遊戲。守衛長城，抵禦末日的獸群。指揮歐洲聯軍，部署活生生的防線，阻擋成千上萬的敵人。瞄準！開火！指揮官，為人類再贏得一個黎明。

4932820.name: Bottle Flip Inc
4932820.desc: 一款以翻轉瓶子為核心的增量遊戲，解鎖並升級獨特能力，將簡單的翻瓶轉變為越來越令人滿足的精彩時刻。

4948250.name: Purrtopia
4948250.desc: 溫馨的像素貓桌面夥伴：在你工作或讀書時，牠就住在視窗上方。餵牠、陪牠玩、幫牠打扮，看著牠的個性慢慢展現：牠記得你的照顧，被吵醒會鬧脾氣，還會追捕玩具。

5286160.name: Tidyspell
5286160.desc: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

5472850.name: Vendilooper - original
5472850.desc: Incremental factory + automation clicker + vending machines + steampunk = Vendilooper. Build a snack empire you can get lost watching. Automate refills, stack machines into towers, and feed trains and rockets to Mars. How many snacks can you vend per minute?

4859520.name: Smashboom
4859520.desc: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

4545470.name: The Totemist
4545470.desc: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.

4083130.name: Against the Horde
4083130.desc: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

5074650.name: Memento Resonance
5074650.desc: 與原本是敵人的怪物產生共鳴，將牠們迎入隊伍。為技能裝配遺物，打造自己的戰鬥方式；追尋失落的記憶，攀登每次冒險都會變化的高塔——這是一款怪物收集類輕度 Rogue 回合制策略遊戲。

4993930.name: Pixel Worker
4993930.desc: Pixel Worker is a pixel-art work-life simulation where you take jobs, earn money, appraise gear, raise pets, mine, fish, cut jade, trade stocks, and play casino mini-games as you build your own path through a lively city.

5152150.name: Cocaine Smuggler
5152150.desc: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

4827000.name: Quarterheart
4827000.desc: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

5529130.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages Soundtrack
5529130.desc: The official soundtrack for game 'Choice of Life: Modern Ages' with music by 'misha root'

5400830.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
5400830.desc: 款溫馨的夢境整理模擬器：將 6344 隻立方體動物、120 個獨特物種放到對應的架子上。把混亂的夢境變成井然有序的收藏。

2450350.name: Fat Goblins
2450350.desc: 準備好迎接滿是哥布林、偷帽子、讓公主發胖的16對16基於團隊的戰鬥吧！圍攻城堡牆壁，救出你的胖乎乎的公主，用美味的肉讓敵人的公主發胖，解鎖新帽子和武器，並在愚蠢而混亂的PvP戰爭中反覆殺死對方！

movies.name: Fat Goblins Steam Next Fest Trailer

5417640.name: OFFICE
5417640.desc: 在賢是智惠曾經告白的同事，秀雅是她的好友。意外在公司地下檔案室撞見兩人的秘密後，明天上班，該怎麼面對他們？這是一部以韓國職場為背景的成人心理劇情視覺小說，描寫嫉妒、信任與 BDSM 交織的關係。

5487290.name: Sort the Creatures
5487290.desc: 一款療癒的收納遊戲，將超過4000隻可愛生物分類安置到適合的生態箱中。探索超過400種繽紛造型、解鎖實用能力，讓五彩繽紛的混亂化為充滿生機的收藏。

5186400.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
5186400.desc: 踏上火星，邁出你的第一步，迎接獨自在這顆紅色星球上生存的挑戰。建造你的第一座庇護所、確保維生資源、種植食物、研究新科技，並探索危機四伏的火星地表。你的生存之旅，就從這裡開始。

movies.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps - Release Trailer

4657320.name: The Lifeline
4657320.desc: 想逃離這座恐怖的醫院，你就必須拋開心中的恐懼。你做得到嗎？ 探索、對抗殭屍、使用武器、避開陷阱，並迅速反應以求生存。

214490.name: Alien: Isolation
214490.desc: Discover the true meaning of fear in Alien: Isolation, a survival horror set in an atmosphere of constant dread and mortal danger.

2860490.name: 笑死了，我家隔壁是魔王城www
2860490.desc: 【 村莊建設動作RPG 】被女神所救的你，穿越到一個遭魔王統治、荒廢已久的世界。收集素材、建造設施，靈活運用能夠切換職業的帽子，將各項工作交付給村民，讓村莊蓬勃發展吧。但就在某個夜晚，隔壁城堡竟舉辦了偶像魔王的演唱會，狂熱的魔物們如潮水般湧入村莊！？

compare.en: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon Kings Castle LOL

dlc.name: 笑死了，我家隔壁是魔王城www 試玩版
笑死了，我家隔壁是魔王城www Playtest

4651080.name: CelSector
4651080.desc: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.

3920.name: Sid Meier's Pirates!
3920.desc: Sail the Caribbean, marauding all on the high seas or ally your ship and crew as a privateer in search of riches - the life you choose is up to you. Face dogged enemies, raid unsuspecting villages, woo fair maidens, avoid capture or dig for buried treasure. Discover what it takes to become one of the most famous pirates in history!

281610.name: Homeworld: Deserts of Kharak
281610.desc: A ground-based RTS prequel to the classic Homeworld games. Assemble your fleet and lead them to victory on the shifting sands of Kharak in this compelling strategy game for PC from Blackbird Interactive.

movies.name: Homeworld: Deserts of Kharak Accolades Trailer
Homeworld: Deserts of Kharak Launch Trailer

2228030.name: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
2228030.desc: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game that will push your skills to the limit.

movies.name: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine - Release Trailer
Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine - Announcement Trailer 2

5402730.name: Core Awakened
5402730.desc: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.

4694530.name: Under Tower Idle
4694530.desc: Build, expand, and automate your island empire in this 3D idle clicker adventure. Gather resources, train units, and conquer dangerous dungeons.

5503580.name: Audio Motion Lab
5503580.desc: 製作隨節拍律動的音樂影片。使用自己的音樂，或從內建的 100 多首範例曲目中挑選。自由搭配特效，打造自己的風格，最高可匯出 4K、每秒 60 影格的影片。入門教學會帶你開始。

5211040.name: DESIRO.
5211040.desc: Hello there, kind stranger!! DESIR〇. Find your inner peace and the cosmic truth in this minimalist, relaxed network-building thingy. Build systems. Observe tiny commuters. Discover bottlenecks. Attain enlightenment... >> Chill tunes and nice visuals to boot ◯∘

5053000.name: From Zero: Idle Factory
5053000.desc: 從一台機器起步，逐步拓展到五座工廠。在這款放置型增量經營遊戲中，建立生產鏈、研究更好的零件，再將利潤投入下一階段的發展。找出生產瓶頸，選好下一項升級，一步步邁向最終目標。

movies.name: From Zero: Idle Factory - Gameplay Trailer

5298430.name: Detonator Squad
5298430.desc: Team up for explosive co-op, take on the campaign solo, or challenge friends in Arena PvP. Clear 20 levels of enemies and spawners, find upgrades and plan your escape before the bombs go off. Play with up to four in campaign or eight in continuous Arena battles.

5462360.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター
5462360.desc: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.

4606680.name: Super Slime
4606680.desc: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.

4747930.name: The Witch
4747930.desc: The Witch is a co-op survival horror game for up to 6 players featuring physics-based interaction, proximity voice chat, powerful spells, and a monster that hears every sound you make. Explore Castle Blackmoor with your friends, unravel its secrets, and find a way to escape alive.

5333020.name: 電競教父擴展包3
5333020.desc: 《电竞教父：英雄扩展 3》带来六位全新英雄、全新装备与15条版本规则。从越战越勇的正面交锋，到隐匿追猎、标记处决，甚至提前开启决战，围绕英雄能力构筑新的阵容与卡牌战术，在变化的版本中找到属于你的制胜组合。

5292020.name: Master Of Kebab
5292020.desc: Run your own kebab business on the night streets of Istanbul. Prepare ingredients, cook different meals, serve customers, manage your supplies, upgrade your shop and deal with unexpected events in this first-person cooking and business simulation.

movies.name: Master Of Kebab Trailer Game Play

4400020.name: The Dust Between: Observer
4400020.desc: 遭塵埃感染的地表世界，早已面目全非。身為觀察者，你必須繪製新地圖、發掘線索，並透過與外勤人員的通訊連線調查外界。獨自熬過這份非比尋常的辦公室工作所帶來的危險，或找朋友一起來上班。

4518950.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum
4518950.desc: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

3737610.name: Explosiovania
3737610.desc: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

4866510.name: Purrfect Beats
4866510.desc: 一隻貓、電子復古音樂（Synthwave）和僅需一個按鍵來考驗你的節奏感。能有多難呢？

4640230.name: Counter Targets Clicker
4640230.desc: A short incremental shooting range game that starts simple and gets CRAZY. Shoot targets, earn money, buy upgrades, unlock and customize new weapons - all to earn even more money.

2784470.name: 九王 9 Kings
2784470.desc: 《九王》是一款快節奏的王國建造遊戲，玩家將建設王國，在戰場上與強大的敵方國王決一死戰。組合出打破成規的牌組，成為萬王之王！

2953940.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
2953940.desc: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

5056840.name: Toybox Tactics
5056840.desc: Enter a block-sized world and conquer the world by defending your towers in this colorful strategy game!

5311340.name: Royal Court
5311340.desc: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.

5104100.name: Lifespan.exe
5104100.desc: 你是否好奇過另一種人生會是怎樣？在Lifespan.exe中一切無法重來。在復古終端中體驗精美ASCII藝術，譜寫專屬命運：成為音樂家、運動員、外科醫生或黑幫；自主挑選伴侶與職業生涯。結婚成家、深陷債務、鋃鐺入獄或環遊世界。做出每個抉擇，盡情享受你渴望探索的人生！

5226580.name: Mask Splitters
5226580.desc: Play as a powerful ninja archer capable of teleporting to your arrows. Outplay and outsmart your friends in this frantic arena party game and become the ultimate Mask Splitter!

4821590.name: Solbreak Skirmish
4821590.desc: Solbreak Skirmish is a fast-paced tactical 1v1 battle with RTS-like mechanics. Control your units, each with a unique ability, to help turn the tide of battle in your favor! With multiple win conditions, there's plenty of room for skill expression and creativity to take down your opponent.

5204500.name: 拼題獵碼手 VI
5204500.desc: 用程式策劃完美犯罪——甚至可以 Vibe Coding。

5289760.name: Monster Girls of Another World: Pleasure Chronicle
5289760.desc: 探索城鎮、賺取金錢，前往魔物娘的娼館，再把親身體驗寫成文章，在酒館販售，為下一次邂逅賺取資金！這是一款輕鬆上手的成人動作角色扮演遊戲，所有成人場景均以流暢的像素動畫呈現，動態CG總數超過200張，讓你盡享與各式魔物娘共度的親密時光。戰鬥只需一個按鍵，簡單易玩；還能接受公會委託，外出冒險，或透過釣魚、吃角子老虎、二十一點和撲克等小遊戲賺取收益。挑選釣竿與魚餌，挑戰稀有魚種，找到自己擅長的賺錢方式，在探索、賺錢、體驗與寫作之間，享受為期30天的魔物娘生活！

3373580.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
3373580.desc: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

movies.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. release date trailer - "Getting Wise"
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. announcement trailer - "Winner Takes All"

3373590.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. Soundtrack
3373590.desc: This soundtrack for There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. includes two tracks: the game's title track "To the Victor" with lyrics, which can be heard on the game's title screen, and an instrumental version of that same song.

5493890.name: Slots & Slaughter Demo
5493890.desc: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

4451040.name: Corridor 13
4451040.desc: 一款以廢棄校園走廊為舞台的心理異常恐怖遊戲。找出發生變化的地方，並做出正確的選擇。但即使做出了正確的選擇，也不代表你能逃離這裡。走廊不會輕易放你離開。

408520.name: FORM
408520.desc: Enter a surreal adventure where puzzles are built from dreams and memories. Solve the mystery behind an ancient artifact. Advance through a world that transforms around you. Transcend this existence.

237950.name: UFO: Afterlight
237950.desc: The story is situated on Mars. It starts where UFO: Aftermath left off and runs simultaneously with UFO: Aftershock. While the Laputans on Earth are fighting Wargots and Starghosts and finding out what caused the destruction of their home planet, a small colony on Mars is trying to survive and flourish.

2818110.name: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia
2818110.desc: 《喵在江湖》是一款融合桌面陪伴與武俠養成的放置遊戲。讓一隻喵大俠陪在桌邊，修習心法、搭配招式、蒐集裝備，在自動戰鬥中闖蕩江湖。閒暇時調整打法、打通經脈、突破境界，陪牠一步步實現大俠夢。

dlc.name: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia Demo (喵在江湖 Demo)

4136760.name: TowerBits8
4136760.desc: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.

5295780.name: Undealt - Veyra
5295780.desc: 死靈法師Veyra帶著完整技能樹與魔法書裝備加入Undealt。掌握骷髏與復活的敵人，並將該英雄放入任意隊伍欄位。需要免費的Undealt主程式。

5205880.name: Undealt
5205880.desc: Undealt是一款住在螢幕角落裡的放置RPG。你工作或玩其他遊戲時，四位英雄會自行戰鬥。回來裝備戰利品、鍛造更好的裝備、學習技能，收集能改寫戰鬥規則的卡牌。免費遊玩。

5390550.name: 隔壁人妻 - 趁丈夫不在榨乾我
5390550.desc: 一位美麗迷人的人妻搬到了隔壁。某天，趁丈夫不在家，她突然向你發出大膽的邀請。面對她甜蜜的誘惑，你根本無法抗拒。背著她的丈夫，兩人逐漸陷入甜蜜而淫靡的祕密關係之中……

4435810.name: 焚天烈火之元素领主
4435810.desc: 经典1:1原味复刻，战法道三职业重聚！⚔️ 踏入充满争夺与挑战的传奇世界，挑战强大 BOSS，收集装备，培养并肩作战的英雄，施展强大的英雄合击。集结行会伙伴征战沙城，争夺战场上的荣誉与资源。老情怀与新体验碰撞，焕新出发！

5040220.name: HoloCozy
5040220.desc: HoloCozy 是一款溫馨療癒的放置型桌面陪伴遊戲，讓你與 hololive 成員在舒適的房間裡共度悠閒時光。聆聽音樂與環境音，在工作、學習或休息時讓喜愛的角色陪伴在旁，並按照自己的步調見證她們成長。

5412000.name: Jibtik - جبتك
5412000.desc: Play Solitaire. Move cards, undo a move, start a new deal, or check the in-game guide at your own pace. Then Explore DLCs. العب سوليتير بنظام سحب بطاقة واحدة. يمكنك نقل البطاقات، والتراجع عن خطوة، وبدء جولة جديدة، أو الرجوع إلى دليل اللعبة وبالسرعة التي تناسبك. ثم إستكشف الألعاب الأخرى.

5339620.name: DEFY
5339620.desc: Two nations, each certain it is the hero, fight over a beautiful world running out of supply. Blow the bridges, burn the forests, bring the buildings down. Villagers hide in cellars or take up arms, and a downed aircraft falls on what lies beneath it. Real-time strategy for up to eight leaders.

5335410.name: Calamity Quarry
5335410.desc: 隕石墜落了，而你是來開採它的。把游標停在隕石上採掘，用龐大的技能樹強化裝置，然後祈求下一場災厄。接下來會落下什麼，我們不會告訴你。祈禱吧。

5430150.name: Mosquito Problem
5430150.desc: Survive as a mosquito in a punk musician’s apartment. Learn his habits, avoid his traps and slaps, drink his blood and upgrade your skills. Spend blood at the Roach Market, spin the Lucky Wheel for free boosts and explore an apartment full of fun, interactive things to do.

4459590.name: Slotbound
4459590.desc: 這是一款讓運氣與策略交織的 Roguelike 自動戰鬥防守遊戲。轉動 3×3 拉霸機召喚單位，透過吸收其他單位來壯大你的軍隊。運用道具與核心改變機率、扭轉戰局，並在危險的審判波次與 Boss 戰中存活下來。每一次轉動、每一個選擇，都至關重要。

4348420.name: 穿刺
4348420.desc: PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing. A yuri dark fantasy.

4829780.name: Frontier Tale
4829780.desc: 《开拓物语》是一款融合了戰術撤離與領地建設的冒險種田遊戲。鍛造獨特武器，探索世界、尋找稀有寶物，在這個以療癒系賽璐璐動畫風格打造的奇幻世界中，與個性十足的夥伴們一同開拓繼承自先祖的遺落領地。收集資源、建造村莊、建立羈絆，勤勞致富，親手打造屬於你的頂級夢幻家園！

4672480.name: 雞瘟檢察官：最後的IKUN
4672480.desc: 一場致命的雞瘟疫摧毀了世界。 作為人類最後一個安全區的守衛，你必須檢查尋求庇護的倖存者，一個錯誤可能會毀滅整個社區，在允許他們進入之前，要仔細檢查每個人。

3745320.name: 三國往事：季漢之魂
3745320.desc: Arcade Three Kingdoms! Wolf-style forging! Soul-style map! Follow Zhao Yun on his lifetime journey, while the narrative focuses on the historical masterpieces of Liu Bei and Cao Cao.

3256790.name: Satelital
3256790.desc: 一款規則探索類解謎遊戲，玩家需將外星符號放置在網格上。在穿越充滿氛圍感的太陽系旅程中，逐步揭開這些符號背後的邏輯。

5435120.name: PrintMarket
5435120.desc: Build and manage your own 3D printing shop. Buy printers, load colorful filaments, produce and sell models, and reinvest in your workshop. Organize your space, manage electricity and materials, and grow from your first machine to an automated production line.

5480320.name: ！？龙龙？！
5480320.desc: A pixel shooter with automatic fire, random loot, and permanent upgrades. Steer your fighter left and right, combining gear, relics, and items packed with memes. Spend gold on the skill tree, chase survival records, and face a boss with three phases. Your next chest might hold a surprise!

4421480.name: Best Streamer
4421480.desc: A ruthless streamer simulation where you'll do anything to reach the top. Grow legally with content or eliminate rivals with weapons. Manage survival needs, use illegal tactics to crush the competition, evade the police, and become the world's number one streamer

5381000.name: 白雪公主與矮人奴隸
5381000.desc: 在桌面底部運行的簡單經營遊戲。安排矮人採集、製作、研究和交易，發展你的村落。每十年向兇悍的巨龍白雪公主獻上黃金，在長達百年的童話中生存下來。

5417410.name: 還債時光：自動化
5417410.desc: 鎮長又來催債了。別慌，從一把鎬子開始，把礦場、農田、熔爐和工作台用導管連成生產線，讓小鎮自己替你賺錢。接委託、解鎖配方、賣貨還債，早日無債一身輕。

2810320.name: 世界傳記
2810320.desc: 奇幻王道RPG，主打AP行動回合制戰鬥與多項RPG養成要素，同時也有著豐富多樣與扣人心弦的角色劇情。

5432450.name: 波霸奶．茶
5432450.desc: 獨特的雙牌組構築性愛戰鬥遊戲。構築兩副牌組，一副普通牌組一副慾望牌組。隨著慾望值升高，將會抽出越來越多強力的慾望卡牌。但是小心!一但慾望牌組抽乾，遊戲就Game Over了!

movies.name: Booba Milk Tea Gameplay Trailer Traditional Chinese

4591260.name: Desktop Claw Master
4591260.desc: 當你工作或享受遊戲的時候，Graboo 會在畫面的一角，靜靜地夾起娃娃朋友們。 請為孤單的 Graboo 送上溫暖的朋友吧！

2891970.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker
2891970.desc: 你是大天使的一片靈魂碎片，擁有雙翼和一把有生命的劍，每次招架都會讓它變得更強。你就是梅內斯。擊敗神明與怪物，克服重重險阻，揭開神秘的傳說，探索超現實的奇景。

movies.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker Game and OST Preview

5387660.name: STRAW
5387660.desc: 把教室變成紙團競技場！STRAW 是色彩繽紛的俯視角射擊遊戲，可單人對抗電腦玩家，或透過 Steam 線上連線與最多 16 名參與者同場遊玩。用吸管發射紙團，完成課堂任務，小心別被老師抓到！

5490150.name: PARTNERS IN PANIC - asymmetric CO-OP driving game
5490150.desc: TWO COPS. ONE CAR. ZERO CHILL. In this asymmetric CO-OP driving game, one player drives while the other navigates and leans out the window to shoot out the suspect’s tyre. Keep the windscreen clear, communicate under pressure, and work together to end the chase!

5462040.name: KNURLWORM
5462040.desc: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The KNURLWORM.

594130.name: Winds of Change
594130.desc: Lead The Rebellion, build your army, and shape the world with your choices. A story-heavy adventure game with multiple endings, romance options, and non-linear storytelling. A vast fantasy world waiting to be explored. Inspired by Dragon Age, and Mass Effect. Fully voice acted by a stellar cast!

206190.name: Gunpoint
206190.desc: Gunpoint is a stealth puzzle game that lets you rewire its levels to trick people. You play a freelance spy who takes jobs from his clients to break into high security buildings and steal sensitive data.

268130.name: Heat Signature
268130.desc: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.

597170.name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
597170.desc: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone is a robot voxel slice-em-up where any part of your body can be sliced off. With your mind downloaded into a robot gladiator, you must survive the sinister trials of the arena.

compare.en: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone

2319390.name: Kvark
2319390.desc: Kvark is an FPS game set in a fictional version of the 80s Czech Republic. The player finds themselves in an underground facility that is falling apart as they travel through it. They will have to navigate through dark tunnels and will encounter many obstacles and enemies that will test their skills

235320.name: Original War
235320.desc: An American geological expedition, under a UN mandate, assesses the natural resources in a distant part of Siberia, deep in the trackless steppes of Eastern Russia. But instead of oil, they discover a deposit of a hitherto unknown mineral.

1781070.name: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 黑絲襪貓咪套裝
1781070.desc: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 黑絲襪貓咪套裝

1781100.name: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 假日泳裝
1781100.desc: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 假日泳裝

1855260.name: Retrowave - Map Pack
1855260.desc: Continue your exploration in the world of Retrowave with these unique new worlds!

277777.name: Train Simulator: Weardale & Teesdale Network Route Add-On
277777.desc: Some of the north east of England’s oldest and most important railway lines come together in the stunning new Weardale & Teesdale Network route for Train Simulator.The broad network of railway lines connected some of the north east’s largest town and cities with collieries across the Pennines, with the first line opening in 1825 that...

561620.name: American Truck Simulator - Dragon Truck Design Pack
561620.desc: 使用獨特的選項改裝卡車：獨特的Dragon烤漆、Dragon設計輪圈、Dragon設計金屬方向盤

398916.name: Armello - The Bandit Clan
398916.desc: 愛門羅首款部族DLC，使用惡名昭彰的強盜部族來場榮譽之戰！強盜部族包含了四位新英雄，超過50個獨特的部族任務，部族骰子，一枚新的部族戒指和一堆優質好禮哦！

304212.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Scandinavia
304212.desc: Scandinavia擴充插件包括瑞典、挪威和丹麥，你可以在這三個佔地廣闊的北歐國家中探索不盡的美麗風光。你還可以在新的渡輪碼頭直接登上渡輪，探索27個斯堪的納維亞城市、新產業以及超過80種的新貨物。

946970.name: Scroll Of Taiwu - OST
946970.desc: 《太吾绘卷》的无损原声音乐，共收录了游戏中40首原创音乐。

318521.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Raven Truck Design Pack
318521.desc: 使用獨特的改裝選項自行改裝卡車：4種座艙配件、3種前後輪圈以及2種烤漆。

1888350.name: Easy Red 2: Stalingrad
1888350.desc: 伏爾加河尚未失守！ 來吧，同志們 透過《Easy Red 2：史達林格勒》，您將首次將戰線擴展到東方，在蘇聯的心臟地帶使用新武器、車輛、制服和任務！

1256030.name: Neon Beats - A beat further
1256030.desc: Your favorite minimalist platformer returns with more content! Discover new Mechanics, Levels and Musics!

461245.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - South Korean Paint Jobs Pack
461245.desc: Customize your truck with your country flag! A choice of four unique paint jobs will come handy if you feel you need to show your affiliation... Taekwondo Gamer Paradise South Korean Flag South Korean Flag DecalAll of these themes are applicable to any in-game truck except for 8x4 chassis configurations.

336370.name: LISA: Original Soundtrack + Art Collection
336370.desc: A total of 90 red hot pieces of sick 'zick (music) for you to lick!!! And the hottest aork around town.

398913.name: Armello - Usurpers Hero Pack
398913.desc: 加入以愛門羅的王座為目標的人們吧！有四位新的英雄還有四個新的戒指，每個部族各一個！

737270.name: Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Pulling Rank Cosmetic DLC
737270.desc: Show your team that you're above the rank and file with this set of Customization options that put you a cut above regular infantry.

2925190.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Radical Reptiles
2925190.desc: 活力充沛的2人組與烏龜們一起踏上另一趟精彩的冒險！

3816120.name: 重生2我独自逆袭 Re2 I Rise Alone
3816120.desc: Interactive movie‑game blending SLG gameplay and real‑life romance simulation: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out a power‑fantasy rags‑to‑riches story. Combat, character progression, drinking and romance — all in one! 100‑GB content volume- redefines your power‑fantasy experience!

4915680.name: StreamLay
4915680.desc: Your supporters become little characters that walk across your stream. Donations, follows, subs, bits, Super Chats and raids bring them in, and bigger support makes them grow and transform. Add a goal bar, a leaderboard, a viewer queue and daily check-ins. For OBS, through Streamlabs.

5360820.name: DesktopKins
5360820.desc: Bring your desktop to life with playful 3D companions. Customize your DesktopKins, play soccer and other mini-games, and watch them interact with windows and icons. Keep up to four companions by your side, using included characters or your own compatible VRM models.

movies.name: Play Ball and Custom Character features

5469840.name: Kinetile
5469840.desc: Build a route for one rolling ball, then let physics test your plan. Arrange jumps, teleports and sliding platforms in this 3D puzzle. Solve 56 handcrafted levels, then keep going with endless generated puzzles in Infinity mode. No timer, no move limit.

5360480.name: Hellterns
5360480.desc: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

5073710.name: Inkturn
5073710.desc: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

5289950.name: Keep Farming Aura
5289950.desc: 不斷刷取 Aura，讓每個動作都推動你的成長。吸引越來越多觀眾、組建自己的團隊、解鎖升級並挑戰強大的對手，從默默無名一路成為 Aura 傳奇。這是一款主動式 3D 增量遊戲。

5184460.name: 農場守護者
5184460.desc: 守好農田，強化傭兵，擊倒敵人取得聖物強化自身。就算倒下，累積的成長也不會白費。

movies.name: 農場守護者 CropKeep 預告片

5553260.name: Pixelithra
5553260.desc: Pixelithra is a pixel art and animation studio for Windows. Draw sprites and backgrounds, animate frame by frame, and keep curves, shapes, and linked fills editable as you refine your artwork.

5044500.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院
5044500.desc: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

5397100.name: Witch’s Cottage: Tidy Up the Potions!
5397100.desc: A cozy first-person tidying game with magical upgrades. Sort over 3,000 potions in a four-storey witch’s cottage. Find matching bottles, complete sets and unlock spells that summon potions to your hands and send them onto shelves. Turn a magical mess into a collection worth admiring.

movies.name: Witch’s Cottage: Tidy Up the Potions!

5376970.name: Farm Business Simulator
5376970.desc: 把一座小院子發展成供應全鎮的農場。種植作物、加工商品、配送訂單、擴展生意——單人遊玩，或最多 4 人合作。

5448590.name: AI面接官を突破せよ
5448590.desc: 履歴書に「幽霊」「前世」「土下座」!? 指定された変なワードを全部入れて履歴書を書き、AI面接官の審査を突破せよ。質問はあなたの履歴書からAIがその場で考える。言い訳とこじつけで採用をもぎ取る、おバカ就活ゲーム。

5454930.name: No Refunds
5454930.desc: 一款 1~4 人合作的直播購物派對遊戲。在幕後偷偷測試來路不明的商品，再到鏡頭前大膽喊出賣點把它賣掉。用謊言衝高銷量、躲開反駁蜂鳴器，撐過隨之而來的退貨、貓咪和各種混亂。

5513760.name: 拼豆农场 : ColorFarm
5513760.desc: A cozy farming companion that lives in the corner of your desktop. Earn coins through everyday keyboard and mouse activity, grow colorful plants, turn each harvest into bead-art materials, create freely from patterns, collect your artwork, and expand your own floating farms.

5496700.name: Sudoku Supreme
5496700.desc: Sudoku, beautifully set. 200 puzzles across four difficulty levels - Easy, Medium, Hard and Supreme. Every puzzle has one unique solution, with difficulty shaped by the logic it takes to solve it.

5379860.name: Maze Echo
5379860.desc: Someone here knows what you've forgotten. Explore a sanatorium and its mirror world, piece together lost memories, and decide whom to trust in this psychological horror visual novel. Your state of mind shapes some of the choices ahead.

4553880.name: 百萬立方
4553880.desc: 《Million Cube》是一款支援最多30人連線的迷宮探索遊戲。你需要從最多100萬個房間中，找出唯一正確的房間。循著門上文字和周圍景色中隱藏的線索，向終點房間前進吧！

4631070.name: Vroomity Loops
4631070.desc: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout common sense goes out the window.

4188070.name: 來吃！小兔麵包房
4188070.desc: 現在，開始在桌面經營麵包坊吧！從一塊餅乾、第一張餐桌起步。佈置小店、提升廚藝、聘請特色店員、學習新菜色……滿足一個個生動有趣的兔子顧客點單，同時邂逅那些或溫情、或古怪、或令人捧腹的小兔，收穫它們的食譜與故事。

4337080.name: 龙晶 Draconite
4337080.desc: 《龍晶》是一款Furry主題的以探索與敘事為核心的橫向捲軸冒險遊戲。故事發生在龍晶研究所召開第六次龍晶科技峰會之際，你將作為研究所的一名安保隊員，在峰會期間執行安保任務，與角色互動，解開謎題，收集隱秘的線索，並逐步揭開平靜表象下的暗湧。

movies.name: 《龙晶draconite》游戏终极预告英文字幕

3067590.name: 地下創世紀 II
3067590.desc: 時間所剩無幾，食物與飲水告罄，守護者的代理人正一個個地殺害受困的英雄。不列顛尼亞的命運再次掌握在你手中。

4707110.name: Outralism
4707110.desc: A minimalist black-and-white rhythm game made for modding. Play songs from the Steam Workshop, chart your own, write Lua mods in the game's own editor, and play together in Steam lobbies of up to 16 players.

5242390.name: Nightcup
5242390.desc: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

5465780.name: Vape Empire Simulator Demo
5465780.desc: Run your own vape shop for five days. Stock the shelves, set your prices against a moving market, serve customers at the till and grow your reputation. Your shop is saved, so you can carry on from day six in the full game.

5270190.name: A.N.S.I.A.
5270190.desc: It's your first day at ANSIA. Review citizens' paperwork according to regulations that change every day, growing more absurd by the minute. A satire of Italian bureaucracy inspired by Papers, Please, with 4 different endings.

2174510.name: Backseat Champions
2174510.desc: 成為賽車工程師，在短暫而刺激的比賽中指揮你的AI車手。規劃進站策略，應用升級，並在不斷變化的天氣中管理加速。觀察AI訓練的車手讓每場比賽都獨一無二。現在開始比賽，擊敗你的對手！

5326680.name: Career Manager 27
5326680.desc: Experience a complete football career, from the youth academy to stardom. Create your player, develop through training, earn a place in the senior squad, compete matches, negotiate contracts, and turn every decision into part of your legacy.

5485410.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator - First Bite
5485410.desc: Get your first taste of running a bakery in space in this free introduction to Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator. Bake sweet treats, serve coffee, put your robot helper to work, and adopt a cat — solo or with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5579680.name: Pop Dynasty Demo
5579680.desc: 打造屬於你的經紀公司的放置經營模擬遊戲。從200位流行明星中招募新人，安排訓練，送他們去巡演，在頒獎典禮上爭奪獎盃。即使關閉遊戲，經紀公司也會持續運作。而奪冠，只是一切的開始。

3178040.name: Deja-Vu of the Dead
3178040.desc: Drink. Die. Repeat. When a mysterious experimental sparks a city-wide zombie outbreak you find yourself trapped in a 25-minute temporal time loop. Every decision you make matters. Explore an interconnected city, talk to fully voiced survivors, collect weapons, and uncover 24 distinct endings.

movies.name: Deja-Vu of the Dead: Boss Trailer

5372780.name: Spirithale
5372780.desc: Spirithale is a strategy god game where you guide the natural world as an animal spirit. Shape regions, create ecosystems, inspire civilizations, and compete with rival spirits for dominion over an evolving world.

2932260.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
2932260.desc: 《Trine 6: Together in Time》是一款支援1至4人的合作解謎平台遊戲。運用智慧、節奏與合作，破解謎題、對抗狡猾生物，穿越險峻道路，展開全新奇幻冒險。

movies.name: Trine 6: Together in Time Announce Trailer
Trine 6: Together in Time Announce Trailer

609320.name: FAR: Lone Sails
609320.desc: 在散佈著衰落文明遺跡的乾涸海床上穿行。讓自己獨特的小車不斷前行，克服重重的障礙，抵禦危險的天氣。你能行多遠？你能找到什麼？

700160.name: Semblance
700160.desc: Semblance is an innovative platformer with deformable terrain, set in a beautiful minimalist world. It’s a game that asks, what if you could deform and reshape the world itself? Semblance takes the idea of a ‘platform’ in a platformer and turns it on its head.

13600.name: Prince of Persia®: The Sands of Time
13600.desc: Amidst the scorched sands of ancient Persia, there is a legend spun in an ancient tongue. It speaks of a time borne by blood and ruled by deceit. Drawn to the dark powers of a magic dagger, a young Prince is led to unleash a deadly evil upon a beautiful kingdom.

compare.en: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time

900270.name: Reventure
900270.desc: The one and only non-linear adventure with 100 different endings. Don't just wishlist me. I'm not that expensive... also, look at those reviews!

4614660.name: 精喜全孕會
4614660.desc: 你麾下有一支由四位頂級「臀部健將」組成的隊伍，她們正全力以赴，力求在各項競技中刷新個人紀錄。身為受聘的專業人員，你的任務就是為這些擁有完美身材的美女們提供她們所需的競技優勢。

5189780.name: Aspect Arena
5189780.desc: A siege auto-battler. Buy fighters, arm them, order the line, then watch sixty seconds decide it without you. Fifteen wins takes a campaign, one castle carries every wound it took getting there, and the rival Aspect opposite is building too.

5297870.name: Hellmouth
5297870.desc: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!

3502460.name: Gun Gone Wrong
3502460.desc: A first-person survivors-like: trapped parents, a real gun in each hand, and hordes of teddy bears. Shoot your way out of child TV hell.

2498890.name: BOOM! Buster
2498890.desc: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.

5375890.name: Sort Them Dice
5375890.desc: 在這款溫馨的第一人稱整理遊戲中，把雜亂的骰子商店變成令人滿足的收藏天地。探索六個主題區域，撿起並欣賞 4,235 顆骰子，將它們配成 605 套，擺滿木製貨架，解鎖實用升級。

3763040.name: Mellings
3763040.desc: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

5132920.name: Pigeon Ball
5132920.desc: Pigeon Ball 是一款節奏快速的第一人稱／第三人稱多人運動遊戲。鴿子們會飛行、啄擊、傳球，並為爭奪球權而戰。掌握移動、擊敗對手，在混亂的競技場比賽中踢進精彩進球。

4768630.name: LARVIS
4768630.desc: Draw your cards, uncover stories, and question everything in this magical Indie experience that transcends the boundaries of art and tabletop games.

1504100.name: Playground VR
1504100.desc: 想搭熱氣球？快上來！想坐大砲出門？鑽進去！在這款開放世界 VR 物理沙盒裡，你可以在 Sunset Circuit 飆車、自己造車，或從屋頂一路翻過去。堅持走大馬路的話，城裡也有。

4505200.name: Retro Music Player
4505200.desc: A customizable retro-inspired music widget that lets you import your favorite songs, create vinyl records, organize collections, and enjoy reactive visuals while you listen.

movies.name: RETRO MUSIC PLAYER - Official Demo Trailer

5257620.name: One More Rule
5257620.desc: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

4487360.name: Spinova
4487360.desc: A Slavic-myth slot roguelike. Build a deck of symbols, hang Ancients over the grid, bargain in the shop, and squeeze multipliers from every spin before the Kolovrat slips into a spiral for good.

4578320.name: Deathly Delights
4578320.desc: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

5326850.name: Music Empire Tycoon
5326850.desc: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.

4959060.name: Legacy Miner
4959060.desc: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

3687090.name: Dice Hoarder
3687090.desc: 《Dice Hoarder》是一款溫馨的整理遊戲，你將為一間神秘的骰子商店補貨。分類整理店內的每一顆骰子，將它們配對組成完整的七顆一組 TRPG 骰組，並揭開這份新工作背後隱藏的祕密。

4930190.name: Drive or Die
4930190.desc: With the horde behind you and asphalt in front, there's only one choice. Drive or Die. An arcade roguelite about outrunning the apocalypse in a gun covered junker. Draft cards, chain kills, die, upgrade and go again.

5408770.name: 5 Nights at Data Center
5408770.desc: Walter Kessler works the night shift at a data center that is always quiet, always cold, and never quite right. Five nights of first-person psychological horror: clear the alerts, walk the halls, answer the radio, and make it to six.

4688730.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn
4688730.desc: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night

5501670.name: The City - Force of Nature
5501670.desc: A weather and disaster expansion for The City. Track storms on the forecast, then watch your city face lightning, hail, floods, forest fires, earthquakes and EF0 to EF5 tornadoes. Build sirens, shelters, levees and seawalls, drain flooded streets, insure your buildings and rebuild.

5409100.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness
5409100.desc: 踏入十二間受詛咒的密室，體驗哥德式生存遊戲。武器會自動攻擊，靈活走位才能活下來。發現100種武器，裝備數量不限，挑戰越來越難的關卡和頭目，向黑暗深處進發。（非 Roguelike 遊戲）

4433840.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector
4433840.desc: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!

4382510.name: Monster Girls Dice Board
4382510.desc: 在充满神秘魔法的米斯特利亚岛上，与个性各异的魔物娘们一起展开刺激的骰子冒险！通过策略棋盘游戏收集资源、购买土地、展开友好竞争，与她们建立温暖的羁绊，共同探索奇幻岛屿！

3540610.name: 星源獵手：歸航
3540610.desc: 這是一款俯視角動作RogueLite遊戲。​​ 挑選武器與成群的異星生物戰鬥。從各種升級模組與道具中構築獨特的戰鬥風格。 捕捉異星生物：馴服牠們使用特殊能力，或帶回基地生產資源。 選擇武器，征服這顆星球吧！

4960970.name: Monster Girl Tactics: Oubliette
4960970.desc: A dark romance SRPG. Pledge your life to feisty and unhinged monstergirls, then defeat your foes using careful positioning and strategical wit. From the downtrodden rise a revolting mafia; join them in a wild hunt for power, revenge, change... and love.

2408840.name: 不煉丹，就會死
2408840.desc: 這是一款第一人稱煉丹輕度Rogue遊戲。一覺醒來，你被困在邪尊的丹房裡，你必須靠煉丹交貢，換來活過明天的機會。親手拿丹、投料、用火，在成功、損傷與報廢之間決定何時收手，組合丹器、藥引和火種，讓機率為你所用，每一天都將是全新的挑戰，那麼，你能活到逃出去的那一天嗎？

movies.name: 不煉丹，就會死 - 玩法宣傳片

5300300.name: Elementys
5300300.desc: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

5082170.name: Fruit Kombat
5082170.desc: 爆紅的水果狗血劇，如今變成一款混亂的3D格鬥遊戲。當水果們在健身房裡算總帳時，體驗八點檔式的背叛和沒人想看的真相。刷滿氣場，釋放武器終結技，單機對戰和Steam線上PvP都能打。

331480.name: Pinstripe
331480.desc: An ex-minister ventures through the frozen depths of Hell in search of his kidnapped daughter.

2406770.name: Bodycam
2406770.desc: Bodycam 是虛幻引擎 5 中第一款具有真實隨身攝影機視野的戰術多人 FPS。近距離戰鬥感覺原始而響亮。每個角度、標註和項目符號都很重要。在逼真的地圖上玩死亡競賽、團隊死亡競賽和僚機，其中團隊合作、戰術和關鍵技能是關鍵沒有準星、彈藥計數器或 HUD。團隊合作與戰術決策將決定勝負。每次交火都要求你保持冷靜、精準並迅速行動。沉浸在逼真的戰場中，與隊友配合完成任務。在瞬息萬變的戰局中，善用掩體、聆聽聲音並掌握每個關鍵時刻。

movies.name: Bodycam Major Update Locked And Loaded Reactions

773370.name: Exo One
773370.desc: 奇怪的信號…外星飛行器…穿梭星際與時間展開一場反重力的旅程。

5487820.name: World of Stick
5487820.desc: Defend your base, recruit an army, gather resources, and fight epic battles in this real-time strategy game! Play the campaign, survive waves of enemies, and challenge other players online.

4369110.name: デモンズゲート with サバゲでGo!
4369110.desc: 享受角色養成。超過100個角色槽位。自動推進的派遣系統。超過50個關卡。也可全程自動推進。 戰術角色扮演遊戲（Tactical RPG） 策略角色扮演遊戲（SRPG） 基於網格的回合制戰術遊戲 日式回合制戰術RPG系列

dlc.name: デモンズゲート with サバゲでGo! Demo
DEMØNS GATE & Paintball Ops - Shared Mana ×3 Boost
DEMØNS GATE & Paintball Ops - NPC Growth + 2x Stat Boost
DEMØNS GATE & Paintball Ops - Premium: Unlimited Character Creation

5178010.name: 无尽战斗：放置与构筑
5178010.desc: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

5318250.name: 謀定三國：卡牌單機版
5318250.desc: 《謀定三國：卡牌單機版》是一款以三國時代為背景的卡牌構築對戰遊戲。玩家將執掌一方勢力， 透過調遣 300 名武將，招募 100+ 位軍師，靈活使用各種策略，洞察敵方兵種與戰役特色， 構築出數十種陣型中最合宜的一副，攜君主之威出戰沙場——以陣型為骨，以戰力與威勢 兩條軸為血，落進七段結算的正確順序，一戰打出最盛的一筆戰功。 三分天下，請君執牌入場。

5502460.name: Doomfield:The Maze
5502460.desc: Doomfield: The Maze is a single-player horror minigame where you explore a cornfield maze to find your missing dog while evading two deadly virus entities. Venture off the main path to discover hidden areas where the digital memory grows increasingly distorted.

4706390.name: Adventures Online
4706390.desc: Tactical hex-grid fantasy RPG meets persistent multiplayer world. Six races, six classes, deep crafting, real-time exploration with shared or solo player shards. Free to play, free forever. No pay-to-win, ever.

5302700.name: Sort and Stack!
5302700.desc: Turn an overflowing card market into your personal empire! Tear through cards, unlock powerful cutters, unleash five tiers of explosive booster packs, build your skill network, manipulate market prices, and grow stronger with every Prestige.

5466100.name: Hunter Bro VR
5466100.desc: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Use a rifle, play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt or set the woods on fire with your flamethrower

5282510.name: Shadow Realms RPG
5282510.desc: A free dark-fantasy idle RPG that keeps fighting in a strip above your taskbar while you work. One persistent world on Steam, web and Android with a single account: loot, world bosses, the endless Eternal, clan wars. No energy walls. Power is never for sale.

3857370.name: Theriothron Spire
3857370.desc: A young boy ventures into the twisted Tower of the Beast God to save his sister from sacrificial ritual. This adventure RPG blends deep storytelling with classic tactical combat – your choices will forge the final outcome.

4175050.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
4175050.desc: 正經歷人生低潮的伊森，決定獨自前往 Pinebark 森林露營。他只想暫時遠離一切，找到一點安靜。他沒想到，在 Pinebark，連寂靜也在側耳傾聽。

4578590.name: BagoLand
4578590.desc: Bagoland is a unique community sandbox in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and roam the world.

4118070.name: A.C.H.E.S.
4118070.desc: Click, shop and minigame your way to the top. Collect clicks in order to ቻቹቹጋ ፱ነ buy upgrades, unlock collectables and get even more ጋቹረጎርጎዐ፱ነ clicks. Test your skills in a variety of mini games. Discover the story between the cracks. Do you have what it takes to prepare for the Grand Ascension?

5020540.name: Tanto
5020540.desc: 你受困於彷彿無窮無盡的房間。每走一步、每穿過一扇門，迎接你的都是與上一間幾乎相同的房間。忽然，輕微的腳步聲傳來，你意識到：這裡不只有你。解開謎題，活著找到出口。

5465790.name: Gold Idle
5465790.desc: Start with a single coin. Flip, upgrade, and automate your way to a fortune in an incremental game where flips determine power.

4562770.name: Cosmo Piercers
4562770.desc: A vertical scrolling shooter where you fire your main shot and strategically switch between limited ammo special weapons to take down enemies. Earn bonus points by clearing areas, and defeat as many enemies as possible before the game ends to achieve a high score.

5348940.name: Exo7
5348940.desc: Build your interstellar empire in Exo7! Colonize new worlds, extract Metal, Silicium, Tridioxid, and Antimatter, build mighty fleets, and explore hyperspace. Choose your faction, conquer raids and bounty hunts, and dominate Sector 7!

2742720.name: After the Wane
2742720.desc: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

3116230.name: Abashed
3116230.desc: Abashed lets you step into the troubled mind of Issac, as the fragments of his past flash before his eyes. Solve puzzles, meet mysterious characters, and alter reality as he faces his worst fears to uncover the truth behind his missing partner, or so he thought.

4995460.name: Tiny Chef
4995460.desc: A co-op restaurant management sim for 1-4 players. Chop, fry and plate orders against a ticking clock, then spend the takings between shifts on new appliances, conveyor automation, knocked-down walls and a second restaurant across town.

5547370.name: 文明融合
5547370.desc: A history-driven merge puzzler. Water meets fire and becomes steam; steam pushes the first machine — 223 elements, 10 Chinese dynasties, 74 levels, from a Stone Age campfire to a Qing-era firearms workshop. Every invention cites a real source.

movies.name: 文明融合 官方预告片

5450860.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
5450860.desc: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

2384980.name: Cafe Simulator
2384980.desc: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.

5285190.name: That's My Life
5285190.desc: Build one life across an entire connected world. Choose from hundreds of careers, run businesses from raw materials to retail, invest, own property, raise a family, enter politics or crime, and deal with active NPCs and lasting consequences.

movies.name: That's My Life – Official Gameplay Trailer

976900.name: Lumberhill
976900.desc: 一款瘋狂的多人派對伐木工遊戲，每人皆須各司其職，而大自然也會百般阻撓。穿梭各個世界和時空時，必須與時間賽跑、完成任務、撲滅野火、擊退海盜還有令人抓狂的猴群。可遊玩合作、對決及單人模式！

1153410.name: JDM: 漂移大師
1153410.desc: 在《JDM：飄移大師》中體驗日本傳奇車文化！駕駛官方授權的 JDM 車款挑戰蜿蜒山道、造訪日本各大知名漂移勝地，透過手繪漫畫頁沉浸於關於「第二次機會」的故事。在開放世界中探索，並在每一個彎道中掌握漂移的藝術。

movies.name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master | Multiplayer Launch
JDM: Japanese Drift Master | Release Trailer

865680.name: The Eternal Cylinder
865680.desc: 你將控制一群稱為「Trebhum」的可愛生物，帶領牠們探索充滿異星生物與超現實環境的外星世界。探索數十種突變與進化前往新區域，破解謎題，在危險的世界中生存下去。

914750.name: Bee Simulator
914750.desc: 體驗蜜蜂的生活！探索洋溢著生命之樂的世界，在這裡收集花粉，對抗危險的黃蜂，並拯救你的蜂巢。在三種遊戲模式中與其他人一起玩，包括合作模式並以分割畫面進行玩家對戰。

1266840.name: The Last Stand: Aftermath
1266840.desc: From the creators of The Last Stand: Union City and Dead Zone comes an all-new singleplayer rogue-lite action adventure. After you become infected by the zombie virus, you set out to explore the post-apocalypse and find hope for your fellow survivors. You can still make a difference. Don't give up.

movies.name: The Last Stand: Aftermath Launch Day Trailer
The Last Stand: Aftermath Release Date Reveal Trailer

2009527.name: Train Simulator: Taurus Mountains: Ulukışla – Yenice Route Add-On
2009527.desc: Explore the thrills of a new territory as Turkey makes its debut in Train Simulator Classic, with AND Model’s breathtakingly scenic Taurus Mountains route!

1781000.name: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 青春魅力套裝
1781000.desc: 《光明記憶：無限》DLC - 青春魅力套裝

5421960.name: The Friendly Monster
5421960.desc: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

5247600.name: YourTenderCatgirl
5247600.desc: A cat-girl Live2D desktop pet featuring Sora and Rin. Drag, lock, and scale; mouse gaze tracking; blink, breath, ear twitch, and physics. Switch expressions and motions manually or automatically. Supports Live2D import and Steam Workshop.

5388200.name: 球球幸存者 · Ball Survivor
5388200.desc: A 2D survivor action game. Players choose hidden heroes such as Little Mage and Wave Swordsman to survive and strengthen their skills in the constantly surging tide of enemies, challenge their limits - and fully enjoy the decompression and dopamine pleasure brought by bullet screen monster clearing.

2692520.name: Project BLACKNODE
2692520.desc: Drift through asteroid fields, build your ship, and risk one more encounter. BLACKNODE is a space roguelite with two modes: explore and extract with recovered parts, or survive a Endless arena and chase the leaderboard scores.

4484970.name: Wallpaper Animator
4484970.desc: 在桌面上使用動態桌布。無限探索社群中的動態桌布，或使用隨應用程式附帶、每天補充的 AI 生成額度創作屬於你自己的作品。

5081980.name: HEXFORGE
5081980.desc: Command a hex arena where your weapons fire themselves, but the build is yours. Mark targets, drop abilities, vent the heat. Between rounds, crack capsules, merge mods and rewire a 13-socket grid. Six zones, one long run, and a machine that slowly starts playing itself.

4802670.name: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure
4802670.desc: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.

movies.name: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure - Official Trailer

5285650.name: Warstead
5285650.desc: Warstead融合了聚落建設、資源管理及戰術即時戰鬥。建造、貿易，並指揮你的部隊。遊戲仍在持續開發中，尚未完成。 多人模式：可加入現有遊戲；建立遊戲需獲得特別權限。

5405940.name: Rosaline: The Dragon Girl
5405940.desc: Awakening from a deadly clash with a dragon, Rosaline gains terrifying powers. Set off on an epic journey through the kingdom of Artolia, slay fearsome monsters alongside allies, and confront the corrupt shadow threatening her homeland.

5510580.name: Bottle King
5510580.desc: From collecting bottles in the city park to founding the Cosmic Deposit Council: gather empties, hire helpers and grow a recycling empire that stretches from a small town to the edge of the universe. A relaxed pixel-art idle game that keeps running on the side.

5491440.name: FINAL COUNT
5491440.desc: Clock in for inventory week and scan every box before 6:00 AM. Explore a foggy shipping yard through a store-issued phone, manage its battery, follow radio instructions, and survive five increasingly impossible night shifts.

5011760.name: CHUM Fishing
5011760.desc: 《CHUM Fishing》是一款合作多人恐怖釣魚遊戲。身為這片恐怖海域的外星飼養員，你和朋友必須釣到足夠重量的怪魚，餵飽藏在水下的未知存在。但祂的胃口一天比一天大，到最後，或許你們才是真正的……魚餌？！

4989970.name: Pot O' Gnomes
4989970.desc: Pot o' Gnomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

4951770.name: Door Code
4951770.desc: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.

5403440.name: 奥术棋域
5403440.desc: A free online 1v1 tactics game combining chess-inspired movement with deckbuilding. Build a 24-card deck, move your pieces, and use cards to outmaneuver your opponent. Contest river chests, adapt to spreading danger zones, and defeat the enemy commander. All battle cards are unlocked.

movies.name: 奥术棋域｜实机玩法宣传片

5440720.name: Her Next Chapter
5440720.desc: A cozy sticker game about finding your place after graduation. Arrange little objects to build street corners, a rented room, and a dream garden full of cats. Follow a young woman's next chapter, one sticker and one small kindness at a time.

5456790.name: Livingston County
5456790.desc: The dead fill the streets of Howell, Michigan. Search houses for food, haul supplies home, and board up before dark. Build a base and keep people alive in an isometric zombie survival sandbox.

4632250.name: Lastrip
4632250.desc: A girl and a vampire travel through a frozen world in this post-apocalyptic yuri visual novel. Read from Mei's perspective as she heads toward Huangshan, meets other survivors, and grows closer to the stranger who offered her a hand in the snow.

3175580.name: Water Maid
3175580.desc: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

5043330.name: Snake Echos
5043330.desc: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

5492180.name: Grand Space Game
5492180.desc: A whacky physics action game about space! In Grand Space Game, take control of a problematic planet that has attracted the attention of many across the cosmos. Smash your way through the galaxy and form objects from the dust for more chaos. Take what you earned and build a new galaxy in your image.
